store_data.about_the_game:
REBROOD is a top-down survival roguelite set in a cute fantasy world.

You are the mother queen — the last hope of your kind. Command your loyal brood

of grublings, defend your nest, and push back the endless darkness.

KEY FEATURES

Survive the Waves

Face relentless waves of enemies. Every run tests your reflexes, your build,

and your strategy. One life. One chance. How long can you last?

Raise Your Brood

Grow and evolve your adorable grublings. Each choice shapes your army —

customize their abilities to create a unique swarm every run.

Roguelite Progression

Procedurally generated runs, powerful upgrades, and game-changing modifiers.

No two runs are ever the same.

Cute, but Dark

A charming world hiding a creeping darkness. Beautiful pixel art meets

an atmospheric, emotional story about a mother's love.

Play as the Queen

Lead from the front. Protect your brood, unlock new powers, and uncover

what lurks in the shadows of the forest.

Can you keep the darkness at bay?

store_data.about_the_game:
Rex buried your homework.

Your mum left for work, the dog is covered in dirt, and the homework is somewhere down there. Grab a pickaxe and start digging.

The loop

Dig, fill your bag, sell at the house, buy better gear, dig deeper. 19 ores are layered under your backyard, and when digging gets slow you prestige: the world reseeds, your gold and gear are gone, and you spend the points on permanent talents that make every later run faster. A few runs in you have a double jump, a jetpack and a mining laser.

It gets strange down there

The underground holds things the shop does not sell. Caves sealed from the inside. Buried things older than the house you live in. Keys that open portals to other dimensions. A neighbour who pays for odd jobs in junk, and the junk keeps turning out to be the best gear in the game.

At 5,000 metres

The ground changes and your pickaxe stops working. There is a way through.

Good to know

  • Nine languages: English, Deutsch, 简体中文, Русский, Español, Português (BR), 日本語, Français, Polski.

  • Five save slots.

  • No offline progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
PartyScape Chronicles is a free idle RPG about the long haul. Pick something worth training, and your character keeps at it - while the tab is closed, while you are at work, while you sleep.

Twenty skills, and none of them are a progress bar with a different colour. Woodcutting, Mining, Smithing, Fishing, Cooking, Fletching, Thieving, Crafting, Farming, Runecrafting, Enchanting, Tailoring, Herblore, Prayer, Slayer and the full combat set all feed each other. Chop magic logs to fletch the bow you take to a boss. Farm the herbs for the potions that keep you alive. Nothing is grind for grind's sake.

A WORLD THAT IS ACTUALLY SHARED

Every player is in the same world, on the same server, right now. Prices in the Auction House are set by the people playing, not by a table in a config file. Form a party and take on raid bosses together. Duel someone in the arena. Watch a world boss appear and pile in with everyone else online.

FIGHT SOMETHING THAT FIGHTS BACK

Combat is server-authoritative and honest: melee, ranged and magic each have their own gear and their own maths. Forty-nine monsters, from a goblin outside town to bosses that will end a badly prepared run. Slayer tasks send you after specific targets and pay you for the trouble.

BUILT FOR PICKING UP AND PUTTING DOWN

It runs in a browser and on your phone, one account across both - start something on the bus, check it at your desk. There is no energy meter nagging you and nothing expires because you took a week off.

FREE, AND NOT SECRETLY A SHOP

No pay-to-win. No stat boosts for sale, no loot boxes, no ads between actions. Every item in the game is earned by playing it.

WHAT IS IN THERE

20 skills to 99, with mastery beyond that

400+ items, 200+ recipes

49 monsters, world bosses, party raids and a duel arena

A player-run Auction House

Farming, expeditions, quests, achievements and a collection log

Global, trade and party chat, with an active community

The game is in active development and updates land most weeks, usually from something a player asked for in chat.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reclaim your birthright

Once a powerful King, you lost your crown on a deceitful game of cards. Now, you have to trick and outsmart your way through the lowest scum in all the lands in order to reclaim your throne; whether you face guards, thieves or even monsters that surpass humanity, all are just obstacles in your resurgence to power.



Explore the shadiest corners in the Kingdom

From the deep, rotten sewers, all the way through the god forgotten prison and up onto the unrelenting Royal Fortress, you will get to know the dark underworld of what you once used to rule.

Four suits, a myriad of play styles

Inspired by the Spanish deck of cards, each suit brings a specific tool to your battles,such as healing, dealing damage and protecting yourself; mixing & matching the right cards will be the key to your victory over your enemies.


There is no honor amongst the lawless

You and your cards are not alone in this journey; you have at your disposition many tools and gadgets to outmaneuver your foes: Look at their hand, invalidate their moves or even steal their cards. Any and all means are valid as long as you are winning.

⚠️ Photosensitivity Warning ⚠️

This game contains flashing lights, high-contrast strobing, and rapidly changing visual patterns that may cause seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. A photosensitivity warning is also displayed in-game before play begins.



Konbini Shift is an arcade puzzler about working the register at a Tokyo convenience store overnight.

Orders pile up. Customers get impatient. Your stock keeps moving. Serve the right snacks, hit your targets, and try not to lose the night's takings.

Enable SPEEDRUNNER in Settings if you want to chase your best time.

WORK THE REGISTER


Orders tell you what to sell and how many. Find matching snacks on the shelf, drag across them, and serve the order. The shelf shifts as you work, so nothing stays where you left it.

Make too many mistakes and you lose the points you've been building up. Keep the shift clean and you'll earn bonuses, while the pressure gets higher with every successful night. VIP customers pay more, but they don't wait around.

SPEND YOUR EARNINGS




Spend your yen on abilities that help you survive the shift: throw away a tile, reduce an order, move a snack, or earn more from a customer.

Between shifts, decide whether to take your money home or risk it in OVERTIME.

The longer you stay, the harder it gets, and the more you stand to make.

MAKE THE SHELF YOURS




Sato, your shift manager, gives you a new goal every night.

Hit your target and you'll unlock the stock room, where you can bring new snacks into the shop and retire ones that aren't pulling their weight.

Build your shelf over time from more than a hundred different items.

Sato: "Miss the goal and you get nothing."

THE KITCHEN >> FULL GAME


The demo takes place on the shop floor. The full game opens up the kitchen.

In the kitchen you'll merge ingredients, unlock machines, and make food that eventually finds its way onto your shelf.

The shop pays for the kitchen. The kitchen changes the shop.

And Sato has his own reasons for asking you to make things. 

IN THE DEMO


The complete shop-floor loop, nightly goals, the stock room, break room abilities, OVERTIME, and records to chase.

The Kitchen is waiting in the full game!

store_data.about_the_game:
What is this game?

Command a squad of hard-working dudes, tunnel through different biomes and layers, collect rare ores and gemstones, equip powerful pickaxes, and descend into the depths!

Early Access notice:

During the Early Access (EA) period profiles may become unstable and unusable, please have patience and provide any feedback you may have, it is always welcome and might be implemented if it fits the theme of the game.

How to Play & Basic Controls

  • Toggle Dig Mode (D): Click or drag over rock blocks to queue dig locations up to 3 tiles away.

  • Automated Mining: Dudes reach the orders to dig blocks, then return to the hut or workbenches for stamina and depositing ores.

  • Expand & Upgrade: Spend earnings on Upgrades, allocate Dude Skill Points (SP), equip high-tier Pickaxes, build Ladders (L), and place Torches (T).

Roadmap direction:

  • Steam achievements integration - first priority before launch!

  • Bombs

  • Mini biomes - obsidian boulders, geode caves

  • Ascension skill tree expansion and balance

  • Lava layer, ores, mechanics

  • Localization - in progress!

  • Events - partly done, needs testing!

  • World modifiers - partly done, needs testing!

  • More optimization for large and busy worlds - done!

  • Frozen biome, ore - done!

  • Cave plants; light and buffs - done!

  • Deep Stone layer, ore variants - done!

  • Animations updated - done!

store_data.about_the_game:
SNOP - Snowboarding Slop

Think you can snowboard? Prove it.

SNOP is a brutally unforgiving physics-based snowboarding challenge inspired by games like QWOP, where every movement matters and every mistake can send you crashing down the mountain.

You don't control a snowboarder — you control the struggle. Each joystick controls a different heel:

  • Left joystick = left heel

  • Right joystick = right heel

Your goal is simple: make it down the course. Actually doing it is the hard part.

Expect awkward movements, ridiculous crashes, and mechanics designed to test your patience. SNOP isn't about smooth tricks or effortless runs — it's about mastering an intentionally difficult control system and overcoming the chaos.

Can you conquer the mountain?

A $200 prize is available for the first person to complete the challenge. Full rules, requirements, and details are available on the DeckTronic web page.

Good luck. You'll need it.

store_data.about_the_game:
A first-person movement game with faithfully recreated 2000s-era jump physics. No enemies, no story - just maps, your movement and a timer.

Movement

Air-strafe, bounce, and rocket-jump. The physics are recreated from the ground up to match the originals exactly — every jump, bounce, and speed gain works the way veterans remember.

Runs

Every finished run is timed and ranked. Leaderboards track your time, rockets used, and saves/loads per run. Categories are earned, not picked: no speedometer is Hardcore, with it is Normal. Off-rate physics or exploit tricks tag your entry instead of disqualifying it. Maps can have multiple routes, each with its own board.

Practice

Save and load your position to drill individual jumps. Practice mode lets you fly the route freely without affecting your run. Every keybind, HUD element, and physics rate is rebindable and movable.

Planned

More movement disciplines — surf, bhop, climb — built on the same physics-first approach.

Practice

Save and load your position to drill individual jumps. Practice mode lets you fly the route freely without affecting your run. Every keybind, HUD element, and physics rate is rebindable and movable.

Planned

More movement disciplines — surf, bhop, climb — built on the same physics-first approach.
store_data.short_description: A precision first-person movement game. Air-strafe, bounce, and rocket-jump through hand-crafted jump maps with faithfully recreated 2000s-era physics, and chase records on leaderboards that track every route, category, and discipline.

5043510.name: I Keep Reincarnating as a Rat in the Mad Scientist’s Maze

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the cage. You are Subject №... honestly, who cares?

I Keep Reincarnating as a Rat in the Mad Scientist’s Maze is an atmospheric adventure game where death isn't a game over—it’s just the start of another meaningless loop. You wake up as a rat in the dead center of a massive, cold, unforgiving labyrinth. There are no tutorials, no pity, and most likely, no point to any of this.

Death is Your Only Constant

Danger lurks around every single corner. Some traps are glaringly obvious. Others will crush your tiny furry body before you even realize you stepped on the trigger. In this place, everything is lethal: a wrong turn, a sudden noise, or a split-second of hesitation. But when darkness takes you, your eyes snap open right back at the starting line. The only difference? The number stamped on your back just went up by one. Time to run again.

A Graveyard of Your Own Making

The deeper you crawl, the more bodies you’ll stumble upon. These aren't strangers. They are your own past incarnations. Each cold, stiff rat corpse with a lower number on its back serves as a silent monument to your wasted lives and stupid mistakes. They won’t help you find a way out. They just sit there, mocking you, proving that you’ve already died here. And you will die here again.

No Answers. No Hope.

Don't look for hidden lore, deep philosophy, or cosmic explanations as to why the Mad Scientist built this place. Maybe he just forgot to clean the cage. The maze doesn't care about you, and this game doesn't promise a happy ending. Who’s to say an exit even exists? And even if it does… what changes for a rat that knows nothing but dying and starting over?

Features

  • Pure, Unadulterated Hopelessness: Experience a bleak, nihilistic atmosphere where your best efforts guarantee absolutely nothing.

  • The Necropolis of Your Failures: Stumble upon the corpses of your previous runs—the only permanent decoration in this shifting hell.

  • Brutal, Unforgiving Traps: Navigate a mechanical meat-grinder that ruthlessly punishes even a second of hesitation.

  • Low-Profile Survival: Avoid hazards, blend into the shadows, and keep moving forward. Mostly because there is no going back.

  • Zero False Promises: A game that doesn't feed you hope, refuses to give answers, and honestly tells you: this might all be for nothing.

Please note: All locations, visuals, and gameplay mechanics shown on this page are early prototypes. The game is actively in development, and many elements will be tweaked, overhauled, and polished along the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dreadnaught has been granted the Holiest of Tasks: destroy everything in his path until all he sees is in ruins.

However, upon finding a damaged robot named Miss Sunshine…something within him snaps.

And now only one who may be safe is Miss Sunshine.

[ HAVE FUN 🎈 ]

—[ From the two-person team behind Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel ]—

[ YOU HAVE BEEN GRANTED THE HOLIEST OF TASKS ]

You are DREADNAUGHT, a hulking monstrosity meant to break whatever he gets his hands on. 

No one will stand in your way. 

[No one can.]

Explore the vast labyrinth of THE PLAYGROUND, a sprawling megastructure of party-themed architecture.

Climb, jump, and bum-rush your way through its halls. You’re the monster here!

[ YOU ARE AN INTERLOPER ]

Not everyone who thrives in The Playground will be accepting of Dreadnaught’s presence…as if that will stop him!

[ WHY ARE YOU HERE? ]

Dreadnaught is as tight-lipped as he can be without any actual lips, and the only person he seems to like is Miss Sunshine, a damaged robot,,,,maybe she can peel back his layers a bit?

[ RAZE THIS HELL ]

Throw, stomp, and punch your way through literally thousands of enemies as a one-man army.

--

Demo 1.10 Notes [8/20/26]:

This is our second game, and we hope everyone enjoys it! This demo doesn't have a definitive "end," and it will be something I'll try updating and polishing over time. Things like dialogue, cinematics, and characters will receive different art down the line. But for now, this is a glimpse of how the game will play!

-We don't have a definitive release date; we're trying not to rush it lmao hopefully we'll have one some time later on!

-Don’t hesitate to let me know if you experience issues or have any ideas you think would be cool to implement! While this game is heavily story-based, I would love to hear what anyone thinks for combat or other things! If you’d rather not comment on the page, just contact us on social media or at mudagames3891@gmail.com!

--

[ No AI was used and never will be used by us. ]

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your gear. Climb the circuit. Claim the crown.

DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

Assemble your DriveGear

Every machine is built from four interchangeable components: Core, Chassis, Axle, and Bearing. Change the way you accelerate, collide, defend, and deploy special abilities by rebuilding between encounters. Build for attack, defense, or stamina, or find that killer combination of parts across three specialized part lines.

Control Every Clash

Dash attack an open opponent, guard through pressure, and utilize build dependent special moves and abilities.  Find the right timing and openings to defeat difficult opponents or finish in style.

Route Under Pressure

Scout branching paths across each district. Contracts, vendors, events, and fights all compete for limited time. A risky detour can secure a badge, reveal a stronger part, or leave you scrambling to reach the qualifier.

Customize Your Gear

Reshape your gear as you move across the districts. Claim gear spoils from defeated rivals. Buy parts, upgrades, and badges at vendors.  Complete contracts to earn credits for vital new parts.  Every encounter is an opportunity to push your build even further.

Claim the Crown

Every district brings it's own local flair, changing the opposition and the arena around you. Route through the new environments, adapt to the rivals, and make them remember your name.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Fresh Take on a Classic Puzzle

Sudoku Mania brings the timeless logic of Sudoku into a relaxing, nature-filled world. Solve puzzles at your own pace, challenge yourself against the clock, or explore new variations that build on the classic Sudoku formula.

Choose How You Play

  • Classic Sudoku — Play across Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulties.

  • Speed Mode — Put your solving skills to the test against the clock.

  • Sudoku+ — Take on larger, multi-board challenges with additional objectives and rewards.

Complete Challenges and Earn Rewards

Every puzzle is another opportunity to make progress. Complete levels, meet optional challenge requirements, and earn rewards that can help you during future games. Use boosts when you need assistance, or challenge yourself to finish puzzles without errors or extra help.

Make the Game Your Own

Unlock new ways to personalize your experience as you play. Customize your game with different:

  • Backgrounds

  • Board color themes

  • Number styles

  • Button designs 

Mix and match your unlocked items to create a Sudoku board that feels like your own.

Features

  • A large collection of handcrafted Sudoku puzzles

  • Four classic difficulty levels

  • Speed-based gameplay

  • Multi-board Sudoku+ puzzles

  • Optional challenges and gameplay boosts

  • Unlockable visual customization

  • Progress and statistics tracking

  • A relaxing, nature-inspired presentation

Whether you are learning Sudoku, looking for a peaceful puzzle to unwind with, or searching for a more demanding challenge, Sudoku Mania gives you a new way to enjoy every number.

store_data.about_the_game:
Time is Running Out, The Conveyor Never Stops

You have a very clear and simple ultimate goal: pack 10,000 toys correctly and send them down the conveyor belt. But the pressure on you is immense. There are only 4 days left until Christmas, and this countdown operates entirely in real-time. As the seconds tick away, the belt never slows down.

Evolve, Accelerate, and Meet the Demand

At first, everything might seem like an ordinary packaging job. However, as you successfully ship boxes, brand-new toys will be unlocked, and the packaging processes will change. To survive the increasing workload, you must strategically use special skills that make your job easier and significantly boost your speed.

Just Do Your Job... And Don't Ask Questions

Our only goal is to get all the boxes ready by Christmas. However, while working, be careful not to get too curious about the strange events unfolding around you. This is no ordinary workshop. Do your job on time, keep your head down, and no matter what, do not anger Santa. Remember, things rarely end well for interns who ask too many questions.

FEATURES

  • A Massive Goal: Achieve your ultimate objective by flawlessly packing and shipping 10,000 toys down the conveyor belt.

  • Real Time Pressure: The 4-day countdown to Christmas runs in real-time; feel the crushing weight of time down to your bones.

  • Dynamic Progression: As you succeed, discover new toy types and unlock new skills to optimize your workflow.

  • Mystery and Tension: Don't cross the line while doing your job, avoid being overly curious, and try to survive Santa's wrath.

store_data.about_the_game:
The center of every duel is a shared mana line. Spending mana moves momentum across the field. Commit too much and your turn may end with resources waiting for your opponent. Hold back, recover mana through your cards, or push through the Battle Phase and pass the remaining momentum across the table. Every decision changes both sides of the next turn.

A Shared Resource Changes Every Play

Mana moves between players instead of resetting independently.

  •  Paying a cost pushes mana toward your opponent.

  •  Crossing below zero ends your turn after effects resolve.

  •  Mana left after the Battle Phase passes to the next player as overflow.

  •  Enhancements can shape the field and later be Dispelled to recover their printed mana cost.

  •  A large hand can be returned to the bottom of the deck during the Draw Phase to gain additional mana.

The strongest play is not always the biggest card you can afford. You must also decide how much momentum you are willing to hand over.

Build Across Universes

Explore card pools with different identities, artwork, and tactical goals:

  • Dark Reincarnations: swift Loners and students that turn specific monsters into powerful Immaterial summons.

  • Psycho Relics: futuristic machines, strange relics, and disruptive resource loops.

  • Celestial Stall: defensive angels built to survive pressure and control the pace of a duel.

  • The Giant Hand: immense threats that trade flexibility for overwhelming presence.

  • Small Beastfolk: compact creatures that recycle resources and build advantage through repeated movement.

Search your collection, inspect every card, and organize a legal deck around the worlds and mechanics you want to master.

Play Your Way

Campaign

Challenge scripted opponents across persistent campaign chapters. Adapt your deck to each encounter, learn how a Universe fights, and earn lasting rewards for your collection.

Collection and Deck Building

Open packs, browse your cards, create decks, and customize your profile and battle presentation with fields, sleeves, deck boxes, coins, avatars, and wallpapers.

Player Versus Player

Prepare for casual matchmaking, ranked seasons, private rooms, 2v2 and four-player battles. Competitive systems are being developed around visible results, maintained card statistics, and regular card-pool review.

Open packs, browse your cards, create decks, and customize your profile and battle presentation with fields, sleeves, deck boxes, coins, avatars, and wallpapers.

Prepare for casual matchmaking, ranked seasons, private rooms, 2v2 and four-player battles. Competitive systems are being developed around visible results, maintained card statistics, and regular card-pool review.

store_data.about_the_game:
Declare is a fast-paced card game designed for 2 players, utilizing a standard 52-card deck. Using strategy, probability, and deception, the goal of the game is to have the computer have the highest amount of points before you receive more than or equal to 100 points.

  • Bluff, Count, and Declare — Track your opponent's hand, weigh the odds, and decide the exact moment to call declare before they beat you to it

  • High-Stakes Push-Your-Luck Scoring — Get greedy and misjudge your declare, and you'll eat the penalty — bad reads can cost you the whole game

  • Smart AI Opponent — Play against a computer that reacts to the discard pile, your visible plays, and its own hand value to make calculated moves

  • Multiple Game Modes — Different modifiers change the rules just enough to keep every session feeling different

  • Persistent High Scores & Stats — Track your performance across sessions and chase your best run, synced automatically through Steam Cloud so your progress follows you across devices

  • Handcrafted Pixel Art & Sound — Original pixel art, from a mandala-adorned background to face cards reimagined as Indian royalty, paired with an Indian-fusion jazz soundtrack built for a cozy but tense card-table feel

  • Cross-Platform — Play on Windows or macOS with smooth, responsive controls built for mouse-only gameplay

Goal of the Game

The goal of the game is to have the computer have the highest amount of points before you receive more than or equal to 100 points. To achieve this, you have to have the least number of points in your hand when a player declares each round. If you receive more than or equal to 100 points across any number of rounds, the game is over and the computer’s total score will be your score for that game. A game is played until you receive more than or equal to 100 points.

Contents and Setup

The game is played with a standard deck of 52 cards. Points are scored by the rank associated with a card. Cards with rank 2-10 have points equal to their rank. Face cards (J, Q, K) are all equal to 10 points. Aces are equal to 1 point. The game starts with each player being dealt 5 cards from the deck. The rest of the deck is then placed face down between the players.

How to Play

To complete a turn, you must either click the DECLARE button to end the round or by dropping cards from your hand. You should click the DECLARE button when you think you have the least number of points in your hand compared to the computer. You must drop a single card or multiple cards of the same rank on each of your turns (unless you declare). To select the card(s) you want to drop, you can simply click on them and they will start to hover. After selecting what cards you want to drop, you must either click on the deck to draw a card or the discard pile to pickup the top card. All dropped cards will be put into the discard pile face up. Different game modes will have modifiers that change some of the rules of the game slightly, but the core gameplay remains the same in all game modes.

Scoring

When a player declares, the value of all of their cards are added up to get their total. Totals are then compared between players. If the declaring player has the lowest total, they receive 0 points and the opposing player receives their total as points. However, if the opposing player has a lower total compared to the declaring player, then the declaring player’s attempt is broken. The opposing player receives -10 points and the declaring player receives the total points of both players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stumbling into a cult infested mining facility, try to escape the unimaginable horrors found below as a routine inspection takes a dark turn. Discover what the cult has found in the depths, miles under the surface something stalks the shadows. The game will progress over a five chapter experience.

To progress throughout the world players must scavenge for different items to repair machinery, re-rout power to open doors and enable lights, hide from patrolling enemies making sure not get get spotted. The gameplay is built to be linear with occasional optional areas for exploration and supplies to aid the player, mainly pertaining to health and stamina.

    You play as a Stunridge Mining co. facility inspector. Rumors of disappearances and tensions arise as the output of wax, the main power and constructing material in this world takes a steep decline. Discovering the lack of employs you go deeper into the facility discovering the horrors that hide below. Each step weighs with regret as you plunge into the void. Will you survive or end up like the countless others? 

    Enjoy a completely hand drawn world filed with color and atmosphere. Solve simple puzzles, find records to play around the world, uncover secrets, and avoid becoming the next sacrifice. Dr. Montana leads a dangerous and loyal cult taking on the appearance of the crow. They are the least of your concerns.

store_data.about_the_game:
Scarryland: The Potion Goes Wrong!

This game is currently in development. Screenshots, trailer, and other assets will be updated as new content is finished

Long ago, a king named Chudlingpong ruled over a small island. He named the island after himself, Chudling Land. The king had a strange business. He sold his own pee as a blessing drink called Kepsy, and somehow everyone on the island loved it and drank it every day.

One day a tea seller named Demojee arrived on the island and started selling tea. The islanders tried it for the first time and fell in love with it. Slowly everyone stopped drinking Kepsy and started drinking tea instead. The king began to worry. Nobody was buying his blessing drink anymore. His servants told him a new drink had arrived and the whole island was obsessed with it.

The king called Demojee to the palace. He made him an offer. If the king tried the tea and liked it, Demojee would get permission to sell tea across the island. If he didn't like it, Demojee would have to leave forever. Demojee agreed. The king drank the tea and was amazed by the taste. Instead of just giving permission, he appointed Demojee as his personal tea maker.

Weeks later, a magician who had always dreamed of becoming king approached Demojee, but he never revealed his real plan. He told Demojee he had a magic powder. If Demojee mixed it into the king's tea, the king would become hypnotized and hand over the entire kingdom. Demojee, blinded by greed and his own dream of becoming king, agreed. He mixed the powder into the tea and served it to the king. The king drank it, fell under the spell, and gave away his kingdom on the spot. King Chudlingpong disappeared from the island, as if he had never existed.

What the magician never told Demojee was that this was part of an old rule. Whoever became king through the spell could only rule for sixty nine days. If he failed to pass the crown to someone else before those days ended, he would die.

Demojee became king, but he never planned to give the kingdom back to the magician. Instead, when his time was running out, he handed the crown to a streamer named ScarryMichan. Because island law says the land must take on the name of its ruler, the island was renamed ScarryLand.

The magician was furious. His plan had failed and someone else sat on the throne. In his rage, he cursed the entire island with dark magic.

You are Dimkalu, once a man who sold black colored eggs for a living, now appointed as the island's zoo caretaker by King ScarryMichan himself. Your family is a strange one. You have two grandfathers and a grandmother who rides a motorcycle everywhere she goes. Your first grandfather is the island's garbage collector. Your current grandfather is a scientist who has spent years chasing one dream, turning animals into humans.

He wanted to test his new potion on the zoo animals. You refused to let him and walked away to relax with a cup of Kepsy instead. But he tested it anyway while you were gone. The potion failed. The animals did not turn human. They simply started acting like humans, and in the chaos they broke through the zoo's gates. Almost every animal escaped into the island.

Panicked by what he had done, your grandfather ran from the zoo toward his lab. Right beside the lab sat the island's water supply tank. In his panic he threw out the barrel holding the leftover potion, and it spilled straight into the tank, mixing with the island's water. Everyone who drank that water that night began to change. Instead of animals becoming human, the people of the island started turning into animals.

Your grandfather finally realized the size of the mistake he had made. The island fell into total chaos.

Now he needs your help. He needs the ingredients and the knowledge to craft a cure strong enough to undo what the potion has done. You are the only one who can save ScarryLand from this curse. Explore the island, solve its mysteries, and gather what you need for the cure, all while your skeleton companion Bonky tags along, calling you dad every step of the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Metal rusts. Flesh decays. But the Copper Heart heals all.

Descend into the depths of The Boilers, a vast and labyrinthine subterranean metropolis consumed by rust and maddened automatons. You are a wanderer on the verge of systemic failure, and your only hope of survival lies in locating a forgotten relic: The Copper Heart.

You are not alone in this descent. Traveling by your side is Mata, a brilliant medic-engineer who turns salvaged junk into your greatest arsenal. While you provide the brawn and steel, she keeps your pulse steady and upgrades your prosthetics with stolen technology.

An Inseparable Dynamic Duo

She is more than a companion. Your medic-engineer doesn’t just patch your wounds in combat—she modifies your abilities, analyzes boss weaknesses, and repairs ancient machinery to clear your path.

Classic Metroidvania Exploration

Unlock interconnected areas by combining cybernetic implants, precision tools, and high-octane mechanical maneuvers. Backtrack with new gear to discover hidden rooms and rare components.

A World of Brass and Steam

Immerse yourself in a haunting industrial world featuring atmospheric visuals and a soundtrack that blends rhythmic mechanical beats with melancholic melodies.

Every level is a grid with a few bombs counting down on it, and all you have to do is reach the door.

Nothing moves until you move, so, take your time!

You just read the timing and pick a path that doesn't leave you standing in a blast.

Later levels add walls, traps, keys and a few other things to deal with, but that's basically the whole game.

Easy to learn, and it gets mean.

store_data.about_the_game:
They sank her for a reason.

Your ship is gone. Your escape pod drifted the belt for days - until the scanner caught a faint reactor signature: the MSV Lodestar, a freighter scuttled by her own crew and left dark in the rocks.

You board her. Then you get to work.

  • Defend. Aim the main cannon yourself. Asteroids bounce off your shield — but every deflected rock is ore you'll never smelt.

  • Salvage. Tractor in the shards, refine ore to ingots, and spend them on the machine keeping you alive.

  • Rebuild. Every repair and upgrade appears on your ship: turret barrels sweep from under the hull, drones sortie from real cargo doors, the warp core assembles piece by piece.

  • Descend. Five Power Core tiers push you deeper — through magnetic storms, comet windfalls, swarm surges, pirates that rob your salvage, and the guardian that rules each sector.

  • Uncover. The Lodestar's crew left their logs behind. Each guardian you kill recovers one — and the deeper you go, the clearer the reason they sank her becomes.

  • Escape. Charge the warp drive while everything in the belt comes for you. Then go home.

One ship. Six sectors. One way out. No offline progress, no prestige treadmill - a complete 5-6 hour arc with an actual ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
Play Hearts. Break the rules. Expose the truth.

Court of Hearts: Masquerade Trials transforms classic Hearts into a Victorian gothic roguelike filled with powerful combinations, supernatural rule changes, masked witnesses, and courtroom deception.

Pass dangerous cards, create voids in your hand, force penalties onto your rivals, and decide whether to avoid the Queen of Spades or turn her into your greatest weapon. Build around Artifacts, enhanced cards, and scoring Tactics that reward clever passing, precise plays, and calculated risks.

The Early Access version includes complete Solo Runs, AI opponents, public matchmaking, private Steam friend lobbies, and private online co-op against AI. The Masquerade Trials story campaign is planned for version 1.0.

Build a Powerful Run

In Solo Run, survive increasingly dangerous Hearts rounds while assembling a build that changes how every hand is played.

Generate Power by sending penalty cards to your opponents. Create voids through strategic passing, trigger specialized Tactics, enhance individual cards, and combine Artifacts into powerful scoring chains.

Build around strategies such as:

  • Disposing of dangerous cards while void in a suit

  • Passing marked cards and tracking their recipients

  • Turning the Queen of Spades into a scoring weapon

  • Chaining precise plays into large Power bonuses

  • Protecting your limited Composure

  • Risking everything on a declared Moonshot

Visit shops between rounds, improve your Tactics, enhance important cards, restore Composure, and prepare for Elite encounters and Boss Rules that alter the foundations of Hearts.

Unlock 40+ Artifacts

Artifacts provide build-defining effects that change how you pass cards, create voids, generate Power, protect Composure, and interact with penalty cards.

Some strengthen passed cards, reward specialized Tactics, improve enhanced cards, or amplify the Queen of Spades. Others enable unusual combinations that can completely reshape your strategy.

Earn Profile XP through Solo Runs and multiplayer matches. Increase your Profile Level, open gameplay-earned Artifact Packs, and permanently unlock new Artifacts for future runs.

Artifact Packs are earned through play and provide no paid competitive advantage.

Play Hearts Your Way

Solo Run

Take on complete roguelite runs featuring shops, upgrades, Elite encounters, Boss Rules, limited Composure, and persistent progression.

Classic Hearts

Play traditional Hearts against AI opponents, enter public online matchmaking, or create a private lobby with Steam friends.

Court of Hearts

Play a rule-breaking version of Hearts featuring Artifacts, enhanced cards, Tactics, and gameplay modifiers that change how each match unfolds.

Compete through online matchmaking or create a private lobby with friends.

Private Online Co-op

Invite a Steam friend to a private lobby and work together against two AI opponents.

Masquerade Trials: Planned for Version 1.0

The Masquerade Trials story campaign is planned for version 1.0 and is not included in the initial Early Access release.

The full campaign will combine Hearts with a Victorian gothic mystery involving masked witnesses, evidence, testimony, supernatural rule changes, and courtroom deduction.

Use Trial Effects to uncover hidden details, preserve evidence, challenge suspicious testimony, and strengthen your case against each witness.

Early Access focuses on the complete Hearts roguelite, progression, AI, multiplayer, and private co-op modes described above.

Features

  • Tactical Hearts gameplay built around passing, void creation, penalty routing, and Shooting the Moon

  • Complete solo roguelite runs with shops, upgrades, Elite encounters, and Boss Rules

  • 40+ unlockable Artifacts with build-defining effects

  • Card Enhancements, Tactic upgrades, and powerful build combinations

  • Persistent Profile Levels and gameplay-earned Artifact Packs

  • Classic Hearts against AI or online players

  • Rule-breaking online multiplayer Hearts

  • Public matchmaking and private Steam friend lobbies

  • Private online co-op against AI opponents

  • Steam friend invitations

  • Achievements, statistics, leaderboards, and Steam Cloud support

  • Mouse, keyboard, controller, and Steam Deck support

  • Accessibility options

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend the realms from tyrannical warlords. Then recruit them.

Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords is a turn-based tactical RPG that let's you build a party of warlords. What begins as the defense of a single kingdom grows into a sprawling campaign across the land from storm-battered castles, to desert dune kingdoms, to shogun-era provinces, and everywhere in between. Every region has its own warlords, its own tyrants, and its own people counting on someone to stand between them and oppression.

Defeat Them. Recruit Them.

Hundreds of warlords roam this world, each with their own reasons for fighting. Beat them in battle and there's a good chance they'll join your banner instead of falling to it, turning your fiercest enemies into your strongest allies.

Tactical, Turn-Based Battles

Position, plan, and outthink your enemies in battles. Set your tactician and choose your tactics wisely, as your tactical points may run out before you fight a difficult warlord.

Arm Your Legends

Every warlord you recruit can be armed. Seek out weapons, armor, and rare relics scattered across the land to equip your growing army and turn your warriors into a force no tyrant can stand against.

A World Without Borders

Journey from a small-kingdom skirmish to the doorsteps of tyrants crushing the common folk under their heel. Every realm you liberate adds new warriors, new terrain, and new stakes to your growing legend.

From Farmhands to Legends

A war will decide who rules this kingdom.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not a lone warrior. You command the entire battle line.

WHEN ARMIES WAVER is a medieval strategy roguelite where morale can turn a steady formation into a rout.

Advance when the enemy begins to waver. Defend to absorb an incoming charge. Retreat to recover morale and rebuild your formation. Instead of controlling individual soldiers, you read battlefield pressure, morale, formation, and attrition—then issue orders to the army as a whole.

READ THE LINE AND GIVE THE ORDER

Switch between Advance, Defend, and Retreat as the battle develops. Commit to an All-Out Charge when the enemy line weakens, hold your ground under pressure, or withdraw before your formation collapses.

Choosing the right order matters. Choosing the right moment matters even more.

BUILD YOUR COMMAND

After each victory, choose one of three reward cards.

• Formations define the structure and basic fighting style of your army.

• Orders temporarily reinforce actions such as advancing, defending, or retreating.

• Stratagems provide special tools such as arrow volleys, smoke screens, and morale recovery.

• Doctrines grant persistent bonuses while equipped.

In the War Room, combine formations, front- and rear-rank troops, orders, stratagems, and doctrines. The same army can become a durable defensive line, a mobile force, or an aggressive breakthrough formation depending on your loadout.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE

Between battles, choose the next connected route on the campaign map. Standard battles, elite forces, supplies, rewards, events, and the final enemy offer different risks and returns.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a PnL number on a Bloomberg-style terminal. Nothing more.

No character model. No portrait. No backstory beyond a single line delivered once and never revisited. You did something that put you deep in personal debt to a wealthy creditor, and that person now has you trading their money — as a test, and as leverage.

There is no crime storyline, no moral-choice system, no insider-trading mechanic. The debt is a number. The number has a rate. The rate climbs if you don't pay.

You trade your way out, or you don't.

The Loop

  • Review your desk. Each day surfaces a shortlist of names with real evidence behind them — a valuation signal, a screen hit, a model result, news that just landed.
  • Read. Financial statements, 10-K style filings, analyst notes, earnings-call transcripts, channel-check data, a live procedural news feed. Nothing is hidden from you. Plenty is missable.
  • Build a thesis. Run a quick weighted-factor model, underwrite a real DCF, save a screen, regress two assets against each other.
  • Trade it. Market, limit, stop, or a full conditional entry/target/stop package — across whichever instrument actually expresses the view.
  • Advance the day. Watch the market tick live, or fast-forward through it. News lands. Positions mark. Interest accrues. Margin gets called.
  • Live with it. There is no hidden "true value" you are being graded against. The only scoreboard is your PnL.

A Market That Actually Behaves Like One

Every run seeds a fresh universe. Nothing is scripted or hand-placed.
  • Generated companies with real financials — income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, evolving quarter over quarter into real filings. Some bury a genuine accounting tell: receivables outrunning revenue, margins that never convert to cash, buybacks funded by debt.
  • Persistent management behavior — every team has a seeded archetype. Some sandbag guidance every quarter. Some overpromise and miss. Track them across quarters and you earn a real read.
  • A sparse, explainable causal graph — shocks travel through real paths. A refinery outage reaches airlines, logistics and chemicals, and never touches an unrelated sector just because the math said so.
  • News as shock propagation, not exposition — headlines name an origin and deliberately never spell out who is exposed downstream. Noticing first is the deepest legitimate edge in the game.
  • A real macro layer — a policy rate steered on its own meeting cadence, an inflation print, a dollar index, and a full yield curve that genuinely inverts and normalizes.
  • Market regimes — bull, normal, correction, bear, crisis, each with its own volatility and spread character. A crisis widens spreads exactly when it hurts most.
The design promise underneath all of it: the market must be learnable, not random.

The Full Desk, From Day One

No unlocks. Equities, ETFs and indices, a full options chain, cash-settled futures, corporate bonds with real duration and credit ratings, FX pairs, vanilla swaps, and reputation-gated bespoke OTC structures — all available on your first trading day.

Complexity is managed the way real markets manage it: margin requirements, broker pricing width and liquidity. Not level gates.

Risk Discipline Is the Real Edge

  • Reputation-gated leverage that scales with your track record — and hurts proportionally more when you are wrong above the base cap.
  • Real margin calls. Cross the line and new risk is refused. Cross further and the desk force-sells your book at market.
  • Leverage you draw on purpose — an explicit institutional credit line financed daily at a real rate, never an accident you fell into.
  • Short borrow costs that price crowded, squeezing shorts honestly.
  • Optional self-imposed risk limits — Conservative, Standard, Aggressive, your own numbers, or none at all.
A player with mediocre ideas and real sizing discipline should outlast a player with great ideas and reckless size.

Three Acts. No Single Ending.

  • Act 1 — Indentured. Run a desk allocation while carrying personal debt. Miss payments and the rate escalates toward force-liquidation.
  • Act 2 — Independent. Your own book, your own AUM, real redemption pressure. Trust rebuilds slower than it is lost.
  • Act 3 — The Firm. A real shop, and the redemption math that comes with it.
Five parallel win conditions — personal net worth, AUM milestones, risk-managed consistency, cycles survived. Retire on your terms with a full victory report, or get wiped out and read exactly what happened and why. Neither ending is a silent game-over. New Game+ raises the debt ladder each time you come back.

The Terminal

A single configurable terminal: independently draggable, resizable panels bound to one function each, arranged into named workspace layouts you swap between like a real desk user.

No popups. Ever. Nothing steals focus. If something is urgent it appears on the persistent, always-visible Notification Tape — margin calls, redemption notices, loan deadlines, broker chat, earnings alerts — and nowhere else. You can miss something because you were looking at the wrong panel. You can never miss something because the game hid it from you.

The Alpha Leaderboard

Fifteen AI-run rival funds plus your own book, ranked by risk-adjusted return rather than raw PnL — so a fund that levered into one lucky name does not outrank one that ground it out. Each rival runs a genuine, distinct strategy, from momentum chasers to deep-value waiters to a fund built entirely out of spite for another fund's model.

How You Want To Play

  • Career — the full arc, debt and all.
  • Chill — start independent. No loan, no deadline. Just the market.
  • Custom — seed, market size, volatility, starting capital, risk preset.
  • Ironman — one save slot, continuously overwritten. No reloading your way out of variance.
  • Weekly Challenge — everyone gets the identical seeded world, deterministic down to the byte.

A horror adventure game set in an old apartment building deep in the mountains of Japan.
Features puzzle elements and can be completed in about 1–2 hours.

Shunya Takahashi, a paranormal streamer, sneaks into a cursed apartment building rumored to be the site of a family's mysterious disappearance, hoping to capture footage.
The moment the door of Room 101 closes behind him, he finds himself trapped in a space he cannot escape without solving its riddles.
Unravel the mysteries room by room and confront the truth of "that day" waiting beyond Room 203.

An escape-room-style first-person horror puzzle adventure.

Three different endings.

  • No voice acting, text-based / Supports Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Russian

  • This game contains potentially distressing content, including depictions of suicide. If you are sensitive to such content or plan to stream your playthrough, please enable Sensitive Mode in the settings.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Submit your report. Immediately."


The Bureau of Records handed you a single task: restore the complete record of the death game held on a remote island a few days ago, and submit a report.

All that remains are the records the dead left behind in their final moments, and a single terminal.
Your job is to restore those records one by one, and bring to light the truth of every death on the island.

About the Game

You work at a single, aging terminal.

Type in a record name to restore a broken record, and read the memory the victim left behind in their final moments.
Cross-reference the clues scattered through the record against the student roster and the island map, and work out the cause, the weapon, and the culprit for each death, one at a time.

Every time three correct reports line up, they're confirmed.
With each one you fill in, the remaining records connect to one another and the shape of the next death begins to emerge.



  • Your only clues: the victims' records, the student roster, and the island map
  • Identify and report the cause, the weapon, and the culprit for every student
  • A hint system for when you get stuck
  • Around 5 hours to complete

Streaming & Let's Plays

Streaming and Let's Plays are welcome, whether you're an individual or a company, and monetization is fine.
If you can, we'd appreciate it if you'd include this store page's URL in your video description.

store_data.about_the_game:
The wind is real. The sea wants to sink you. The cargo won't pay for itself.

Leeway is a physics-first sailing game set in a procedurally generated age-of-sail archipelago. Every wind shift, every wave and every cannon shot is simulated. There are no canned animations, no invisible walls - just you, the breeze, and the consequences.

MERCHANT

Buy goods cheap at one island, sell them dear at another. But a fat hold sits low in the water, and the pirates know it. Use the wind, the weather and your wits to reach port before they do.
  • Real sail physics: trim your main and jib to the groove, or go soft and lose ground
  • A living economy: prices shift with supply, weather and what the harbourmaster is missing
  • Cargo is weight: a full hold changes how she sails, how deep she sits, and when she sinks
  • Evade, outrun, signal the navy, dump a decoy - but never fire back. Merchants don't carry guns

PIRATE

You carry guns. Board prizes to steal cargo without sinking them, because a sunken ship pays nothing. Build heat, spend gold at the black market, and don't let the revenue cutter run you down.
  • Cannons that fire round shot, chain and grape - each cuts a different way
  • Subdue, don't sink: overwhelm the prize's crew so you can board and take her cargo
  • Five black-flag hulls from the nimble Corsair sloop to the three-masted Leviathan flagship
  • Square-rigged ships sail like square-rigged ships: they fly off the wind and struggle to windward

LEEWAY TOGETHER (BETA)

Play both roles against each other in peer-to-peer multiplayer. The merchant runs a real campaign; the pirate hunts them down with the same economy and weather. A host-authoritative Reaving mode pits one hunter against a convoy of haulers racing to bank a shared purse before he breaks them.

THE SEA

  • A procedurally placed archipelago that changes every new campaign
  • Storm cells you can see from a distance and try to avoid - or sail straight into
  • Day-night cycle driven by elapsed sailing time, not wall clock
  • Rain, fog, squalls, swells, and a barometer that tells you what is coming

OTHER THINGS WORTH KNOWING

  • Voice chat over WebRTC for crews (proximity-faded for strangers, always-on for crew)
  • Gamepad support with remappable controls
  • Three quality presets, so it scales down to weaker GPUs

store_data.about_the_game:
SPINDLEDRIFT is a top down space trader where the economy actually runs. Every price comes from stations producing things, consuming things, and running out of things. NPC haulers fly real cargo on real routes. Find a fat margin and it won't last, because other traders pile in and close it. That's the game. Find the next one first.

Ships have real weight. A loaded freighter doesn't fly like an empty scout. The whoosh drive burns fuel to cross the long gaps, and fuel range decides how deep into the map you can go.

The map starts safe and gets mean. The core is patrolled. The outer rings are pirate country, and that's where the money is. Better engines get you further, better guns keep you alive, and a bigger hold makes the trip worth taking.

Nothing tells you where the money is. Your tools are the map, your memory, and the prices in front of you. When you find a route nobody else is working, it's yours for a while.

Features
  • 78 stations that produce, consume, and run dry
  • prices move on their own, and routes close when traders exploit them
  • six ships, from a starter skiff to a capital freighter
  • engine, weapon, shield, cargo and scanner upgrades
  • pirates, patrols, convoys, smuggling, salvage, rescue tows
  • keyboard and mouse

store_data.about_the_game:
Dungeon Quest is a dungeon‑crawling RPG with an old‑school soul, blending first‑person exploration with tactical, line‑drawing combat. Step into a labyrinth of shifting halls, hidden chambers, and ancient secrets as you descend deeper into the dark.

Navigate twisting dungeons, uncover hidden rooms, and gather loot that fuels your growth. Every step drags you deeper into a world where traps sharpen, monsters evolve, and the margin for survival narrows with every floor you descend.

Combat

Combat unfolds on a gameboard where every move matters. Trace lines across matching tiles to strike enemies and collect resources.

  • Swords matched with skulls unleash attacks

  • Potions restore your health

  • Shields reinforce your armor

  • Coins unlock powerful upgrades that reshape your strategy and define your build

Level up

As you gather resources, you’ll upgrade your hero and unlock special abilities that transform how you fight. Build synergies, manipulate the board, and chain devastating combos as your power grows. Each run in this roguelite offers opportunities to try different combinations. 

Replay

Every run offers new challenges. Dungeons shift each time you play, with different abilities to choose from and escalating difficulty modes to test your skill. Lose yourself for hours as you chase powerful builds, push deeper, and unlock every achievement.

Ways to play

Unlock new classes including:

  • Warrior

  • Hunter

  • Mage

  • Cleric

Each offering unique abilities and distinct playstyles. Whether you favor brute force, clever manipulation, or intricate ability chains, there’s a class to match your style.

Descend, grow, and survive. The monsters below won’t go quietly.

store_data.about_the_game:
Evoruption is a dark roguelite deckbuilder where nature fights back against an ancient corruption spreading through the world. Build powerful decks, evolve your cards, and adapt your strategy as every journey presents new enemies, rewards and choices.

Fight your way through handcrafted story campaigns inspired by different animal kingdoms, each introducing unique mechanics that change how battles are played. Face memorable bosses, unlock new cards, and discover powerful combinations as you shape your deck to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

When you need a break from the campaign, challenge a cast of quirky Duel opponents — or take your deck into Multiplayer. Fight head-to-head in 1v1 battles or team up for 2v2 matches where teammates share health and status effects while keeping their own decks, hands and energy. Set up combinations for your partner, coordinate your strategy, or fill empty positions with bots.

Features

  • Build and customize unique decks from over 100 collectible cards.

  • Evolve and duplicate cards to create powerful synergies.

  • Five handcrafted story campaigns, each with its own mechanics, enemies and bosses.

  • Battle over 50 unique enemies with distinct AI and attack patterns.

  • Discover rare rewards, achievements and hidden challenges.

  • Test your skills in Duel Mode against memorable opponents with unique personalities.

  • Fight other players in tactical 1v1 or 2v2 team battles.

  • In 2v2, share team health and combat effects while managing your own hand, deck and energy.

  • Customize multiplayer teams, turn timers, race bonuses and other match rules.

  • Fill empty multiplayer slots with AI opponents.

  • High-quality illustrated artwork inspired by nature, fantasy and corruption.

  • Easy to learn, difficult to master, with deep strategic gameplay.

Can you adapt, evolve, and stop the corruption before nature itself is consumed?

store_data.about_the_game:
It rains on NeoTokyo. It always rains.

At 02:47, the comm-link drags detective Kade Katano out of her apartment. Elias Veyr, the executive who sold digital immortality, has been found dead in his penthouse: two hundred floors up, a sealed window wall, twelve bodyguards who saw nothing and cameras that recorded a man dying alone. No trauma. No toxins. Every neural function ceased at once, like a light someone switched off.

That doesn't happen. Tonight, explaining why it happened is your job.

PRECINCT 2099 is a noir investigation visual novel set in a future that no longer tells death and disconnection apart.

REALLY INVESTIGATE

Work the crime scene through Kade's ocular implant: scan the body, crack encrypted terminals, decide what deserves a second look. What you find — and what you miss — opens and closes dialogue, suspicions and endings.

DECIDE WHO KADE IS

Calibrate her operative profile by assigning seven dice rolls across STRENGTH, DEXTERITY, INTELLIGENCE, CODE, PERCEPTION, NERVE and HEALTH. There is no morality meter: there is tone. Professional, cynical or cold — the city reacts to how you speak, not how good you are.

THE DICE DECIDE WITH YOU

store_data.about_the_game:
From one shack to a city of millions

You found a settlement, put up a sawmill - and then it takes off on its own.

The governor lays out districts along the roads, caravans do the rounds of your

neighbours, and the population counter jumps from thousands to millions.

It runs without you. With you, it just runs faster.

Everything feeds into everything

Wood into planks, planks into furniture. Ore into steel, steel into machines.

Every building needs inputs and people to work it. Zoom in and you'll find a

city that actually lives: cars on the roads, citizens with names and wishes,

seasons turning, weather rolling across the land.

It grows while you're away

The governor builds whatever is missing - out of housing, it puts up homes; out

of planks, it builds a sawmill. You decide whether it should spread the city out

or improve what stands, and what it's allowed to build at all. Paint a zone and

a district grows there by itself. Come back later and the game accounts for

every minute you were gone.

Hit the ceiling, start again

Ascension wipes the city but keeps your permanent upgrades - and the next

civilization grows many times faster. Above that sits Legacy: a deeper

reset that lets you carry over the things Ascension normally takes. Knowledge.

The core of your city, roads and all. The wonders you spent longest on. In the

end, the only thing the reset takes is what you let it.

A world worth just watching

Day bleeds into evening, windows light up and street lamps come on along the

roads. Air shimmers above the smelters, reflections drift across the water,

trees sway just barely in the wind. No two cottages are alike. And when you pull

the camera all the way out, your civilization turns into a map of lights in a

dark landscape.

What's in it

  • Over 90 buildings, from a shack to an orbital ring

  • Seven eras: wood and stone through to fusion and nanotech

  • A constellation of technologies that unfolds as you research

  • Fog of war, scouts and foreign cities - trade with them or absorb them, buildings and all

  • Terraforming: add and drain water, reshape the land under your city

  • Districts that form on their own and grant synergies

  • Faith and prayers with a risk - call down rain, or a meteor

  • A chronicle, graphs and a timelapse of the whole run

  • 96 achievements, daily challenges and contracts

  • Photo mode that renders the scene in full detail

  • Full gamepad and Steam Deck support

  • English, Czech, German, Polish, Spanish

Rewrite any of it

All of the game's content lives in JSON - buildings, resources, research,

events, biomes, weather. The mod editor is built in: make your own building or

resource, draw its sprite, try it out on the spot, and push it to the Workshop

with one button.

store_data.about_the_game:
🪰 Welcome to Summer of Singing Insects

This is a soothing casual game brimming with rich summer atmosphere. Within the melody woven by cicada chirps, you can either play exclusive tunes with insect chirp tones, venture deep into the woods to catch various singing insects, raise them carefully in breeding boxes, and quietly listen to the one-of-a-kind crisp chirps of each little bug.

🎹 Cicada-Themed Electronic Keyboard

25-key visual electronic keyboard, playable via mouse clicks or physical computer keyboard

Three tone modes: Pure cicada electronic sound, piano blended with cicada chirps, organ blended with cicada chirps

Equipped with sustain effect, octave shifting and independent volume adjustment functions

A total of 42 singing insect tone skins, unlocked and replaceable through collection

Supports importing JSON/MID music scores for playback, as well as direct playback of local MP3 and WAV audio files

Fully customizable key mapping to match your personal playing habits

🪲 Moonlit Forest Insect Catching Gameplay

Each round is a 30-second timed forest catching challenge that tests your reflexes and eyesight. Consecutive successful catches will grant combo achievements.

There are 42 distinct singing insects categorized into five rarity tiers: Common, Fine, Superior, Epic and Legendary.

Caught insects are automatically unlocked as usable tone skins for the electronic keyboard.

The encyclopedia displays the wild spawn rate of each insect species to help you plan your collection goals.

🏠 Immersive Insect Viewing Breeding Box

Place captured singing insects into the breeding box and watch their lively behaviors of crawling freely and chirping in turns. The bugs will shyly stop chirping when you approach to feed them, and resume singing loudly once you step away, creating a miniature dynamic ecological garden of singing insects.

AI-driven autonomous behaviors including free movement, chirping and playful interactions for insects

Interactive feeding system to visually observe the responsive actions of bugs

Independent volume control for each individual box to prevent overlapping noisy chirps

📦 Complete Collection Encyclopedia System

Files archives for all 42 singing insects, allowing you to check the appearance, rarity and wild spawn probability of each species. Unlocked insect chirp skins can be switched with one click to change the playing timbre of the keyboard at any time.

🌐 Multi-Language Localization Support

The game includes 9 in-game interface languages: Simplified Chinese, English, 日本語，한국어, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português (Brasil), Русский

Minimum System Requirements

Operating System: Windows 10 64-bit

Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent CPU

Memory: 4 GB RAM

Graphics Card: Integrated graphics card for smooth operation

Storage Space: 500 MB available hard drive space

Hentai Step Sister is an anime game about a mysterious girl who unexpectedly begins living under the same roof as the main character. Behind her reserved behavior and calm smile lies a bright personality, a love of jokes, and a habit of constantly testing the player’s attention. Complete every level to get to know the heroine better and unlock the full collection of themed illustrations.

With each new level, you will unlock new scenes and outfits featuring the heroine. Watch her mood, style, and surroundings change—from ordinary moments at home to colorful themed costumes. Complete challenges, solve puzzles, and gradually unlock the entire gallery of anime illustrations.

🔹 Game Features:

Two stages in each level: First, a memory game in which you must find matching pairs. Then, a puzzle featuring a new illustration, which becomes available after completing the first stage.

Unlock new illustrations: Each completed level unlocks a new look for the heroine and brings you closer to completing the full collection.

Plenty of content: 24 memory-game levels and 24 puzzles—a total of 48 engaging stages featuring colorful anime illustrations.

Additional features: Achievements for completing the game. A gallery where you can view all unlocked illustrations. Three difficulty levels: easy, normal, and hard—choose the mode that suits you and complete the game at your own pace.

Hentai Step Sister combines a classic memory game, puzzles, and collectible anime illustrations. Can you complete all 48 stages and fully unlock the gallery?

store_data.about_the_game:
A woman carries out a deadly attack at a hospital, then takes her own life. She leaves behind a set of cassette tapes containing encoded data.

The entire game takes place at a tape-decoding machine. Solve over 40 signal-decoding puzzles across the seven tapes, unlocking a new story fragment with every successful decode.

To decode a signal, recreate a target waveform shown by the machine: choose a base waveform, route it through a chain of processing modules that reshape the signal, and adjust the modules and their order until the output matches the target.

Each recovered fragment reveals part of the story of the tapes' owner through text, an image, or an occasional audio recording, gradually reconstructing her life and the events that led to her final actions.

store_data.about_the_game:
A hallucination indistinguishable from reality.

What if you gained the power to break someone without leaving a trace?

Would you use it?

Takumi, a second-year high school student, gains the ability to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality.

What begins as a tool for revenge gradually eats away at his own mind—and changes the fate of the people he cares about.

HALLUCINATION is a psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape how the story ends.

Hallucinations Become Reality

Another reality, visible only to the person trapped inside it.

What they see.

What they hear.

What they feel.

Every sensation is indistinguishable from reality.

And it leaves no evidence behind.

That is precisely what makes this power capable of breaking the human mind.

Your Choices Shape the Ending

There is no single right answer.

A seemingly small decision can eventually alter the course of someone's fate.

Lives that could be saved.

Futures that could be lost.

And multiple endings waiting at the end of each path.

What ending will you choose?

Protagonist

Takumi

A second-year high school student.

After being bullied, he gains the ability to make others experience hallucinations.

What begins as a means of revenge gradually forces him to question even his own sense of what is right.

Features

● Multiple endings shaped by your choices

● Psychological battles centered around the power of hallucination

● A psychological suspense story exploring bullying, revenge, guilt, and forgiveness

● An immersive visual novel experience brought to life through illustrations, sound, and cinematic presentation

● Approximately 3–5 hours of playtime, depending on reading speed and the routes you explore

English Version Coming at Launch

HALLUCINATION is currently being localized into English.

The English version is planned to launch alongside the Japanese version on October 27, 2026.

An English-language demo is also planned for Steam Next Fest.

store_data.about_the_game:
The guests who obeyed the rules are still in the ledger, and nowhere else.

At night you cannot leave your room in an old Japanese inn.

The rules on the wall are the only thing keeping morning within reach. But some nights a thing arrives wearing the name of a thing the rules describe, and then the correct rite is how you hand yourself over.

"If the shadow moves, lower your eyes." You have memorised that one.

So: did something move behind the paper screen just now, or did you imagine it?

Judge wrong, and morning will not come.

What you do

  • Watch the room from your futon. A rustle of cloth, a shadow, a flicker of lantern light - find what is wrong

  • When you find it, perform the rite the rules demand. Lower your eyes / cover your ears / quell the flame

  • Gaze upon the hanging scroll, but never meet its eyes. Do not cross that line

The rites are easy to memorise. What is hard is deciding, in a dark room, whether this is the moment.

No two nights arrive the same way

Nothing is on a script. There are 26 kinds of wrongness, 68 individuals - and which wall, how large, and how close is drawn fresh every time.

Which one comes, which surface of the room it comes through, how large it is,

and even whether the rules on the wall are still legible - all of it is drawn fresh each night.

It does not always wear the same face.

The reaction that was fast enough last night is too slow tonight. That is why you go back in -

to find out how it comes for you next.

Every night the room gets heavier

Each dawn adds another rule. More to remember, more to watch.

By the seventh night you notice how long you have been holding your breath.

Which dawn will you be given?

The one who endured. The one who was devoured. The one who broke the rules.

And the one who touched the truth of this inn.

Which ending you are given is decided by your seven nights.

Easy to pick up. Nowhere to run.

  • Mouse only. No movement, no inventory - only looking, and the rites

  • One run is all seven nights. More than one ending is waiting for you

  • Text in Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese

  • Play with the lights off and headphones on

──────────

Note: This game contains dark scenes, sudden sounds, startling imagery, and flashing light.

If you have a heart condition, or are sensitive to light or sound, please lower the volume, play in a well-lit room, and take breaks.

──────────

Streaming, Video and Let's Play Policy

I love watching Let's Plays! It genuinely makes my day when someone streams, records or uploads video of Rules of the Inn. If you post one, I will come and watch it. Play it however you like, and say whatever you like about it.

No application and no individual permission is needed. Please go ahead, within the terms below.

  • Individuals and companies alike. If you belong to an agency, a studio or a talent management company, no additional permission is needed.

  • Live streams, recorded videos, clips and short-form video are all fine.

  • Any platform is fine (YouTube, Twitch, niconico, bilibili and others).

  • You do not need to avoid spoilers. Please show the game all the way through to its hidden ending.

  • You may monetise your video. You do not owe us any share of the revenue.

  • You may use the game's video and audio exactly as they appear in the game.

Just these few things, please.

  • Do not extract the music or sound effects on their own for use as material in unrelated works.

  • Do not upload or stream footage of a modified build of the game.

  • Please don't post videos whose main purpose is to let viewers watch the story footage alone, without commentary of your own.

  • Please don't combine the game with content that is unlawful, or that defames any person or group.

One request, and only one: when you stream or post a video, a link to this store page would make me very happy!

Coverage of the demo alone is just as welcome as coverage of the full game.

Contact

Please get in touch about anything at all. Japanese or English are both fine.

  • E-mail (best for private enquiries and review key requests) - kcreates.go (at) gmail (dot) com - anti-bot measure: please replace (at) with @ and (dot) with a full stop.

  • Steam community discussions (for public questions and thoughts) - reach it from "Community Hub" at the top of this page, then "Discussions".

These guidelines may be revised without notice. We accept no liability for any damages arising from your videos or streams.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chess With Magic

Immortal Chess keeps the core rules of chess intact, but adds classes, Mana, spells, traps, and unique skills that create entirely new ways to play.

Every standard chess move grants Mana, except White’s first move which solves natural advantage of moving first. The first capture of the match also grants one additional Mana.

Use Mana to disrupt your opponent, protect your pieces, escape seemingly impossible situations or create opportunities that could never exist in traditional chess.

Choose Your Class

Each class comes with its own spells, passive skill and offers a different way to approach the game.
Currently available classes:

Inquisitor • Champion • Sentinel • Disruptor • Cultist • Monarch • Strider • Necromancer • Mage

Future updates will introduce more classes to the game and new fun ways to play.

Every Match Plays Differently

Chess is still chess. Spells are there to expand its strategy, not replace it.

You do not know every opening? That is fine. Familiar openings can quickly turn into completely new positions, giving newer players a chance to compete without spending years studying theory.

A familiar position can suddenly become dangerous. A seemingly safe King may be exposed by a single spell, completely changing the direction of the match.

Watch your opponent’s Mana, status effects and remaining durations, then build your strategy around the tools available to both players.

Compete in ranked, create casual matches or practice against the AI. You can also play both sides to test positions and experiment freely.

Choose your preferred server, play across PC and mobile through cross-platform multiplayer.

What else can you do in this game?

  • Experiment with different classes and spell combinations

  • Customize your game with cosmetic boards and pieces

  • Climb the leaderboard and improve your rating

  • Watch other people playing games directly

  • Watch replays of the games you played

Why Play Immortal Chess?

  • There are many chess games, but nothing plays quite like Immortal Chess.

  • Each game and each class will have its own fun moments

  • You like magic, spells, classes, and RPG inspired mechanics

  • Enjoy competitive games and love tactical decision making

  • Already love chess

  • Want to learn chess in a less traditional way

  • Want to have fun

Fair Competition

Immortal Chess is free to play and will never be pay to play or pay to win.

Your first class is free and after the first selection you will receive enough Essence points to unlock one or two additional classes of your choice.

More classes can be unlocked with Essence earned by playing or purchased directly.

Cosmetic boards and pieces are also available, but purchases never increase the power of your spells or give direct advantages during a match.

The truth is out there. Nothing escapes time and space.

store_data.about_the_game:
Have you ever stared at a room and thought, "Wait, was that chair always there?"

​Be the Shuffler

Rearrange the room before the clock runs out! Moving massive objects are incredibly risky, but they score you huge points. Sneaking a tiny cup into the corner pays less, but it might just drive the Seekers crazy. The choice is yours!

​Be the Seeker

Figure out exactly what the Shufflers changed. Scream "Gotcha!" when you think they moved the fridge, or call an item "Sus" when you start doubting your own memory. You can also kick the shufflers when they are dancing in front of you to taunt you!

​Grab your friends or play with strangers and get ready for the arguments over a misplaced lamp.

Release in September 2026

Wishlist Now So You Don't Miss It!

No Generative AI

Shuffle and Seek does not use any generative AI. The models, animations, 2D images, music, and sound effects are either handcrafted directly by Groovy Zebra Studio or purchased from human-made asset stores.

The main character is a mysterious succubus who works in a modern office and hides her true nature behind a professional smile. She invites you to complete a series of challenges and unlock all of her different looks.
