Every small achievement brings you closer to something greater.

■ Tame Monsters. Give Them a Name

・Weaken a monster and use Tame to recruit it
・If Tame fails, you may try again on the same monster
・Every recruited monster can be given a name of your choosing
・The first nickname raises every growth rate except Movement by 5%
・Tamed monsters can be Summoned onto the battlefield without using a deployment slot
・The unit who summons a monster gains experience and may sometimes receive a gift from the summoned monster

They are more than extra units.
Once named and raised, they become companions shaped by your choices.

■ Monster Side-Stories — Monsters Only

・More stages unlock as you tame more monsters
・Human party members cannot participate
・Build a squad using only the monsters you have recruited
・Face powerful bosses drawn from myths around the world across 24 stages

These battles place the monsters you raised in the leading role.

■ Shop in Town. Forge from Ore

・Visit armorers, morning markets, skewer stalls, inns, bookshops, and more
・Each shop carries a different selection
・Ingredients provide healing or temporary bonuses
・Skewers combine HP recovery with support effects
・Bring collected ore to the workshop
・Weapons and armor are crafted directly from raw ore rather than fused from existing equipment

Preparation between battles matters just as much as the choices made on the battlefield.

■ A Party That Keeps Growing

・A sharp-tongued maid with gentle hands
・A knight whose voice is the only thing oversized
・A mage who teaches you to read the wind instead of watching the target
・A recruit who trembles but never lets go of her spear
・A horned swordsman incapable of telling a lie
・A blacksmith who studies your hands before forging your weapon
・And the friend standing with the Demon Army

As more companions join you, one army will eventually become two,
and battles fought across multiple fronts await.

The story also moves beyond the kingdom's point of view.
Kingdom and Demon Army. Human and monster.
Different lives and loyalties gradually cross on the same battlefield.

A free demo is coming soon.
store_data.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where two students from modern Japan are pulled into a world at war. Move units across grid maps, exploit terrain and weapon matchups, and build a party of knights, blacksmiths and swordsmen. The story is told through dialogue alone, with no narration at any point.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jump Crew is a multiplayer space survival sandbox where crews build their own ships, automate production and push outward through a persistent galaxy shared with other players.

Build and Automate Your Ship

Construct your ship floor by floor, then fill it with storage, machinery and conveyor belts. Process ore, forge steel, fill oxygen bottles and automate the production of equipment, building parts and FTL jump tokens. Your ship can grow from a small platform into a travelling factory, fortified base, a raiding vessel or a fleet of many kinds of ship.

Explore a Persistent Galaxy

Land on compact worlds containing forests, caves, oceans, lava, ice, comets and other environments. Each planet has its own resources, creatures and hazards, so reaching new regions requires preparation and a capable ship. Establish autonomous mining outposts, leave them running and return later to collect their output. Everything remains within the persistent server between sessions.

Survive Rival Crews

Every player on a server inhabits the same open-PvP galaxy. Other crews can find your ship, raid your outposts and take your supplies—and you can track them down and do the same. Fight creatures and players in real-time melee combat, protect your industry and decide how much equipment you are prepared to risk on each expedition.

Features

  • Persistent shared galaxy with unrestricted open PvP

  • Online co-op aboard a single player-built ship

  • Modular ship construction and expansion

  • Conveyor belts and automated production lines

  • Resource gathering, mining, hunting and metal forging

  • FTL travel powered by manufactured jump tokens

  • Distinct planets with different biomes, resources and enemies

  • Autonomous planetary mining and production outposts

  • Real-time melee combat against creatures and rival crews

  • Oxygen, radiation, meteor and environmental survival systems

  • Travel between planetary surfaces, orbit and distant star systems

  • Persistent ships, installations and progression across sessions

store_data.about_the_game:
Mor has spent years alone...

At seventeen, he was convicted of causing a school fire that killed another student...

The evidence was questionable... The trial became a spectacle... But the public had already decided what he was.

A monster... A devil...

His only friend brings him a little gift...

A faded body pillow of Imi... The heroine from an old VN he played.

Mor hates it. He's humiliated by it...

But in a cell where every day is exactly the same... It's not the worst thing to happen to him. 

Imi starts talking back.

She listens... She cries...

But Imi remembers things Mor never told her...

“I thought the west wing of the school would be empty.”

Did Mor somehow make Imi real?

What something real?

If she listens... If she remembers...

Make Her Real is a short psychological horror visual novel about isolation and the desperate need for love.

Key Features:

  • A short psychological horror story about an imprisoned man and a body pillow gift he receives. 

  • Choice-driven progression that shapes Mor's attachment to Imi and how he responds when her reality begins to fracture.

  • Three distinct endings determined by what Mor is willing to believe...

  • An ambiguous mystery surrounding a deadly school fire, a questionable conviction, and memories that were never meant to be shared.

  • Orthographic prison environments, character close-ups, and surreal visual sequences that shift alongside Mor's perception of reality.

  • Creepy music and sound effects.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Underlayer!

A simple trip to the bathroom becomes a journey through the bizarre worlds of the human psyche. Fight hordes of bizarre creatures, collect powerful weapons, defeat formidable bosses, and help Petka find his way back home... if there is such a thing as a home.

Explore the Living Underlayer

Each dimension reflects a different aspect of the human mind. Everyday objects come to life, familiar places become deadly labyrinths, and our strangest habits govern the world around us. You never know what awaits around the next corner.

Humor Everywhere

Petka is not a hero. He's lazy, sloppy, and overconfident. But his witty commentary on the situation makes even the most dire situations laughable.

Fast-Paced Combat

Use a variety of weapons, including experimental shotguns and automatic pistols crafted by the inhabitants of the Underlayer. Each fight demands quick movement, dodges, and careful positioning.

Defeat massive bosses.

A unique boss awaits you at the end of each dimension. Each boss has its own set of attacks, combat phases, and weaknesses. In order to progress to the next level of the Underside, you must defeat them.

Will you be able to escape?

The Underside is constantly evolving. Each new portal leads to an even more bizarre world. The only question is: can you find your way out before becoming a part of the madness?

His Country, the land of Catsgetta, has promised to do everything they can to obtain his release. Top negotiators began the process of communicating with the enemy Government of Ratscotta. When hearing from her son, she swears she will be the one to rescue him from tyranny.

This game includes five large maps with lots of secret areas to find. The missions are varied and include many opportunities for forward advancement. The enemies are very skilled and come in all styles: melee, shooters, and magic attackers!

store_data.about_the_game:
ESCAPE THE REALITY OF EQUATIONS

Escape Matrix is a mind-bending, first-person puzzle game where mathematics is your only key to freedom. Trapped inside a surreal simulation governed by raw mathematical laws, you must navigate through a sequence of puzzle chambers to find the final exit.

To open locked doors and progress deeper, you have to reconstruct disrupted mathematical formulas—spanning from limits and integrals to trigonometry and calculus fundamentals—by finding the missing symbols and placing them in their rightful slots.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Interactive Math Puzzles: Freely explore each room to gather scattered 3D symbols.

  • Universal Placement System: Place any symbol into any wall slot. Experiment with different configurations, test your intuition, and retrieve placed pieces at any time to rethink your strategy.

  • Chamber Progression: Every completed formula unlocks access to new chambers with increasingly intricate logic challenges.

  • Physics & Tactile Interaction: Pick up, drop, inspect, and slot pieces in full 3D space with responsive controls.

KEY FEATURES

  • Challenging Logic & Calculus: Accessible yet stimulating puzzles designed for both math enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike.

  • Sleek Minimalist Aesthetic: A clean, stylish environment featuring glowing neon symbols and atmospheric lighting.

  • Room-by-Room Progression: Clear formula and level tracking so you always know how close you are to total freedom.

  • Intuitive First-Person Controls: Seamless movement, object inspection, and inventory handling.

Can you decipher the matrix and find your way out?

store_data.about_the_game:
You find an old computer, and you turn it on, only to discover that it is inhabited by a digital companion named LITA, designed to pass on knowledge that was forgotten by humanity.

LITA's mission is to guide you through a series of challenges that explore the basic of low-level programming, focusing on how computer memory works.

Starting with simple concepts like variables and their representation in memory and slowly move to more advanced concepts such as pointers and memory manipulation.

But LITA isn't just an instructor. As you go through, you will undertands why she was created and that not everything happens by chance.

Through visual programming, connecting instruction blocks, you will be able to create small programs and visualize their execution while watching, in real time, the changes in memory.

No prior programming knowledge is required, just curiosity and a love of solving puzzles.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric walking simulator horror game set in a typical post-Soviet school in the early 2000s, decorated for Christmas. Arriving at school before everyone else to help prepare for the holiday, the protagonist soon realizes that something is terribly wrong. The familiar hallways and classrooms slowly transform into a place filled with fear and unsettling mysteries.

Explore dark classrooms, endless corridors, the gym, the cafeteria, and other areas of the school while searching for notes that reveal the story behind the terrifying events. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and move deeper into the building as the feeling of being watched grows stronger with every step.

Colorful Christmas lights, festive decorations, and cheerful holiday music create a disturbing contrast with the horrors unfolding around you. What should have been an ordinary morning before Christmas quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival.

Features:

  • Atmospheric horror focused on exploration and psychological tension.

  • A detailed recreation of a post-Soviet school from the early 2000s.

  • Exploration, environmental storytelling, key item collection, and light puzzles.

  • A mysterious story revealed through notes, locations, and the environment.

  • Terrifying encounters and unexpected scares that keep you on edge from beginning to end.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neosis Echoes explores a future shaped by megacorporations, consciousness cloning, cybernetic humans and the price of immortality.

On the hostile planet of Varos, cybernetically enhanced humans mine Echorium, a mysterious resource hidden beneath the surface, while the world is controlled by Monolith, a superintelligence that considers human emotion a system defect.

You play as Evan Draxell, a synthetic clone of the founder of Draxell Corp, a powerful military-industrial megacorporation. After a 200-year journey through space, Evan awakens carrying fragmented memories of a life he never lived and the legacy of an empire he never built.

As he explores Varos, fragments of the past begin to resurface, revealing a conflict that reaches far beyond his own existence.

The world affects you. Your emotional state reshapes gameplay. Your actions reshape the world.

Manage Stress, Focus and Mood to survive, stay effective in combat and exploration, and influence how the world responds to you.

Fight hostile creatures and machines using firearms, abilities and advanced mobility. Adapt your approach to each encounter and use your environment, equipment and movement to stay alive.

Explore Varos to gather resources, craft tools and equipment, manage your survival needs and prepare for hostile environments. Improve your gear and use what you find to venture deeper into the world.

Travel across a hostile alien world alongside K.I.T., a robotic companion designed to assist Evan during exploration and survival.

Explore the remnants of a complex civilization, encounter powerful artificial intelligences and uncover the history hidden across Varos as you piece together Evan's forgotten past.

Neosis Echoes is currently in development, and the systems presented so far represent the foundations of a much larger experience.

Our goal is to progressively expand Varos with new environments, creatures, machines, weapons, abilities, bosses, resources and survival systems.

The emotional system will also continue to evolve, giving Stress, Focus and Mood deeper consequences for the environment, enemies, Echorium and the way the world reacts to Evan.

A cyberpunk electronic music producer whose music blends cinematic science fiction, dark electronic sounds and futuristic atmospheres.

The soundtrack is being developed alongside the world itself, helping define the identity of Varos, its environments, its conflicts and its emotional atmosphere.

The music of Neosis Echoes isn't added to the world. It's built with it.

store_data.about_the_game:
The puzzle is the trigger of your arsenal.

Packfall Chain Arena fuses a falling-block puzzle with a backpack-building auto battler on a single screen. Clear 4 orbs of the same color and the gear of that color in your backpack activates. Chain your clears for even stronger effects. Your backpack build and your puzzle skill are the keys to victory.

■ How it plays

1. Clear — line up 4 orbs of a color on the board

2. Activate — gear of the cleared color automatically attacks, guards, or heals

3. Build — between waves, buy gear in the shop and arrange it in your backpack

4. Battle — break enemy auto-rigs and conquer the 10-wave tournament

■ Features

- Color-bound combat — the board and your backpack share one color language. Choosing which color to clear IS choosing which gear activates

- Placement is the build — gear has shapes and sizes. Place same-colored pieces adjacent for amplify bonuses and hunt for the strongest packing

- Enemies run auto-builds too — every enemy fights with its own behavior pattern. Craft a build that can beat them all

- Casual to pick up, deep to master — a lives-based roguelite: when you lose, rebuild and rematch

- PvE auto battle — a single-player game where you can focus on your backpack and your puzzle play

The Varitav is an action-roguelike where you control a fox and fight to survive against endless waves of animal-themed enemies.

  • Three distinct biomes with unique enemies

  • Various ability choices upon leveling up

  • Boss encounters triggered at specific stages

  • Endlessly scaling difficulty

  • Pixel art visual style

Stay foxy!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to The Holey Kingdom — a place where knights battle evil, peasants grow crops, the king cares exclusively about himself, and cows occasionally get abducted by aliens.

Explore a vast pixel-art kingdom, complete quests, fight enemies, and meet its less-than-normal inhabitants. Beyond the castle walls lie villages, forests, taverns, farms, dungeons, and even Hell itself. Danger can hide anywhere — from a living book to a carnivorous plant beside which someone, for some reason, placed a warning sign.

MULTIPLE HEROES

Control different characters, each with unique abilities and approaches to combat. The knight relies on his sword and strength, the archer attacks from a distance, the mage casts spells and raises the fallen, while an ordinary housewife gradually realizes that she can change not only her own life, but the entire kingdom.

EXPLORE THE HOLEY KINGDOM

Travel between the poor districts, the estates of the nobility, and the royal castle. Enter homes and public buildings, explore basements, prisons, and forbidden chambers. Talk to the locals, discover unusual quests, and uncover what lies behind the polished speeches of those in power.

FIGHT AND SEEK ADVENTURE

Engage in sword fights, ranged combat, magic, platforming challenges, and encounters with demons, zombies, goblins, aliens, and other threats. Sometimes a problem can be solved with force, sometimes with cunning, and sometimes it is simply cheaper to pay.

A LIVING AND UNPREDICTABLE WORLD

Attend knightly tournaments, help out on the farm, witness cows being abducted, try your luck at the Three Swords Casino, and interfere in events that may change the lives of the locals. In The Holey Kingdom, adventures often begin by accident and end even worse.

DARK SATIRE

The Holey Kingdom combines medieval fantasy, dark humor, and political and social satire. The game contains mature content, including stylized violence, strong language, alcohol, tobacco, nudity, and sexual themes.

This project is currently in the pre-production development phase. Some content will be revised or even deleted as production moves forward, especially content that bears clear references to real-world elements.

The project title is provisional and will be changed during subsequent development.

The project is currently in the project initiation stage. Everyone is welcome to visit the official website of "Ritsuai律合" to learn more about this project!

We are all masters of the story!

New AVG Project by Ritsuai · Player Co-Creation Program

Every bit of your support will shape the complete narrative!

About the Story

A graduation certificate should mark the end of an old chapter and the ticket to a brand-new life, yet he is a total exception.

He glances at the hard-won conditional admission notice lit up on his phone, then stares at endless job recruitment pages on his computer, letting out nothing but a long, exhausted sigh.

The small county where he grew up is filled with memories, yet it holds no room for him to settle down and build a life.

When he has run out of all options, his family offers him a completely unfamiliar part-time job: head to a coastal city he has never set foot in, spend an entire spring and summer there, and then start his new campus life in this seaside town.

Sea winds, sunsets, lively street scenery and unexpected tenderness are all waiting for him here. His coming-of-age story and the road ahead of him will be written entirely by your own hands!

Story:

The story follows Piker, an investigative journalist from Los Angeles, who travels to Machu Picchu after hearing rumors of a newly discovered hidden passage leading to underground caves. The year is 1981.

Upon arriving at Machu Picchu, Piker crawls through a narrow stone crevice that leads to a part of the site closed to the public. His curiosity draws him toward an ancient pyramid. Something doesn't feel right, but he continues.

Gameplay:

Immerse yourself in the role of an investigative journalist. Explore the secrets beneath Machu Picchu and document your findings using your reporting equipment.

Navigate the darkness using only your flashlight. Search abandoned tunnels, and stay alert as the caves become increasingly hostile.

Solve environmental puzzles to uncover hidden paths, unlock forgotten passages, and progress deeper into the ancient cave system.

Features:

  • Explore the underground caves beneath Machu Picchu.

  • Discover ancient relics and hidden passageways.

  • Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new areas.

  • Experience immersive sound design and environmental storytelling.

  • Atmospheric first-person psychological horror.

store_data.about_the_game:
Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats

Find the Cats Hidden Around the World!

Are you ready to find the cats hidden in the world’s most popular and iconic places? Every scene awaits you in a detailed environment inspired by the real world… but be careful, the cats are cleverly hidden and won’t give themselves away easily!

Game Features:

• Race Against Time — The game is entirely time-based. The faster you find them, the higher you climb. Players who finish in the shortest time earn a place on the world leaderboard.

• Hint System — If a cat is giving you too much trouble, you can press the hint button to reveal its location. But remember, every hint adds extra time to your total score.

• Wrong Click Penalty — Clicking in the wrong place adds a time penalty. And if you keep clicking wrong, the penalty stacks and grows. Being careful is just as important as being fast.

• Achievements — Unlock achievements throughout the game and crown your progress. Speed, precision, and discovery await you.

Ready? Find the cats, manage your time, and put your name on the world leaderboard!

store_data.about_the_game:
Make every lap faster—and more valuable.

Speed Goes Up is a single player incremental arcade racer about making the number climb. Run time trials, earn Bits every time you complete a lap, then reinvest your winnings in speed, handling, drift, boost, and a stronger racing economy.

Every Lap Matters

Chase personal bests in continuous time trials while your latest and fastest laps stay on the clock. Timed lap challenges reward precise driving, while long term lap mastery turns persistence into lasting payout bonuses.

Put Your Best Lap to Work

Record a fast route, purchase a Ghost, and watch it replay your personal best. Ghosts earn a share of the lap reward each time they finish, turning your own driving into a growing income engine across unlocked tracks.

Build a Faster Machine

Spend Bits in a branching Garage upgrade tree. Raise top speed, acceleration, braking, handling, and lap payouts. Unlock drifting, build Heat through controlled slides, then spend that Heat on boost to break past your normal speed ceiling.

Each track also has its own Pit Upgrades. Improve its lap reward, add more Ghosts, and invest in specialised bonuses that strengthen the wider run.

Tracks That Push Back

Learn authored floating circuits shaped by hills, railway crossings, low grip ice, alternate routes, moving gates, speed pads, and timed hazards. Smash through obstacles when you are fast enough, choose the right line through branching sections, and take on one-on-one races for permanent progression rewards.

Reset. Rebuild. Go Faster.

Prestige turns a completed build into permanent lap reward power. Begin again with that payout boost and your Legacy Cores intact, work through new upgrade tiers, and unlock a new machine as you chase the next speed ceiling.

Features

  • Single player arcade racing with incremental progression

  • Continuous time trials with latest lap and personal best tracking

  • Income generating Ghosts based on your own fastest recorded routes

  • A branching Garage tree for speed, handling, economy, drift, Heat, and boost

  • Pit Upgrades, timed challenges, and long-term lap mastery

  • Prestige progression with permanent payout growth and new cars

  • Vehicle paint choices and performance tuning

  • Authored tracks with distinct surfaces, routes, shortcuts, and hazards

store_data.about_the_game:
"A beast stalks us. I have seen it in my dreams."

The letter came from a priest. Eight children in a modest orphanage beside the ruins of Kloster Allerheiligen, and something circling them in the dark.

Hasko Brand took the work but the carriage never reached the abbey. Amidst the ruins of your carriage you are forced to improvise. Your rifle is gone with everything else. What you have is a torch, a handful of knives, and a long walk through the Black Forest.

You fight with what survived the wreck and what you can improvise: throwing knives and pulling them back out of the corpse, molotovs that turn a thicket into a killing field, and a sword for whatever closes the distance. Real time combat against enemies who are unforgiving.

Guns and Gargoyles is a top down pixel art rpg. This grimdark rpg with old school design incorporates real time combat as opposed to the turn based mechanisms of its predecessors/inspirations. Set against the backdrop of the infamous black forest of germany in an alternate reality where monsters out of folklore comes to life. Even if you survive the feral wolves, bats and bears, the creatures of the night will not spare you and in the black forest the sun never shines. Step into the world of Hasko Brand and his adventures across old Europe in this story set in the darkest parts of Germania. 

The demo shows how it begins, If you want to see how it ends, wishlist us.

store_data.about_the_game:
Retro racing. Modern glow.

Glow Arcade Racer brings back the pure, pick-up-and-play thrill of classic top-down racers — rebuilt in a modern 3D engine with dynamic lighting, glowing neon tracks and effects that would have melted an arcade cabinet.

20 tracks, no two alike.

Race across 12 unique levels, each built around its own twist: raised tracks, bridges, jumps and drops, bouncing surfaces, splitting routes, teleports and boost pads. Master them all, then take on 4 hyper-speed reverse tracks — and 4 bonus tracks that drop you into first person.

Fight for the lead.

Grab pickups as you race — missiles, mines, shields, boosts and more — and use them to claw your way to the front or defend your lead on the final lap.

Build your own.

The full track editor puts every block from the game in your hands. Raised sections, jumps, splits, teleports — if it's in the game, you can build with it.

Racing for everyone.

Play with 1–4 players on keyboard, Xbox controllers or any Steam-compatible controller. Choose classic or simplified controls, a dynamic action cam or a steady classic top-down view, and dial the look from authentic CRT scanlines to crisp modern neon — all the way up to 4K.

No sprawling career mode. No unlock grind. Just fast, simple, retro fun — the way arcade racing used to feel.

store_data.about_the_game:
Day forty-one. The door is open. The valley still expects a body.

The Escape from Dungeon Keep - Expanded Edition is a classic text adventure of typed commands, turn-based fights, and a keep that was never only a prison.

You wake in a cell beneath Dungeon Keep. The guards are gone. Forty-one tally marks score the wall - and you know what that number really means. Escape the dungeon, walk the wilds of Thornwick, and decide what the mountain under the rock has been fed for a hundred years.

What you do

  • Type your way out - look, go, take, examine, talk, fight. A living adventure log with typewriter text, and shortcuts when you already know the next move.

  • Explore a full campaign - the keep, the valley, and the caves under the mountain, with side quests, readable lore, and a map that fills in as you travel.

  • Fight turn by turn - attack, guard, focus, heavy strikes, potions, and loot that feeds weapon upgrades at the forge.

  • Meet the valley - innkeepers, merchants, hermits, and a blacksmith who will sharpen more than your blade if you bring the right materials.

  • Choose how the story ends - more than one summit ending, then New Game+ beyond the mountain into distant lands, contract paths, and a harder secret finish for those who dig.

Expanded Edition

  • New Game+ and a second continent of rooms, bosses, and endings

  • Dozens of achievements (including hidden ones)

  • Chronicle / lore fragments for players who examine everything

  • Difficulty options, high-contrast mode, large text, and volume control

  • Local Workshop / JSON mod support - addon content and standalone maps

  • Save slots that keep your run (and your display preferences)

For fans of

Parser adventures, short story-driven RPGs, and games that reward reading the room - literally.

The keep has kept its arithmetic for a century.

On day forty-one, someone finally leaves a different answer.

store_data.about_the_game:
MINE MINE MINE

It's Minesweeper. And then it really, really isn't.

You know the rules: read the numbers, flag the mines, clear the field. Now put that field at the top of a mine shaft that goes down forever — and fill it with things that move.

Every floor you clear, you descend. The deeper you go, the higher your score, the richer the ore… and the nastier the things buried with it. Mole People burrow under the board and rewrite the numbers behind your back. Timer mines start ticking. One number is always lying to you. And every fifth floor, the Mole Queen is waiting in the dark — a hidden boss you have to triangulate from the numbers and dig straight into.

Survival is always fair. Every floor can be reached by pure logic — you will never die to a blind coin-flip. But clearing a floor for the big payout? That's where you gamble. Bank your gold and play it safe, or carry it deeper and multiply your score with the rats, the lava, and the abyss all trying to take it back.

Dig deeper. Get stranger.

  • 28 companions you unearth mid-run — a canary that warns you, a gorilla that hurls bananas, a paperclip that intercepts your fatal click ("It looks like you're trying to explode").

  • Two dozen relics and a bag of consumables that bend the rules: X-ray monocles, dowsing pendulums, phoenix feathers, a recycle bin that eats a mine per floor.

  • A shaft that transforms as you fall — Stone, Moss, Obsidian, Magma, and the violet-black Abyss, each with its own palette, hazards, and music.

  • A living board — moving moles, rising magma, shifting columns, gas pockets, chained fuses, cracked tiles, and the Mimic's single lying number.

Four ways to play

  • Descent — the main event. Endless, greedy, roguelite. How deep can you get?

  • Daily Dig — one date-seeded board a day, the same for everyone. Share your result in emoji and settle it on the leaderboard.

  • Classic — pure Minesweeper with the reactive smiley. No monsters, no shops. Just you, the numbers, and how far down you dare.

  • Pacifist — guaranteed logic-only boards. For the purist who wants the sweep, not the fight.

Bank it or risk it

Gold you carry multiplies your score — and dies with you. Gold you bank is yours forever, feeding a vault of permanent upgrades: more hearts, more tool slots, a head start down the shaft. Every run makes the next one a little less brutal. That's the deal you make with the dark.

The details

  • Global Steam leaderboards across every mode.

  • 12 achievements, from your first flag to your hundredth floor.

  • An original 8-bit soundtrack that shifts with the depth — and a boss theme worth dying to.

  • Full controller support. Colorblind-friendly numbers. CRT scanline toggle for the nostalgics.

  • First-click-safe, solver-verified boards. No cheap deaths — only greedy ones.

Read the numbers. Flag the mines. Then keep digging.[/p]

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO MOG TOWN

The ultimate proving ground for self-improvement. You don't choose your genetics—every run starts with a completely randomized beta character. Your mission? Rank them up as high as possible. See if you have what it takes to unlock legendary gigachad status over a strict 14-day schedule.

IMPROVE YOUR LOOKS

Take your transformation into your own hands. Engage in specialized mini-games to manually rank up your character's appearance. Commit to the looksmaxxing rituals, and watch your baseline stats skyrocket as you build undeniable aura.

MANAGE YOUR MONEY

Budget your cash to fund your looksmaxxing journey. Invest in high-quality items to fuel your ascension, or settle for cheaper beta options just to pull through. Every purchase directly impacts your final rank.

BEAT THE CLOCK

The clock doesn't stop for anyone. With a strict 14-day countdown, time is your most valuable resource. Every day operates on a tight schedule with limited hours, forcing you to prioritize your actions. Plan your daily grind flawlessly, because wasted time is wasted potential.

PROGRESS THE STORY

  • All that isolated grinding leads to this; Hitting weekend parties and talking to the girls is how you progress the story. Your dialogue choices determine your fate. Secure the right responses to advance the narrative, because one wrong choice will pump your cortisol up—and if it spikes too high, you'll completely fumble the interaction.

  • Words aren't enough—your stats dictate their reactions before you even open your mouth. You can't show up with a beta rank and expect to charm anyone, even if you pick the right dialogue options. You need the stats to back up your chat.

MULTIPLE ENDINGS

How does the run end? That is entirely up to you and your final rank.

store_data.about_the_game:
47,000,000 KRW

You co-signed a loan. Your friend ghosted you. All you have left is one game account and an 8-digit debt.

Every single won you earn chips away at that number. Hit zero, and you're free. Until then, the grind never stops.

Mind Games — 1-on-1 Gold Trading

Pay first, or send first?

Demanding payment upfront is safe, but buyers will walk away. Sending gold first gets you a premium rate — or gets you blocked and scammed.

One bad read wipes out an entire day of farming.

Reputation & Clean Slates

Build trust with regulars, and they'll pay above market price. The higher your reputation, the higher the payoff — and the dirtier the temptation to exit scam.

Scam too many people, and you're blacklisted from the trade chat. You can buy a fresh fake ID to get back in, but every loyal customer you had is gone forever.

Play it straight as an honest trader, or take one massive score and run.

The Grind — 3D Field

Behind the chat window lies a silent valley ringed by mountains. Chop timber, mine stone, gather herbs, and cash them in at the forge.

Upgrade your backpack, sharpen your tools, speed up your boots. Every resource pulled from the wild becomes liquidation inventory for the chat room.

Automated Drones & Loot Boxes

Invest your earnings into drones to passive-farm resources while you're away. Higher-tier drones run faster, longer, and harder.

Drones drop from loot boxes. Boxes open with cash. There is a pity system, but it's a long way up — and low-tier boxes pay out mere pocket change.

*Note: Uses in-game currency only. Contains NO real-money microtransactions.

Build Archers, Knights, Mages, and Tanks across the battlefield, then upgrade each unit’s damage, attack speed, range, status effects, targeting behavior, and unique abilities.

As the battle continues, new zones unlock and expand the enemy’s path toward your portal. Each new area adds more places to defend, more active enemy portals, and stronger threats.

Earn gold by defeating enemies, strengthen your army between waves, and prepare for powerful bosses as you fight toward the final victory at Wave 150.

  • Increasingly difficult enemy waves

STAFF WANTED. AGAIN.

You and your friends run the last supermarket in the bunker. One of you decides who gets in, the rest keep the store alive. Something always gets in anyway. Ask the previous staff. Actually, you can't.

TRUST NO ONE. SELL TO EVERYONE!

Every customer goes through screening: documents, x-ray, photo, temperature. Perfectly routine paperwork. Until the x-ray shows two skeletons. In one customer. Straight to the decontamination shower with him. The infection washes off. The complaints don't.

EVERYTHING MUST GO!

Fires, spills, breaches, and whatever the green stuff is. Put it out, mop it up, seal the wall, and get back to your register. We reopen in the morning. We always reopen.

KEY FEATURES

  • Online co-op with friends

  • Work the checkpoint or run the store

  • Screen customers with documents, x-ray, photos and temperature checks

  • Physics-based customers, stock and store chaos

  • Fires, infections, spills and containment breaches

store_data.about_the_game:
The county is yours. So is the blame.

The management sim for the Gaelic games — football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football. Take a county in Ireland, name your fifteen from the parishes that produced them, and answer to a board that remembers everything — four codes on one calendar, and a summer that stops the country.

You are the bainisteoir. Not a chairman, not a director of football; the one on the sideline in a county jacket, appointed by a board that expects par and dreams of more, working with the players your parishes actually produce. Nobody is bought. Everybody is from somewhere.

Four codes, one sideline.

Pick your code — football, hurling, camogie or ladies' football — and the rest run beside you on the one calendar, with real dual counties, dual players, and the fixture congestion that comes with them. Lead with one; the others are always a screen away.

The season as she is played.

January shields under sodium lights. A league where the table pays your bills. Provincial championships, round-robin summer groups, back doors, preliminary quarter-finals, and one final in a national stadium of 82,500. Winner on the day: extra time, then penalties, exactly per the regulations.

Match days you actually manage.

Watch the game live; a ticking clock, an ambient ball, replays for the scores that matter. Make your switches while the play runs, burn your subs, pick your moment for the speech at the break, and stand over the result afterward.

A system, not a formation.

Restarts, shape, press and tempo: four levers that each buy their edge somewhere by paying for it somewhere else. Name a free-taker, a long-range taker, a target man. Put a marker on their danger man, tight or goal-side — whether he does the job is his character, not your team talk. Change any of it from the sideline and it lands at the next passage of play.

A county, not a squad list.

Players come up from real club country; surnames that belong to their ground, a Power where Powers are from. Call a club man into the panel, retrain a corner-back into a midfielder, nurse the panel through training knocks, and answer the disciplinary post on time or lose your man for the summer. What you see is what your selectors know: a stranger's figures are a guess until somebody watches him.

A quiet word.

Praise a purple patch, demand more of a slump, reassure the player losing their Sundays, contest a dual player's weekend with the other code, or talk somebody out of the boats for one more winter. One word per player per month: talk constantly and the room tunes you out.

The county happens to you.

Between the Sundays the post arrives: a wedding the night before a championship match, a J1 summer in Boston, the river in the street and the parish out with sandbags, a greyhound running Thursday. Ten days to answer, and the consequences run through the same systems as everything else. Write your own in plain JSON and share them through the Steam Workshop.

Careers with consequences.

Board confidence, severance cheques, sackings, and the job market that follows them. Have a good year and another county's board makes a quiet call; have a bad one and read about your own position in the paper. Start with a county, take whatever the dice give you, or start with nothing at all and wait for a phone that may not ring. Silverware buys patience. Drift buys none.

Feature list

  • All four codes fully simulated: football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football — one save, one calendar

  • 36 county boards: the island's 32 plus London, New York, Warwickshire and Lancashire

  • Exact modern season structures: shields, league finals, provincial championships, round-robin groups, tiered cups, preliminary quarter-finals and a national series that ends in high summer

  • Live match engine with on-the-fly subs, team talks, injuries and discipline drawn from the official playing rules

  • Tactics that read as a system: restarts, shape, press, tempo, marking jobs and named takers, changed mid-match

  • Deep counties: club call-ups, position retraining, staff market, finances, gate receipts and procedural county crests

  • Scouting that gates what you know — point your selectors' week and watch the file fill in

  • One-on-ones with your players: praise, demand, reassure, contest a dual man's weekend, talk him out of the boats

  • Stories with consequences, moddable in plain JSON and shared through the Steam Workshop

  • The match report: every man's rating, score, assists, turnovers and saves on one sheet, kept season after season

  • Careers remembered year by year with medals and Player of the Match awards — players and backroom alike

  • Career stakes: board expectations, dismissals, approaches from other counties, a working job market

  • Season honours: awards, an All-County Fifteen, the top scorer race, head-to-head ledgers and the full roll of honour

  • The county underneath: U20 springs and club championships fully played, watchable from the stand — and the call-up rows they start

  • Deterministic world seeds — share a seed, share a world

store_data.about_the_game:
Packages Fell Over

At the start, the warehouse is filled with waiting boxes scattered on the floor and empty pallets. As you stack the boxes onto pallets and transport them to the appropriate shelves, the clutter gives way to a clean, organized, and spacious warehouse.

Order That Grows as You Stack

Whether you transport boxes with a hand truck or stack them one by one directly onto pallets, the choice is yours. Load your completed pallets onto shelves using various transport vehicles. With every finished shelf, you take one step closer to unlocking new abilities and upgrades. Get lost in the rhythm of organizing and complete the warehouse step by step at your own pace.

Grow, Speed Up, Organize!

Unlock new abilities as you progress and upgrade your existing skills. Carry boxes with ease, sprint for longer, locate target packages faster, and identify the correct shelves more quickly. With every upgrade you earn, organizing the warehouse becomes smoother and more efficient.

Key Features

  • 3 different vehicles for transporting pallets and placing them on shelves

  • A total of 3,069 boxes to stack across 108 pallets

  • 12 main categories, each with 3 subcategories, and 3 pallet loads of boxes in every subcategory

  • Unlockable abilities such as automatic hand truck loading and package sense

  • A calm and relaxing organization experience with no time pressure—progress at your own pace

store_data.about_the_game:
The stars were divided by design.

The Ancients scattered humanity. One crew can reunite it.

Find the home world. End the Ancient threat.

Broken Orbits is a fast-paced top-down space-combat campaign for one to four players. Boost through dense fleet battles, evade missile swarms, tear apart capital ships, and breach massive rotating fortresses as the screen fills with weapons, enemies, and environmental chaos.

Every successful mission can transform your build. Loot new weapons and rare prototype effects, unlock two specialized upgrade branches for each weapon, and combine six combat systems into a ship that fights exactly the way you want.

Flood space with seeker swarms. Pierce formations with rail lances. Chain electricity between ships, detonate gravity mines, disrupt entire fleets with EMP weapons, or launch armored torpedoes into fortress cores. In co-op, combine different loadouts to overwhelm enemies in ways no single ship could manage alone.

Fight through a complete three-chapter storyline that begins with dangerous salvage work and escalates into a war against the Ancients, the machine civilization responsible for destroying every society powerful enough to challenge it.

Win missions, extract powerful technology, expand your arsenal, strengthen your base, and build the crew capable of finishing the war.

Fight fast. Loot something strange. Come back stronger.

store_data.about_the_game:
The house is dark. Your flashlight is dying.

Something laughs in the ballroom beneath Grisewood Manor. You have a pistol, a failing flashlight, and however many rooms you can survive on the way down.

THE HOUSE ON GRISEWOOD is a top-down gothic horror shooter about limited light and limited resources. Every room is black until you sweep it. Walls swallow your beam, corners hide what's waiting, and the battery counting down in your hand is the only reason you can see at all.

Light is a resource

Your flashlight carves a narrow cone through the dark, and it does not last forever. Switch it off to save power and the manor closes in around you. Leave it on and you will be blind when it matters. Batteries are scavenged, never guaranteed.

Every shot is a decision

Six rounds in the revolver and a slow reload. A shotgun if you find one, and shells if you're lucky. Ammunition is scarce enough that running is often smarter than fighting — and knowing which is which is the difference between life and death.

The things in the dark are not all the same

Shamblers press forward without stopping. Grinners lunge from beyond your light. Weepers freeze in your beam and move the instant it leaves them. Something tall breathes in rooms you haven't reached yet. Learn what each one does, or learn the hard way.

Descend

Nineteen rooms of a rotting manor — library, chapel, conservatory, crypt — connected in ways that don't always make sense. Find your way down to the ballroom and end what's laughing there.

ZOMBIE SURVIVAL MODE

Sealed inside the Grand Hall with the doors boarded shut. Waves arrive out of the black and never stop coming. Scavenge rounds, batteries and bandages from supply caches scattered across the floor — which means leaving the corner you're hiding in. Survive as long as you can, then go again.

content_descriptors.notes:
The House on Grisewood is a horror game and contains sustained frightening content.

Violence and gore: The player uses firearms against humanoid supernatural enemies. Combat produces visible blood spatter, pooling blood on the floor, and blood trails tracked underfoot. Enemies are depicted as emaciated, disfigured human figures. There is no dismemberment or graphic anatomical detail, and the art style is low-resolution and stylized rather than photorealistic.

Horror and startle content: The game is played almost entirely in darkness with a limited flashlight, and is designed around sudden appearances of enemies at close range. It contains jump scares, screen-shake, brief red screen flashes when the player is injured, and distressing audio including screaming, crying, laughter, and breathing. Players sensitive to sudden loud noise or abrupt visual shifts should be aware of this.

Themes: The setting involves a haunted house, death, and the implied deaths of previous occupants. The player character can die, and death is depicted on screen.

The game does not contain sexual content or nudity, sexual violence, drug or alcohol use, self-harm, suicide, or violence against children. There is no profanity.

store_data.about_the_game:
Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment.

Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1–4 players. Order products, carry boxes, stock shelves, set prices, run checkout, and clean up customer messes. Work alone or split the jobs with friends while customers fill the store with rude, strange, and completely unnecessary commentary.

DO THE WORK

  • Order products: Choose what the store needs and pay for delivery boxes using the store’s money.

  • Carry and stock: Move physical boxes through the store, assign products to compatible shelves, and keep the sales floor supplied.

  • Organize overstock: Move extra products into backroom storage so they are ready when shelves run low.

  • Set prices: Control each product’s store-wide selling price. Charge too much and customers may refuse to buy.

  • Run checkout: Scan and bag individual products, accept payments, and count out the correct cash change.

  • Clean the store: Deal with the messes customers leave behind before they affect the next shopper.

DEAL WITH THE CUSTOMERS

  • Customers enter the store, search for products, react to what they find, queue, pay, and leave.

  • Missing products, high prices, dirty floors, long waits, and checkout problems can damage an individual customer’s experience.

  • Customer outcomes feed into complaints, store reputation, and future customer traffic.

  • Customers also deliver a growing collection of voiced remarks that are rude, strange, personal, or simply unnecessary. There are no dialogue choices. You just have to hear them.

GROW THE BUSINESS

  • Unlock additional products and the fixtures required to sell them.

  • Purchase and place new shelves, refrigerators, freezers, registers, and other store equipment.

  • Hire physical cashiers, stockers, and cleaners who perform real store jobs.

  • Add backroom storage space as the operation grows.

  • Balance sales against product costs, wages, rent, utilities, equipment, and expansion purchases.

WORK ALONE OR TOGETHER

  • Play solo or share one online store with up to three other players.

  • Split up stocking, checkout, cleaning, ordering, pricing, and store organization however you want.

  • Money, inventory, customers, employees, progression, and the physical store are shared by the whole group.

  • The host’s store persists between sessions, including its fixtures, stock, unlocks, employees, reputation, and finances.

MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT

  • Prepare the store before opening and decide what needs attention first.

  • Keep checkout moving, shelves stocked, and messes under control while customers are inside.

  • Finish the remaining work after customer entry ends, then clock out when the team is ready.

  • Review sales, expenses, profit, customer outcomes, reputation changes, and stock problems in the end-of-day report.

You will not have enough time to do everything. Make meaningful progress, learn what went wrong, and come back with a better plan tomorrow.

Stock the shelves. Balance the books. Survive the customers.

store_data.about_the_game:
A first-person horror set in a locked mansion the size of a city block. Carry three scrolls out of a 200-metre labyrinth while a man with an axe walks its corridors. Your flashlight is the only thing he will not walk into.

You are not a hero. You are a contractor.

The paperwork calls it an extraction job: enter the mansion, recover three artifacts, walk back out, and the corporation wipes what is left of your sentence. The fine print mentions an outsider on the premises, armed. The briefing gives you exactly one useful fact about him — he cannot stand direct light in the eyes.

The mansion is a labyrinth of 200 by 200 metres: five-metre corridors under 4.6-metre ceilings, sixteen halls swallowed into the floor plan, and lamps that stand like islands in the dark. The building does not light itself for you. Between the lamps there is only the cone of your flashlight, and that  cone is also your weapon — a short protective burst that pushes him back and then leaves you in the dark for two full minutes while it recovers.

He hunts by sight and by sound. He hears you sprint. He hears a bottle drop. Sixty wardrobes stand along the corridors, and behind their doors you can wait him out while the floor creaks and you count the seconds. Get it wrong and the last thing you hear is not footsteps.

The labyrinth does not remember your path — so you leave one. Throw coloured glowsticks and the corridors slowly fill with your own breadcrumb trail, up to two dozen burning at once. Drop a noise trap and he walks toward the sound instead of toward you. Drink from a bottle and your legs hold out a little longer. Every one of those is a choice made in the dark with something moving two corridors away.

The scrolls are somewhere in the building. Ten seconds of the tracker will show you where — once a minute. Take all three and the tracker turns around and points you at the only door that opens outward.

Getting in was the easy part.

KEY FEATURES:

  • A 200 x 200 METRE MANSION-LABYRINTH. Five-metre corridors, 4.6-metre ceilings, sixteen halls, 145 lamps, seventy pieces of furniture. Built as a single continuous space with no loading screens.

  • ONE HUNTER, NO WEAPONS. A man with an axe walks the corridors, hunts by sight and sound, and never stops. You cannot fight him. You can blind him for a moment, hide from him, or outrun him — nothing else.

  • THE FLASHLIGHT IS A RESOURCE. Six seconds of protective light, then two minutes of darkness while the charge comes back. Spend it wrong and the next encounter is unarmed.

  • SIXTY PLACES TO HIDE. Step into a wardrobe, hold still, and listen to how close he passes.

  • LEAVE YOUR OWN LIGHT BEHIND. Infinite coloured glowsticks, up to 24 burning at once, turn an amnesiac labyrinth into a map you drew yourself.

  • NOISE IS A TOOL. 24 noise traps pull him away from where you need to be. 36 water bottles keep your stamina alive.

  • A TRACKER, NOT A MAP. Ten seconds of scroll vision, sixty seconds of cooldown — and after the third scroll it points to the exit.

  • SET UP YOUR OWN RUN. Three difficulty profiles, plus switches for hiding spots, noise lures, glowsticks and the ceiling lamps. Turn off the lights and the mansion becomes a different game.

  • A PROLOGUE THAT IS NOT A MENU. The job starts in a prison cell, with the terms read out loud.

  • NEW ARTIFACT POSITIONS EVERY RUN. Each new game rolls a fresh seed for the three scrolls.

  • 5 STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS.

There is no safe route. There is only the one you can still walk back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Minesweeper 3D rebuilds the familiar logic puzzle across four geometries with different cell connections. Numbers still tell you how many mines touch a cell, but each field changes how you read the space and plan the next move.

Rotate every field, follow numbers across the seams of a hexagonal prism, and read the four connected faces of a tetrahedron. Start on Novice, master each shape, then unlock the higher-risk Expert difficulty. The first move is always safe, and an unfinished round is saved automatically.

Features:

  • four distinct field geometries;

  • Novice and Expert difficulty levels;

  • an always-safe first move;

  • quick neighbour clearing around correctly flagged numbers;

  • automatic saving of unfinished rounds;

  • five achievements for mastering shapes and alternate play styles;

  • complete English and Russian interface localization;

  • mouse and keyboard controls;

  • untimed single-player play.

Controls | Action | Mouse | Keyboard |:

  • | Reveal a cell | Left click | Enter or Space |

  • | Toggle a flag | Right click | Shift+Enter, Shift+Space, or F on the selected cell |

  • | Select a cell | Point and click | Arrow keys, Home, End |

  • | Rotate the 3D field | Drag | — |

  • | Zoom | Mouse wheel | On-screen + and − controls |

  • | Flag mode | Flag button | F |

  • | New round | Restart button | R |

  • | Reset view | Reset button | 0 |

  • | Menu/back | Menu button | Escape |

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR DECISIONS WILL REACH FAR BEYOND THE BORDER

Seal & Sentence is a medieval document-inspection and decision-making game set at the border of a kingdom on the brink of war. Enforce royal decrees, inspect travelers’ papers, and decide who may enter the realm.

But not every traveler is who they claim to be.

INSPECT THE DOCUMENTS

Compare names, seals, portraits, travel permits, and kingdom records. Discover forged papers and contradictory statements. One careless mistake could allow a spy, smuggler, or wanted criminal to cross the border.

INTERROGATE THE SUSPICIOUS

Question travelers and compare their answers with the information in their documents. Search for suspicious possessions, expose lies, and detain people when necessary. But remember: not everyone who appears suspicious is guilty.

OBEY THE CROWN

The rules at the border may change each day. Citizens of certain kingdoms may be banned, new documents may become mandatory, and arrest warrants may be issued for specific individuals. Fail to follow your orders, and you will pay the price.

CHOOSE BETWEEN DUTY AND CONSCIENCE

Not everyone who approaches your gate is a criminal. You will encounter families fleeing war, desperate refugees, merchants, soldiers, and strangers hiding dangerous intentions. Will you enforce the law, or do what you believe is right?

Your decisions may affect not only the outcome of the day, but also the people you encounter later and the fate of the kingdom itself.

FEATURES

• Inspect documents, royal seals, and personal information.
• Interrogate suspicious travelers and search their belongings.
• Adapt to new rules and royal decrees each day.
• Respond to bribes, threats, and moral dilemmas.
• Follow the stories of characters who return to your checkpoint.
• Unlock different events and consequences through your decisions.

A restless line waits beyond the gate. New orders lie on your desk. Difficult decisions rest in your hands.

Stamp the seal. Pass the sentence.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Hitherto High, his Majesty's Magic School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration! You play as the teacher at this illustrious school. Train your students in the ways of magic to ready them for their final exams!!

THE GAMEPLAY

This is a turn-based tile-based tactics game. Every turn, you position your students across the battlefield to make attacks. Every turn, the enemy students will make counterattacks. By defeating enemy students, you earn experience. Earn enough experience and you level-up! Pick a special powerup as part of the levelup.

THE STUDENTS

You have 3 students, each with their own unique method of earning experience.

  • The Punk: Earns experience by tanking damage.

  • The Nerd: Earns experience by dealing damage.

  • The Goth: Earns experience by healing.

Take careful note of each of your students and how they learn best!

THE CURRICULUM

You play through a series of 10 stages. The tenth stage are your final exams. You must grind enough experience and levels before that tenth level, or you'll flunk out. You can play all 10 stages in roughly 2 hours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Overview

"A detective's intuition alone isn't enough to solve a case. Examine the scene carefully."

『Sanitecty』 is a 2D detective adventure game where you investigate mysterious cases across a variety of locations, from high-speed trains to hotels. Bandoha, a private detective with an emotional perspective unlike most people's, spends her days solving cases alongside her boyfriend and assistant, Sion, while trying to live an ordinary life. Collect testimonies and traces, connect hypotheses with evidence, and uncover the truth hidden behind each case.

Standalone episodic chapters: From a murder aboard a speeding high-speed train to a quiet hotel, each chapter presents a new setting, new suspects, and a new case to solve.

A modern Korean setting: Experience a unique, analog-style mystery set against the calm and refined backdrop of contemporary Korea.

Key Features

  • Crime Scene Investigation
    Don't overlook even the smallest detail. Carefully observe and investigate each scene to uncover clues. Not every piece of information is relevant. It is up to you to determine which clues hold the key to the case.

  • Suspect Interrogation
    Question suspects with their own motives and personalities. New questions become available as you uncover additional evidence. Find the contradictions hidden within their statements.

  • Evidence-Based Deduction
    Place the clues you've collected on a whiteboard and connect them to hypothesis nodes. When the right hypothesis is linked to the evidence that logically supports it, you'll unlock the key to solving the case.

  • Uncover the Hidden Truth
    Piece together the trick and method behind each crime, and the truth that has been hidden from view will finally be revealed.

store_data.about_the_game:
BACKUP_71. The truth never dies. It waits to be found.

After his father's mysterious death, Victor Gottlieb returns to his childhood home to care for his aging mother.

What begins as a quiet visit soon turns into a psychological nightmare. Strange fungal growth spreads throughout the house, forgotten documents reveal fragments of a hidden past, and an old computer begins communicating with someone or something that should not exist.

As reality slowly unravels, Victor must investigate the house, survive the growing infestation, and uncover secrets that were never meant to resurface.

INVESTIGATE A HIDDEN PAST

Explore every room of the house, uncover hidden compartments, examine photographs, journals, tapes, classified reports, and piece together decades of forgotten history.

Use a fully interactive retro computer to browse files, recover corrupted documents, solve puzzles, and communicate with an unknown presence.

SURVIVE THE INFESTATION

Monitor the fungus growth, prepare treatments, craft chemical compounds, and prevent it from spreading throughout the house. Ignore it for too long, and you will regret it.

EVERY RESOURCE MATTERS

Manage limited supplies while balancing exploration, investigation, and survival.

Your decisions affect the condition of the house, your own sanity, and the people still living inside.

A PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR EXPERIENCE

As Victor's mind deteriorates, hallucinations, impossible events, and disturbing encounters blur the line between memory and reality. Can you trust what you see?

FEATURES

  • Investigate a house filled with hidden secrets.

  • Fully interactive retro desktop simulator.

  • Manage a living fungal infestation.

  • Solve environmental and computer-based puzzles.

  • Multiple unique investigation minigames.

  • Rich narrative inspired by Cold War conspiracies and psychological horror.

  • Multiple endings based on your choices.

  • Ambience that mixes tension with frightening vocal elements.

Some secrets should never be recovered.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Reaching this place with nothing but a mortal body… is truly impressive.
As an omniscient and omnipotent god, hehe… do you wish to know the truth?
If you want the answer, you must pay the price. Let me see if you truly possess the power to bear it.”

That day…

The tribe you lived in was consumed by a plague of black smoke.
Everyone within it died in this meaningless catastrophe.

For miles around, trees withered instantly, the land dried and cracked, and no living creature survived.

The tribe elder once said:

“This land is protected by Kai.
She will bless this earth and all of her people…”

But the nightmare that continued to linger in your dreams never disappeared.

To seek power.
To take revenge against the nightmare that haunted you.

You began searching for greater and stronger power.

Until the day you met her…

The power of Kai can burn away all impurities in this world.

Even… the moon in the sky.

But the proud flames of Kai will never allow a mortal to touch her fire.

Angry mortal…

If you wish to endure the power of the sun, then fight.

Use the blood of the apocalypse to temper your mortal body.
Use the blessings of the gods to make yourself stronger.

As for that shattered moon…

Beautiful, yet miserable.
A sight that brings sadness… even disgust.

But after all…

On the day you opened your eyes for the first time,
it was the only light that shone upon you.

Powers of the Valkyries

From the authorities of the gods who govern:

Protection, Sky, Rivers, Wealth, Speed, and War

The Valkyries transform their powers into weapons, which will randomly appear during your journey.

You can pick up and equip two weapons, combining their powers together.

Switch between them freely during battle, adapt to changing battlefield situations, and choose the weapon most suitable for different enemies.

By defeating enemies with the corresponding Valkyrie's weapon, you will earn their recognition and increase their favor toward you.

Divine Powers Beyond Weapons

Weapons are not the only gifts from the Valkyries.

After choosing a Valkyrie's authority weapon, you will gain her divine power.

These powers allow you to unleash the Valkyrie's exclusive abilities:

  • Small Skills

  • Big Skill

When you possess the authority of two Valkyries at the same time, their powers will expand and create additional Valkyrie synergy abilities—the hidden connection between their divine forces.

A total of six skills can be combined.

Through proper combinations, adaptation, and combat strategy, create your own powerful skill pool.

Perform incredible combat sequences, greatly increase Valkyrie favor, and unlock exclusive illustrations and special abilities.

Countless Blessings Guide Your Journey

Every Valkyrie has their own weapon blessings and universal blessings.

When holding a Valkyrie's weapon, you can receive blessings that enhance:

  • Weapon abilities

  • Skills

  • Exclusive mechanics

These blessings make your weapons easier to control and strengthen your divine powers.

Even without holding their weapons, you can still receive universal blessings from Valkyries and gain their enhancements.

Some blessings can directly modify the way divine powers are released, changing skill modules and making them better suited to your combat style.

Certain blessings can be obtained repeatedly, allowing you to create extreme builds and achieve overwhelming power.

Use every blessing wisely.

Create the perfect build.

Make every battle more satisfying and efficient.

A Unique Health System & Fluid Combat

Hide small amounts of instant damage and reward powerful burst combinations as well as high-speed continuous damage builds.

Experience the thrill of stacking massive damage to remove a huge portion of an enemy's health in a single strike.

Or unleash rapid attacks that continuously tear enemies apart.

With instant response and flexible movement systems, every action can be controlled and adjusted.

React to every enemy move.

Experience the satisfaction of defeating bosses and monsters with only a small amount of health remaining.

Everything Slows Down

When danger approaches, performing a perfectly timed dodge or releasing certain skills will slow down time itself.

Everything seems to stop.

In that brief moment, seize the opportunity and counterattack.

Feel the changing speed of time.

Move through the battlefield with precision.

Strike down every monster standing in your way.

Even in the most desperate moments…

Find your chance to fight back.

store_data.about_the_game:
■ Overview

Shin Jinrui Complex is a cinematic text adventure about a scientist on a mission to save her dying world, only to become stranded aboard a derelict spaceship drifting at the edge of the universe. As she uncovers the ship's forgotten traces, her consciousness is drawn into memories from different points in time.

Experience the intertwined stories of three protagonists living across separate timelines through stunning 2D character art, immersive 3D environments, and cinematic presentation. Every choice you make shapes the path toward the truth—and the ending.

■ A Mission to Find a New Home

Year 256 of the Stellar Calendar.

In a solar system ruled by highly intelligent civilizations, the homeworld Terra Prime is slowly approaching extinction as abnormal solar activity threatens all life.

Biological environmental scientist Solaris embarks on an expedition alongside her assistant robot G-30 to search for a new habitable planet. During the journey, however, a distress signal from the far reaches of space changes her fate forever.

The signal leads her to a colossal derelict spaceship drifting silently through the void. Forced to make an emergency landing, Solaris begins exploring its decaying corridors, where she encounters an inexplicable phenomenon. Every object and trace left behind pulls her consciousness into another time, allowing her to relive the memories of those who once lived aboard the vessel.

■ Three Stories Across Time

store_data.about_the_game:
COLLAPSE THE FIELD. REACH THE TRANSFER. SURVIVE THE VECTOR.

Collapse Vector is a fast-paced top-down space arcade game about piloting an experimental probe through unstable celestial fields.

Dodge cascading debris, gather collapsing matter, activate transfer gates, and escape before the field becomes impossible to control.

WHAT LEVEL CAN YOU REACH?

The Transfer Gauntlet is the heart of Collapse Vector: an escalating arcade challenge beginning at Level 001, building toward Level 100, and continuing beyond.

Every successful transfer sends you into a more dangerous field. Hazards become faster, denser, and increasingly unpredictable as celestial threats combine in ways that test your reactions, judgment, and probe build.

Collect what you need and escape—or remain in the collapsing field a little longer for greater rewards. Every second you overstay could strengthen your run or end it.

Push deeper. Develop your probe. Chase personal records. Find out how far you can survive.

EXPERIENCE THE VECTOR INCIDENT

Take on an authored campaign featuring 10 operations across two acts.

Navigate the Operations Map, complete multi-phase objectives, recover lost records, pursue mission mastery, and trace the collapse from the inner system to Jupiter and Saturn.

The campaign and Transfer Gauntlet maintain their own flight records, progression, statistics, difficulty settings, and suspended runs.

SURVIVE THE COLLAPSE

Every flight takes place inside an increasingly unstable field filled with shifting gravity, moving celestial bodies, violent ruptures, shockwaves, and chain-reaction destruction.

Read the field. Protect your probe. Collect the matter you need. Reach the transfer before the chaos closes in.

BUILD YOUR PROBE

Bank matter and earn talent points across three interconnected upgrade paths:

  • Deep Harvest — Improves collection range, warning systems, and matter yield.

  • Armored Transfer — Strengthens shields, collision recovery, and defensive control.

  • Overdrive — Rewards speed, aggressive flight, and high-risk extraction.

Choose between multiple ranks, branching upgrades, mutually exclusive paths, and powerful capstone protocols.

You cannot take everything. Build your probe around the way you want to fly.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR FLIGHT

Unlock hull finishes, engine effects, and ion trails through Gauntlet milestones, campaign accomplishments, celestial encounters, risky collections, and long-term mastery.

Configure and preview your probe inside the Probe Bay, with cosmetic progression shared across both modes.

CHOOSE YOUR LEVEL OF CHAOS

Select from four difficulty profiles:

  • A reduced-pressure practice mode for new pilots

  • The intended standard experience

  • A faster High Tempo challenge

  • An extreme Apex stress test

Standard and higher difficulties provide full mastery and cosmetic-unlock eligibility.

CORE FEATURES

  • Transfer Gauntlet progression from Level 001 to Level 100 and beyond

  • An endless high-level challenge built around one question: How far can you reach?

  • 10-operation campaign across two acts

  • Authored objectives, scripted phases, optional challenges, and recovered records

  • Responsive top-down gravity flight

  • Dynamic celestial fields and escalating hazard combinations

  • Planets, stars, black holes, ruptures, debris, shockwaves, and chain reactions

  • Matter collection, transfer gates, and overstay risk-versus-reward

  • Three branching talent trees with capstone upgrades

  • Four difficulty profiles

  • Unlockable hull, engine, and trail cosmetics

  • Named flight records with persistent progression and suspend-and-resume support

  • Career statistics, personal records, run history, and a Celestial Codex

  • Mouse and keyboard controls with remappable controller support

  • Adjustable graphics, audio, interface, motion, flash, contrast, and warning-color settings

  • A stylized journey through a collapsing solar system

  • Available in 8 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean

store_data.about_the_game:
Fantasy Auto Chess combines elements of roguelite gameplay, extraction-based progression, and auto chess.

Through a series of battles, you will gradually expand your squad of Heroic Spirits. Judge your current strength, decide whether to fight to the bitter end or retreat in time, and bring a number of Heroic Spirits out of the run based on the result. These spirits become permanent assets, helping you gain a stronger start in future runs or unlock more strategic options.

With an ever-expanding pool of strategies and a highly unpredictable adventure journey, every run offers different choices, surprises, and enjoyment.

Collect Unique Heroic Spirits

These Heroic Spirits come from the histories, legends, myths, and fantasies of different civilizations. Freed from the constraints of PvP, players can collect and build their own teams at their own pace.

The experience is meant to capture the feeling of lining up toys from different childhood cartoons and letting them battle against each other.

Turn the Tide with Support Skills

Some Heroic Spirits come with special support skills. Simply placing them in your backpack can unlock active abilities or grant your team continuous bonuses.

A well-timed manual skill can help you escape a desperate situation, while passive bonuses may greatly empower certain team archetypes.

Talents Make Every Spirit Distinct

Each Heroic Spirit has its own talent pool, and some exclusive talents are especially powerful.

Through the inheritance system outside of battle, talents can be transferred between Heroic Spirits, creating unexpected combinations. Some Heroic Spirits can even undergo major evolutions after meeting the requirements of their exclusive talents.

Winning Is Not Everything — What Matters Is How Much You Win

You can enter a run with only one Heroic Spirit for a low-risk expedition, or bring up to six Heroic Spirits for an all-out assault.

Victory, defeat, and mid-run retreat can all bring rewards. Every approach has its own risks, gains, and unique fun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the museum. Half the visitors are innocent. The rest are painting your replacement masterpiece in the back room.

Sneak & Snitch is an online social deduction party game where a team of thieves tries to rob a museum blind while a guard on a Segway hunts them down.

PLAY AS A THIEF

Blend into the crowd of visitors and act like you belong. Study a painting, then forge your own copy in the forgery editor: draw the shapes, match the colors, nail the background. Swap the real painting for your fake without getting caught, and cash in. But remember: real visitors never run, never panic, and never stare at the guard. Every move you make can expose you.

PLAY AS THE GUARD

Patrol the museum on your trusty Segway. Compare paintings against the records, investigate suspects, and build your case. Spotted a fake? Find the thief who planted it. Your stun gun guarantees the arrest, but accuse an innocent visitor and you are the one who gets the electric shock.

FEATURES

  • Online PvP social deduction for up to 8 players

  • Asymmetric roles: a team of thieves versus the guard

  • A real forgery mini-game: you actually paint the fake yourself

  • Disguise and acting: move like an NPC, emote like an NPC, fool a human

  • Caught thieves return as ghosts to haunt the museum and watch the chaos

  • A charming cartoony museum full of art worth stealing

Sneak & Snitch is in active development. Wishlist it to follow along!
