store_data.about_the_game:
The forge is the game. The carnage is the proof.

Your wielder fights forever, hands-free, in a burning world that pays in loot.

You never swing the sword. You build the sword — and every rule it obeys.

When the screen fills with chained fire, splitting embers and ghost-blades, that

is not a cutscene. That is your program running.

ENGINEER A WEAPON, DON'T PILOT A HERO

  • One eternal blade, six parts. Each part hosts a behaviour chain:
    WHEN this happens, IF this holds, DO that — TWICE, LOUDER, and AGAIN a moment
    later. 66 modules to wire together.

  • 13 trait families across 5 tiers, each with a branching evolution and
    a final mythic FORK. Two families at tier 2 anywhere on the blade can reveal a
    hidden rune: 48 combinations, discovered only by forging strange things together.

  • Complexity is the budget. Overload the blade and it turns UNSTABLE —
    actions misfire, but everything hits harder. One dial, one honest decision.

STRIKE THE STEEL YOURSELF

  • Every infusion is hammered by hand. Three timed strikes on a white-hot
    band; land them all and a permanent GODFORGED mark goes into the metal.

  • The First Pour. The first time you craft a recipe, you hold the
    crucible yourself — and a crowned pour cuts that recipe's cost forever.

  • A workshop you lay out by hand — 15 structures, freely placed, where
    spacing is the craft: bellows and kilns feed the neighbours they can reach.

A WORLD THAT COUNTERS YOU

  • 8 biomes, 32 chambers, 45 foes, 9 guardians. From the burning
    Cinderwood to the drowned belfry, a wasteland of living glass, a court of
    phased dead, and THE WOUND, where the world first caught fire.

  • The world adapts. Chambers rotate mutators that invalidate exactly one
    strategy at a time — burn-immune hides, brand-reflecting plate, blight drinkers.
    Each tell names its own counter. Read the scouting report. Re-spec. Return.

  • Guardians are not sponges. They stride, they quicken as they bleed,
    and at half blood each bares a fourth signature move — the maw lunges, the court
    charges as one, the world burns in waves.

THE LONG GAME

  • Reforge melts the world and keeps your knowledge, paying godsteel into
    12 permanent Ages tracks.

  • THE ARSENAL. Kill THE FIRST FLAME and you may retire your blade to the
    wall forever. It grants a permanent boon, returns as an heirloom — and the whole
    world levels up to meet the next one.

  • The Hunt. Every foe keeps a lifetime chronicle. Study a whole biome's
    prey and that ground yields a permanent trophy.

  • Recipes the world teaches you — some blueprints are never sold or
    unlocked. They are found, by doing something the world noticed.

AN IDLE GAME THAT RESPECTS YOUR PRESENCE

  • No offline progression. The forge earns while the window is open —
    built for the second monitor, not the alarm clock.

  • Automate the tedium: refining queues, auto-extract priorities, build
    presets, and a commission board paying collectible one-off modules.

  • Defeat is information, never loss. Death costs the cycle, not the
    loot. The failure analysis names the rule you should rewrite.

    a final mythic FORK. Two families at tier 2 anywhere on the blade can reveal a
    hidden rune: 48 combinations, discovered only by forging strange things together.

  • Complexity is the budget. Overload the blade and it turns UNSTABLE —
    actions misfire, but everything hits harder. One dial, one honest decision.

STRIKE THE STEEL YOURSELF

  • Every infusion is hammered by hand. Three timed strikes on a white-hot
    band; land them all and a permanent GODFORGED mark goes into the metal.

  • The First Pour. The first time you craft a recipe, you hold the
    crucible yourself — and a crowned pour cuts that recipe's cost forever.

  • A workshop you lay out by hand — 15 structures, freely placed, where
    spacing is the craft: bellows and kilns feed the neighbours they can reach.

A WORLD THAT COUNTERS YOU

  • 8 biomes, 32 chambers, 45 foes, 9 guardians. From the burning
    Cinderwood to the drowned belfry, a wasteland of living glass, a court of
    phased dead, and THE WOUND, where the world first caught fire.

  • The world adapts. Chambers rotate mutators that invalidate exactly one
    strategy at a time — burn-immune hides, brand-reflecting plate, blight drinkers.
    Each tell names its own counter. Read the scouting report. Re-spec. Return.

  • Guardians are not sponges. They stride, they quicken as they bleed,
    and at half blood each bares a fourth signature move — the maw lunges, the court
    charges as one, the world burns in waves.

THE LONG GAME

  • Reforge melts the world and keeps your knowledge, paying godsteel into
    12 permanent Ages tracks.

  • THE ARSENAL. Kill THE FIRST FLAME and you may retire your blade to the
    wall forever. It grants a permanent boon, returns as an heirloom — and the whole
    world levels up to meet the next one.

  • The Hunt. Every foe keeps a lifetime chronicle. Study a whole biome's
    prey and that ground yields a permanent trophy.

  • Recipes the world teaches you — some blueprints are never sold or
    unlocked. They are found, by doing something the world noticed.

AN IDLE GAME THAT RESPECTS YOUR PRESENCE

  • No offline progression. The forge earns while the window is open —
    built for the second monitor, not the alarm clock.

  • Automate the tedium: refining queues, auto-extract priorities, build
    presets, and a commission board paying collectible one-off modules.

  • Defeat is information, never loss. Death costs the cycle, not the
    loot. The failure analysis names the rule you should rewrite.
store_data.short_description: You are the blacksmith, not the hero. Forge ONE Godblade, program its behaviour like a machine, and watch it fight for you with a single swing. Wire trait chains, hammer the steel by hand, and re-engineer everything each time the world adapts to kill your build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slowdrift is an arcade drift game. Slide through a city at night, link corners
into a chain, and decide when to bank it — or push one more corner and risk the
lot.

Commit, Or Lose It


  • Chain scoring: link corners without straightening up and the
    multiplier climbs, but everything you've earned sits unbanked until the chain
    drops. Crash before it does and you were never holding it.
  • Close calls: the biggest points in the game come from passing a wall
    near enough to feel it — and they pay more in the dark, or in fog, when you
    didn't know the wall was there
  • A move for every corner: SIDEWAYS, SWITCHBACK, STRIKE, CLEARED IT,
    SEND IT. Each one bumps the multiplier and buys another second of chain
  • One ring on the HUD: time until this pays out and resets. Everything
    you do is aimed at that ring

DRIFT


One fixed city, the same streets for every player, running from midday through
to deep night. No lives, no run to lose — just the layout and however long you
want with it, until you know it block by block.

A rolling chain of gates pulls you through the grid if you want a line to
follow, and X-ray vision cuts a hole through the building between you and the
corner you can't see round.

CHALLENGE


Take three lives into a branching map of generated levels and see how far you
get. Every node shows its speed, technicality and exposure before you pick it,
and the generator lays out the streets from those same three numbers.

Deeper into a run, the levels start pushing back.

  • DRIFT OR DIE: a clock that only refills while you're sideways, and
    takes a second off you every time you lose the drift
  • THE RED WALL: something grinding up the road behind you that never
    stops, and closes the moment you get comfortable
  • GAUNTLET: no respawns. Crash, and you're back at the start line
  • NIGHT RUN and FOG: these don't kill you. They just take the corner
    away until you're already in it

Each tier's boss becomes the next tier's ordinary evening. THE CITY teaches you
the conditions one at a time and stacks all three on its boss. NO LET UP runs
the clock and the wall on every level. ONE LINE caps how many drifts you're
allowed to start at all — and its boss allows exactly one, start line to finish.

Bosses stay shut until you've banked the reputation to face them. Play it safe
on the way there and you'll arrive with nothing to show.

CHASE


Drive until it catches you.

No finish line, no checkpoints, one life. The red wall sets off behind you and
the drift clock starts draining, and the only thing that refills it is being
sideways. The wall's top pace sits just under yours, so a good run is one you
spend a few car lengths ahead of it for kilometres — every mistake paid out of a
margin you never had.

Easy, medium and hard change how long your leash is, how fast the wall builds,
and how much clock you're given. Distance survived is the whole score.

Make It Yours


  • Four cars, bought with credits earned on challenge runs
  • Paint: primary and secondary panels, fourteen colours
  • A sticker editor: draw 32x32 pixel art in the game, keep a library of
    your designs, and wear four of them on any car — steer each one around the
    bodywork, spin it, size it, fade it
  • Fifteen unlockable skins: mirror chrome, an oil slick that moves,
    holographic interference, a starfield. They're the achievement list as well —
    there's no separate screen, you just see what a locked one is asking for and go
    and do it

Some want a boss beaten. Some want ten kilometres of chase. One wants five
switchbacks inside a single banked drift, and it is not as easy as it sounds.

Leaderboards


Best single drift, best session and best chase, ranked over today, this month
and all time, against your friends or the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Forgotten things do not disappear. They simply lose their way home.

REASSEMBLE SCATTERED FORMS

Discover a glowing silhouette in the haven and step into the Land of Restoration. Search for its scattered pieces, pick them up, rotate them, and place each one in the matching silhouette until the form is whole again.

FILL THE HAVEN WITH 51 RESTORATIONS

Restore 51 forms, from everyday objects and creatures to buildings and guardians. Every restored form remains in the haven, turning each restoration into a lasting part of the world and your collection.

GROW AS A RESTORER

As you restore forms, develop five abilities that support exploration and restoration: Running, Interaction Range, Form Shield, Waypoint, and Held Auto Fit. Move through the haven more easily, reach distant pieces, protect a restoration attempt from an incorrect placement, travel to eligible completed forms, or fit the piece in your hands into place.

RESTORE AT YOUR OWN PACE

There is no combat gameplay and no time limit. Explore the haven, study each silhouette, and take the time you need to rebuild every form.

KEY FEATURES

  • Explore a peaceful, atmospheric fantasy haven from a first-person perspective.
  • Find, pick up, rotate, and place scattered pieces to complete each form.
  • Restore 51 objects, creatures, buildings, and guardians.
  • See every restored form remain in the haven as your collection grows.
  • Develop five supportive abilities and play with no combat gameplay or time limits.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your home system is dying. You have one ship, a handful of specialists, and a heading. There is no new home, just pit stops in the sky.

Continuum is a generation ship roguelite. Hire your founding crew, plot a route between worlds you can't settle, and manage fuel, food, morale, metal, and the hull itself across the void. Each route is a bet: Do you go for the relic, the risky path with more resources, or the planet that has the fuel your lacking. Choose, fly, arrive, resupply.

Nobody you launch with will see the journey's end. Crew age, have children, and die aboard. Their children inherit the ship, the skills and even their parents looks. A generation without an engineer means a hull nobody can repair. A generation without a diplomat means a dispute breaking out. Every leap forward leaves you with a new crew, new strengths, and new gaps to survive.

Along the way, encounter nearly 50 hand-crafted mini-games across voyage events, planet arrivals, and rare encounters. Thread a probe through an ice shell. Strip a derelict for parts before it collapses on you. Seat a dinner table full of people who can't stand each other.

And when the run ends the ship leaves behind a chronicle: a generation-by-generation record of everyone who lived and died aboard. Who was born on which leg. Who took the helm through the debris and held it. Who died of old age with the route charts still open on their terminal. Export it. Keep it. Start again.

  • No win condition. The journey ends when it ends. Get further than last time.

  • Every run is procedural; crew, routes, events, worlds. No two ships fly the same voyage.

  • Nearly 50 mini-games spanning engineering, medicine, science, navigation and social.

  • An exportable chronicle for every run; the full record of your ship, its generations, and everyone you lost along the way.

  • Pets to find, relics to recover, rare encounters to survive.

  • Unlock new modules and features to shape your next launch.

  • A dynamic soundtrack that changes between the sparse void and lively arrival

  • Many unknowns out there, waiting to be found

store_data.about_the_game:
Oriental Martial Fantasy Game: The Fate of Mortals traces the life of one ordinary physician.

In the raw wilderness of high antiquity, among the beasts that crawl out of it, you have to stay alive.

You don't learn martial arts here. You eat them. Dig up the herbs. Brew the elixir. Eat it. That elixir decides the martial art you'll fight with next.

The gourd spirit at your side helps you do it.

One Pill, One Martial Art

Swallow a sword elixir and sword qi runs out of you — you fight as a swordsman. A staff elixir, staff qi. Drink liquor and out come drunken fists.

Nothing accumulates in you. The art is held in the pill, and you borrow it only while the dose lasts. What you packed before you left is how you fight today.

Into the Unknown, Back Alive

The battlefield is generated fresh every time you enter it. The terrain, what's lying around, what's waiting for you — different every run.

Weight and volume are both capped. You decide on the spot what gets left behind. Die and you lose everything you were carrying — what you left at the village stays yours.

Regroup at the Village

Raise workbenches with what you hauled back. Widen your storage. Wrap bandages, simmer remedies, brew and age the elixirs you'll need next.

Tension out there, repair back here, turn and turn about. What you built at the village is your odds of walking back into it.

The Spirit in the Gourd

The gourd spirit woke inside the heirloom your parents left you. Your guide, and your brewing vessel.

The liquid it offers is your first elixir. There is not an endless supply of it.

Before the Martial Arts Had Names

This is high antiquity — no writing, no schools, no established forms. People are only starting to learn how to fight by copying beasts and grasses.

Shennong chewed his way through every grass on earth and wrote down what each one did. You pick up where he left off. This is the story of the man later called the first immortal, back when he was nobody.

Nothing lasts. Not what you carried, not the art you swallowed, not the village you built.

So don't be afraid to lose it. Brew again. Go back out.

store_data.about_the_game:
[For streamers] HUG&BETRAY is a party psychology game designed to be streamed. Live streaming, recording, clips, shorts and monetization are all pre-approved for individuals, companies and agency talents — no permission needed. All music and SFX are original or fully licensed, so there is no Content ID risk. Hashtag: #ハグビット. Full guideline:

Hug, or Betray

Adorable plushies gathered in an ominous dark room.
Every round, all players secretly choose one of three actions — revealed at the same moment.

HUG — Trust and embrace. If everyone hugs, everyone survives
SWORD — Go for the betrayal: cut down a hugger
GUN — Smell the betrayal: shoot down the sword

45 seconds to think.

The real question isn't what you'll play.




It's what they'll play.

Every Lie Gets Exposed

In-game chat is wheel phrases and free comments. "I'm hugging," "Trust me this time," "Someone will betray us" — but nothing anyone says has to be true.
At the reveal, if words don't match actions, a red tag stabs into the message: "→ That was a lie."
The evidence of the betrayal stays on screen, in front of everyone.

Taunt, bluff, and rack up points.

Ever wanted to make your favorite streamer squirm?


Next round — can you still hug them?

The Stream IS the Game Board — A New Kind of Viewer-Participation Game

Until now, "viewer participation" streams meant playing on your own screen while the stream ran in the background — you joined your favorite streamer's game, but you barely watched their stream.

HUG&BETRAY flips that.　The game board is the stream itself.

The round table, the timer, the simultaneous reveal — it all happens on the streamer's screen. Viewers watch the stream and simply pick their move on their phone. No install needed — open a URL in your browser and take a seat at the table.

・Phones never show the results — at the reveal, every player's eyes are on the stream

・Manual host progression lets streamers commentate at their own pace

・Designed to work smoothly even with stream delay

Watch your favorite streamer's reaction — while you betray them.

Play with friends, with viewers, with strangers. Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

Features

・Watch the stream, play from your phone — a new kind of viewer-participation game

・Cute plushies meet an ominous neon-lit dark room

・4–7 players + bot matches (playable solo)

・Fast psychological rounds — 10–15 minutes per match

・A cast of unique plushie characters

A stapler. A pepper grinder. A pickle launcher. Or a skill that drags everyone into a meeting.

Roll Arena is a physics-driven twin-stick roguelite where physics has a personal grudge against you. Roll, aim, shoot, bounce, and slam face-first into walls and enemies. Help Bobby and his friends destroy the daily grind: dive into the arena, loot, blow up anything that moves, and walk out with as much gold as you can carry.

Physics-driven combat

Shove enemies into walls and traps, dodge bullets, sidestep melee charges before they send you flying. Physics matters here, and simply pointing and shooting won't cut it.

Themed arenas

A TV game show. An open-plan office. A supermarket. A casino. Every arena brings its own world, enemies, items and difficulty.

200+ items to unlock

Every item was designed and tuned to make each run fun and completely different, and every arena brings new ones.

Endless mode and leaderboards

Once you've cleared an arena, put your hard-earned gold back on the line and see how much further you can push. Compare your scores with other players and show them who's on top.

Full controller support, keyboard and mouse recommended.

Shove your friends off the bed to get a good night's sleep. Good Night is a PvP party game where you fight by tossing and turning.

Controls

Roll, squirm, and shove. Of course, you cannot move the way you want because you are sleeping. If your sleeping posture becomes messy, calm down. Reset.

Modes & Stages

There are two modes. Survival: fight to be the last one still in bed. Endless: kick down other players within the time limit and get points. The stages: it's not just a simple double bed. There are also a giant bed, an ice bed, and a bed which falls down. The players are crazy. They don't care where they sleep.

Best Shots

The funniest moment is recorded automatically. When the match is over, check the weird posture. Maybe someone becomes a mess.

King Sleeper

You win the battles with bad manners. Congratulations, you can become the King Sleeper. Misbehave yourself.

Multiplayer

Play Online with remote friends, or locally with friends in the same room for up to four people.

Aim for comfortable sleep with wobbly posture and take the throne of King Sleeper.

store_data.about_the_game: After Silence is a story-driven, third-person survival hybrid built in Unreal Engine 5 that seamlessly blends visceral, bodycam-style tactical combat with a deeply personal narrative. Players navigate a decaying dystopian world controlled by the corrupt Black Protocol, utilizing deep gunsmithing customization, realistic physical object interactions, and brutal, high-impact recoil to survive. More than just a shooter, it is an immersive narrative experience where every tactical decision and bullet fired carries the heavy, unforgiving weight of a mother's relentless fight for survival.
store_data.detailed_description:
EARLY ACCESS CONTENT

After Silence is launching in Early Access with a robust foundation of content, allowing players to experience both the narrative depth and the tactical gameplay immediately.

  • Full Narrative Story Mode: Experience the opening chapters of the campaign. A fully realized, cinematic narrative mode that establishes the grimdark world of Evergreen, the collapse of Black Protocol, and Sarah’s desperate fight for her son.

  • Tactical FPS Mode: Drop into high-stakes, standalone combat scenarios. Test your loadouts, refine your mechanics, and survive waves of Black Protocol Cleaners and Hollowed threats in a dedicated, replayable shooter experience.

  • The Shooting Range: A dedicated sandbox environment designed for mastering your arsenal. Test weapon ballistics, experiment with attachment synergies, and learn recoil patterns in a controlled setting before hitting the field.

  • Two Fully Realized FPS Maps:

    • The Container Yard: A claustrophobic, multi-level industrial maze. Navigate stacked shipping containers and rusted catwalks in a high-intensity, close-quarters combat environment.

    • St. Elias Hospital: A sprawling, atmospheric subterranean labyrinth. Move through sterile white corridors, ruined sub-basements, and flickering emergency-lit wards in a tense, survival-horror-infused firefight.

KEY FEATURES

After Silence is not just another tactical shooter; it is a hybrid experience that marries the visceral mechanics of a high-fidelity FPS with the emotional weight of a literary thriller.

  • A True Hybrid Experience: Seamlessly transition between a deep, narrative-driven Story Mode and a robust, mechanically rich Tactical FPS Mode. You aren't just playing a shooter; you are surviving a story.

  • Physics-Based Traversal: Movement matters. Navigate environments using realistic, physics-based mechanics. Vaulting, sliding, and climbing feel weighty and grounded, making every firefight a dynamic, three-dimensional puzzle.

  • Granular Weapon Customization: Overhaul your arsenal with a deep gunsmithing system. Modify barrels, optics, grips, and ammunition types to fundamentally alter weapon handling, recoil patterns, and damage profiles to suit your tactical doctrine.

  • Operator Selection: Choose from a roster of specialized operatives before deploying. Each operator brings unique tactical advantages, passive traits, and starting loadouts, allowing you to tailor your approach to the mission.

  • Visceral, High-Impact Combat: Experience the terrifying weight of every bullet. High recoil, realistic ballistics, and a lethal time-to-kill mean every engagement is a desperate, adrenaline-fueled fight for survival.

FORGED IN FICTION: THE STORY CAME FIRST

Before the first line of code was written, before the first concept sketch was drawn, there was the story. After Silence is built upon the foundation of The Weight of the Silence, a massive, 60,000+ word dystopian thriller novel developed over three years by 16-year-old solo developer Zac (Token Studios).

This is not a game with a script; it is a game with a soul.

  • 16 Chapters of Relentless Narrative: The game's lore is backed by a complete, standalone novel featuring 16 chapters of meticulously crafted prose.

  • 4 Unique Perspectives: The story is told through the eyes of four deeply flawed, morally grey characters: Sarah (the betrayed mother), Vance (the complicit commander), Kaelan (the radicalized rebel), and Dr. Voss (the architect of the horror).

  • A Literary Foundation: By writing the novel first, the world of Evergreen, the mechanics of Compound Z, and the tragic cost of survival were fully realized before the game was ever built. The game doesn't just adapt the book; it expands upon it, allowing you to physically inhabit the devastating world the text created.

In an industry obsessed with transmedia from day one, we took a different path. We believed that story must be the foundation, not an afterthought. After Silence proves that passion has no age limit, and that the most terrifying monsters aren't the ones in the dark—they're the ones who signed the orders.


After Silence Kickstarter Live

The Official Kickstarter Is Now Live

Hello everyone, I have some great news. The Official After Silence Kickstarter is now live! 🎉 Thank you everyone so much for following me along on this journey.

It has been a dream of mine ever since I began developing in unreal engine 5 and to see it now becoming a reality is something I hope for all of you to experience one day.

I couldn't have made it here without you guys and for that I am forever grateful. If you do decide to back just know you have my gratitude!

Thank you all for making a 16 year old's dream come true.


KICKSTARTER CAMPAIGN

THE SILENCE

After Silence is launching a 30-day Kickstarter campaign to help bring this vision to life. The campaign runs alongside the Steam page launch, and here's what you need to know:

THE PROMISE

The game WILL release. Whether we hit our funding goal or not, After Silence is coming to Steam. This project has been three years in the making, and nothing will stop it from reaching you.

But reaching our funding goal means something bigger. It means:

✓ Professional Voice Acting - Full narration for key story moments
✓ Expanded DLC Content - Free post-launch story expansion
✓ Enhanced Audio Design - Professional sound mixing and score
✓ Community Stretch Goals - Unlocked rewards for all backers

JOIN THE RESISTANCE

This isn't just about funding a game. It's about proving that dark, story-driven experiences still matter. That atmospheric survival horror with emotional depth deserves to exist.

Campaign Duration: 30 Days

Game Release: Q4 2026 (Post-Campaign)

Platform: Steam (Windows)

Players navigate a decaying dystopian world controlled by the corrupt Black Protocol, utilizing deep gunsmithing customization, realistic physical object interactions, and brutal, high-impact recoil to survive. store_data.about_the_game:
THEY COME IN BOXES

In the year 2084 an unknown cataclysm swept across the Earth leaving some cities in ruins and shrouding the atmosphere in a dense, toxic fog.

This event changed the world forever.

📦 YOUR JOB

Your task is simple:

  • Look at the boxes coming in.

  • Verify if the boxes are safe.

  • Input your choice.

  • Get the next box.

Remember: YOU ARE ALONE.

📦 THE PACKAGES ARE ALIVE

Every box is a risk. Use the console in front of you to look for the subtle signs of infestation. You have to decide if it's safe to ship or if it needs to be immediately eliminated.

📦 KEY MECHANICS

  • OBSERVE: Look for tell-tale signs on the boxes, along with the descriptions inside the dossier on your right.

  • MANAGE: Decide if you want to immediately check the next box or flip the server switch on as this decision could be your last one...

📦 KEEP THE POWER ON. PLEASE.

You can't just check boxes. Your server is unstable, and constantly crashing.

📦 FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL

  • CHAOS: Lights flicker, networks get out of order.

  • You must constantly tear your eyes away from the packages to run to the server panel and fix Networking, Switches and other failures...

Can you maintain your focus, keep the lights on, and survive your shift? Or will the job finally break you?

store_data.about_the_game:
STRAYWARD is an open-world voxel survival game with co-op support for up to four players. Scavenge supplies, gather resources, build a base, explore multiple maps with a wide variety of weapons, and confront enemies and boss teams permanently stationed throughout the world.

Scavenging, Crafting, and Survival

Explore towns, buildings, and wilderness areas while scavenging items that can be used directly or as crafting materials.

In addition to searching for existing supplies, you can gather resources in the wild, hunt animals, and turn the materials you collect into tools, equipment, weapons, and survival supplies.

Editable Voxel World and Building

The game world is made entirely from editable voxels. You can dig through, destroy, and reshape the terrain and structures around you.

Choose a suitable location to build a shelter, set up areas for storage, crafting, and processing, and arrange your living space according to your own needs.

Equipment and Weapons

Use a variety of melee and ranged weapons to deal with different enemies and combat situations.

The game features a realistic firearm system with authentic ballistics. Different firearms, ammunition types, and shooting conditions all affect how each weapon performs.

Bosses, Multiple Maps, Events, and Points of Interest

The game includes multiple maps that you can travel to and explore. Each map contains its own points of interest, resources, enemies, and events.

Some bosses are not single enemies that appear only once. Instead, they are persistent boss teams made up of multiple members, stationed in specific areas of the map.

During exploration, you may encounter events that can be anticipated and prepared for, as well as unexpected situations that disrupt your original plans.

Up to Four-Player Co-op

Play alone or team up with up to three other players to explore, scavenge, build, and fight together.

The game world is made entirely from editable voxels. You can dig through, destroy, and reshape the terrain and structures around you.

Choose a suitable location to build a shelter, set up areas for storage, crafting, and processing, and arrange your living space according to your own needs.

Equipment and Weapons

Use a variety of melee and ranged weapons to deal with different enemies and combat situations.

The game features a realistic firearm system with authentic ballistics. Different firearms, ammunition types, and shooting conditions all affect how each weapon performs.

Bosses, Multiple Maps, Events, and Points of Interest

The game includes multiple maps that you can travel to and explore. Each map contains its own points of interest, resources, enemies, and events.

Some bosses are not single enemies that appear only once. Instead, they are persistent boss teams made up of multiple members, stationed in specific areas of the map.

During exploration, you may encounter events that can be anticipated and prepared for, as well as unexpected situations that disrupt your original plans.

Up to Four-Player Co-op

Play alone or team up with up to three other players to explore, scavenge, build, and fight together.

Explore, scavenge, gather resources, build shelters, and fight to survive as you venture deeper into an unfamiliar world filled with persistent threats and unexplained phenomena.

store_data.about_the_game:
🎴 MATCH THE FLOWERS. BUILD YOUR YAKU. KNOW WHEN TO STOP.

Hanafuda brings Koi-Koi🐟, the classic two-player Japanese card game to an elegant, tactile 3D tabletop. Take your time against the computer or test your skills and luck against another player online.

A traditional Hanafuda deck contains 48 cards, representing the twelve months of the year through flowers🌸, animals🦌, ribbons🎀, and seasonal scenes🌕. Play a card from your hand to match a month on the table, capture the pair, then reveal a card from the deck and watch the possibilities change again.

Collect Brights, Animals, Ribbons, and Chaff to form Yaku: scoring combinations ranging from dependable foundations to celebrated hands such as Boar-Deer-Butterflies and the Five Brights.

🎴 THE DECISION AT THE HEART OF KOI-KOI

Completing a Yaku presents you with a choice.

Stop and secure your score, or call “Koi-Koi”🐟 and continue playing in pursuit of a greater reward by multiplying your score.

Press your advantage too far, however, and your opponent may complete a Yaku first and turn the round against you. Every captured card changes what remains possible, making timing, observation, probability, and nerve just as important as the cards you draw.

🎴 A CLASSIC GAME, CLEARLY PRESENTED

• Follow the state of every round through at-a-glance card information, organized capture areas, and clear Yaku and scoring feedback.

• Enjoy all 48 seasonal cards as tactile 3D pieces, brought to life with smooth dealing, matching, and capture animations.

• Play solo against the computer or compete in online head-to-head matches.

• Choose a 3-round short game, 6-round half year, or 12-round full year match.

• Learn through a presentation designed to make months, card categories, matching opportunities, and potential Yaku easy to understand.

🎴 BEAUTIFUL, CALM, AND QUIETLY COMPETITIVE

Hanafuda may appear serene, but every round becomes a contest of calculated risk. Build combinations, read your opponent’s captures, and decide whether one more turn is worth everything already gained.

Will you take your points, or call Koi-Koi🐟?

store_data.about_the_game:
Pastimes is a large logic puzzle set inside "Children's Games", the famous painting by Pieter Bruegel from 1560.

At first there is only a vast grid and numbers. Then, cell by cell, the painting comes into view: children rolling hoops, spinning tops, playing leapfrog, blind man's buff… until the whole scene reappears.

The rule is simple: each number tells how many cells must be filled in the 3×3 square around it, counting the number's own cell. By cross-checking the clues, you gradually work out which cells to fill and which to leave empty.

Pastimes is meant to be solved at your own pace, a few minutes at a time or across long sessions.

The entire painting is one large play area, divided into scenes inspired by the different games Bruegel painted. Finish a region and unlock a close-up of the scene, plus a few lines about the game or pastime it shows.

You can work through the whole painting solo, or share the grid with a partner on the same PC. In split-screen, each player has their own camera, zoom, and cursor: you can think side by side on the same area, or head off to solve two completely different spots.

With Steam Remote Play Together, that local co-op can also be shared remotely with a friend.

Your progress is saved automatically: leave whenever you like and pick up later, alone or together.

  • A vast logic grid to solve

  • The gradual reveal of Children's Games by Pieter Bruegel the Elder

  • Scenes to complete, with short historical notes

  • Fully playable as a solo experience

  • Local co-op split-screen

  • Compatible with Steam Remote Play Together

store_data.about_the_game:
A single shot breaks the illusion. A masterpiece hides a stolen truth. Every note brings someone closer to death.

Step behind the velvet curtain of a grand opera house, where art and deception share the same stage. Summoned from the newsroom by Barbara Clark, you arrive to cover the highly anticipated production of Adrian Morro. A closed rehearsal, a prestigious assignment - nothing out of the ordinary. Until...

In the middle of the most intense scene, actor Garrett Vale fires what should have been a blank shot. Instead, a real bullet tears through the air, by chance missing the diva, Evelyn Shaw. Panic spreads. This wasn't an accident!

Constable Melinda Watson confirms your suspicion: the shot was planned. Precise. Timed to the music. Someone turned the performance into an execution.

As you dig deeper, the theater reveals its darker side - whispers of a "cursed opera," rivalries buried in the past, and a forgotten composer's name tied to stolen music and broken lives. From dressing rooms to hidden tunnels beneath the stage, every clue pulls you closer to a truth someone is willing to kill for.

And as opening night approaches, one thing becomes clear: the final act has already been written. The only question is - who survives it.

FEATURES:
★ Investigate a cinematic mystery set inside a living, breathing opera house
★ Explore diverse locations: backstage, rehearsal halls, hotel rooms, and secret underground passages
★ Collect and connect clues: annotated scores, letters, photos, and hidden archive records
★ Uncover a conspiracy driven by ambition, jealousy, and revenge!

Take your seat. The curtain is rising - and the final act may be your own.

store_data.about_the_game:
Have you ever looked up at the sky and thought, "That's obviously a dinosaur"? Congratulations, you already know how to play.

Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds is a sky-gazing simulator where your only goal is to relax, watch the clouds, and discover the hundreds of hidden shapes drifting above you. No rush. No enemies. No explosions. Just you, the sky, and your imagination.

And yes, before you ask: we also recommend watching real clouds whenever you can. The graphics are amazing, and most of the time, they work pretty well.

But we know that's not always possible. Maybe there aren't any clouds where you live today. Maybe your window faces the building next door. Maybe you can't go outside. Or maybe you just feel like enjoying a perfect sky from the comfort of your couch.

That's exactly what Cloudgazer is for.

Features:

  • Hundreds of shapes to discover: From animals and everyday objects to mythical creatures and plenty of surprises.

  • Realistic, dynamic clouds: A natural cloud simulation ensures every sky is different.

  • A full day-night cycle: Experience sunrises, sunsets, starry nights, and every color the sky has to offer.

  • Relax at your own pace: No pressure. No timers. Just you, the sky, and a cloud that insists on looking like a cat.

  • Train your pareidolia: How many shapes can you find?

Real life will always be the best place to watch clouds. But when the sky doesn't cooperate... we'll lend you one.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nobody becomes CEO by working hard. They become CEO by arranging for the work to happen without them.

CEO.exe is an idle game about climbing a corporate ladder, played entirely inside a simulated 1990s office computer — a machine that boots, hums, glows and occasionally crashes. No HUD, no menu screen. A desktop, a taskbar, and a slowly growing number of programs you had to earn.

File it yourself. Then never again.

You start by dragging documents into the filer one at a time, paid per document, binning the red carbons before they cost you the work. Then you write the batch files that do it for you, requisition better hardware out of the IT budget, and set the TURBO jumper to run the machine past what it is rated for. It will get you through the afternoon. It will also, eventually, hand you a blue screen.

Hire the people who replace you

Manager grade gets you staff. Your section clears the tray while you do something else — as long as morale holds, wages go out at 17:00, and you notice who is drowning. The loop you spent an hour mastering becomes a line item somebody else handles.

Then it stops being about the work

At Director there is a table, six rivals and not enough chairs. Influence buys schemes: take credit for somebody else's quarter, strike an alliance, quietly undermine the man ahead of you. Every reorganisation removes the weakest director in the room. Sometimes that is you.

It runs while you are gone

Close the game and the section keeps working. Come back to a payslip, a full inbox and whatever resolved without you. A full climb from intern to the top floor runs roughly nine to ten hours, built to be played in the gaps of a day.

  • A whole fake OS: draggable windows, a boot sequence, error dialogs, and a curved CRT you can turn the scanlines down on

  • SNAKE.EXE and MINES.EXE, for when the tray can wait

  • A run timer and achievements for a second, faster climb

  • No microtransactions, no ads, no timer that asks you for money

CEO.exe is in active development. Follow and Wishlist to stay updated on the process and be the first to play the upcoming Demo!

Close the game and the section keeps working. Come back to a payslip, a full inbox and whatever resolved without you. A full climb from intern to the top floor runs roughly nine to ten hours, built to be played in the gaps of a day.

  • A whole fake OS: draggable windows, a boot sequence, error dialogs, and a curved CRT you can turn the scanlines down on

  • SNAKE.EXE and MINES.EXE, for when the tray can wait

  • A run timer and achievements for a second, faster climb

  • No microtransactions, no ads, no timer that asks you for money

CEO.exe is in active development. Follow and Wishlist to stay updated on the process and be the first to play the upcoming Demo!

store_data.about_the_game:
Wyrdane is a tactical card game where every board decision matters. Face other players in 1v1 matches or test yourself against a challenging AI, in a combat system where positioning, resources, and timing make all the difference.

Four Factions, Four Ways to Play

Pick your faction and build a deck around its strengths:

  • Undead — bring your minions back from the dead, spread infection, and grind your opponent down through attrition.

  • Human — lean on faction synergy and defensive auras to win the exchanges that matter.

  • Demon — power has a price: sacrifice your own health for devastating effects, manage corruption and fear.

  • Abomination — an unstable, unpredictable playstyle still taking shape.

Each faction has its own dedicated resource, played onto the board turn after turn, choosing to commit to a single faction or spread across several becomes a real strategic decision.

A Living Board

Front and Back rows, Ritual and Enchantment zones, chained effects, targeted sacrifices: every match in Wyrdane plays out on a dynamic board where positioning your minions matters just as much as the cards you play.

Face Whoever You Want

  • Online 1v1 multiplayer through Steam — host a game, jump into a quick match, or invite a friend directly from the lobby.

  • Solo mode against the AI — three difficulty levels, from a warm-up match to an opponent that will genuinely punish your mistakes.

Build Your Strategy

A full deck builder lets you assemble your decks from over 300 cards, filtering by type, faction, and cost. Find the right balance between faction cards, resource cards, and flexibility.

Available in English and French

The entire interface and every card are fully translated, for a smooth experience in both languages.

A Fair Fight, Always

Wyrdane will never sell cards that are stronger than what you can earn for free. No paid boosters, no pay-to-win advantage — ever. Any future monetization (cosmetics, seasonal content) will only ever affect how your deck looks, never how it plays.

Key Features

  • Tactical row-based combat with triggered effects and sacrifices

  • 4 factions with exclusive mechanics and a dedicated resource system

  • Online 1v1 multiplayer (host, quick match, friend invites)

  • AI opponent with three difficulty levels

  • Full deck builder, 317 cards

  • No pay-to-win, ever

  • English and French

store_data.about_the_game:
EVERY BULLET HAS A TARGET. EVERY SECRET HAS A PRICE. EVERY DESIRE HAS CONSEQUENCES.

In Sexperado, you play as a former bounty hunter trying to start over in the frontier town of Red Creek.

A stagecoach ambush ruins that plan before you even reach town. By sundown, the Black Vulture gang knows your face, and the local sheriff has a dangerous job waiting for you.

At first, the work seems simple: keep the peace and hunt down outlaws. Then stolen land deeds, missing workers, illegal weapons, and traces of a strange material called Red Silver begin pointing toward the same conclusion—the gang is only one part of the problem.

Follow the evidence, protect the people caught in the crossfire, and make a name for yourself in a town where trust is scarce and trouble rarely waits for an invitation.

THE WOMEN OF RED CREEK

Your investigation brings you close to six women with their own place in Red Creek’s conflict.

Ruby is a well-connected saloon keeper who rarely reveals everything she knows. Clara is a determined deputy struggling to protect her town. Belle refuses to surrender her ranch to anyone. Mara is an inventive gunsmith whose experiments do not always go quietly. Evelyn is the town doctor, burdened by a guarded past. Vivienne is the dangerous outlaw known as Blue Viper.

Choose how you speak and act around them. Trust and attraction develop separately, changing conversations and private moments throughout the story. Your decisions also affect your reputation and how certain confrontations play out.

FEATURES

  • Choose your character’s name

  • A complete Western story told across a prologue, eight chapters, a finale, and an epilogue

  • Six adult women with distinct personalities, histories, and relationship development

  • Choices that affect trust, attraction, reputation, dialogue, and how certain confrontations unfold

  • An investigation involving evidence, hidden motives, and a criminal conspiracy

  • Western encounters including shootouts, quick-draw duels, a stagecoach ambush, poker, and a lasso challenge

  • A reputation system that records your actions and performance

  • Story-integrated animated adult scenes

  • Stylized 2D artwork with a first-person presentation

  • Save, quick-save, auto-save, history, auto-play, and skip features

    BUILD YOUR REPUTATION

Your performance during ambushes, rescues, shootouts, and duels determines how much reputation you earn. Track your growing status as you go from an unknown traveler to one of Red Creek’s most important gunslingers.

MATURE CONTENT NOTICE

Sexperado is intended for adults only. It contains explicit sexual content, full nudity, animated sex scenes, mature dialogue, gun violence, and themes of crime and corruption. Every character depicted in sexual content is an adult.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crownsink is a 1–4, player action roguelite built around one rule: carry four weapons, swap between them at any moment, and make your entire build work across the full loadout.

Open with a spear thrust, call down a meteor, cut through the survivors with a scythe, then rebuild the whole rotation when a legendary weapon drops. Combine melee, ranged and magic into a hybrid class of your own making. For six hundred years, every lost crown has sunk into the Crownsink—a bottomless pit beneath the citadel. Now the pit has taken the king himself.

As the newest Warden of the Order of the Descent, you are going down after him. Grab your weapons. Down you go.

FOUR WEAPONS. ONE LOADOUT.

Carry four weapons at once from an arsenal of more than 170, spanning nine distinct combat styles. Swap between them freely in the middle of battle and build combinations no single weapon class could support.

Pierce enemies with a spear, clear a swarm with a staff, control the battlefield from range, or finish the survivors with a scythe. Replace one weapon when something better drops — or rebuild the entire loadout around a legendary such as Excalibur, Mjolnir, Gungnir or Soul Reaper.

EVERYTHING STACKS

Relics, spell tomes, cursed treasures, and hundreds of upgrade choices can interact across everything you carry.

Add chain lightning to a crossbow. Put vampirism on a scythe sweep. Layer meteor strikes over the entire rotation. A single pickup can reshape how all four weapons work together, turning every run into a new buildcrafting problem.

DESCEND ALONE OR TOGETHER

Descend alone or form a party of up to four through public matchmaking, private online sessions, or LAN co-op. Each player receives their own loot, while enemy strength and density scale with the size of the party. Coordinate weapons and builds, combine your strengths, and revive fallen teammates before their bleed-out timers expire.

Choose Casual for an unranked descent with the full power of your permanent progression. Or enter Ranked, with separate leaderboards for solo players and teams. In Ranked Softcore, bring your unrestricted progression into the competition. In Ranked Hardcore, every build is capped to the same power budget — putting skill, coordination, and execution ahead of accumulated upgrades.

ONE PIT. ALWAYS DOWN.

Descend through four stacked worlds: the Dungeon, the Caves, the Infernal and the Ashen Catacombs.

Each world is ruled by a king wearing a stolen crown, with a second, rarer boss waiting somewhere in its depths. Defeat them and the Crownsink points you deeper.

Beyond the final world, the pit becomes Endless. There is no last floor—only the depth your build, execution and team can survive.

Your floor count is your score. How deep can you get?

DEATH MAKES YOU STRONGER

Every run feeds gold into the Ancestral Ledger, a permanent skill tree with more than 500 nodes.

Strengthen individual combat styles, unlock new possibilities, and use synergy nodes to fuse different weapon families into specialized hybrid builds. Save up to eight build presets and test them across six difficulty levels, culminating in Nightmare+.

Every floor also presents a new objective: hunt a target, solve a riddle, uncover a hidden cache, or search for a secret room. Death ends the descent — not your progress.

A WARDEN THAT'S YOURS — EARNED PIECE BY PIECE

Choose from nine starting presets, then customize armour, helmets, hair, facial details, adornments, back pieces, boots, dyes, weapon trails, and more through a layered character system. The wardrobe contains 150 pieces, with more than 100 earned through play. Dethrone bosses, clear flawless floors, survive Nightmare, rescue teammates, and master special rooms. Across 90 achievements, your victories become part of your appearance—and your Warden wears the proof.

AT A GLANCE

  • More than 170 weapons across nine combat styles—carry four and swap mid-combat

  • Hundreds of relics, spell tomes, cursed treasures, and upgrade choices

  • Four worlds, eight crowned bosses, more than 50 enemy types, and an Endless descent

  • Public matchmaking, private online sessions, and LAN co-op for 1–4 players

  • Unranked Casual, Ranked Softcore, and equal-budget Ranked Hardcore modes

  • A permanent skill tree with more than 500 nodes

  • A 150-piece wardrobe with more than 100 unlockable pieces

  • 90 achievements tied to combat, exploration, teamwork, and mastery

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO KAZFALL

The keep fell. The vaults beneath it fell. Everyone who ever held the place went down with it.
Something else lives there now and it did not come from above.

This dungeon does not open because you got stronger. It opens because you found who is left.

  • A Vendor still trades from a lantern-lit corner, having lugged his wares through hell to

    reach you. What he sells lasts one delve only — the depths keep what they're given.

  • An Artificer waits deeper still, and what he forges endures. Every upgrade is bound to you

    and carried into every run after.

  • A Hierophant tends an altar nobody has knelt at in a long time. He offers covenants: take on

    a curse, walk the harder road, and the depths repay your suffering with greater glory.

Each one you reach permanently opens the place further — new rooms, new enemies, a new boss and a

tier of gear that did not exist for you before.

ONE DESCENT, AND A CLOCK

A run is a single unbroken delve against a countdown. There is no safe backtracking and no grinding a

floor for scraps — the timer takes you if the dungeon doesn't. Reach the boss, kill it, and climb out.

The steel you found stays down there. What you carry back up is worth more than any of it.

COMBAT THAT ASKS SOMETHING OF YOU

  • Weave light and heavy into three-hit chains that cost stamina. Swing carelessly and you have

    nothing left to defend with.

  • Perfect block on the frame the blow lands: you take no damage and open enemies

    up. Mistime it and your guard breaks.

  • Multiple enemy types that fight differently — lancers that close, spearwraiths that keep their

    distance, obelisks that shield everything around them until you deal with them first.

BUILD A RUN OUT OF WHAT THE FLOOR GIVES YOU

  • 63 pieces of equipment — burn, freeze, thorns, lifesteal, crit, and armour that retaliates

    against whoever hit you.

  • 29 skills — 15 active and 14 passive, with an Ultimate unlocked at level 20.

  • Chests as a reward— scrap what you don't want and re-roll with the gold it earns.

  • Covenants from the Hierophant multiply your score — and make the descent meaningfully worse.

THE DEPTHS KEEP WHAT THEY'RE GIVEN

  • Gold lives and dies with the delve: the Vendor's stock, chest rewards, potions. None of it

    comes back up with you.

  • Essence does. Buy permanent stat upgrades, weapons and unlocked gear at your Antechamber

    before the next descent.

Dying is not a wasted run. Dying is the economy.

BUILT TO BE PLAYED HOW YOU PLAY

  • Full controller support, with native PlayStation, Xbox and Steam Deck button prompts that

    follow the pad you actually plugged in.

  • Accessibility — colourblind modes, UI scaling, brightness calibration, a light-flicker toggle

    and a damage-number toggle.
store_data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO KAZFALL

The keep fell. The vaults beneath it fell. Everyone who ever held the place went down with it.
Something else lives there now and it did not come from above.

This dungeon does not open because you got stronger. It opens because you found who is left.

  • A Vendor still trades from a lantern-lit corner, having lugged his wares through hell to

    reach you. What he sells lasts one delve only — the depths keep what they're given.

  • An Artificer waits deeper still, and what he forges endures. Every upgrade is bound to you

    and carried into every run after.

  • A Hierophant tends an altar nobody has knelt at in a long time. He offers covenants: take on

    a curse, walk the harder road, and the depths repay your suffering with greater glory.

Each one you reach permanently opens the place further — new rooms, new enemies, a new boss and a

tier of gear that did not exist for you before.

ONE DESCENT, AND A CLOCK

A run is a single unbroken delve against a countdown. There is no safe backtracking and no grinding a

floor for scraps — the timer takes you if the dungeon doesn't. Reach the boss, kill it, and climb out.

The steel you found stays down there. What you carry back up is worth more than any of it.

COMBAT THAT ASKS SOMETHING OF YOU

  • Weave light and heavy into three-hit chains that cost stamina. Swing carelessly and you have

    nothing left to defend with.

  • Perfect block on the frame the blow lands: you take no damage and open enemies

    up. Mistime it and your guard breaks.

  • Multiple enemy types that fight differently — lancers that close, spearwraiths that keep their

    distance, obelisks that shield everything around them until you deal with them first.

BUILD A RUN OUT OF WHAT THE FLOOR GIVES YOU

  • 63 pieces of equipment — burn, freeze, thorns, lifesteal, crit, and armour that retaliates

    against whoever hit you.

  • 29 skills — 15 active and 14 passive, with an Ultimate unlocked at level 20.

  • Chests as a reward— scrap what you don't want and re-roll with the gold it earns.

  • Covenants from the Hierophant multiply your score — and make the descent meaningfully worse.

THE DEPTHS KEEP WHAT THEY'RE GIVEN

  • Gold lives and dies with the delve: the Vendor's stock, chest rewards, potions. None of it

    comes back up with you.

  • Essence does. Buy permanent stat upgrades, weapons and unlocked gear at your Antechamber

    before the next descent.

Dying is not a wasted run. Dying is the economy.

BUILT TO BE PLAYED HOW YOU PLAY

  • Full controller support, with native PlayStation, Xbox and Steam Deck button prompts that

    follow the pad you actually plugged in.

  • Accessibility — colourblind modes, UI scaling, brightness calibration, a light-flicker toggle

    and a damage-number toggle.

store_data.about_the_game:
The village sends you its dead. Your job is to make sure they stay that way.

The Dead Must Rest is a 1-4 player medieval cemetery-management horror game. Dig graves, judge the occasional corpse, and pay the church its due. Honest work, right up until your mistakes start climbing back out.

The Routine

A wagon arrives each day with bodies, burial papers, and plenty of clerical errors. It’s your job to match them up, prep them, and put them in the ground. Families might lie about their dead to save a coin.

Evil Within

Test suspicious corpses for signs of evil. Then decide what exactly you’re about to bury. Every evil demands the proper rites.

The Living Are Trouble Too

Mourners may leave a coin behind. Not every visitor comes to pay their respects, keep an eye on the grounds and a shovel nearby.

The Soil Remembers

Anything you buried wrong during the day may be waiting for you after dark.

The Church Is Watching

The church demands payment without exception.

What it does with your coin is not your concern. What lies behind the locked door is definitely not your concern.

Dig. Bury. Survive.

Features

  • Play alone or with up to three friends online

  • Match burial papers to unmarked corpses using physical clues

  • Perform occult tests and identify supernatural threats

  • Prepare, carry, pose, wrap, bury, and burn bodies by hand

  • Manage your time, money, supplies, and grave space

  • Use the correct rites or face your mistakes after dark

  • Pay the church on time and do not ask any questions

store_data.about_the_game:
The parish is dead. The bell must be kept.


You are the last keeper of a plague-dead parish. Each night you ring the passing bell for the dead, as the office demands — but the bell has begun calling something back. Now every night is a vigil: survive from the first toll until matins, twenty minutes of dark, and everything in it wants your candle out.

What the night holds


  • The bell keeps time. Every minute it tolls, and every toll calls worse dead. Elites at the fifth and fifteenth; at the tenth and the last, the Tolling Ones — things the bell named directly.
  • Rites turned violent. Eleven weapons drawn from grave-rites and sexton's tools: the censer, the salt ring, coffin nails, holy water, a corpse-candle sent out hunting, the knell itself. Pair a rite with its matching relic and it evolves into something the parish never sanctioned.
  • The night changes, not just hardens. Early dead fade to chaff as new silhouettes answer. Past the fifteenth toll, the churchyard floods — walls and rings of hundreds.
  • Your candle is your life. Health is the Wick; damage gutters it. Souls of the slain drift as vigil lights — gather them, lay them to rest, grow stronger.
  • Fall, and the night still pays. Ash swept from the churchyard buys permanent restoration in the Reliquary: eleven relic tracks to deepen, six keepers to bring out of the dark — each holding the bell a different way — and a longer fuse for the next vigil.
  • Press on into the dark. Survive to dawn and you may keep walking. The endless dark compounds without mercy. Every endless run ends — how far is up to you.

A complete game at one fair price


Everything included. No ads, no currency packs, no dark patterns — the only darkness is on screen.

KNELL contains flashing lights and visual effects that may affect photosensitive players.

store_data.about_the_game:
nk Unfurls is a calm 3D ink-wash creation experience about guiding a painting as it grows.

Begin with an open canvas and choose an ink point. A new form emerges, shaped by the theme and the composition around it. Keep it, cycle through a safe alternative, or withdraw the latest stroke. There are no timers, resources, or failure states—only a quiet dialogue between intention and surprise.

### Shape a Living Ink Painting

- Choose where the composition grows next.

- Cycle through curated forms without wrestling with a full 3D editor.

- Withdraw the latest stroke when the balance no longer feels right.

- Orbit, zoom, and reset the camera to study the work from every angle.

- Finish whenever the piece feels complete and save it to your personal gallery.

Each canvas follows one focused theme, allowing bamboo, stone, flowers, cats, and other subjects to unfold as a coherent miniature scene. Ink Unfurls is designed for short, unhurried creative sessions and for players who enjoy contemplative art, gentle experimentation, and the beauty of imperfect forms.

store_data.about_the_game:
SCP: KOS is a round-based, top-down 2D multiplayer game set in a Foundation containment site where a massive containment failure has occurred. Every round the map is randomly generated and you're assigned a role - Foundation personnel, Chaos Insurgency, or a sentient SCP anomaly - each with different goals. Loot the facility, upgrade your keycard, fight the other alive factions, and either detonate or defend the on-site nuclear warhead before the round ends.

Games are fast, chaotic, and different every time. When a round ends, the map rebuilds and roles are reshuffled automatically.

Play as one of three factions

  • Foundation personnel - Scavenge for loot, upgrade your keycard to reach locked areas, and neutralize (or run from) any threat you come across.

  • Chaos Insurgency - Enter the facility from the surface using elevator-A to sabotage the site and hunt Foundation staff.

  • SCP anomalies - Play a sentient SCP with unique abilities. Break containment, wipe out the humans, and stop the warhead from going off.

What's in the game right now

  • Randomly generated maps - no two rounds share a layout.

  • Four connected zones - Light Containment, Heavy Containment, Entrance, and a Surface zone - plus special areas to discover.

  • Interactive facility rooms - including SCP-914 (the upgrade machine), armories, elevators, and more.

  • Tiered keycards & loot - find better cards to unlock deeper areas and better gear.

  • Multiple human and SCP roles, each playing differently.

  • Dynamic round events - a rotating set of in-round events (containment hazards, anomalous encounters, and more) that shake up each match.

  • The on-site nuclear warhead - activating this destroys a large part of the facility and irradiates the surface. escape when it gets close to going off!

  • Tesla gates, corpses, an inventory system, and a fog-of-war minimap.

SCP: KOS is in active development and new content is added regularly. See the Early Access section below for what's here today and where it's headed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Merge. Chain. Ascend to K-ing.

Drop cute dogs into the pen. Two of the same breed touch — they merge into the next tier. Chain enough merges together and you'll trigger cascading combos that rocket your score into the stratosphere. Keep going long enough, and you'll create the legendary [b]K-ing Dog[/b] — the ultimate goal.

But be careful — let the pen overflow past the danger line and it's game over!

✨ Features

  • 12 Adorable Dog Tiers — From tiny puppy to the majestic K-ing Dog, every merge reveals a new breed with its own personality.

  • Satisfying Chain Combos — Trigger Combo → Super Combo → Amazing Combo → Droppy Dog Combo for massive score multipliers.

  • Broom Power-Up — Stuck with a bad drop? Sweep any dog off the field with your trusty broom. 10 brooms per game, free!

  • Global Leaderboard — Compete with players worldwide on the Steam Leaderboard.

  • 18 Steam Achievements — Tier milestones, score records, combo mastery, and broom legend.

  • Steam Cloud Saves — Progress syncs across all your devices.

  • 30 Languages Supported — Play in your native language.

  • Customizable Profile — Pick your name and pup avatar.

  • Zero Ads, Zero Microtransactions — One purchase. Full game. Forever.

🎯 Simple to Learn, Hard to Master

Anyone can drop a dog. But when you're deep into a game, one careful placement can trigger a 6-chain combo cascade that clears half the field and scores 50,000 points in a single moment. That "aha!" feeling never gets old.

🧘 The Perfect Cozy Break

Warm colors, cute dogs, satisfying merges, and a soundtrack that makes you smile. Droppy Dog is designed for the moments between meetings, before bed, or that lazy Sunday afternoon.

🏆 Or Chase the High Score

Score-attack players: the global leaderboard is waiting. How high can you climb?

Ready to build your Droppy Dog empire?

store_data.about_the_game:
From Zero: Idle Factory is an active incremental factory-management game about turning a worn-out workshop into eight increasingly advanced factories.

Start each production line by hand. Store products, ship them for profit and reinvest every payment. As the factory grows, robots take over repetitive work and your attention shifts from clicking machines to making smarter production decisions.


ALT: At a busy factory, the player ships stocked products; the payout appears while production continues.

Build from the floor up

  • Grow through eight factories and 24 products. Each stage brings its own objectives, events and technologies.
  • Choose where to invest. Improve machine speed and quality, expand warehouse capacity, manage electricity and water, and complete timed training and development projects.
  • Shape the factory floor. Add machines and place support equipment where it benefits production most.
  • Complete factory-specific tasks and solve temporary problems. Earn varied rewards, read every event's effect clearly and repair it at a cost that stays fixed once the event begins.

Turn routine work into automation

Install robots, assign them to the machines that need them most and decide which lines still deserve manual attention. Keep expanding until a once hand-operated workshop becomes a coordinated automated factory.


ALT: The player assigns an available robot to a selected machine; the robot counter and gear indicator update as automation starts.

Trade up or master the climb

When a factory is ready, trade it for a more advanced facility. Or accept an optional Prestige offer to restart the climb while preserving discovered systems and technology limits; higher Prestige also shortens future timed projects.


ALT: Three increasingly advanced factory floors appear in sequence, each denser with machines and active product popups.

This is a finite, single-player campaign designed for active play. The factory pauses when the game is closed: there is no offline production or hidden idle income. Save your progress, return when you want and keep building toward the final factory.

Mosaic Melt is a color puzzle game where you clear connected blocks of the same color, complete a variety of objectives, and aim for high scores.

Make split-second decisions as you quickly refresh the board with a right-click, searching for your next big clear through fast-paced play.

In Color Trial, complete each of five color goals before time runs out. Choose a target size in Practice Mode for focused training, chase records in High Score and Time Score modes, or test your strategy with full-clear puzzles and randomly generated boards.

Mosaic Melt also includes CHROMA LINEBREAK, a Match-3 action puzzle where you move enemies and clear groups of three or more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Brave the River. Save Lives.

Take the helm of a rescue boat, navigate a river packed with danger, and save everyone stranded in the current.

River Rescue is a top-down 2D arcade action game about fighting the flow of the river. Steer left and right, accelerate when the moment is right, and find a safe route to the goal.

Read the River and React

Dodge rocks, logs, and barrels, escape fuel-draining rapids, and outmaneuver hostile boats blocking your path. Rush ahead and you risk a collision; hesitate for too long and the current will push you back. Watch your fuel, read the hazards, and choose your line in an instant.

Chain Rescues and Chase High Scores

Rescue stranded people in order to build a rescue streak and earn bigger score bonuses. Conquer five courses, save more people, travel farther, and leave your name on the high-score table.

Build Your Own River with the Course Editor

Use the built-in Course Editor to place rocks, logs, stranded people, hostile boats, barrels, and rapids. Drag objects into position, set a goal distance from 100 to 1,000 meters, and save your custom courses. Register up to 32 courses in the stage list and arrange them in any order.

Key Features

  • Top-down 2D arcade action set on vertically scrolling rivers

  • Simple, tense gameplay combining steering, acceleration, and fuel management

  • Distinct hazards including rocks, logs, rapids, barrels, and hostile boats

  • Rescue-streak bonuses and a name-entry high-score table

  • Five included courses

  • A built-in Course Editor for creating, saving, loading, and arranging courses

  • Keyboard and gamepad support

  • English and Japanese interface options

Your skills aren't picked from a menu — they land on a slot machine. Build your party from 8 classes: every choice shapes the skills you'll have on your run.

But nothing comes free. You start alone. Choose your path carefully to recruit the right companions and avoid the deadliest enemies.

  • Parry enemy attacks on time, or take the hit! Every strike has its window, and it doesn't forgive. Parry a full combo, and the enemy is the one who regrets it.

  • Your skills aren't cast — they're spun. Every turn, the slot machine decides what your heroes do: damage, healing, magic, buffs and debuffs. 50 unique skills to unlock by beating challenges throughout your adventures.

  • Not every skill plays out the same way. Some open a minigame : aim, hold, keep the rhythm. Land it and the hit hurts - a lot more.

  • Every run carves its own path. Fights, treasure, encounters: you decide where to go. And sometimes, someone agrees to follow you.

  • Some enemies don't target one hero — they target your whole party. One window to protect everyone. Nobody makes it out alone.

Bonne chance !

store_data.about_the_game:
Mithril is a procedurally generated voxel mining survival game. Infinite caves to explore, where each world changes with you. Every stone you touch, every flow of lava you manipulate, all has consequence.

Dig by hand. Build factories to process it for you. Survive what hunts you.

Then trigger the Dormancy, a deep sleep, and watch a million years of geology reshape the cave around you.

Every Stone Bears Weight

Every piece of rock you take, another has to carry what is left. Take too much, too fast, and it all comes down.

Structural stress propagates through the rock in real time. Support your tunnels with struts, or listen to the ceiling make the decision for you.

The stone is not known for forgiveness.

(Unscripted natural collapse event.)

A Million Years in Minutes

Dormancy is not a rest. It is a fast-forward.

The engine simulates deep geological time live on the cave you are standing in.

Open a path for water and the minerals it carries follow it, concentrating ores along ancient water tables. Channel lava into untouched rock and hydrothermal heat transforms it into new minerals. Leave a tunnel unsupported and it gives way under its own weight. Every change is player driven, the world is yours to manipulate.

You shape it. You trigger it. You watch it happen. And then you come back to a place you no longer recognise.

But you will do it anyway. The ore you need does not exist yet.

Same base. New danger.

(Deep time simulation of heat source turning into new minerals.)

Destruction at Every Scale

From entire caverns collapsing, to mining keyholes around ores, destruction happens flawlessly across any scale.

The Memory

The world is not the only thing that changes. 

While you play, creatures in the dark watch you. And they learn. Where you dig. What you build. How you fight.

The ones that survive Dormancy come back knowing what didn’t work last time. 

Dormancy reshapes the world. The Memory reshapes what hunts you.

Real Geology

The cave was generated. The geology was simulated. 

  • Depth-layered rock strata across procedurally generated cave systems

  • Geologically accurate mineral formation, veins, and enrichment

  • Stalactites, columns, flowstone, crystal growths, lava pools, water systems

  • Every material has real physical properties that change how you mine it

Every descent is different.

Build The Chain

Start with your claws and a torch. Finish with a line of machines pulling ore out of the dark while you work three tunnels over.

  • Crushers, furnaces, conveyors, storage

  • Orehands that keep the line moving while you are elsewhere

  • Build the chain, then build the chain that feeds the chain

None of it survives Dormancy untouched. You do not build the line once.

Same Caves. Now With Friends

Online and local co-op for up to four. One of you digs. One of you watches the dark.

Arrives at launch.

The Quiet Version

Freeplay leaves out the creatures and gives you the cave, the geology, and the machines.

Arrives at launch.

Built From Scratch

Powered by a custom Rust voxel engine driving Unreal Engine 5. Built by a solo developer in Melbourne, Australia.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Card to Play, One to Discard — Everything Resolves at Once

Each turn you pick one card to play and one to discard from a six-card hand (3 Move + 3 Action). Your played card stays hidden until it resolves, and both players' choices resolve simultaneously at the end of the turn. Read an incoming strike and set a Parry — succeed and you block everything and stick your opponent with a Paralysis token; fail and you take Fatigue yourself. Mid- and upper-tier spells demand a Chant, and the turn you commit to a magic card, you are Defenseless. Every card is a risk you have to weigh.

Tactics on a 13x8 Grid

Position is power: +2 ATK/MATK when you strike from the flank, +4 from behind. Use Dodge Step to slip around your opponent

Facing and collisions matter: step into the same tile and you lock blades; shove an enemy into a wall and they risk Knockdown. Pillars and other obstacles shape every route

Chain physical melee attacks and the combo bonus to ATK/SPD keeps building — it survives one move before it breaks

Defenders choose too: shield guards that block fully or by half, going Airborne to ignore ground melee (at an MP cost every turn), even shooting down incoming arrows

Speed means more actions: lead your opponent's SPD by 60 or more and you play 2 cards per turn; by 80 or more, 3

Toggle the battle board between 2D and 3D

See the Unseen

Your opponent's hand, HP, and MP are hidden by default. Scouting covers the 3 tiles around you, and just beyond that a presence marker shows direction only. Catch them in your field of view — or bring Eye Skills (Foresight Eye, Far Sight Eye, Observation Eye, Analysis Eye) — to strip the fog away and narrow down their next card.

Builds × Dual Decks

Build a Move deck (up to 20 cards) and an Action deck (up to 30); 74 cards appear in play across movement, attacks, defense, magic, skills, and consumables

Pick your hand refill ratio before battle — 2:4, 3:3, or 4:2 — so deckbuilding decides how your game flows

One Card to Play, One to Discard — Everything Resolves at Once

Each turn you pick one card to play and one to discard from a six-card hand (3 Move + 3 Action). Your played card stays hidden until it resolves, and both players' choices resolve simultaneously at the end of the turn. Read an incoming strike and set a Parry — succeed and you block everything and stick your opponent with a Paralysis token; fail and you take Fatigue yourself. Mid- and upper-tier spells demand a Chant, and the turn you commit to a magic card, you are Defenseless. Every card is a risk you have to weigh.

Tactics on a 13x8 Grid

Position is power: +2 ATK/MATK when you strike from the flank, +4 from behind. Use Dodge Step to slip around your opponent

Facing and collisions matter: step into the same tile and you lock blades; shove an enemy into a wall and they risk Knockdown. Pillars and other obstacles shape every route

Chain physical melee attacks and the combo bonus to ATK/SPD keeps building — it survives one move before it breaks

Toggle the battle board between 2D and 3D

Your opponent's hand, HP, and MP are hidden by default. Scouting covers the 3 tiles around you, and just beyond that a presence marker shows direction only. store_data.about_the_game:
Meet Sanya. A man whose life has stalled somewhere between an empty refrigerator and a sagging sofa. A typical Friday evening, a dating site—and suddenly a profile without a single photo, but with a promise of heartfelt love. Thus begins a blind date that will turn into the longest and best evening in the last six months.

She's Anya. Big, lively eyes, the personality of an investigator, and a gut instinct that can't hide a single lie. She meets our hero at the fountain and announces her signature approach to men: three questions, honest answers, no fluff. And that's just the beginning.

Then they'll be whisked away across the city: the cozy dumpling shop "At Matryona's" with its formidable waitress Angela and the philosopher cat at the bar, a golden sunset on the embankment, the evening streets of the old city center, and a courtyard under a dim street lamp. At every turn, there's a new trio of questions and a new test thrown at you by life, as if on cue: a wise homeless man, a child with a kite stuck in the power lines, ex-husband Vityok, brazen thugs, mean neighbors Grandpa Petrovich and Grandma Klava, and a greedy taxi driver.

Every answer is a choice. Every choice is either a step toward a warm kitchen with thyme tea, apple pie made according to Grandma's recipe, and honey labeled "summer," or a sharp turn and a lonely walk home under the pitiful gazes of pigeons, cats, and random passersby. Because behind all these questions, teasing, and tests, there's one, the most important thing: can you be trusted?

Will Sanya pass every single exam? Or will one careless word ruin an entire wonderful evening? The ending is entirely up to you—and it's much warmer than it initially seems.

GAME FEATURES

Lively folk humor—colorful dialogues, astute observations, and characters you've likely met in real life.

A choice system with consequences—every answer matters, and the wrong word instantly leads to the ending.

Multiple mini-endings—about a hundred possible failures, each with its own ironic ending.

Changing locations—a park, a dumpling shop, an embankment at sunset, evening streets, a courtyard, an entrance, and a cozy kitchen.

Atmospheric, light music in every location.

One action-packed evening—a complete, cohesive story that can be completed in one sitting and replayed for other endings.

Shall we help Sanya find love?
