store_data.about_the_game:
A bookshop is a building full of strangers' lives.

You never met Arthur Pell. The solicitor's letter named you — Iris Calloway, of an address he had no reason to know — the will was in order, and the keys work. Above the door, in flaking gold: HERITAGE & SONS, and nobody left alive remembers any sons. Inside: his coat on the hook, his lamp on the counter, a ledger that stops mid-word — and shelving rules too strange to be housekeeping. The Baedeker is never shelved beside the atlases.

Every book here carries its previous owner.

Pressed violets from a garden that flowered at night. Love letters conducted entirely in the margins of second-hand novels. A soldier's promise folded into a book that outlived both parties. Buy and sell them, find the book each customer is really asking for, and keep the shop alive through the autumn of 1994.

And in the margins, one hand keeps recurring.

The inks age. The handwriting never does. It signs itself only "M." Pell spent years tracking it through his stock; his files are still in the back room, exactly where he left them, and the last thing he wrote was addressed to you: shelve by the rules, and do not read the margins.

How much you read is up to you. It always was.

What's inside

  • Keep the shop — buy collections, price finds, match books to the people who need them.
  • Read the owners — marginalia, inscriptions, photographs and pressed things, drawn from five decades of previous owners.
  • Follow the files — the previous owner's investigation, exactly where he left it.
  • Choose what the collection becomes — what you keep, what you release, and how close you let the hand in the margins come. Four endings.
  • Painted London, 1994; rain on the glass, lamplight in the aisles — and the back rows, where the bulbs keep dying.

5053540.name: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール

store_data.about_the_game:
EVERYTHING BEGINS WITH A LIE.

In a near-future world where humanoid cyborgs known as “Dolls” have become part of everyday life, international crime has evolved alongside technology.

Take on the role of V.D, an elite Doll investigator assigned to Division 9 of W.A.N.D., an international organization dedicated to suppressing crime across national borders.

Feared by criminals as the “VIOLENCE DOLL” for her overwhelming combat capabilities, V.D does not take pleasure in violence. To her, it is simply the most logical means of eliminating a threat.

As she investigates incidents across the planet Ranunculus, V.D becomes entangled in a vast conspiracy created by those who claim to represent peace, salvation, progress, and revolution.

Someone has to stop them—before it is too late.

■HACK THEM. STOP THEM. CRUSH THEM.

VIOLENCE DOLL combines real-time 3D action combat with a unique close-range hacking system.

The closer V.D remains to an enemy, the faster her Hacking Gauge charges. Staying within an opponent’s most dangerous range allows her to build hacking stocks rapidly—but one mistake can leave her exposed to a devastating counterattack.

Activate hacking to take control of the combat space and temporarily freeze surrounding enemies, including powerful targets. Once their movement has been disabled, unleash melee attacks, gunfire, Arts, and Limit Breaks to create overwhelming combos.

You can keep your distance and rely on firearms, but ammunition is limited and the Hacking Gauge will charge far more slowly. Fighting safely is possible, but the greatest rewards belong to players willing to confront enemies at close range.

However, some enemies protected by military-grade security protocols are resistant to standard hacking. Against these opponents, you must rely on direct combat, defensive systems, careful positioning, and the strength of your build.

■2.5D EXPLORATION MEETS 3D REAL-TIME COMBAT

Explore side-scrolling 2.5D fields filled with hidden routes, environmental hazards, enemies, treasure, and ancient machinery.

Run, jump, dash, hover, and use specialized tools to navigate snow-covered mountains, forgotten ruins, military installations, and other regions across the world.

V.D can conceal her hostility with her Stealth System, allowing her to avoid detection, bypass dangerous encounters, and search for alternate routes through hostile territory.

When combat begins, the game transitions into a real-time 3D battlefield where multiple enemies can attack from different directions. Lock onto priority targets, manage your distance, identify enemy behavior, and decide when to attack, defend, evade, or hack.

BUILD YOUR OWN COMBAT STYLE

Acquire new skills to unlock and develop multiple combat classes. Each class changes V.D’s strengths, available tactics, and approach to battle.

  • Fighter
    A close-range class with high physical attack power.

  • Gunner
    A ranged class specializing in firearms and distance control.

  • Fenrir Knight
    A high-speed class that sacrifices defense for greater mobility.

  • Gladiator
    A close-combat specialist designed for aggressive players.

  • Kaiser Cyborg
    A special annihilation-focused class capable of maintaining an extended awakened state.

Change classes, equip weapons and armor, select accessories, strengthen abilities, and combine skills to create a combat style that suits you.

V.D can also deploy different types of shields. Some reduce incoming damage, while others sacrifice protection in exchange for reflecting attacks. Choosing the right defensive system can completely change the outcome of a battle.

■EXPLORE A WORLD OF CONFLICTING IDEALS

Travel across multiple nations and regions, each with its own history, political system, conflicts, and hidden agenda.

Investigate abandoned ruins in Sylvana, climb the frozen peaks of the Great Snow Mountain, infiltrate military facilities in Alba, and uncover the truth behind territories that appear peaceful on the surface.

New areas, missions, technologies, classes, and combat options become available as the story progresses. Information collected during investigations can reveal enemy data, historical records, terminology, and clues connected to the larger conspiracy.

A DOLL WITHOUT EMOTIONS. A WORLD DRIVEN BY THEM.

V.D begins her mission as an investigator who evaluates every situation through logic alone.

However, her encounters with soldiers, revolutionaries, scientists, terrorists, corporate leaders, and ordinary citizens gradually force her to confront questions that cannot be solved through calculation.

What separates justice from control?

Can violence remain logical when it is used in the name of peace?

And if a Doll begins to make decisions beyond her original programming, can she still be called a machine?

Uncover the lies surrounding the world of Ranunculus—and decide what the name “VIOLENCE DOLL” truly means.
store_data.detailed_description:
EVERYTHING BEGINS WITH A LIE.

In a near-future world where humanoid cyborgs known as “Dolls” have become part of everyday life, international crime has evolved alongside technology.

Take on the role of V.D, an elite Doll investigator assigned to Division 9 of W.A.N.D., an international organization dedicated to suppressing crime across national borders.

Feared by criminals as the “VIOLENCE DOLL” for her overwhelming combat capabilities, V.D does not take pleasure in violence. To her, it is simply the most logical means of eliminating a threat.

As she investigates incidents across the planet Ranunculus, V.D becomes entangled in a vast conspiracy created by those who claim to represent peace, salvation, progress, and revolution.

Someone has to stop them—before it is too late.

■HACK THEM. STOP THEM. CRUSH THEM.

VIOLENCE DOLL combines real-time 3D action combat with a unique close-range hacking system.

The closer V.D remains to an enemy, the faster her Hacking Gauge charges. Staying within an opponent’s most dangerous range allows her to build hacking stocks rapidly—but one mistake can leave her exposed to a devastating counterattack.

Activate hacking to take control of the combat space and temporarily freeze surrounding enemies, including powerful targets. Once their movement has been disabled, unleash melee attacks, gunfire, Arts, and Limit Breaks to create overwhelming combos.

You can keep your distance and rely on firearms, but ammunition is limited and the Hacking Gauge will charge far more slowly. Fighting safely is possible, but the greatest rewards belong to players willing to confront enemies at close range.

However, some enemies protected by military-grade security protocols are resistant to standard hacking. Against these opponents, you must rely on direct combat, defensive systems, careful positioning, and the strength of your build.

■2.5D EXPLORATION MEETS 3D REAL-TIME COMBAT

Explore side-scrolling 2.5D fields filled with hidden routes, environmental hazards, enemies, treasure, and ancient machinery.

Run, jump, dash, hover, and use specialized tools to navigate snow-covered mountains, forgotten ruins, military installations, and other regions across the world.

V.D can conceal her hostility with her Stealth System, allowing her to avoid detection, bypass dangerous encounters, and search for alternate routes through hostile territory.

When combat begins, the game transitions into a real-time 3D battlefield where multiple enemies can attack from different directions. Lock onto priority targets, manage your distance, identify enemy behavior, and decide when to attack, defend, evade, or hack.

BUILD YOUR OWN COMBAT STYLE

Acquire new skills to unlock and develop multiple combat classes. Each class changes V.D’s strengths, available tactics, and approach to battle.

  • Fighter
    A close-range class with high physical attack power.

  • Gunner
    A ranged class specializing in firearms and distance control.

  • Fenrir Knight
    A high-speed class that sacrifices defense for greater mobility.

  • Gladiator
    A close-combat specialist designed for aggressive players.

  • Kaiser Cyborg
    A special annihilation-focused class capable of maintaining an extended awakened state.

Change classes, equip weapons and armor, select accessories, strengthen abilities, and combine skills to create a combat style that suits you.

V.D can also deploy different types of shields. Some reduce incoming damage, while others sacrifice protection in exchange for reflecting attacks. Choosing the right defensive system can completely change the outcome of a battle.

■EXPLORE A WORLD OF CONFLICTING IDEALS

Travel across multiple nations and regions, each with its own history, political system, conflicts, and hidden agenda.

Investigate abandoned ruins in Sylvana, climb the frozen peaks of the Great Snow Mountain, infiltrate military facilities in Alba, and uncover the truth behind territories that appear peaceful on the surface.

New areas, missions, technologies, classes, and combat options become available as the story progresses. Information collected during investigations can reveal enemy data, historical records, terminology, and clues connected to the larger conspiracy.

A DOLL WITHOUT EMOTIONS. A WORLD DRIVEN BY THEM.

V.D begins her mission as an investigator who evaluates every situation through logic alone.

However, her encounters with soldiers, revolutionaries, scientists, terrorists, corporate leaders, and ordinary citizens gradually force her to confront questions that cannot be solved through calculation.

What separates justice from control?

Can violence remain logical when it is used in the name of peace?

And if a Doll begins to make decisions beyond her original programming, can she still be called a machine?

Uncover the lies surrounding the world of Ranunculus—and decide what the name “VIOLENCE DOLL” truly means.

store_data.about_the_game:
I created this game because I’ve always been a fan of movement puzzles in Pokémon games (the ice caves).

In this game there are 3 modes, campaign, multiplayer and endless.

The campaign:
-7 worlds with their own visual theme.
-50 levels per world.
The levels get harder and harder (I’m personally at level 270 and it takes me 10-15 minutes per level, sometimes even more!). Each campaign has its own set of cosmetic rewards available in multiplayer!

Multiplayer:
-50,000+ official levels (and this is only the beginning ^^). Difficulty 5 to 30 (corresponding to the minimum number of moves).
-1v1 against players from all around the world.
-1v1 available against friends.
-Global leaderboard for difficulties 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30.
-1v1 leaderboard
-Daily challenge: the same 5 random levels for everyone, the fastest time wins!
-1 Boss every week: players deal damage to it by completing ranked levels, a reward will be waiting for the best hunters.
-Possibility to customize the game skin, your character, your trail, your profile icon as well as your profile frame (the profile icon and frame are visible to other players in the leaderboards etc.)
-Level history to analyze levels played in 1v1 or solo ranked levels.
-Map Rating mode: allows players to give each map a difficulty rating, which makes it possible to select the best maps in future updates, to offer a harder campaign, or more difficult challenges)

Infinity mode:
Allows you to play with the generation settings to create custom-made levels. Unlocks after completing world 4 in the campaign.

I hope you’ll enjoy the game, I can’t wait to make it evolve based on the community’s feedback, and I have plenty of ideas for what comes next!

Think. Trace. Master the grid.

store_data.about_the_game:
You were a judge in life. Death did not take the job away.

After a fatal accident you wake up in Purgatory, behind a desk, in a marble office.
A demon statue stands on your left. An angel statue stands on your right. Between them
there is an arch of light, and souls keep walking out of it.

There is a terminal, a rulebook, a printer, a telephone and two seals. There is no manager, no training, and no announced end of shift. The queue simply continues.

Your own case is still open. Nobody has told you what it takes to close it.

READ THE FILE

Every soul arrives with a record. Name, age, religion, species, and a list of what they
did with their life. The entries are short, official, and completely without sympathy.

A moral philosophy professor who failed 87% of his students for character development.
A man who died in a fire doing something he still believes was a good idea. A billionaire
whose file says he loves children, and says nothing after that.

Records go missing more often than they go wrong. A blank field is not always an accident, and the person standing in front of your desk usually knows which line is missing.

The records were not written to make your job easier.

ASK WHAT YOU WANT TO ASK

You choose the questions. Answers open new questions, and the ones you never ask stay unasked. Nothing tells you when you have asked enough.

Some souls lie. Some tell you the truth in a way that makes the decision harder than a lie would have. A few are still defending a position they held their entire life, and they are not going to drop it now that it costs them everything.

You can send someone on their way in thirty seconds. You can also spend the whole conversation looking for the one sentence that changes your mind.

CHECK TODAY'S DIRECTIVE

The Hobble Book holds the rules for the day. They come from above and they are binding.

They are also not always reasonable. Today the book may inform you that blue eyed souls belong in Hell. It does not explain why. It is not required to.

Yesterday's rule does not carry over. A soul you would have cleared last week is a violation this morning. You still have to apply the rule, or decide not to, in writing, with your name at the bottom of the page.

DO THE PAPERWORK

Once you have decided, you file it properly.

Pick the correct form from the terminal. Soul Judgment Form, Reincarnation Request, Verdict Appeal, Record Amendment, Earth Return Permit. Print it. Sign it in your own hand. Press the seal into the paper. Gold for Heaven, cracked stone for Hell.

The form matters as much as the verdict. The right decision on the wrong document is still a filing error, and the office keeps a copy of both.

Then hand it over.

ANSWER THE PHONE

You are not the only one working in this building.

Sometimes the phone rings about the file that is already open on your desk, and the caller has an opinion about it. They are polite. They are patient. They will call again about the next one.

Nothing forces you to agree with them. Nothing protects you either.

YOUR FILE IS OPEN TOO

Every verdict you sign goes on the record. Following the rulebook is on the record. Ignoring it is also on the record.

The office never tells you which of the two it is counting. There is no score on the desk, no standard posted on the wall, and no calendar.

At some point somebody reads your file the way you have been reading everyone else's.

NOTICE TO ALL DEPARTED SOULS

Keep this document with you at all times.
Follow the instructions given by the desk clerk.
Do not press suspicious red buttons.
Do not attempt to bribe staff, angels, or demons.
Complaining will not change your destination.
Unscheduled resurrection requests will not be accepted.
Personal grudges must be declared at the counter.
Every time someone says "There must be a mistake," the waiting line gets a little longer.

WHAT THIS GAME IS

  • A single player game about reading files, asking questions, and signing documents.

  • You stay at one desk. There is no combat and nothing to run from.

  • Text heavy. If you do not like reading, this is not for you.

  • Every rule you follow and every rule you break is recorded.

  • Multiple endings depending on how you worked.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mimic Party

An online 1-5 player voice party game. You hear a sound. You get one shot to reproduce it with your own voice. A local AI grades how close you got melody, rhythm, attacks and then the wheel decides who walks away with a bonus and whose next take comes back saturated, echoing, or replaced by a fart.

FEATURES:

🎤 1-5 player online voice party game

🎧 One-shot takes - no retries, no undo, no mercy

🤖 Local AI scoring: melody, rhythm and attacks, not your voice

🎡A wheel between rounds: bonuses, multipliers, and sabotages to hand out

😈 Sabotages: saturation, echo, pitch shift, chopped audio or your take swapped for a fart

🗣️ In-game voice chat that goes quiet exactly when someone performs

🔊 Themed sound packs - animals, machines, voices, and more

🛠️ Steam Workshop: build and share your own sound packs

⏱️ 10 minutes per game

ONE SOUND. ONE SHOT.

Every round reveals a reference sound to the whole table at once. Everybody records on the same countdown, then the takes are played back one by one while the room reacts. There is no second attempt and no rehearsal - whatever came out of your mouth is what everyone hears.

WE DON'T CARE ABOUT YOUR VOICE

Scoring is built around what a human throat can actually reproduce: the shape of the melody, the rhythm, the attacks, whether you barked once or three times. Not your timbre. A deep voice and a high voice doing the same curve score the same, so nobody wins just because they got lucky with their vocal cords.

THE WHEEL DECIDES

Between rounds the wheel spins for everyone at once. It hands out points, multipliers and sabotages. Draw one and you choose your victim: their next take comes out saturated, echoing, chopped to pieces, or replaced outright by a garbage sound the whole table hears instead of their voice. It costs them points on top. And you find out who aimed at you only when your take plays.

THE ROOM GOES QUIET

Voice chat is always on except when it shouldn't be. The moment a take starts playing, the whole table is muted so everyone hears the same thing. The second it ends, the mics open again, right in time for the reaction. That half-second is the game.

BRING YOUR OWN NOISES

Sound packs are just content. Make one, publish it to the Steam Workshop in a couple of clicks, and subscribe to whatever the community comes up with. Everyone at the table needs the pack before a game can start - the lobby tells you exactly who is still downloading.

store_data.about_the_game:
Swinging is easy. Landing it isn't.

SlapGains is a power-slap duel against the clock. Two figures, one podium, arm's length apart. First one to wobble loses. There is no block button. You read the wind-up, commit to blocking or rolling with it, and live with the choice.

The body is the stat sheet.

There are no skill points to spend. There are machines. Train power and your upper arms thicken and your shoulders widen. Train legs and you stand your ground longer. You read your progress off the figure, not off a number.

Five leagues, a ranking that means something.

Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, twenty rungs in all. Your points run through a dedicated server and out to the Steam leaderboard from there. Everyone above you got there by playing. And the trophy wall in your gym fills up with what you actually earned.

All one room.

No loading screen between training and fighting. The gym, the hallway and the arena are a single place you walk through.

  • Four training machines, each with its own rhythm minigame

  • Duels with wind-ups, feints, blocks, rolls and counters

  • Slow-motion replay when a slap really lands

  • Visible muscle growth, per body region

  • Five leagues, twenty rungs, server-verified leaderboards

  • Eight languages

  • Full controller support

store_data.about_the_game:
IT'S 1992. YOU NEED A JOB. ANY JOB.

Congratulations. You've just landed a job at your local VHS rental store.

It's not glamorous. It's not well paid. And apparently, the previous employee decided that 1,120 movies didn't need to be organised.

Your shift ends when every tape is in the right place.

Sort movies by genre. Sort them by year. Read the ridiculous blurbs. Keep the shelves tidy.

And whatever you do, don't lose the tape.

📼 1,120 MOVIES. ZERO REPEATS.

A huge collection of fictional VHS movies spanning decades of cinema.

Every movie has its own:

  • 🎬 Unique parody title

  • ⭐ Parody cast

  • 📅 Release year

  • 🎭 Genre

  • 📼 Movie blurb

  • 🗂️ Correct place on the shelf

No two movies have the same title. 

🎞️ 20 VHS GENRES

From big-budget blockbusters to absolute bargain-bin garbage:

ACTION • MARTIAL ARTS • HORROR • SCI-FI • COMEDY • ROMANCE • THRILLERS • CRIME • FANTASY • ADVENTURE • WESTERNS • MONSTERS • CULT CLASSICS • FAMILY • TEEN HITS • MUSIC & DANCE • SPORTS • IMPORTS & ANIME • DOCUMENTARIES • HOLIDAY FAVORITES

⏪ BE KIND. PLEASE REWIND.

Sorting isn't the only thing you'll be doing.

Customers return tapes without rewinding them, because apparently that's your problem now.

Keep the store running, get through your shift and deal with whatever disasters turn up along the way.

🕹️ GET BETTER AT THE JOB

The more you play, the more capable you become.

Unlock new abilities that help you sort faster, manage the store and deal with the increasingly ridiculous workload.

What starts as a simple job becomes a race against the clock to become the ultimate VHS sorting machine.

YOUR SHIFT HAS STARTED.

1,120 TAPES.
20 GENRES.
DECADES OF MOVIES.
ONE VERY TIRED EMPLOYEE.

Now get sorting.

One button. One beat. Keep the ricochet alive.

Project Ricochet is a high-stakes rhythm game built around a single input. Press the button the instant the ball hits a wall, chain each bounce to the music, and survive all the way to the end of the track.

The controls take seconds to learn, but every chart demands focus. A single miss ends the run. Retry instantly, learn each difficult passage, and experience the rush of finally clearing a track you once thought was impossible.

Key Features

• Rhythm-powered ricochet action — Time every impact and build a chain of Perfect hits.

• One miss ends the run — Every attempt is a tense, all-or-nothing performance.

• Simple one-button controls — Play with a keyboard, mouse, or gamepad and understand the basics in seconds.

• Create and share charts — Place walls with an intuitive editor, publish your creations, and take on charts made by other players.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

A routine mission. A deadly ambush. An ancient crystal that should never have been found.

You are a member of a task force in a deep operation. When your team is betrayed and attacked by heavily armed mercenaries, you flee into a set of forgotten ruins. Cornered and out of options, you discover a mysterious chamber filled with glowing crystals—and are suddenly transported somewhere beyond imagination.

You awaken in Crysaria, a fantasy kingdom populated by warriors, priestesses, sorceresses, monsters, and other creatures you thought existed only in stories.

Unfortunately, the people of Crysaria are not particularly happy to see you.

Some believe you are the hero foretold by an ancient prophecy. Others suspect you are a servant of Vaelith, the fearsome necromancer whose dark forces threaten the entire kingdom. Before you can earn your freedom—or find a way home—you will need to prove that you are more than a strangely dressed outsider.

Your arrival has changed the fate of Crysaria. What happens next will depend on your actions, your strength, and the relationships you build along the way.

Explore the Kingdom of Crysaria

Travel across an interactive fantasy world filled with dangerous and mysterious locations.

Visit the royal castle, train at the military barracks, study magic in an ancient tower, pray at the Crystal Church, explore dark forests and frozen mountains, or gather information at the local inn. Each location offers new characters, quests, activities, and opportunities.

But tread carefully: beyond the safety of the castle walls, monsters and darker forces are waiting.

Build Meaningful Relationships

Crysaria is home to a diverse cast of powerful and alluring women, each with her own personality, ambitions, secrets, and personal story.

Your dialogue choices and actions can change how they see you. Earn their trust, help them with their problems, spend time together, and discover where each relationship may lead.

Will you charm the proud princess, survive the attention of a wild warrior, earn the respect of a disciplined captain, or uncover the desires hidden beneath a devoted priestess’s sacred vows?

Choose your words carefully. First impressions are difficult to undo.

Become the Hero Crysaria Needs

You may have been a trained soldier in your own world, but swords, monsters, and magic follow very different rules.

Improve your attributes, acquire new equipment, and develop your own combat style. Combine physical attacks with offensive runes, healing grimoires, armor, rings, weapons, and potions to overcome increasingly dangerous enemies in turn-based battles.

Train with the inhabitants of Crysaria to improve your abilities and unlock new ways to face the challenges ahead.

Features

  • A story-driven fantasy adventure filled with action, comedy, romance, and adult situations.

  • A modern protagonist transported into a dangerous medieval fantasy world.

  • A varied cast of heroines with distinct personalities and individual storylines.

  • Dialogue choices that influence relationships and character interactions.

  • An explorable kingdom featuring multiple locations and activities.

  • Turn-based combat against monsters and other dangerous enemies.

  • Character progression with physical, defensive, and magical attributes.

  • Weapons, armor, potions, rings, offensive runes, and healing grimoires.

  • Quests, treasures, gold, shops, training activities, and unlockable upgrades.

  • Animated scenes and detailed fantasy environments.

  • An overarching story centered on an ancient prophecy and the fight against the necromancer Vaelith.

Become stronger. Win their trust. Uncover the truth behind the crystal—and decide what kind of hero you want to be.

Welcome Space Crawler!

The battles are over, the fleets have departed... but thousands of metric tons of wreckage still drift through space. It’s time to clean up these debris fields.

Pilot your ship, control its inertia, and use a physics-based grappling hook to grab, move, and launch debris into the barge ship.

Once the area has been cleared, wreckage and debris are recycled into materials. Use them to craft new equipment, upgrade your ship, and unlock new technologies. Sell your resources, invest in blueprints, maintain your ships, and secure mining rights to increasingly lucrative—and increasingly dangerous—sectors.

  • Grab, pull, swing, and throw debris with precision.

  • Recycle it to obtain the materials you need to progress.

  • Unlock and craft new equipment, and customize your ships for upcoming sectors.

  • Purchase mining rights for sectors that are more profitable but also more dangerous.

  • Explore a variety of sectors: ancient battlefields, abandoned stations, mining zones…

The game is currently in active development. Screenshots reflect the current pre-alpha state and are subject to change.

In "Mermade" the childhood fantasy of becoming a mermaid is turned into a cruel and twisted reality.

You play as a woman who was experimented on against her will, robbed of her legs and stitched together with a fishtail.

Faced with this new reality, you have to escape in whatever way you can, while surviving the dangers lurking within the facility with other failed experiments.

A BODY MADE FOR WATER

Use your new tail to swim and dive through the tanks of the facility. In the water, your transformed body gives you freedom of movement, but leaving the water behind comes at a cost.

VULNERABLE ON ONCE FAMILIAR GROUND

Without legs, even basic movement becomes a struggle. Pull yourself across the floor and find a way forward while the facility’s dangers close in around you.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH

Can you piece together what happened to you? Who would do something like that and why?

Discover where you are and why you are here.

store_data.about_the_game:
The mystery was only the beginning.

Return to the world of The Libido Enigma in a new adult visual novel where scientific ambition, corporate power, romance, and desire collide once again.

After uncovering the truth behind a revolutionary libido-enhancing drug, you might have thought the danger was over. Instead, the discovery has opened the door to something far greater—something that could change medicine, reshape the pharmaceutical industry, and alter millions of lives.

And some very powerful people want control of it.

As a scientist caught at the center of a growing corporate battle, you'll reunite with familiar faces while meeting new allies, rivals, and temptations. Friendships will be tested, relationships will deepen, and the choices you made before will continue to shape the people around you.

The women at the heart of your story return with their own ambitions, struggles, and secrets. Isabella, Emily, Brooke, and Giselle aren't simply along for the ride—their lives are changing too, and your relationships with them can grow in very different directions.

But science doesn't happen in a vacuum.

Corporate takeovers, stolen research, hidden agendas, and billion-dollar interests threaten everything you've worked for. What began with a drug designed to enhance libido has become a fight over a discovery with consequences no one could have imagined.

Along the way, you'll decide who to trust, who to love, and just how far you're willing to go to protect the people and the science that matter to you.

The Libido Enigma II: The Fountain of Youth expands the original story with:

  • A new biotech mystery with much higher stakes

  • Returning characters and new faces

  • Multiple romance paths and relationship choices

  • Decisions that shape both personal and professional relationships

  • Humor, drama, romance, intrigue, and plenty of adult fun

  • Detailed visuals and animated adult scenes

  • A continuing story where science and desire are never far apart

You play as a new cafeteria worker: prepare meals, complete your everyday duties, and make it through five working days while gradually discovering that something unsettling lies beneath the ordinary routine.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the cellarer, the monk answerable for provisioning the whole monastery.

With nothing to start from but a cloister and its lay brothers, you will clear the land around it to raise workshops, lay paths, and see that every part of the monastery gets what it needs.

Every cart matters. Every path matters. Every decision shapes the future of your monastery.

Play the Free Demo

Discover the first Tier of the Cellarer in the free demo, available now.

Manage your first lay brothers, establish production chains, keep the monastery fed, and grow your settlement until its first great edifice stands complete: the Belfry.

The demo includes the whole of Tier I. Download it now and begin building your monastery!

Logistics Down to the Last Detail

Paths are not simple connections.

Every lane runs one way, every junction forces a choice, and it falls to you to keep congestion off the board. Every cart is pulled by a lay brother, and that brother must be housed and fed before he can work.

Your transport network is bounded by the workforce your monastery can support. As production grows, congestion becomes the real challenge: one blocked workshop, and your whole economy stands still.

Far More Than Production Chains

A monastery is far more than a collection of workshops.

The daily Offices must be supplied with candles and everything else the liturgy calls for. Offices well celebrated earn Prestige, which unlocks new production chains and the buildings that serve them. Faith and Parchment, for their part, let the Chapter adopt new customs: permanent improvements to your monastery, as well as new buildings of their own.

Build It Stone by Stone

Most buildings go up instantly.

Great edifices follow an altogether different course.

Stone, timber and the other materials travel a dedicated construction network before each stage of the work can begin. From the belfry to the cathedral, every monument rises by degrees on the effort of your entire economy.

An Interface Built for Management

store_data.detailed_description:
You are the cellarer, the monk answerable for provisioning the whole monastery.

With nothing to start from but a cloister and its lay brothers, you will clear the land around it to raise workshops, lay paths, and see that every part of the monastery gets what it needs.

Every cart matters. Every path matters. Every decision shapes the future of your monastery.

Play the Free Demo

Discover the first Tier of the Cellarer in the free demo, available now.

Manage your first lay brothers, establish production chains, keep the monastery fed, and grow your settlement until its first great edifice stands complete: the Belfry.

The demo includes the whole of Tier I. Download it now and begin building your monastery!

Logistics Down to the Last Detail

Paths are not simple connections.

Every lane runs one way, every junction forces a choice, and it falls to you to keep congestion off the board. Every cart is pulled by a lay brother, and that brother must be housed and fed before he can work.

Your transport network is bounded by the workforce your monastery can support. As production grows, congestion becomes the real challenge: one blocked workshop, and your whole economy stands still.

Far More Than Production Chains

A monastery is far more than a collection of workshops.

The daily Offices must be supplied with candles and everything else the liturgy calls for. Offices well celebrated earn Prestige, which unlocks new production chains and the buildings that serve them. Faith and Parchment, for their part, let the Chapter adopt new customs: permanent improvements to your monastery, as well as new buildings of their own.

Build It Stone by Stone

Most buildings go up instantly.

Great edifices follow an altogether different course.

Stone, timber and the other materials travel a dedicated construction network before each stage of the work can begin. From the belfry to the cathedral, every monument rises by degrees on the effort of your entire economy.

store_data.about_the_game:
MARVELOUS SOCCER SIMULATION

Management Simulation

You are the manager. The board wants results. The fans want football. The budget wants discipline.

Marvelous Soccer Simulation is a single-player football career manager inspired by the late-90s and early-2000s management sims — fast seasons, clear stakes, leagues and cups that matter, and players you actually know — without modern bloat.

Take a club. Live the calendar. Climb divisions, chase silverware, and shape a squad under real pressure. This is management first — not arcade skill games, not online multiplayer.

THE CLASSIC SIM SPIRIT

• Fast-paced career loop — seasons that move; decisions that stick

• Leagues — promotion, relegation, and table fights from the lower divisions up

• Cups — knockout runs, upsets, and midweek pressure

• Players — squad depth, roles, fitness, and the names that define your side

• Fictional clubs, competitions, and identities — a world of its own (no licensed real-world leagues)

LEAD THE CLUB

• Take charge and live the full season calendar

• Climb the pyramid, chase promotion, fight relegation

• Balance results with cash, wages, and board expectations

TACTICS & SQUAD

• Formations, roles, and match plans that shape the side

• Manage depth and fitness when the calendar bites

• Make the call when the match turns — changes that matter

TRANSFERS & ECONOMY

• Buy and sell in a living market

• Watch the wage bill, the runway, and the cost of ambition

• Grow the club beyond the first eleven — stadium and commercial levers where the sim supports them

MATCH NIGHT

• Readable drama and managerial stakes — the story of the game, not button-mashing

• Continental stages like the Marvelous Liberty Cup — groups, brackets, and big nights

• Presentation that puts you in the dugout, including set-piece theatre such as penalties

A WORLD TO MANAGE

• Choose your starting league from a wide nation list at New Game

• National leagues and cups plus continental competition paths

• Long careers built for climb, survival, and dynasty — not a single weekend campaign

EARLY ACCESS

Marvelous Soccer Simulation is in Early Access from JV Interactive. The career core is playable now. Balance, presentation, systems depth, and localization expand with free updates based on player feedback and our roadmap.

Who is this for?

Managers who want long careers, transfer puzzles, cup tension, and the grind of a real season calendar.

Who is this not for?

Players looking for online multiplayer, licensed real-world leagues, or console-style action soccer. This is a management simulation first.

store_data.about_the_game:
Agent Sherine: Oil Baron is a sequel to Agent Sherine: Dancing Fox.

Sherine Hale’s previous operation was only preparation. After discovering that the CIA had been training her to enter Oleg Ivanov’s inner circle, she begins the true mission.

Oleg is preparing to host Sheikh Ramid Al-Dosari and his international delegation at a secluded mansion. Together, they intend to negotiate an enormous investment in new oil routes across South America.

If successful, the agreement could create a global energy empire worth an almost unimaginable fortune.

Sherine enters the mansion undercover as part of its hospitality staff. Meetings may begin early, continue late into the night, or be arranged without warning, requiring selected staff members to remain inside the estate throughout the negotiations.

This places Sherine at the center of everything.

Behind the mansion’s luxury lies a dangerous struggle for influence. Rival agents want to interfere with the agreement, members of the delegation pursue their own interests, and Oleg’s people are watching everyone. Every private conversation, secret meeting, and intimate encounter may reveal valuable information—or bring Sherine closer to exposure.

The CIA wants the agreement to succeed, but Sherine has ambitions of her own. This time, Sherine is not merely completing somebody else’s mission. She intends to play every side—and take control of the fortune for herself.

Features

  • A cinematic adult spy visual novel

  • A direct continuation of Agent Sherine: Dancing Fox

  • Choices that influence relationships, intelligence, and outcomes

  • Espionage, conspiracy, betrayal, and mature encounters

  • Returning characters and a new international cast

  • A story planned across approximately 6–8 episodes

store_data.about_the_game:
Neon Breaker is a fun horizontal shmup 3d retro shooter in the legacy of the great action arcade classics.

Familiar twin stick gameplay with a polished and modernized look & feel.

No backstory and no one to rescue! Just pure adrenaline action and fun!

Gameplay :

Dominate the skies and have fun doing it!

Shoot, evade, hunt & get hunted while making everything explode as you clear waves for points.

Push your limits playing through endless waves to unlock new leaderboard high scores and gameplay cards.

Game Modes :

-Classic: for that managed chaos. Things explode predictably and on time.

-Anomaly: rogue-like twist with 50+ cards! Make each run memorable with different gameplay mutations.

Difficulty :

-Normal: no continues, all achievements, contribute to online leaderboards, provides a good challenge.

-Rookie: 1 continue slot, only 8 unlock-able achievements, no online leaderboards, easier chill fights.

Your Ships :

-The Neon Breaker is your trusty balanced fighter.

-The Dropzoner is fast, fragile and furious. 

-Each with different life/shield profile, both able to boost out of danger.

Weapons :

-Bolt, dependable message spreader.

-Lancet, longer range piercing negotiator.

-Pulse, personal space management.

-Cycle between weapons for overcharge bonus.

-Mega Bomb & Ultra Bomb, quick conflict resolution.

-10+ stackable pickups.

Coop play:

-Local & remote with cross-play support.

-Invite friends, play on the public lobby or with local AI pilots.

The World :

-Multiple 80s neon themed music reactive procedural sci-fi worlds. (Space, Alien, Ocean, Cyberpunk, Vortex)

-120 unique waves for a full repeatable run for endless gameplay.

-Synthwave music soundtrack that ticks all the good vibes. (20+)

-Configurable VFX settings (Bloom, Filmic tone-mapping, DOF, letterbox, volumetric, high FPS support..)

-Mini map support.

The Cast :

-20 varied disposable enemy unit types.

-6 mini boss map controllers to give you trouble.

-20 unique herald bosses to give you a real challenge. (plus bonus looting interludes on defeating them)

Scoring :

-Chain kills for up to x8 score combos.

-Finish waves early for x2 bonus on next wave. Or finish late and be hunted.

-Multiple Anomaly cards to trade score multipliers.


Featuring :

-Stylized low poly 3d retro visuals inspired by 80s action arcade game cabinets.

-Rich full 3d Gallery and music Jukebox with support for custom soundtracks.

-Replay system so you can easily share and analyze your runs.

-Localization in English, French, Spanish and Japanese.

-Steam leaderboards for Classic and Anomaly modes.

-Arcade cabinet style demo attraction mode.

-2 different 3d gameplay camera play modes.

-60 achievement awards to unlock.

-Defeat up to thousands of enemies per wave.

-Play against up to 300 enemy units on screen at any one time.

-Physics of mass debris destruction.

-Supports 60 to 144+ fps even on low end specs.

-Remappable controls, mouse, keyboards, and controller support.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Alice // In the Firewall, you are plunged into the neon-lit mainframe of an Aegis Corp facility. Operating through your digital avatar, Alice, your job is simple: breach impenetrable security gates, override automated defense subroutines, and reconstruct the missing memory fragments buried deep within the grid to escape the lockdown.

Story

Just another high-stakes contract. Until the firewall locked the doors.

As a freelance net-hacker contracted by Aegis Corp, your job is simple: enter their massive, high-security server facilities and resolve the critical, high-level system failures that no one else can handle. You fix the impossible bugs, collect your fee, and leave.

But during a routine diagnostic inside a locked Aegis facility, a sudden lockdown seals you inside. Forced to jack directly into the core terminal to override the security protocols, you are pulled into a surreal digital landscape—a neon-lit firewall structured like a twisted cyber-Wonderland.

To escape the physical building, you must navigate through glitched system processes, solve intricate security ciphers, and unearth the hidden data files Aegis left behind—unraveling a dark truth about the corporation, the firewall, and your own forgotten past.

Gameplay

Override protocols. Decrypt the grid. Escape the facility.

Alice // In the Firewall combines classic point-and-click investigation with tactical puzzle-solving and responsive visual interaction:

  • On-Site & Terminal Investigation: Search high-tech Aegis facility terminals, decrypt corporate emails, and reconstruct corrupted logs to bypass physical and digital lockdowns.

  • Cyber-Wonderland Architecture: Navigate a surreal mainframe inhabited by glitched digital entities—from mechanical CRT caterpillars to razor-sharp security queens—each guarding key network nodes.

  • Tactical Logic Diagnostics: Override corporate security measures by solving complex circuit routing, pentomino ciphers, and diagnostic system locks.

  • Interactive Neural Interface: Direct Alice's digital avatar in real time. Her visual state and emotional reactions respond dynamically to your diagnostic inputs, puzzle failures, and security overrides as you navigate the firewall.

Key Features

  • Cyber-Wonderland Architecture: Navigate a dark, atmospheric mainframe inhabited by rogue system processes, glitched digital entities, and hostile security protocols.

  • Terminal & Logic Puzzles: Solve intricate circuit routing, pentomino ciphers, and diagnostic locks to bypass firewall sectors.

  • Deep Narrative Investigation: Decrypt forgotten audio logs, system emails, and corrupted data vaults to uncover a massive digital conspiracy.

  • Classic Tactical Investigation: Explore high-tech terminal interfaces with focus-driven, point-and-click interactions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome back to the digital world of the 2000s - the era of pixelated icons, pop-up windows, shady software, early internet memes, and filenames that explain absolutely nothing.

In Cleandows XP, you work as a PC cleaner, taking on the messiest desktops around. Choose your clients, review each job’s requirements, and bring order to their digital chaos—preferably without deleting anything important along the way.

Sorting files into folders isn’t as easy as it sounds. Filenames rarely tell you anything useful, so you’ll need to open and inspect photos, documents, memes, and programs. It’s the only way to tell whether you’re looking at a family photo, an important report, yet another cat meme, or a suspicious file you probably shouldn’t have opened in the first place.

Every client has their own story, their own requirements, and their own idea of what “organized” means. Some simply don’t understand how folders work. Others keep files on their desktop that you’d rather not ask about.

Sometimes, a routine cleanup turns into a full-blown computer disaster. Viruses lock up the system, ransomware demands payment, and suddenly you’re thrown into unexpected code-breaking minigames. Fix the problem and get back to work before you hit your fatal-error limit.

Once you think the computer is clean enough, submit the job and see how you did. Earn ratings, stars, and cash, climb the career ladder, unlock new clients, and spend your hard-earned money in the shop.

Features:

  • Choose clients and complete jobs with different requirements.

  • Open files and sort them by what they contain, not just what they’re called.

  • Organize photos, memes, documents, and programs into the right folders.

  • Track the files left to sort and stay within your fatal-error limit.

  • Deal with viruses, ransomware, and unexpected minigames.

  • Earn cleanup ratings, stars, and cash.

  • Climb the career ladder and unlock new clients.

  • Get to know your clients through their files, habits, and digital clutter.

  • Step back into the 2000s with old-school interfaces, bizarre software, internet memes, and chaotic desktops.

Cleandows XP is a game about order, curiosity, and nostalgia for a time when the internet was slower and every button looked pressable.

store_data.about_the_game:
🍫 Soft Marshmallows, Melted Chocolate & Gentle Chess Magic!


Welcome to a world that looks and feels like a warm, sweet dessert!

In Life of Pawn: Chocolate and Marshmallow, you play as an adorable little marshmallow hopping across crumbling chocolate platforms, collecting ice cream treats, and dodging glowing cherry bombs. Watch your tiny friend evolve step-by-step from a sweet little Pawn all the way into the legendary Fritz!

✨ 100% Hand-Drawn then Converted to SVG


Every single curve, blush, and melting chocolate drip was drawn by hand with love, using zero stock assets and zero generic templates. Enjoy squishy squash-and-stretch landings, fluffy cream dash clouds, and cute dizzy-star spins that make every jump feel alive!

🧠 Learn Real Chess Tactics Without Any Stress


Always wanted to learn chess, but felt intimidated? We turned learning chess into a cute, friendly adventure. As your marshmallow character evolves, it naturally introduces real-world tactical vocabulary:

  • Pawn Stage: Master sneaky En Passant captures!
  • Bishop Stage: Untangle diagonal Pins.
  • Knight Stage: Leap into multi-target Forks under gentle timers.
  • Rook & Queen Stage: Execute intermezzo checks, desperado rooks, and mating nets!

Make a wrong move? No big deal! The game gently shows you the correct answer with a friendly explanation before your next hop.

☕ Play Exactly How You Want: 5 Cozy-to-Clever Modes


Whether you want to chill on the couch with a cup of tea or test your quick-thinking reflexes, there is a playstyle tailored just for you:

  • 🎨 I LIKE COLOURS (Pure Chill Platforming): Relax and enjoy the sweet visuals! The game solves all the chess puzzles automatically in the background while you hop, dash, and collect rewards.
  • 🧩 I WANT TO SOLVE CHESS (Cozy Puzzle Mode): Zero platforming stress! The game handles the jumping while you relax, sip your drink, and solve cute chess puzzles at your own comfortable pace.
  • 🤖 CHESS BOT (Hypnotic Screensaver Mode): Sit back and watch a living, animated chocolate chess world play itself. Perfect background cozy vibes while you study, work, or relax!
  • 🎵 RHYTHM LIGHT & TRUE RHYTHM: Ready for a gentle spark of energy? Test your timing with beginner-friendly 4-option choices or full notation puzzles!

🎀 Sweet Game Features


  • 7 Cute Character Evolutions with 100% unique, frame-by-frame hand-drawn animations.
  • Ice Cream Gap-Fills: Bridge broken chocolate platforms using sweet ice cream cups!
  • 5 Game Modes ranging from zero-stress spectator modes to rewarding rhythm platforming.
  • Real Chess Curriculum that builds genuine pattern recognition and board vision.
  • Voiced Character Moments: Enjoy cute voiced lines and screen-filling animations when you cash out your ultimate moves!
  • Full Keyboard Support & 144 FPS: Smooth vector graphics that run like butter on any setup.

5055190.name: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal

store_data.about_the_game:
Bring him back

Your master was the best fighter in the keep, right up until the Corruption Crystal pulled him inside it. Somebody has to go in after him. That somebody is you, and you are, at the moment, not very good at this.

Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a small, chunky survivor roguelite about walking into a field full of enemies and coming back out with a slightly better sword.

Moving is your whole job

Your knight swings on his own, in a steady pulse, forever. There's no attack button. What you actually do is walk: decide who's inside the radius, thread the gap in the pack, and read the field half a second before it happens.

The camera doesn't move and the arena doesn't scroll, so everything that can reach you is already on screen. Easy to pick up. Harder to get good at.

Decide what your sword is made of

Somewhere in your first run you'll commune with the Fire Crystal, and your swing gets a little warmer. Later you'll pick up Frost Crystal, and now you have two elements and a slider that decides how much of each goes into every hit.

Fire burns things down over time. Frost drags the horde into slow motion so you can walk circles around it. Lightning jumps between bodies and clears the clumps. Run 60% fire and 40% lightning and see how it feels. Go pure frost the next run and find out it's a different game.

Two buttons worth pressing

Bulwark plants your shield and throws everything around you backwards, with a window of invulnerability while it lands. It's the answer to being surrounded.

Bladestorm throws your sword into the crowd and let it chew. Unleash the blender.

Moving is your whole job

[About This Game]

Survive the Twisted Midnight Streets

Past midnight, the once-familiar city has morphed into an unsettling, chilling nightmare. In Midnight Haunting, you have only one goal: make it home alive. However, an array of deadly traps hidden within the thick darkness and fog block your path, waiting to claim your life.

Precise Classic Platforming

Tread carefully, hang from ledges, and leap over hazards. Every movement carries physical weight, and a single hasty decision or misstep will lead to a brutal end.

[Key Features]

  • Unforgiving Death Traps: Crumbling floors, hidden hazards striking from the shadows, and sudden ghostly ambushes. Analyze and overcome cunningly placed traps scattered throughout the dark streets.

  • Haunting Atmosphere: Flickering streetlights, unsettling shadows, and unidentified footsteps blend together to create an isolating, tense midnight horror experience where you can never drop your guard.

  • Precise, Weighty Controls: A modern reimagining of the classic cinematic platformer experience. Realistic animations and deliberate mechanics convey the sheer desperation of survival.

  • Death and Mastery: Dying is simply the process of learning the rules of these streets. Memorize the terrain, master the trap patterns, and experience a thrilling sense of accomplishment when you finally open your front door.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Edge of the Backrooms takes players into the deepest, most unnerving reaches of the Backrooms ever seen. Told through a found footage format, the story follows an astronaut who falls through a null zone on Jupiter's moon, Europa. Due to its distance from Earth, this threshold reaches the farthest edges of the complex, where reality itself begins to disintegrate, and existential dread takes hold.

  • Immersive and ultra-realistic found footage gameplay.

  • Strange and uncanny locations spread across multiple levels.

  • A subtle combination of both liminal and cosmic horror elements.

  • Multiple branching pathways and endings. Each playthrough may be different.

  • An unsettling soundtrack.

  • You cannot die during gameplay. However, that does not mean you are alone.

NOTE: This is my own interpretation of the Backrooms. It takes inspiration from Kane Pixels' series and The Complex: Expedition, but these projects are unrelated.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your failed attempts don't disappear. You climb them.


AFTERIMAGE is a puzzle platformer built on a single button that matters. Press ECHO and the run you
just made is sealed and released as a solid body — a past self that replays your exact inputs,
forever, and that you can stand on.

You are put back at the start, on top of the stack. Every route up is one you built out of the
attempts that didn't make it.

One rule. Eleven ways to use it.


There are no unlocks and no upgrade tree. Everything in the game falls out of two facts: your echoes
are solid, and anything standing on something that moves inherits its motion.

  • STEP — park an echo and stand on it.
  • TOWER — stack them, each on the last, until you can reach.
  • BRIDGE — leave one as a stepping stone.
  • RIDE — a sideways-moving echo carries you across.
  • LIFT — ride a jumping echo and step off at the top of its arc.
  • HOLD — park one on a pressure plate to hold a door open while you walk somewhere else.
  • ROUTE — every key must be collected, and your echoes collect them too, on every replay.
  • DRIFT — conveyors drag you, and drag your past selves out of position.
  • TRACK — moving platforms are a ride you have to catch.
  • FRAGILE — crumbling platforms hold once; an echo can spend one so you don't have to.
  • WEIGH — counterweights, where an echo is nothing but ballast. Load one pan, ride the other.

Hazards destroy everything, your past selves included — so a tower is never safe by default,
and an echo that walks into spikes is gone for the rest of the attempt.

80 hand-built floors


The campaign is 80 authored rooms in fourteen tiers, each introducing one idea on its own before
combining it with everything before it. No procedural generation, no filler: every floor was placed
by hand and solved before it shipped.

  • UNDO removes your newest echo and rewinds to where that recording began — so you can walk a
    tower all the way back down and try a different shape.
  • RESET restarts the attempt clock, and the whole tower reassembles in the order you built it.
  • Par on every floor, for players who want to find the version of the answer that costs fewer
    past selves.

The editor is the same game


Build levels in the physics you just played, not an approximation of it. Eleven elements — solids,
crumblers, belts, movers, hazards, counterweights, plates, gates, keys, spawn and exit — drag,
resize and snap on a grid, with TEST one keystroke away.

Proven, not promised


You cannot publish a level you have not beaten.

The simulation is deterministic, and a run is recorded as inputs rather than positions — one byte per
frame. That makes your clear a checkable claim: when you publish, the server re-runs your
solution against the level you built and confirms it actually finishes. Levels that pass carry a
VERIFIED badge.

Nothing in the community pool is a room somebody uploaded and hoped was possible.

Play what other people built


  • Browse by newest, top rated, featured or hardest — with a preview of every level before you open it.
  • Per-level leaderboards for fewest echoes and fastest time.
  • Remix any level to fork someone else's idea into your own editor.
  • Rate levels, and share any of them by a short code.

Details


  • Ten languages, fully translated: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese,
    Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian.
  • The campaign plays entirely offline. A connection is only needed for community levels and
    leaderboards.
  • Windows, Linux and SteamOS, native 64-bit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cosmic Seance is a victorian investigation game blended with cosmic horror. As a Medium, your mission is to summon cosmic entities to uncover the truth that can save the realm. But the ancient gods do not speak like humans. They do not lie, but they do not give direct answers either. They show you fragments: loose visions, images with no apparent connection.

Your job is to interpret those fragments, give them shape, and piece together the truth one piece at a time.

The problem: every question you ask brings you closer to madness.

SEANCES

Face Lovecraftian entities in over 50 sessions across 13 chapters. Each entity has its own sanity mechanic, preparing you for the abyss.

SANITY IS A RESOURCE

Every question, every vision, every choice consumes your sanity. If it reaches zero, the abyss consumes you and you lose the session. You can fail. You can die. But when you replay a session, you remember what you have already seen.

A sort of narrative "roguelike" with mental resource management.

YOUR VISION BOARD

Every vision you discover becomes a card on your board. Drag them, organize them, interpret them. When you understand their meaning, place them in the answer slots to advance the investigation.

It's just you, the visions, and the pressure of your sanity ticking down in the background.

A DYING REALM

You are not a street detective. You are the Medium. The only one. There is a realm to save, traitors to punish, and a young queen who placed her last hope in your talents.

There are no battles. No weapons. But enemies and traitors are everywhere.

To face them: your mind against the abyss.

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?

Cosmic Seance is for you if:

  • You enjoy reading between the lines and piecing together mysteries

  • You want a game that respects your patience and intelligence

  • You like narrative games with no quick reflexes or jump scares

  • You enjoy managing scarce resources and making decisions with real consequences

COMING SOON

A demo will be available soon.

Add Cosmic Seance to your wishlist and don't miss the launch.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wizard Disaster is a cartoon boss rush and nothing else. No corridors, no fetch quests, no filler between the fights. Every location on the map is a boss. The whole map is open from the start, and there are twelve bosses between you and the end of the game.

Simple enough.

Unfortunately, they are very good at their jobs.

There are twelve bosses, and most of them won't be what you expect.

Nothing here is unfair.

Nothing here is forgiving, either.

Fight them in whatever order you want, or whatever order you can survive.

You have three hearts. That's your entire health budget. Want a fourth? It'll cost you.

You start with one spell and a pair of boots. Everything else has to be earned and bought:

  • New ways to attack

  • Better ways to move

  • A few tricks to keep in reserve when everything goes wrong

Every boss rewards you with a medal. Bronze for beating them, Silver for doing it without taking more than one hit, and Gold for a clean run under par.

Medals earn you coin, and coins buy upgrades.

So going back to a boss you've already beaten isn't just replaying old fights for the sake of it. It's how you earn the upgrades that might finally get you through the next one.

Full keyboard and controller support, both rebindable. Three save slots.
store_data.detailed_description:
Wizard Disaster is a cartoon boss rush and nothing else. No corridors, no fetch quests, no filler between the fights. Every location on the map is a boss. The whole map is open from the start, and there are twelve bosses between you and the end of the game.

Simple enough.

Unfortunately, they are very good at their jobs.

There are twelve bosses, and most of them won't be what you expect.

Nothing here is unfair.

Nothing here is forgiving, either.

Fight them in whatever order you want, or whatever order you can survive.

You have three hearts. That's your entire health budget. Want a fourth? It'll cost you.

You start with one spell and a pair of boots. Everything else has to be earned and bought:

  • New ways to attack

  • Better ways to move

  • A few tricks to keep in reserve when everything goes wrong

Every boss rewards you with a medal. Bronze for beating them, Silver for doing it without taking more than one hit, and Gold for a clean run under par.

Medals earn you coin, and coins buy upgrades.

So going back to a boss you've already beaten isn't just replaying old fights for the sake of it. It's how you earn the upgrades that might finally get you through the next one.

Full keyboard and controller support, both rebindable. Three save slots.
store_data.short_description: A boss-rush adventure through a cartoon wizard universe. Twelve bosses, three spells, and nothing in between them but the next fight. Beat them, take their seals, and finish the banishment you fumbled the first time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Command the orbital plane.

Near-future Earth. Opponents race for orbital superiority, and the

battlefield is a dark shell of empty space where nothing is visible

until someone looks at it.

Orbital Strike is a real-time strategy game where satellites are

weapons. Build them from modular parts, launch them into the orbits you

choose, and command them through a war fought at eight kilometers per

second.

THE SKY IS DARK

Satellites are invisible by default. Yours, theirs, everyone's. An asset

only appears when an active sensor illuminates it — radar, infrared, or

optical — and each of those can be jammed independently.

Overlapping sensor coverage is how you see. Coordinated jamming is how

you disappear. Break every sensor covering a satellite and it drops off

the map entirely.

BUILD. LAUNCH. FIGHT.

  • Hangar — assemble satellites from bus classes and payload modules. Kinetic kill vehicles, directed energy, jammers, sensors.

  • Launch — assign to a rocket, choose LEO, MEO, GEO or polar, and watch it climb.

  • Orbital AOR — the live battlefield. Maneuver, coordinate strike packages, fight.

The clock never stops. Time runs in all three modes at once, and

leaving the orbital view means trusting your constellation to survive

without you.

TIER AGAINST TIER

Every weapon, sensor, and jammer is rated one through five. Higher tiers

defeat lower ones, but nothing defeats an equal. Research costs time and

money, and your opponent is climbing the same tree at the same time.

ORBITAL MECHANICS AS STRATEGY

A satellite can only strike what it passes over. Changing orbit costs

fuel and takes time you may not have. Position is everything, and

position is governed by physics rather than by wishing.

THE ORBIT REMEMBERS

Every satellite you destroy leaves debris, and debris does not go away.

Foul a strategically valuable orbit and it stays fouled for the rest of

the campaign — for your enemy, and for you.

SHIFTING ALLIANCES

Third-party nations move between hostile and allied based on what you

spend, what you protect, and what you share. Allies contribute ground

sensors and basing rights. Your opponent is courting them too.

store_data.about_the_game:
There is a thin slice of empty space above your taskbar. Someone should colonize it.

Taskbar Colony is an idle space colony that lives in a transparent strip along the bottom of your screen. Tiny colonists scavenge, build, and haul cargo while you work, browse, or play. Glance down now and then, catch a supply pod, buy a building, and get back to your day.

A colony above your taskbar

  • Lives in a slim, transparent, always-on-top strip that sits just above the Windows taskbar

  • Click-through everywhere except the colony itself, so your desktop stays 100% usable

  • Stretch it across the whole screen, keep it compact, or minimize it to a tiny stat badge

An idle economy that respects your day

  • Nine building types, from Solar Arrays to a horizon-bending Terraformer

  • Supply pods drop in, cargo ships return for pickup, and colonists wander around

  • Named milestones raise your rate as the colony grows into a city

  • Offline earnings keep the lights on for up to 8 hours while you are away

Crew who are actually somebody

  • Colonists arrive with a name and a trade, and drift toward the work they do

  • They doze at night, notice your cursor, and can be checked on for a moment of their time

  • The ones aboard at liftoff are remembered by name in the Colony Log

Four systems, not one long curve

  • Research projects that change how the colony works, not just how fast it goes

  • Directives you choose from a board and swap whenever you like, never on a timer

  • The Charter, where prestige stops being a number that goes up and becomes something you spend

  • Landing Sites that change what the ground under a new colony is worth

Evacuate. Prestige. Refound.

  • When a colony is rich enough, load everyone onto the colony ship and lift off

  • Every evacuation banks prestige to spend on the Charter, permanently

  • Each colony gets its own generated name and a place in your Colony Log

  • Fly a flag over every settlement: pick a built-in, or make your own in the Steam Workshop

An endgame you build in the sky

  • The Orbital Ring is assembled one span at a time, each carried up by an evacuation

  • Eight spans, then a single ignition you only ever get to watch once

  • After that the sky over every new colony is different, forever

It behaves itself

  • Automatically hides (and goes silent) when any app runs fullscreen

  • 24 achievements, stats, Steam Cloud saves, and Steam rich presence built in

  • A reduced-motion option for the ambient effects, and the keyboard is never required

  • Built to sip resources: capped frame rate, no giant overlay, no input lag

A very small frontier, right above the Start button.

store_data.about_the_game:
If you loved being left alone with the evidence in Return of the Obra Dinn, or felt the weight Papers, Please puts on every stamp, this game lives at that crossing: behind the counter of a medieval relic shop.

You are the relic appraiser of a pilgrim city. Examine each piece, find the lie, and decide what the truth is worth.

You turn it on the table and weigh what the bone says against the metal, the wood and the document that came with it. At some point, one layer stops fitting the rest. Nobody points at that moment. You find it.

Inspect Before You Buy


Observe each relic, compare its documents with the evidence, sign your verdict—and only then decide whether to buy it.

By the time you press the seal you already know the truth. Your verdict is written down, and the world remembers it.

Sell honestly and earn less. Report the forger and make enemies who do not forget. Keep what you know to yourself and charge full price. The city does not judge you today: it bills you weeks later, when you can no longer tell which choice caught up with you.

Every Fake Sale Leaves a Trace


Sell a forgery knowingly and complaints raise suspicion. Let it accumulate, and the Inquisition may search your shop.

No spreadsheets, no profit graphs. What a pilgrim sees walking through the door says who you are before you open your mouth.

Build a Living Relic Shop


Buy stock from traveling suppliers, fill your shelves, serve each request, collect your denarii and expand the shop.

The Inquisition is not a monster. It is a man who asks polite questions and writes down the answers. Every decision leaves a trace, and traces pile up where you cannot see them.

What You Will Do

  • Examine: cross-check bone, metal, wood and document until the contradiction shows itself.
  • Judge: press the seal; your verdict goes on the record.
  • Decide: sell the truth, sell the hope, report the forger, or keep the piece.
  • Grow: reputation opens doors to pieces, customers and suppliers.
  • Survive suspicion: someone is always taking notes.

store_data.about_the_game:
BUNNYBALL is an arcade basketball roguelike about throwing real shots and building unreal combos. Every basket is a physics throw under a ticking clock - and every five shots form a poker hand. Pair up your balls, break the scoring, and beat the machine one impossible run at a time.

Step up to the machine

Forget simulation basketball - this is the coin-op hoops cabinet from the arcade, rebuilt as a full roguelike. Each round gives you a target score and not enough time. Your aim earns the baskets; your build decides what they're worth. Sink five shots and they're scored like a poker hand - a Pair of matching balls, a Full House, a Five of a Kind - each with its own multiplier. The better you build, the harder every throw counts.

Rig the game in your favor:

Collect the Cards: 25+ run-warping cards that stack into engines - multiply grouped scores, charge the jackpot faster, earn interest on your savings, or summon a god's hand that scores a ball for you every few seconds.

Change the balls themselves: 10+ ball types that rewrite the rules of a hand. The Golden Ball pays coins per basket. The Snowball grows every time it scores. The Chameleon becomes whatever you scored last - pair it with anything. The Glass Ball scores big but shatters if you keep missing.

Sticker them up: slap stickers onto individual balls - double a ball's score at the risk of it breaking, or earn payouts for streaks with your favorite.

Bring in the machines: activate boosters that physically invade the court - twin dunking hands that slam your shots home, revolvers that gun stray balls into the hoop, desk fans that blow balls back to you, and a machine that rains catchable coins over the floor.

Ride the hot streak

Keep scoring without missing a beat and the jackpot bar climbs - five levels up to a full slot-machine spin for coins, points or extra time. Land the time and the round literally reopens: barrier down, clock refilled, streak alive. How long can you keep a round from ending?

Then come the bosses

Every act ends at a boss machine with its own rules: basket eight balls in the exact order they drop from the dispenser, thread your throws through vacuum portals, or crack open a sealed hoop by clearing a rotating ring of nine.

Key Features

All the numbers below describe the demo — the full game grows every one of them.

  • 25+ cards with unique run-altering abilities

  • 10+ ball types that change how hands are scored

  • Ball stickers with risk/reward twists

  • 12+ activatable boosters that enter the court physically

  • 3 full boss fights, each a different machine

  • A jackpot slot machine fed by your hot streaks - win back time itself

  • Market with rerolls, vouchers, interest economy and 5+ starting teams

  • Runs are saved - leave mid-run, continue from your last round

  • Handcrafted pixel art with CRT fuzz, straight from the fairground

Aim with your hand. Break it with your build.

Bring in the machines: activate boosters that physically invade the court - twin dunking hands that slam your shots home, revolvers that gun stray balls into the hoop, desk fans that blow balls back to you, and a machine that rains catchable coins over the floor.

Ride the hot streak

Keep scoring without missing a beat and the jackpot bar climbs - five levels up to a full slot-machine spin for coins, points or extra time. Land the time and the round literally reopens: barrier down, clock refilled, streak alive. How long can you keep a round from ending?

Then come the bosses

Every act ends at a boss machine with its own rules: basket eight balls in the exact order they drop from the dispenser, thread your throws through vacuum portals, or crack open a sealed hoop by clearing a rotating ring of nine.

Key Features

All the numbers below describe the demo — the full game grows every one of them.

  • 25+ cards with unique run-altering abilities

  • 10+ ball types that change how hands are scored

  • Ball stickers with risk/reward twists

  • 12+ activatable boosters that enter the court physically

  • 3 full boss fights, each a different machine

  • A jackpot slot machine fed by your hot streaks - win back time itself

  • Market with rerolls, vouchers, interest economy and 5+ starting teams

  • Runs are saved - leave mid-run, continue from your last round

  • Handcrafted pixel art with CRT fuzz, straight from the fairground

Aim with your hand. Break it with your build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crypt Survivors

Descend into the crypt. Survive the rooms. Claim the power buried below.

Crypt Survivors is a dark fantasy roguelite dungeon-survival game where every room is a fight for survival. Choose your class, battle through handmade dungeon chambers, collect gold and experience, unlock powerful upgrades, and push deeper into the crypt before death finally catches you.

Each run sends you through a chain of dungeon rooms filled with enemies, loot, shops, healing fountains, elite encounters, and deadly bosses. Clear the room, gather what you can, and descend through the ladder into the next chamber. Every floor brings new danger, new choices, and stronger rewards.

Class-Based Combat

Choose from distinct heroes, each with their own combat style:

Archer — fires quick ranged shots and piercing arrows.
Knight — survives up close with heavy melee attacks and flame strikes.
Lancer — controls space with long-reaching thrusts and sweeping specials.
Mage — commands elemental magic such as Fire, Lightning, Void, and Plague.

Aim with mouse or controller, dodge danger, and carve your way through undead hordes in fast top-down combat.

Survive the Crypt

Enemies swarm from the darkness as you fight to complete each chamber. Defeat monsters, gather XP, collect gold, and grow stronger before moving on. Between combat rooms, discover shops, healing rooms, elite battles, and boss chambers that test your build.

Bosses guard powerful rewards that can change the direction of your run, unlocking new abilities, passive effects, and devastating attacks.

Features

  • Fast top-down roguelite survival combat

  • Multiple playable classes with unique attacks and specials

  • Handmade dungeon rooms with room-to-room progression

  • XP, gold, upgrades, shops, healing rooms, and boss rewards

  • Controller and mouse/keyboard support

  • Dark fantasy crypt setting with undead enemies and dungeon hazards

  • Boss fights with unique mechanics and rare rewards

  • Persistent room flow with fade transitions and dungeon depth progression

Can You Survive What Waits Below?

Every room is another step deeper. Every upgrade is another chance to survive. Every boss defeated brings you closer to mastering the crypt.

store_data.about_the_game:
At its core, Pro Birder is an arcade high-score game about being a bird. Fly fast, pull off tricks, and build up a score — then land clean to keep it. The map is designed to be filled with many different ways to increase your score, or lose it all to the cat in the bushes you didn't see.

Momentum-based flight built for flow: dive for speed, climb, tumble, and thread the gaps. Easy to pick up gameplay with a deep enough design to master like a professional birder.

⚠️PRO BIRDER DEVELOPMENT ⚠️

Pro Birder is currently in Pre-Alpha development, shipping into Early Access in October 2026. The game is being rapidly developed alongside community feedback and is still very open to design and directional changes.

SCORE & GROW

  • Tricks, stunts, and stylish flying build your score while you're in the air. Landing safely banks it. Crashing doesn't.

  • Catch food to grow, and work your way up to bigger birds — each one changes how you fly.

THE WORLD

  • A handcrafted lakeside cove to explore and master, full of wildlife that doesn't always have your best interests in mind.

PLAY TOGETHER

  • Fly solo, or host an online lobby and share the sky with friends.

LEADERBOARDS

  • Steam leaderboards at launch

⚡ FUTURE ROADMAP AFTER RELEASE⚡

  • More maps, more bird species, new mechanics & game modes, and other community requested features

Thanks for being apart of the development of Pro Birder — and be sure to wishlist the game on Steam to get notified about demos and Early Access opportunities.
