store_data.about_the_game:
One life ended beneath the ice. Another begins in a world at war.

After dying while saving a stranger, nineteen-year-old Jake awakens on the unfamiliar continent of Valeska. War has scattered its people, destroyed entire communities and placed the roads ahead under the control of the Demon Lord’s armies.

Jake has no legendary power waiting for him. Every advantage must be earned through the cards you draft, the weapon you carry and the decisions you make between battles.

Draftfall is a story-driven fantasy auto-battler where you shape Jake’s abilities and watch your choices come alive in combat.

Draft From 90 Cards

Build Jake using 90 different cards divided between nine affinities:

Attack, Defense, Fire, Healing, Ice, Lightning, Poison, Toughness and Wind.

Combine physical techniques, elemental attacks, protective abilities and survival effects. Strengthen cards through repeated drafts and adapt your build to increasingly dangerous enemies.

Every decision contributes to the fighter Jake becomes.

Choose Your Weapon

Jake’s equipped weapon changes how he fights.

Use swords, axes, spears, daggers, bows, crossbows and other weapons, each with its own attack style, speed, range and strengths. Visit the village forge between expeditions to purchase new equipment and prepare for the battles ahead.

A powerful card build still needs the right weapon to bring it together.

Watch Your Choices Fight

Combat unfolds automatically, but victory is determined by your preparation.

Your drafted cards activate during battle while Jake attacks according to his weapon and combat behaviour. Adjust your equipment and affinities to overcome enemy formations, ranged units, elite soldiers, powerful generals and expedition bosses.

You create the build. Jake puts it to the test.

Restore a Place Worth Defending

Rescue five companions during the campaign and bring them back to a ruined frontier village.

Each companion unlocks a valuable service, including weapons, healing, research, scouting and tactical preparation. As the campaign progresses, the recovering village becomes Jake’s home and the centre of a growing resistance.

Your victories change more than the battlefield.

Fight Across Valeska

Travel through sixteen handcrafted story expeditions across forests, farmlands, villages, mountain roads, military outposts and fortified cities.

Confront the Demon Lord’s armies, defeat the generals commanding them and uncover why Jake’s arrival in this world may not have been an isolated event.

The final battle is waiting—but reaching it is only the beginning.

Features

  • 90 draftable cards

  • Nine distinct affinity trees

  • Automatic battles shaped by your decisions

  • Multiple weapon classes and combat styles

  • Sixteen handcrafted story expeditions

  • Five companions with unlockable village services

  • Elite enemies, army generals and major bosses

  • An evolving village hub

  • Anime-inspired story and character presentation

  • New Game+ progression

  • Multiple companion endings

  • Steam achievements and Steam Cloud support

store_data.about_the_game:
Aboard a scientific mini‑submarine barely 3×2 meters in size, equipped with archaic systems typical of the 1930s, you must manage real parameters such as pressure, battery, oxygen and temperature while solving escape‑room‑style puzzles and confronting abyssal anomalies capable of distorting reality, the senses… and even your memories.

Your main objective is to extract, using the mechanical arm, a sample of the inexhaustible energy source hidden within the core. As secondary missions, you can explore and scan unknown abyssal life, expanding the expedition’s scientific record.

The experience blends claustrophobia, constant tension, and John’s emotional breakdown, as visions of his lost family are twisted by the abyss to strike where it hurts most.

In 1938, the classified expedition codenamed “Last Breath” sought to achieve the deepest manned descent in history. No one agreed to participate… except John, a man devastated by guilt after an accident that destroyed his life. For him, this mission is not science—it is penance.

The descent to 10,000 feet drags him into a hell of pressure and heat comparable to that of a star, where he must tear from the planet a sample of inexhaustible energy with the potential to reshape humanity’s future.

But before that, John must survive the most hostile journey ever attempted, facing not only the cold, hostile abyss but also anomalies that twist his memories of what torments him most.

store_data.about_the_game:
What would you sacrifice to live one more week?

You have money. You have a beautiful home. You have a family.

And you're dying.

Debt Of Life is a short narrative game about a wealthy man facing the final weeks of his life. Every week, an expensive treatment keeps you alive. Every day, you must decide how far you're willing to go to afford it.

Sell the things you own.
Give up something your family cares about.
Accept help from people you don't trust.
Make choices you may never be able to take back.

Your decisions shape your relationships, your home, and the story itself. What begins as a struggle to pay for treatment can slowly turn into something much more personal: deciding what matters enough to keep, and what you're willing to sacrifice.

And then there is The Visitor.

He always has an offer.

Each day brings new events, conversations, opportunities, and difficult choices. Some decisions may help you survive another week. Others may change the way your family sees you — and the person you become.

There is no perfect choice.

Only the choices you make, and the things you're willing to sacrifice for another week of life.

Your fortune is finite.

Your time is limited.

What are you willing to lose to buy one more week?

Embark on a hilarious open-world adventure filled with action, exploration, and absurd surprises in Joke Land. Team up with the explorer Caine on a mission to hunt down The Joke, a mysterious being spreading chaos and turning the world into a giant comedy world. Battle bizarre enemies, wield unique weapons, uncover hidden secrets, and explore a vibrant open world where every corner has something unexpected waiting for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
The rules are simple:

1. Place the offering above the handle.

2. Do not stand where the door can see you.

3. Repeat the sequence until something on the other side listens.

What begins as a ridiculous prank changes the hallway with every ritual. Choose the correct offering, reconstruct a torn hymn, repeat the memory of the doors, and eventually reach room 13.

Michael has never opened the door.

Maybe you have been standing on the wrong side all along.

FEATURES

- Five handcrafted rituals with changing rooms and distinct soundscapes

- First-person exploration and clue-driven puzzles

- Untimed listen-and-repeat memory sequences

- Two different endings

- Four mirror shards, eight lore documents, and 15 hidden crumbs

- Adjustable graphics, FOV, text speed, subtitles, puzzle aids, and audio mix

- Keyboard and mouse support

- Fully playable in English, German, French, and Spanish

- Approximately 30–50 minutes for a first playthrough

- No violence, gore, microtransactions, or live-generated AI

store_data.about_the_game:
WISHLIST NOW

YOU CAME HERE TO STUDY. BUT THEY WERE ALREADY WAITING FOR YOU

A new city was supposed to be a clean slate. Instead, your first walk through campus ends in a fight, the headmistress knows your bus seat number, and your phone fills with messages from women you have barely had time to meet.

Too many coincidences for an ordinary transfer to a new college.

WANTED ON CAMPUS is an adult 18+ story-driven dating sim about exploring the city, building relationships, and uncovering a mystery that began long before you arrived.

EVERY WOMAN HAS HER OWN RULES

One tests your resolve. Another believes she has already figured you out. A third texts you at night and asks you to open a suspicious file. A fourth invites you to a game, though clearly not only for the sport.

Talk face to face and over the phone. Choose your tone, help, flirt, and earn their trust. The closer the relationship becomes, the more personal the conversations and the more intimate and explicit the scenes you unlock.

CAMPUS LIFE IS MORE THAN DIALOGUE

Explore city streets, academic buildings, the dormitory, the club, and other locations in the morning, evening, and at night. New messages, encounters, and quests keep the story moving even beyond campus.

Not every problem can be solved with charm. Sometimes you will have to complete a challenge, find the right item, or deal with local troublemakers.

CHOOSE WHO TO TRUST

Be bold, cautious, or direct. Your answers affect the mood of conversations, each woman's attitude toward you, and the moments available to you.

The question is not whether you will be noticed. The question is who made the first move before you even arrived.

store_data.about_the_game:
◆ Game Overview

Ghosts of the Tozai Line is a side-scrolling exploration adventure set inside a stalled train on the Tozai Line after an accident.

You walk the cars to investigate, talking with distinctive spirits who linger aboard. None of them can clearly remember who they were, or what they still hold onto. Take notes in your notebook, identify the passengers car by car, and return the belongings that matter to them—each step helps a spirit reclaim its own outline.

Beyond the present-day train, you can also glimpse past scenes through lingering thoughts. Who remains here, and why? Listen, observe, hand over the items you find, and pin down the right names. Each correct answer quietly changes the atmosphere of the train.

You may not be able to save every spirit. The number of belongings returned—and the choices you make—will change the ending. There is no flashy combat. Walking, talking, and thinking are how the story moves forward.

In a quiet, faintly humorous train car, as the last passenger, see them off on their final journey.

◆ Game System (Identify Their Names)

The spirits aboard cannot clearly recall their names or identities. Listen to their conversations, glimpse fragments of the past, and record the clues in your notebook.

Each time you identify the right name, a spirit slowly regains its shape. Observation and deduction are at the heart of uncovering who they are.

◆ Game System (Identify Their Belongings)

The objects left throughout the train are remnants of someone's feelings. Pick them up, examine them, consider who they belong to, and return them to the right person.

When a precious belonging finds its way back, the spirits draw closer to passing on. What you give, and to whom—those choices pile up and change how the story ends.

◆ Key Features

・Side-scrolling exploration inside a train

・A notebook system for identifying spirits through conversation and deduction

・Return living possessions to help spirits move on

・Glimpse past scenes through lingering thoughts / recollections

・Multiple endings that branch with the progress of your investigation

・A gentle story of loss and renewal

◆ Playtime

About 1 hour

store_data.about_the_game:
A quiet sea. Then everything breaks.

Head out, cast your line, wait for the bite — so far, an ordinary fishing game.
The moment your catch breaks the surface, time slows, ink lines bleed in, and you draw your gun.

TSURIBAKU welds a calm fishing sim onto an aerial combo shooter, in one unbroken loop.

A loop in three acts

  • Act I — Sail An endless ocean driven by Gerstner waves. The swell you see is the swell your boat feels.
  • Act II — Fight Give line when it runs, reel when it tires, snap the line if tension peaks. The sea state is the difficulty.
  • Act III — Execute Breaching triggers slow motion. Every hit knocks the fish higher — stop firing and it falls. Drop its HP to zero before it hits the water, or it escapes wounded.

Features

  • 20 species — from horse mackerel and sea bream to manta rays, sharks and coelacanths.
  • 3 fishing grounds — harbor reef, blue water, and the deep trench. Deeper water, bigger fish.
  • Upgrade trees — lines, rods, reels, weapons, boats and sonar.
  • Trophy polaroids — every catch is photographed on the spot, stamped and lettered
    like a manga panel.
  • A hand-inked ocean — cel shading with dual outlines; the ink surfaces only during
    the aerial phase, so the art style itself is the payoff.
  • Three control schemes — keyboard & mouse, gamepad, and touch.

Languages

Traditional Chinese · English · Japanese (text)

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Still Working? is an extraction roguelike set in the soul-crushing world of corporate overtime.

You're a nameless intern at Ovortine.co. — a sweatshop of a company infamous for endless overtime and cutthroat rivalry. Here, there's only one way up the ladder: crush every coworker who stands in your way, one Showdown at a time.

Every shift, you fight your way through office floors packed with rivals, traps, and opportunities — collecting gear, growing stronger, and taking on the boss of each Rank. Showdowns are auto-battled: the real fight is won before you clock in — in your build, your gear, and whether you have the nerve to clock out at exactly the right moment.

The salary you earn only counts if you make it home alive.

Features & Mechanics

Extraction: Your salary is a risk asset — bank it or lose it
Every dollar you earn on the clock is a "risk asset" — go down, and it all vanishes. To lock in your winnings, step into the Time Clock Room and make your call:

  • Perfect Clock-Out — safely take this shift's salary home.

  • Leave Early — save time, but risk an ambush by an Elite… or a pay cut.

  • Keep Working — push to a higher Rank for bigger rewards, and bigger risks.

Push your luck, or quit while you're ahead? Every clock-out is a game of nerves.

Roguelike: No two shifts are the same

  • Each Rank takes 13 steps, and every step offers 2–3 rooms: Normal Showdown, Elite Showdown, Incident, Vending Machine, Break Room, Time Clock Room…

  • Step 13 is the Rank's boss — a.k.a. your manager, or some other jerk.

  • Randomized rooms, drops, and events force you to reinvent your build to survive ever-tougher challenges.

Deep progression, auto-battled Showdowns

  • Four item types — Tools, Credentials, Consumables, Mood Trinkets — across four tiers: Silver → Gold → Platinum → Radiant.

  • A one-of-a-kind Mood System: inflict and trigger mood states mid-Showdown to turn the tide.

  • Showdowns play out automatically, so you focus on strategy and build — and enjoy the satisfaction of steamrolling everything in your path.
    Meta progression: Turn blood money into a life
    Clock out and head home, and your salary becomes Total Assets. Spend it to unlock permanent passive perks, upgrade your Apartment, and curate your own Warehouse collection — making every next shift a little stronger.

Get to Work

And so, through blood, sweat, and tears, you claw your way up from a coffee-fetching intern to the very top of the company. Promotions, raises, stocks, mansions, jewels… wealth, power, fame — everyone scrambles to win your favor.

This is your successful life.

…Alright. Time to wake up.

You still have work tomorrow. 9 AM sharp. Don't be late.

Still Working? — Clock in, clock out, clock in again. Congratulations. This is life.

Welcome to Dungeons of Destiny – Your Very Own Adventure!

Your life as an adventurer begins in a remote, peaceful village where a mysterious portal has recently appeared. Join the local Adventurers' Guild, forge your own legend, and live your life exactly as you choose – whether deep inside dangerous dungeons or enjoying cozy village life.

Join the Adventurers' Guild

Head over to the guild board, accept contracts, and rise through the ranks. Team up with your friends to explore perilous dungeons, defeat powerful bosses, gather valuable loot, and level up your character together.

Craft, Farm & Build

A true adventurer relies on their own craftsmanship!

  • Forge Your Own Weapons: Gather rare ores from the depths of the dungeons and craft powerful gear at the village forge.

  • Grow Medicinal Herbs: Plant your own crops, harvest useful herbs, and brew potent potions for your next expedition.

  • Expand Your Home: Upgrade and customize your house to create the perfect sanctuary after a long day of fighting.

A Living World with Day & Night Cycles

Experience a dynamic world following a natural daily routine. Use the daylight to step through the portal, explore dungeons, and gather valuable resources. As night falls, the portal gates close – making it the perfect time to return to the village, process your loot, brew potions, expand your home, or prepare for the next day's expedition.

Better Together – Co-op Multiplayer

You don't have to face the depths alone! Join forces with your friends to clear dungeons together, share the loot, and watch each other's backs in intense combat.

Get ready to step through the portal. Your adventure, your dungeon, your loot!

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE TAP. ONE CHANCE.

A dot moves toward the target.

Press when it crosses.

That is the entire rule.

Then the speed rises, the timing window tightens and every mistake becomes painfully obvious. Each input is measured in milliseconds, so you always know whether you were early, late or perfectly on time.

Miss once and the run may be over.

SEND THE SAME CHALLENGE TO A FRIEND

Every run in .panic is generated from a deterministic seed.

Share a Challenge Code with a friend and both of you will face the exact same sequence under the same rules.

Same movement.

Same timing.

Same Risk opportunities.

No excuses.

Compare your verified scores on the Same Seed leaderboard, send the code back after taking the lead and keep the rivalry going until somebody finally gives up.

GLOBAL RANKINGS

Your best verified runs can enter global rankings.

See the top players, find your own position and check exactly how much score separates you from the next rank.

Classic, Pure Skill, Daily, Weekly and Monthly challenges each have their own competition.

You can also challenge eligible leaderboard rivals on their exact seed and chase their score directly.

TAKE THE RISK

Classic runs may offer Risk contracts.

Choose Standard for controlled danger.

Choose Overload for greater pressure and a much larger reward.

Choose Pass when protecting the run matters more than proving a point.

Risk can change the speed or timing window of upcoming signals. A positive result may even grant one MISS SAVE, but a saved mistake still scores zero and breaks your Precision Lock.

Risk may keep the run alive.

It cannot erase the failure.

BUILD PRECISION LOCK

Every successful signal is graded as Perfect, Great, Good or Barely.

Repeat the same grade to build Precision Lock and increase your score.

Change grade and the Lock starts again.

Miss and it breaks completely.

High scores demand more than survival. They require consistency.

REPLAYS, GHOSTS AND REMATCHES

Every saved run can be watched again in Replay Vault.

Study the exact moment you failed, compare the attempt with your personal best and challenge the same seed again.

Compatible personal bests and verified rivals can appear through Ghost Duel, letting you see whether you are leading, falling behind or approaching the score you need to beat.

FULL CIRCUIT

A standard competitive run contains 512 signals.

Complete every one without a single miss to earn Full Circuit and double your final score.

One saved Miss is still a Miss.

No shortcuts.

No second chances.

Finish the circuit.

PRACTICE WITH REAL FEEDBACK

Practice Lab lets you train specific movement directions, starting difficulty and run length.

No Fail mode allows you to continue after mistakes while the timing coach shows whether you are pressing early, late or close to the center.

It does not tell you to try harder.

It tells you how many milliseconds to correct.

.panic is easy to understand, brutal to master and built for immediate rematches.

Beat your score.

Beat the global ranking.

Beat your friend on the same seed.

Then send them another code.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise an island out of the ocean. Cut rivers through it, push up mountains, paint forests down its slopes. Then seed it with beasts and with peoples — and step back, because from that moment the world stops needing you.

THE WORLD DOES NOT WAIT FOR YOU

Nobody takes orders. Your tribes forage, hunt, haul water and bury their dead entirely on their own. They survive their first winter or they don't. The ones that live raise huts, then a storehouse, then a well; they till fields, tame pigs and put up walls. Villages thicken into towns and towns into cities. Chiefs are crowned. Borders meet and then borders fight.

Around them a whole ecology runs its own course. Wolves stalk deer, bears ambush from cover, birds cross the sky in skeins, bees work the blossom and locusts strip a harvest bare. Kill off the predators and watch what the herds do to the grass.

THEN REACH IN

You are not a spectator. You are a god with hands.

• Sculpt the land itself — raise, lower, flood, or paint sand, grass, forest and mountain wherever you like

• Smite anything that offends you

• Grab a bear in your fist, carry it across the map, and fling it into the sea

• Raise the dead, and let an undead plague walk out of the graveyards

• Send floods, tidal waves, drought, blizzards and volcanic fire

• Rain gold on a favored people, and watch what prosperity does to them

Every one of these leaves a mark. Powers don't just kill — they bend bloodlines, break economies and end dynasties.

THE LAND DECIDES THE BLOOD

Peoples are shaped by where they take root. Humans, elves, dwarves, orcs and giants each read the world differently, and each carries its own strengths through nine separate traits. Those traits are heritable — they pass down, they arise on their own, and what you do to a people is written into their descendants.

FROM FLINT TO THE ASSEMBLY LINE

There are twenty-two rungs on the ladder and no shortcuts. Farming and writing. Masonry, bronze, steel. Guilds, universities, banking, the printing press. Companies, a crown, gunpowder. Then rail, telegraph, the assembly line, and towers of steel and glass climbing out of cities that were huts three hundred days ago.

No tribe is promised any of it. Most never reach the end.

EVERY REIGN AND RUIN, WRITTEN DOWN

The world keeps its own history. First forges, crowned kings, tamed beasts, floods, famines, the last of a dying species, the greatest name of an age — all recorded as it happens, in a chronicle running quietly in the corner of your screen.

Click any line and the camera flies to where it happened. Click again to come back.
store_data.detailed_description:
Raise an island out of the ocean. Cut rivers through it, push up mountains, paint forests down its slopes. Then seed it with beasts and with peoples — and step back, because from that moment the world stops needing you.

THE WORLD DOES NOT WAIT FOR YOU

Nobody takes orders. Your tribes forage, hunt, haul water and bury their dead entirely on their own. They survive their first winter or they don't. The ones that live raise huts, then a storehouse, then a well; they till fields, tame pigs and put up walls. Villages thicken into towns and towns into cities. Chiefs are crowned. Borders meet and then borders fight.

Around them a whole ecology runs its own course. Wolves stalk deer, bears ambush from cover, birds cross the sky in skeins, bees work the blossom and locusts strip a harvest bare. Kill off the predators and watch what the herds do to the grass.

THEN REACH IN

You are not a spectator. You are a god with hands.

• Sculpt the land itself — raise, lower, flood, or paint sand, grass, forest and mountain wherever you like

• Smite anything that offends you

• Grab a bear in your fist, carry it across the map, and fling it into the sea

• Raise the dead, and let an undead plague walk out of the graveyards

• Send floods, tidal waves, drought, blizzards and volcanic fire

• Rain gold on a favored people, and watch what prosperity does to them

Every one of these leaves a mark. Powers don't just kill — they bend bloodlines, break economies and end dynasties.

THE LAND DECIDES THE BLOOD

Peoples are shaped by where they take root. Humans, elves, dwarves, orcs and giants each read the world differently, and each carries its own strengths through nine separate traits. Those traits are heritable — they pass down, they arise on their own, and what you do to a people is written into their descendants.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jumpy Mumpy is a chaotic 2D climbing game designed specifically for TikTok LIVE streamers and their viewers.

Take control of Jumpy and climb an ever-growing tower of floating platforms while your TikTok LIVE audience influences the game in real time. Viewers can help you reach the finish line, create unexpected challenges or send you falling back down.

Every jump matters. As you climb higher, you will encounter standard platforms, bounce blocks, powerful high-jump platforms and unpredictable obstacles. Time your jumps carefully, stay on the platforms.

TikTok LIVE Interaction

Jumpy Mumpy connects to your TikTok LIVE stream and allows viewer gifts to trigger actions directly inside the game.

Streamers can assign supported TikTok gifts to different actions, giving them control over how helpful, difficult or chaotic each stream becomes.

TikTok LIVE viewers can trigger actions such as:

  • Dropping crates, rocks and other objects from the sky

  • Dropping the player down multiple platforms

  • Launching the player upwards

  • Granting wings or powerful jump boosts

  • Triggering instant wins or complete resets

  • Activating special choice events with different outcomes

Certain actions can scale depending on the number of gifts sent. A larger gift streak could push Jumpy higher, drop him further or create a much more powerful event.

Viewers Shape Every Run

Your TikTok LIVE audience is not simply watching. They are actively changing the world around you.

Helpful viewers may create opportunities, launch you towards the finish line or save you from a fall. Other viewers may, drop obstacles onto you or knock you down with a hammer.

No two livestreams will play the same way.

Built for TikTok LIVE Streamers

Jumpy Mumpy is built to create funny reactions, dramatic recoveries and memorable TikTok LIVE moments.

Customise your gift actions, choose your target height and decide how much control your viewers should have over the game.

Will your TikTok community help you reach the top, or make sure you never get there?

Jump. Climb. Survive your TikTok chat.

Jumpy Mumpy is an independent game and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok.

store_data.about_the_game:
Watt the Bounce! is a physics-based incremental sandbox about bouncing balls, automated machinery, and powering the world.

Release balls into a cobalt-blue research facility and generate energy as they collide with walls and one another. Spend energy and collision points on new balls, research, and experimental equipment. What begins as a few simple bounces will gradually grow into a chaotic but efficient momentum power plant.

Turn Collisions into Power

Every effective collision advances the experiment. Add more balls, increase their speed, and choose upgrades that help the facility generate ever-increasing amounts of energy.

Build an Automated Laboratory

Install acceleration pads, spring bumpers, air cannons, portals, black holes, orbital boost rails, and launch wells. Reposition and rotate equipment to create self-sustaining production loops.

Experiment with Different Balls

Unlock balls with distinct physical properties, including magnetic, slime, yarn, cast-iron, and fission balls. Combining them with different machines produces new trajectories and chain reactions.

Recruit Unreliable Assistants

Chase cats pounce on balls to increase their speed. Catcher frogs swallow balls and spit them toward launch wells outside the arena. Upgrade their abilities until their apparent chaos becomes part of your production line.

Expand the Research Network

Use the skill tree to improve balls, collision efficiency, equipment capacity, and automation. Later, construct a global power grid, supply every continent, and push the laboratory toward its ultimate objective.

Features

  • Physics-driven incremental gameplay

  • Balls with unique physical properties

  • Placeable and adjustable automation equipment

  • Branching research and permanent upgrades

  • Cats, frogs, and launch wells forming unusual production chains

  • Progression from a single laboratory to a global power grid

  • Support for ten interface languages

  • Plan, optimize, and watch your experiment run

Can you turn one bouncing ball into a power system capable of lighting the entire world?

store_data.about_the_game:
Spike Force mixes roguelite deckbuilding, 90's action anime, and high school volleyball. Build your team, pick your cards, and represent your school in a supernatural battle for the fate of humanity.

Every match is a fight for survival. You draft a roster of characters, each with their own deck and playstyle, then build your hand before stepping onto the court. Serves, spikes, blocks, and sets all come from cards, so every point is a decision, not just a button press - and explosive elemental combos and Limit Breaks are a must if you hope to win.

Win matches to push your school further up the ladder. Each run branches into different paths, rivals, and events, all wrapped in the over the top energy of the 90's beat em ups and action anime shows that inspired it. Lose a set and you might still claw your way back. Lose the match and your run is over, so every game counts.

Key Features

  • A full roster of characters, each with their own deck and playstyle

  • Roguelite structure with branching runs and permanent unlocks

  • Relics and card upgrades that let you build wild combos

  • Epic boss battles that span space and time

  • 90's anime inspired presentation, tone, and story

  • Fast matches built for quick runs or long sessions

If you grew up on 90's beat em ups, action anime and love a good deckbuilder, Spike Force puts it all in one game.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE WORLD IS FALLING. KEEP MOVING.

Tilefall is a fast-paced platform survival game built around one simple threat: every step can erase the path behind you.

Sprint, jump, recover, and improvise as the arena breaks apart beneath your ghost. Collect what you can, spend powerups at the right moment, and reach safety before there is nowhere left to stand.

SURVIVE THE FALL

The arena is not a static obstacle course. Tiles react, collapse, and disappear as the run unfolds, forcing you to read the board and commit to a route before it is gone.

Every run becomes a balance between speed and control:

  • Keep moving as safe ground vanishes behind you.

  • Plan routes around gaps, unstable tiles, and shifting hazards.

  • Recover from mistakes with precise movement and well-timed abilities.

  • Push for collectibles and score without trapping yourself.

JOURNEY MODE

Take on structured runs made of increasingly demanding levels. Each journey introduces tighter layouts, faster pressure, more dangerous gaps, and less room for hesitation.

Complete levels, preserve your remaining lives, improve your time, and build a stronger score across the full journey. Finishing a level grants an additional life for the current run, rewarding consistent play as the difficulty rises.

  • Progress through distinct journeys and levels.

  • Track attempts, completions, failures, collectibles, tiles fallen, best times, and best scores.

  • Replay completed content to improve your route and ranking.

  • Use level-by-level pacing designed to steadily increase pressure.

CLIMB MODE

Go up instead of forward. Climb builds an ascent from branching tile routes, gaps, elevation changes, bounce pads, checkpoints, and optional shortcuts.

Read the route, follow glowing wisps through available paths, and recover at milestones as the course grows more demanding. Later climb stages add fragile tile clusters that begin to fall after contact, forcing faster decisions as you approach the top.

  • Choose between branching routes and reconnecting paths.

  • Use sprinting, jumping, diving, bounce pads, and recovery movement to keep climbing.

  • Reach checkpoints that protect your progress after a fall.

  • Race other players to the top in multiplayer Climb matches.

ENDLESS MODES

There is no finish line. Stay alive as long as possible while the challenge keeps escalating.

Classic Endless keeps the collapsing arena going until your movement finally gives out. Endless Climb sends you upward through an increasingly difficult single-player ascent, with dedicated statistics and leaderboard tracking for your best climb.

SKILL PRACTICE

Dedicated practice challenges isolate movement techniques so you can train them without committing to a full run. Work on precision landings, bunny-hop rhythm, single-tile jumps, climbing, and other advanced movement before taking those skills into Journey, Climb, and Endless play.

CUSTOM GAMES: CO-OP AND PvP

Create a private match, invite friends, and configure the rules around the way your group wants to play.

Choose between cooperative and competitive variants of Journey, Endless, and Climb modes, then adjust game settings such as lives, pacing, spawning, difficulty, checkpoints, and mode-specific behavior. Custom games can also be launched alone for practice or experimentation.

  • Host and join multiplayer lobbies.

  • Play cooperative or competitive rule sets.

  • Customize mode settings before the match begins.

  • Track wins across repeated matches while the lobby remains open.

  • Spectate after elimination and remain involved through the final result.

BUILT FOR REPLAYABILITY

A successful run is only the beginning. Tilefall records detailed statistics across journeys and levels so that every attempt gives you another target to beat.

  • Best time and best score tracking.

  • Journey and level completion statistics.

  • Collectible and tile-fall totals.

  • Per-level attempts, failures, and successes.

  • Climb ascent records and Endless Climb statistics.

  • Flexible keyboard and controller bindings.

  • Automatic language detection with manual language selection.

ONE MORE TILE. ONE MORE JUMP. ONE MORE RUN.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone but the sculptor gets a secret word. They draw it together on a shared canvas from their phones on their browser. In the headset, the sculptor watches that drawing appear stroke by stroke on the easel and builds what they think it is out of simple shapes: cubes, spheres, cylinders, cones.

Then the reveal. The word. The drawing. The photo of what the sculptor actually built. And the finished masterpiece in 3D, which everyone can spin around.

How it plays

  • 1 VR player + up to 7 phone players

  • Phones join at by room code or QR — nothing to install

  • 90 prompts, from "rocket" to "ferris wheel", each with its own clock: easy words get quick rounds, hard words get room to breathe

  • Host sets the pace — Chill, Normal, or Frantic

  • Overtime: when the phones stop drawing, the sculptor gets extra seconds to finish

  • Sandbox mode in VR for building whatever you want, no room required

store_data.about_the_game:
Weed Inc. is a global strategy simulation about creating a cannabis strain and pushing it into a world that eventually pushes back.

You begin with an empty lab, a little Kief and a map full of untouched markets. The first country is easy. What comes next depends on the strain you built, where you planted it and how much harm you’re willing to tolerate while the numbers climb.

Spread country by country

Grow gives you a direct foothold in legal markets. From there, your strain moves across borders on its own. Closed markets can’t be targeted directly, so sometimes the best route into a country starts next door.

When natural spread reaches a new region, the first country stays quiet on the map until you pop its Chaos bubble. Then the market comes alive.

Not every country is equally valuable. Population, suitability, legal status and geography all affect where your next Grow will do the most work.

Appeal turns untouched populations into Consumers. Addiction pulls those Consumers toward Addict. A strain that catches quickly can cover the map before you’re ready for what follows.

Build the strain yourself

Every run begins with an empty formula. There’s no starter strain waiting to make the important decisions for you.

Buy fragments and fit them into eight sockets to create four reacting pairs. Terpenes, Cannabinoids and Enzymes determine the reaction inside each pair. The stats on the fragments provide the raw strength.

A fragment with great stats can still be the wrong fit. Its type may break a reaction you need. Another fragment may add more Side Effects but complete the pair that pushes the whole formula forward.

The lab shows the old reaction, the new reaction and the final stat change before you pay. Fill all eight sockets to choose a Base, then keep replacing fragments for as long as your Kief holds out.

The product works. Now deal with it.

Consumers create Market Exposure. Addicts and Liabilities count twice. Side Effects and Liability push Global Response even faster.

Global Response never goes down.

You can invest Kief in permanent Institutions that reduce Public Harm and Market Exposure. That makes the run safer, but the Kief you spend there can’t buy another fragment, Shuffle or Grow.

The world also reacts to the run you’re actually playing. Hospitals notice local clusters. Ports begin sharing lists. Authorities learn your strain’s name. Events draw from the countries you reached, the damage you caused and the way you built the product, then leave you with two ways to handle the fallout.

Five runs, five different problems

• Green Rush is the standard Weed Inc. campaign. Build your strain and turn 75% of the world into Addicts.

• Chain Reaction doubles every reaction output. The bonuses grow, but so do the Side Effects.

• Legalize Weed begins in 2025 with only twenty legal countries. A country becomes legal once Addict reaches 20% of its population. Bring the total to 150 legal countries.

• 52 Weeks gives you one year to turn 50% of the world into Addicts.

• Human Liability asks for something uglier: turn 25% of the global population into Liability.

Before any scenario except Green Rush, choose two pieces of Run Equipment. Start with extra Kief, make Shuffle cheaper, strengthen reactions, open faster routes or build around Liability. The objective changes, so the same loadout won’t solve every run.

What’s in the game

• A country-by-country global spread simulation

• Eight fragment sockets, four reacting pairs and six reaction types

• Legal markets, closed markets and natural cross-border spread

• Permanent Institutions and an escalating Global Response

• World events based on your strain, geography and run history

• Five scenarios with pre-run equipment choices

store_data.about_the_game:
A Message to New Members

Welcome to the Resistance. The organization is entrusting you with this RESIST-OS 98 encrypted terminal from a bygone era. It is old, it is slow, and it has a temperament all its own, but everyone in the organization started with a machine just like this. Power it on, connect to the network, and wait for further instructions from the organization.

Feature Highlights

Explore an operating system from a bygone era: behind every window of this RESIST-OS 98, a key clue may be hiding.

Solve puzzles with classic system tools: comb through the file manager, emails, and chat logs, and find a way into those encrypted archives.

Unearth forgotten files: documents, photos, and messages left behind by the previous user are scattered everywhere, waiting to reveal a buried past.

A mystery that draws closer: fragmented records, unsolicited messages, and a quiet desktop intertwine into a chilling digital truth.

Retro digital aesthetics: Win95/98 gray-framed windows, pixel icons, stepped animations, and CRT-style screensavers recreate an entire computer from another era.

The sounds of an old machine: beep prompts, click feedback, and a recording from a ruined broadcast station bring that era back to your ears.

A built-in Sbeam game platform: a place that seems meant only for passing the time, yet maybe the clues are right here.
store_data.detailed_description:
A Message to New Members

Welcome to the Resistance. The organization is entrusting you with this RESIST-OS 98 encrypted terminal from a bygone era. It is old, it is slow, and it has a temperament all its own, but everyone in the organization started with a machine just like this. Power it on, connect to the network, and wait for further instructions from the organization.

Feature Highlights

Explore an operating system from a bygone era: behind every window of this RESIST-OS 98, a key clue may be hiding.

Solve puzzles with classic system tools: comb through the file manager, emails, and chat logs, and find a way into those encrypted archives.

Unearth forgotten files: documents, photos, and messages left behind by the previous user are scattered everywhere, waiting to reveal a buried past.

A mystery that draws closer: fragmented records, unsolicited messages, and a quiet desktop intertwine into a chilling digital truth.

Retro digital aesthetics: Win95/98 gray-framed windows, pixel icons, stepped animations, and CRT-style screensavers recreate an entire computer from another era.

The sounds of an old machine: beep prompts, click feedback, and a recording from a ruined broadcast station bring that era back to your ears.

A built-in Sbeam game platform: a place that seems meant only for passing the time, yet maybe the clues are right here.
store_data.short_description: An aging encrypted terminal. A past deliberately erased. Follow the guidance, solve puzzles one by one, and close in on a buried truth. Who used this computer before you? What happened to them? And now, it is your turn.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU COMMAND THE ARMY, NOT A HERO

Most deckbuilders hand you one fighter and a stack of verbs. Table of War hands you a company.

Your units move and fight on their own action points — walk them, flank them, hold a ridge with them,

no card required. The deck sits on top of that as your [b]command channel[/b]: reinforcements, ordnance,

standing orders, structures, and the fuel for your general's signature power. Two systems, two jobs.

The board is the tactics. The deck is the strategy.

EVERY SOLDIER HAS A NAME

Your roster is persistent and it is permanent. Troops carry their name, rank, experience and scars from

battle to battle, promote through a branch-specific rank ladder, and earn permanent perks at camps.

They do not come back. A rifleman you have carried since Act 1 — three promotions, a medal, a nickname

you gave him yourself — dies to one badly-read artillery arc, and the next battle starts without him.

The run economy is built around that: survivors carry forward, salvage buys what you can afford to

replace, and every reckless push is a decision about who you can stand to lose.

THE BOARD FIGHTS BACK

Battles are fought on procedurally generated, non-rectangular maps — eight silhouettes carved out of

void, so no two fronts have the same shape.

  • Zones of control — you cannot sprint past an armed enemy. Lines have to be broken, not dodged.

  • Flanking — a second body adjacent to the target, not to you. Positioning is a two-unit problem.

  • Fog of war — with a movement rule that stops you sleepwalking into the dark.

  • Terrain and cover — forest, hills, water and rock; some of it carveable, most of it not.

  • Environmental hazards — inferno, toxic, mire and EMP fields, plus drifting storms that wander the board and hurt whoever is standing in them. Including the enemy. There is a whole pacifist toolkit built on that fact.

  • Friendly fire — artillery splashes. It does not check whose uniform it is landing on.

  • Objectives that are not "kill everything" — survive N turns, hold a position under contest.

  • Raiders — a fast thief that crashes a skirmish, grabs your salvage and runs for the map edge. Kill it before it gets there or the money is gone for good.

And you can see it coming. Enemy intent is telegraphed on your turn: ghosted enemy positions, projected

attack arrows, damage numbers, and a two-tier danger overlay separating "they can reach here" from

"they can shoot you from here" — all of it updating live as you move. Turn it on, turn any layer of it

off, play it blind if you want the fear.

THREE COMMANDERS, THREE DIFFERENT GAMES

  • The Warlord— cheap reinforcements and a Wrath gauge that fills on every kill and every loss. Spend it on Rally the Horde: two free riflemen, deployed at the front, right now.

  • The Engineer — the first structure each turn is free, and adjacent power plants charge a gauge that fires Overcharge: every turret double-fires, command points surge, damage repairs.

  • The Nomad — the HQ is a vehicle. There is no fixed base to defend because there is no fixed base. Movement builds Momentum; spend it on Break Camp and the whole army acts again.

Each brings its own starting army, deck skew, and a dozen strictly exclusive cards nobody else can draft.

BUILD A RUN THAT BREAKS THE GAME

  • 150 cards across six categories, 34 of them commander-exclusive, nearly all upgradeable.

  • 38 relics with compounding effects — and eight of them are cursed, which you will find out.

  • 53 events with real double-edged choices, some gated behind relics you are carrying.

  • Curses the enemy injects into your own deck, removable only at an Outpost, for a price.

  • Four acts — First Contact, Two Fronts, Encirclement, Conquest — on a branching node map with seven node types.

  • Eight hand-authored bosses, each with its own mechanic: endless waves, halved damage unless you flank, a curse every single turn, and one that changes the rules at half health.

  • Fourteen elite variants and five enemy archetypes that reshape a battle before it starts, and tell you which one you are facing before you commit.

THEN RAISE THE STAKES

Twelve rungs of Ascension, each stacking one more rule on top of the last, themes rotating as you climb.

Seven run modifiers you can stack yourself for score. A Daily Commission everyone plays on the same seed.

Fifty-five achievements, sixteen collectible board chips, and a seeded-run field so you can hand somebody

an exact run and dare them.

AT A GLANCE

  • 3 commanders · 4-act branching expedition · 7 node types · permadeath roster

  • 150 cards · 38 relics · 53 events · 55 achievements · 12 ascension rungs · 7 run modifiers

  • 32 unit and structure classes · 14 elite variants · 5 enemy archetypes · 8 bosses

  • Procedural non-rectangular battlefields · fog of war · zones of control · hazards · friendly fire

  • Seeded runs · Daily Commission · save and resume mid-run

  • Fully offline. No account, no launcher, no telemetry, no ads, nothing to buy.

TRY IT BEFORE YOU WISHLIST

The demo runs in your browser — no download, no install, no account: @

store_data.about_the_game:
KEEP THE CONTAINMENT


The machine was built around a hole in reality. Now something on the other side is pulling back.

Black shapes spill from collapsing apertures. Warning lamps burn out one by one. The forge can give you another ball—but every second spent making it stronger gives the incursion more time to spread.

What Iron Cannot Hold is a 360-degree ricochet roguelite where every rebound is a decision. Move your launcher around the full perimeter, take aim anywhere inside the sealed arena, and turn walls, angles, and timing into weapons. Your balls wear out. The enemy does not stay still. And when the machine's final light goes dark, Khaos gets the last word.

BUILD SOMETHING RESILIANT


Between encounters, bolt salvaged hardware into the machine and discover what the next run can become. Fill the arena with multiplying balls. Set the field on fire, freeze targets mid-shift, and chain electricity through the swarm. Build around impossible bank shots, cascading explosions, desperate repairs, or a salvage engine that turns close calls into momentum.

The machine never becomes safe. It just becomes stronger.

KHAOS REMEMBERS


Each sector brings a new hostile ecology, a more strained machine, and a boss forcing itself through the center of the arena. Strange incidents interrupt the containment cycle with salvage races, duels, dangerous bargains, and excursions where the ordinary rules stop applying.

If containment fails, Khaos remembers the attempt. It studies how you played, speaks through the broken machine, and offers one final choice before emergency quarantine slams shut. Return with banked shards, permanent retrofits, a copied seed—or simply a better understanding of what killed you.

Complete six seals to finish the containment protocol. Close the machine and walk away—or reopen it in Overclock and find out how long the line can hold.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game

What began as the perfect Halloween livestream at the historic Korvhat Castle quickly descends into a chilling nightmare. When the malevolent ancient entity Kthal-zghor awakens from its slumber, your friends vanish into the shadows, leaving you entirely alone to face a legion of spooky dwellers! Armed with a powerful Talisman of Light, you must navigate the castle's haunted halls to banish the tragic ghosts of the Korvhat bloodline. Battle the creeping darkness through dozens of challenging Match 3 levels, wielding unique gameplay mechanics to outsmart the ancient evil and purify the cursed grounds. Between intense puzzles, catch your breath by exploring Hidden Object scenes and solving another minigame to unlock your path forward. Gather your courage and collect trophies to earn coins, which you'll use to fully decorate The Party Parlor—the ultimate festive backdrop your group dreamed of setting up before the chaos began! Can you vanquish the shadows, uncover the dark truth, and survive the mystery of Korvhat Castle?

Key Features

  • 90 Match 3 levels to conquer with unique gameplay mechanics.
  • Hidden Objects scenes to explore between intense puzzles.
  • Puzzles and other minigame challenges to unlock your path forward.
  • Decorate The Party Parlor using coins earned from collecting trophies.
  • Spooky atmosphere featuring a thrilling Halloween livestream storyline, ghosts, and ancient evil.

Collector's Edition Features

  • 60 bonus Match 3 levels.
  • Bonus minigames.
  • Exclusive objects for The Party Parlor.
  • Wallpapers.

store_data.about_the_game:
More than 900 years ago, an ancient pact sealed away a powerful entity known as Tyanmair, preventing its darkness from consuming the world. Today, that seal is beginning to weaken. Ancient relics have awakened once more, and a dangerous cult will stop at nothing to unleash the power that has remained hidden for centuries. The fate of Yehuelú hangs in the balance once again.

Yehuelú Online is a fantasy MMORPG inspired by the mythology and folklore of southern Chile. Explore a vast world filled with thriving cities, ancient forests, towering mountains, rugged coastlines, mysterious caverns, and forgotten ruins as you uncover the secrets of a land shaped by ancient wars, legendary creatures, and divine beings that still watch from the shadows.

Create your own character and forge your destiny by battling dangerous enemies, completing hundreds of quests, discovering ancient relics, and developing your hero through deep character progression, powerful abilities, and unique equipment. Every adventure brings you one step closer to uncovering the truth behind the ancient pact.

Along your journey, you will encounter diverse races and factions. Some are determined to preserve the balance of the world, while others seek to plunge it into chaos. Explore their territories, earn their trust, and uncover the secrets they guard as the threat of Tyanmair grows ever more real.

Master a variety of professions, gather valuable resources, craft weapons, armor, and unique items, upgrade your equipment, and prepare to face powerful bosses, dangerous dungeons, and challenging events that will test your skills both alone and alongside fellow adventurers.

Key Features

  • Explore a vast open world inspired by Chilean mythology.

  • Experience an original story filled with mysteries, ancient relics, and forgotten gods.

  • Battle legendary creatures and powerful bosses.

  • Complete quests while uncovering the secrets of Yehuelú.

  • Craft weapons, armor, and consumables through multiple professions.

  • Gather resources scattered throughout the world.

  • Customize and develop your character through meaningful progression.

  • Explore dungeons, world events, and ever-expanding challenges.

  • Embark on a cooperative adventure with players from around the world.

The relics have awakened. The balance is beginning to crumble. Only those brave enough to stand against the darkness can decide the future of Yehuelú.

store_data.about_the_game:
LANGUAGE NOTICE

This game currently supports Simplified Chinese only.

ENTER THE WORLD OF QINGHE

Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie is a historical life-simulation and narrative management RPG set in Qinghe County during the Northern Song dynasty. Take the role of Ximen Qing and shape a life among merchants, officials, household members, servants and ordinary townspeople.

  • MANAGE YOUR HOUSEHOLD AND BUSINESSES

Operate businesses, appoint managers, adjust prices, manage stock and develop your family estate. Wealth can open doors, but every investment consumes time, money and attention. A prosperous household also brings greater responsibilities and new risks.

  • BUILD RELATIONSHIPS

The people of Qinghe have their own schedules, desires, loyalties, secrets and conflicts. Friendship, affection, reputation, favors and resentment may change how they treat you—and how they treat one another when you are not present.

  • GATHER RUMORS AND EVIDENCE

Information does not arrive automatically. Talk to people, send servants to investigate, collect rumors and uncover evidence. What you know—and what you only think you know—can alter the course of disputes, investigations and personal relationships.

  • SET SCHEMES IN MOTION

Use your connections, resources and knowledge to arrange plans involving other characters. Choose the right people, timing and approach, then face the consequences when circumstances change or someone acts against your expectations.

  • LIVE WITH TIME AND CONSEQUENCES

Every journey, conversation and action takes time. Characters continue their lives according to their own circumstances. Health, illness, aging, family, birth and death gradually reshape the world around you.

  • CREATE YOUR OWN QINGHE STORY

Follow multiple narrative routes, pursue different ambitions and reach a variety of endings. Build a flourishing household, seek status and influence, protect the people important to you—or watch a seemingly small choice lead your life in an entirely different direction.

The people of Qinghe have their own schedules, desires, loyalties, secrets and conflicts. Friendship, affection, reputation, favors and resentment may change how they treat you—and how they treat one another when you are not present.

  • GATHER RUMORS AND EVIDENCE

Information does not arrive automatically. Talk to people, send servants to investigate, collect rumors and uncover evidence. What you know—and what you only think you know—can alter the course of disputes, investigations and personal relationships.

  • SET SCHEMES IN MOTION

Use your connections, resources and knowledge to arrange plans involving other characters. Choose the right people, timing and approach, then face the consequences when circumstances change or someone acts against your expectations.

  • LIVE WITH TIME AND CONSEQUENCES

Every journey, conversation and action takes time. Characters continue their lives according to their own circumstances. Health, illness, aging, family, birth and death gradually reshape the world around you.

  • CREATE YOUR OWN QINGHE STORY

Follow multiple narrative routes, pursue different ambitions and reach a variety of endings. Build a flourishing household, seek status and influence, protect the people important to you—or watch a seemingly small choice lead your life in an entirely different direction.
store_data.short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ribbit Robber is a challenging stealth game set in a fantasy medieval land inhabited by frog people. Take control of Jaiju, a poor thief struggling to survive in a world consumed by poverty, danger, and uncertainty.

Stealth is not optional. Every encounter requires careful observation, precise timing, and creative use of your abilities. Sneak past enemy guards, manipulate their movements, or eliminate threats when the situation demands it. Success depends on finding the right combination of skills, positioning, and timing to overcome each unique challenge.

The game is designed for both experienced stealth players and newcomers to the genre. Veterans will find demanding puzzles that reward mastery and experimentation, while new players can use the built-in tip system to receive guidance during the most difficult encounters. Tips can be enabled or disabled at any moment, allowing players to choose between assistance and a pure challenge.

Ribbit Robber features both quick saves and traditional save slots. Quick saves allow you to save your progress at any moment and return instantly after being discovered or when you want to experiment with a different approach. This lets players freely test strategies without fear of losing progress.

Every level introduces new challenges through a wide variety of abilities that change the way you approach each situation. Some abilities are simple but powerful, such as invisibility, while others require creativity and precision. Use a boomerang to attack from unexpected angles, place a locator to reposition yourself at the perfect moment, and combine your abilities in countless ways to outsmart your opponents.

Throughout the main campaign, you will follow Jaiju's journey from a desperate thief trying to survive into someone whose decisions shape his fate. Every choice, no matter how small, can influence the path ahead and determine where his story ultimately leads.

Create your own challenges with the built-in level editor. The same tools used to create the game's levels are available to players, allowing you to design, test, and build your own stealth puzzles.

store_data.about_the_game:
Looks Good From My House.

Welcome to Shady Contractor, where building codes are more of a suggestion and every job is another opportunity to make a little too much money.

Take on construction contracts, stack physics-based building pieces into increasingly ridiculous structures, and somehow convince your clients that this is exactly what they asked for. Did the Mona Lisa use a "Blueprint"?

EXACTLY!

Build Your Business

Start with small residential jobs and work your way toward larger, more complex projects. Complete contracts, earn cash, unlock new blueprints, and expand your company's reputation... whether you deserve it or not. (you don't)

Physics-Based Construction

We work with the materials we are given, which is mostly uh... trash. Balance awkward shapes, improvise with whatever materials you have, and hope gravity is feeling generous today.

Hire a Questionable Crew

Recruit specialized crew members who help keep your operation profitable. Negotiate bigger payouts, clean up your "creative interpretations" of the blueprints, scout better contracts, and discover new ways to cut corners without technically cutting corners.

Features

  • Chaotic physics-based block stacking gameplay - it's like if Jenga and Tetris had a baby, then that baby asked you for $20

  • A full Career Mode with progression and unlocks

  • Dozens of construction contracts and building templates

  • Hire upgradeable crew members with unique abilities

  • Earn bigger profits through speed, accuracy, and smart business decisions

  • Plenty of questionable engineering

  • Surprisingly few lawsuits

store_data.about_the_game:
"Fire and Dark Stars" is a real-time 4X strategy game. You can pick one of many factions and sub-factions, build your empire, expand your territory, and finally wipe out your enemies.

Base Building

  • This game has many resource buildings and military buildings. You can freely build and grow your base the way you like.

  • Research new technologies at the right time to unlock new buildings, new ships, or useful bonuses that help your whole side.

  • Use different kinds of defense buildings to protect your base and important positions.

Building Your Fleet

  • Each faction has more than ten basic ship types, and sub-factions also have their own unique buildings and ships.

  • Every ship has many different weapons and equipment with their own features. Using them flexibly based on the situation is the key to winning.

  • Build powerful flagships to turn the tide of battle.

Logistics and Supply

  • Your fleet needs energy, ammo, and other resources to work. If they run out, your ships cannot keep firing.

  • Build supply stations to extend your fleet's operating range, or use supply ships to let your fleet fight for longer.

  • Find a chance to cut off your enemy's supply lines, and then you can trap them and finish them off easily!

Multiplayer

  • This game supports multiplayer mode. You can play co-op with others, or fight against each other. There is even a special co-op campaign made just for multiplayer! Invite your friends and take on the challenge together!

store_data.about_the_game:
You’re in a room. There’s a man. There’s a baseball bat. There’s his stuff. There’s blood.

Baseball Bat Hero; or, Savagely Beating a Man With a Club Until He Dies of Blunt Force Trauma is a deliberately brainless rhythm game.

Swing on the beat. Miss and the combo dies. Land enough hits and the victim’s blunt-force trauma meter fills while the entire room turns into a cartoon crime scene — chairs explode, tables flip, walls get painted, everything gets covered.

Four difficulties: Easy · Medium · Hard · Expert

The higher you go, the tighter the timing windows and the more chaotic the destruction.

Graphics are intentionally crude and simplified. Music is pure public-domain and licence-free iconic tracks rendered in glorious MIDI. No story. No upgrades. No deeper meaning. Just you, a bat, a cartoon man, a room full of breakable stuff, and the absolute commitment to the bit.

store_data.about_the_game:
The 8 O'Clock Block is a fast-paced retro-inspired puzzle game where you're the star of a struggling late-night television show fighting to stay on the air.

Take control of an expressive cat host as you stack, match, chain, and outsmart the ruthless TV Executive determined to cancel your show. Battle bizarre bosses, survive unpredictable live broadcasts, discover powerful items, and master a wide variety of puzzle rules across a collection of unique game modes—all set within one interconnected television universe.

Whether you're chasing high scores, perfecting strategies, or looking for one more run, every episode offers a new challenge.

Features

  • 10 distinct puzzle game modes, each with its own mechanics and objectives.

  • An original Endless Mode featuring bosses, random events, powerful items, and escalating difficulty.

  • A colorful cast of television-themed characters and challenges.

  • Dynamic boss battles that change the rules of play.

  • Satisfying chain reactions, combos, and score-chasing gameplay.

  • Retro-inspired 16-bit pixel art with smooth animations and expressive characters.

  • Original soundtrack inspired by classic arcade puzzle games.

  • Endless replayability with multiple ways to play and master.

The Show Must Go On

Every mode offers a different puzzle experience. Launch blocks into the TV Executive's office, rescue trapped studio cats, swap entire production stacks, feed hungry TV mascots, survive live broadcast challenges, and discover new strategies as you work to keep your show from being canceled.

Do you have what it takes to earn one more season?

store_data.about_the_game:
Iskra is a small, intimate visual novel — closer to a meditative, atmospheric experience than to conventional gameplay. Its aim is immersion: in mood, in symbolism, in depth.

You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

Iskra is steeped in a rather dark, grotesque aesthetic. You'll encounter iconic characters from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland — the White Rabbit, the Caterpillar, the Red Queen, the Cheshire Cat, the Mad Hatter — but shown as if in a distorting mirror. You'll also meet others who don't appear in Lewis Carroll's original at all, yet are known from legend and myth and carry a powerful, archetypal symbolism.

The character portraits are hand-drawn; their style is striking, and it etches itself into memory

store_data.about_the_game:
A twin-stick shooter designed for learners of Japanese.

A mysterious fleet of Katakana has invaded the galaxy and stole the meanings from all the words in the universe, plunging the world into chaos. Now the ancient starship Mu, the only vessel capable of restoring true meaning to words, sorties to reclaim language and restore order.

Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power.

Stack powers that change the way you play. 

From regenerative burst shields that detonate when broken.

To drones that fight with you, catch incoming enemy fire, and even rebuild themselves when destroyed.

Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

Pick a built-in deck or import your own from a CSV file, then battle through the words you want to master.

WaniKani Integration: Generate decks and turn your studies into a fight for survival!

Great with Keyboard / Mouse or Controller.

Every family hides secrets. Every victim has a story. Every clue can lie.

Investigate a haunted mansion in this first-person psychological horror detective game. Search for hidden evidence, solve interconnected mysteries, and identify the real killer before the darkness consumes your sanity. Every investigation unfolds differently, and every decision brings you closer to the truth... or further from it.

The Story

A once-prestigious family inherits an old mansion, hoping to restore it and build a better future. As financial struggles, buried secrets, and personal conflicts begin to tear them apart, tragedy strikes.

But the truth is never the same twice.

Each investigation presents a different version of the family's downfall. A different family member becomes the victim. A different suspect becomes the killer. Even the cause of death changes, creating a brand-new mystery every time.

When unexplained paranormal events prevent the local police from continuing their investigation, the case is handed over to a paranormal detective... You.

Now it's up to you to uncover the truth... before the mansion consumes your sanity.

Investigate the Truth

Explore every corner of the mansion, inspect objects, decode hidden messages, and connect scattered clues to reconstruct the crime.

Every piece of evidence matters, but not every clue tells the truth.

Your final accusation determines the fate of the investigation.

Every Investigation Is Different

No two investigations are exactly alike.

Each new investigation features:

  • A different victim.

  • A different killer.

  • A different cause of death.

  • Different clue locations and evidence.

Every investigation challenges you to adapt, observe carefully, and reach the correct conclusion.

Special Story Scenarios

As you solve investigations, you'll unlock handcrafted Special Scenarios.

Unlike the randomized investigations, these are handcrafted, fully scripted mysteries with fixed victims, killers, motives, clues, and outcomes.

Successfully solving a Special Scenario rewards you with the complete story behind the murder. Each one tells its own self-contained mystery.

Beware the Darkness

The mansion is never truly empty.

Supernatural forces lurk in the shadows, distorting reality and testing your sanity as you search for answers.

Perhaps the only one capable of helping you uncover the truth...

...is the spirit of the victim... The Final Witness to their own murder.

The victim's spirit may assist you during your investigation and guide you closer to the truth. But take too long, and they won't be the same anymore.

Every ghost behaves differently, with its own tactics, behaviors, and dangers. Learn what you're facing and adapt your strategy before it's too late.

More Than Just Investigations

Between investigations, you'll discover optional activities hidden throughout the mansion.

As you progress, you'll also unlock minigames, giving you new ways to enjoy the world of The Final Witness beyond solving crimes.

Features

  • Investigate replayable murder cases with randomized victims, killers, causes of death, puzzles and clues.

  • Unlock handcrafted Special Scenarios featuring unique mysteries and stories.

  • Explore a detailed haunted mansion in first-person, illuminated only by your flashlight. The electricity is gone, leaving you alone with the darkness.

  • Search, analyze, connect evidence and craft your own equipment to identify the true killer under the pressure of being watched.

  • Experience psychological horror with supernatural encounters and ghosts with different behaviors and tactics.

  • Make choices that influence the outcome of each investigation.

  • Discover optional activities throughout the mansion.

  • Unlock bonus minigames as you progress through the game.

  • Planned Early Access updates introducing new rooms, characters, investigations, and unique online modes.

Development Note

The Final Witness is currently in active development. Visuals, gameplay, features, and content shown on this page may change as development continues toward release.

store_data.about_the_game:
The sun did not die. It was put out.

Twelve winters ago, someone extinguished the sun — and the dark poured in like water. One village endures, huddled around the Last Flame. You are the Lightborn: carry the flame into the horde, and find out who betrayed the light.

HORDELIGHT is a story-driven horde survival game: the auto-firing combat of the survivors genre, wrapped around a gothic mystery told across 8 chapters, a living village hub, and an RPG meta layer.

⚔️ Survive the horde

  • Auto-firing weapons — position, dodge, and build. 7 weapons, each with a spectacular evolution.
  • 4 playable Lightborn, each with a signature passive that changes how you fight.
  • 10 active skills on keys 1-4 — meteor storms, blade frenzies, spirit armies.
  • Hunt Ember Bearers, gather shards, then face the chapter's Guardian: 8 unique bosses with teleports, meteor rains and ring waves.

🏘️ Return to Lumenfall

  • A living village hub: the Elder unfolds the mystery, villagers carry their own quest stories.
  • Forge permanent upgrades, equip 6 gear slots, enhance items to +9 — star, moon and sun seals with random properties.
  • Silas's wagon: surprise crates, choice stock and a carnival lottery wheel.

🔥 Rites of the Flame

Stack curses for greater rewards, unlock blessings as you progress — replay every chapter your way.

🌙 Beyond the story

  • Daily Run — one attempt, a fresh modifier every day, escalating boss waves and a Reaper at the door.
  • Endless Night — a dedicated enemy roster and returning Guardians. How long can your light last?
  • 32 achievements · keyboard-first controls, no mouse required · Xbox controller support.

🗣️ 10 languages

Interface, story and dialogues in English, Türkçe, 中文, Русский, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, 日本語, 한국어. Voice-overs in English and Turkish.

store_data.about_the_game:
A planet that lives on your desktop.

Cosmo Corgis runs in a slim always-on-top window docked at the bottom of your screen, with the sky turned transparent so a tiny 3D world floats over your wallpaper. Your astronaut goes to work whether you're watching or not. Glance over between emails, spend what they've gathered, and get back to what you were doing.

You don't drive. You decide.

There's no character to steer. The astronaut chooses what to gather based on what the rocket still needs, walks around the lakes and mountains to get there, chops and mines, hauls it home, and refills their oxygen at the ship. Your job is the part that matters: which upgrade to buy next, and when to spend it all on the next repair.

Watch the rocket come back together.

Every repair is a real, visible thing — the frame straightens, hull panels seat, the engine seals, and the whole ship stands up ready to fly. Then the launch cinematic takes over, and you skip past a star toward the next world.

A corgi on every planet.

One corgi is stranded on each world, waiting to be found. Rescue them and they ride along in the rocket's portholes, faces pressed to the glass. Every tenth planet is Home — a green meadow where the whole rescued crew is released to run free, and the colony keeps growing every time you come back.

Cozy on purpose.

No timers. No fail state. Nobody starves and the oxygen never runs out — it just sends your astronaut walking home. Days pass, night falls, a campfire lights, and your corgi sploots in the grass while she waits for you.

Features

  • True desktop companion mode — always-on-top strip window, transparent sky, capped frame rate, and click-through so it never gets in your way

  • A real 3D planet, not a pixel strip: hand-modelled low-poly worlds you watch rotate under your astronaut

  • Three biomes across nine worlds — temperate, desert, and frozen, in three sizes with their own gravity, dealt in a different order every playthrough

  • Terrain that matters — no walking up mountains or across water; your astronaut paths around them

  • Upgrades that show — six upgrade tracks and four repair milestones per world, the ship visibly rebuilding, and tools that physically evolve (max out both hand tools and a mining laser appears)

  • Rescue a corgi on every planet and grow a permanent colony back Home

  • Light on your machine — capped frame rate, background throttling, and a low-power render option; the companion strip idles at a fraction of one CPU core

Play it properly too — a full-window mode with the whole HUD when you want to sit with it

Performance


I have spent a lot of time optimizing the game so you don't have to worry about corgis wreaking havoc on your computer resources. They cause enough chaos in game. Let's keep it that way!

store_data.about_the_game:
Equilibrium Co. is a macro-economic and logistics management simulation game, where you run regional supply chains, manage offices, hubs, and industries to keep entire cities supplied and growing. Import or export produced goods, or sell them locally. Unlock new products, research efficiency upgrades and optimize business and expand your industry chains and manage it all through a clean, professional modern, SaaS-style interface, built to help you reach market equilibrium. 


Running your company

Your goal is to transform raw materials into finished goods and supply expanding cities. As cities grow, demand evolves, unlocking higher product tiers.

Your objective is to scale, manage, and optimise a regional enterprise to perfection through strategic decisions and optimal infrastructure layouts. Build your operations from the ground up, constructing everything from corporate offices, stores, industries, and central warehouses to logistics hubs.

In Equilibrium Co. everything is deeply interconnected: eliminate supply bottlenecks, move goods efficiently, and sustain corporate profitability.

Logistics & Transport

Transport is a vital lifeline of your supply chain, and the main engine behind your revenue.

Manage a fleet of trucks with different cargo capacities, fuel consumptions, operational costs, to transfer goods between industries, warehouses and stores.

Dynamic City Markets

Cities in Equilibrium Co. act as living economic nodes with shifting populations, purchasing power, and evolving product demands. Market prices fluctuate dynamically based on local supply, market saturation, and population size.

Supplying cities with essential goods fuels their growth into sprawling metropolises, unlocking higher product tiers, advanced industrial needs, and greater profit margins.

Corporate Operations & Administrative Capacity

Every expanding business requires administrative oversight. Managing offices and personnel is essential for supporting and expanding your company.

As you grow and develop, buy more trucks and establish new facilities, administrative workload increases. Expanding your corporate offices and hiring more office workers is critical to preventing operational delays and keeping overhead costs under control.


Financial Management & R&D

Data is your primary tool. As acting CEO, you must make critical business choices backed by real-time financial metrics.

Track daily revenues, analyze expense breakdowns, manage debt through bank loans, and handle tax obligations through dedicated financial dashboards.Invest in research and development to unlock advanced production chains, higher-value goods, and new technologies to dominate the regional market.


Global Market - Import & Export


The ever-changing global prices affect the local independent industry prices, fuel prices, and other raw material prices.

You can wait for global market fluctuations to impact your profits or prepare in advance. Profit by importing goods from global suppliers to cover local deficits, or export surplus production to capture foreign revenue.
