store_data.about_the_game:
COMBAT RUNS ITSELF. EVERYTHING ELSE IS YOURS.

There is no attack button in Quartermark, and that is the point. Your four heroes fight without you. What you control is the only thing that decides whether they win: who stands in the party, what they are wearing, and which skill you feed.

Set up. Watch. Adjust. Then watch a build you assembled take a floor it could not touch an hour ago.

TWELVE HEROES, ONE GRAMMAR

Every hero has four skills and they always mean the same thing, so a new hero is never a new rulebook:

  • Basic — the ordinary attack, always ready.
  • Core — the signature skill, on a cooldown. The one a boss can silence.
  • Reaction — fires by itself the moment a condition trips, and beats everything else.
  • Aura — always on, for the whole party.

GOLD STARS ARE THE DEEP GAME

Nine keywords — Poison, Bleed, Burn, Freeze, Weaken, Shield, Fury, Thorns and Ward — are shared between heroes and items. A hero and a weapon that share one are worth more together than either is apart.

Certain heroes empower each other. Put the right two side by side and their skills grow — and the moment it fires, the screen goes gold. Building for the stars is the deepest thing you can do.

EVERY UPGRADE IS A BET

Gear drops from bosses and nowhere else. Then you gamble it: every +1 multiplies every stat on the item, and every attempt can destroy it outright. The odds are printed before you commit.

A +10 is worth more than twice a +0. That, and nothing else, is why anyone risks one.

RESET TO GO FURTHER

Prestige wipes the floors and your hero levels. It does not touch your gear, your souls, or the heroes you bought. You come back with a permanent tree that compounds.

The point was never to get back where you were. It is to get past it.

1,500 FLOORS BEFORE A ROOM REPEATS

  • 150 distinct dungeons, each with its own art
  • 120 creatures across 12 families, two families to a room
  • A boss guards every tenth floor — and beating one is the only way into the next zone
  • Past floor 80 the zones come back branded — Ashen, Rime, Venomous, Warded, Frenzied, Thorned — so the climb is never the same room twice

IT TELLS YOU WHY YOU LOST

Hit a wall three times and the game opens the file on it: what killed you, what it did to you, who fell first, and exactly which keywords were running on both sides.

It never tells you the answer. Finding that is the game.

WHAT IS NOT HERE

  • No ads
  • No gacha
  • No energy bar
  • No premium currency
  • No microtransactions of any kind

You buy it once. Everything in it is reachable by playing.

And your party keeps fighting while the game is closed — come back to gold you never watched being earned.

store_data.about_the_game:
Roll, bounce, and travel through an entire little world full of plums.

About the Game

Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

The game was mostly made for cozy players, young players, and eventually speedrunners.

Content

  • Roll and bounce through linear levels designed as a cosy journey, simple exploration and easy platforming difficulty.

  • Meet 20 plum-ghosts, each with their own hand-written dialogue and their own story to share. (Meeting plums is not mandatory to finish the game, still, they carry the story. It's up to you.)

  • Collect plum essences at your own pace. Collectibles add depth, but are never required to finish the game

  • An original fully human made soundtrack blending ambient, composed specifically for the journey.

Note from the Dev

First published game from Mad Arena Games, Plum is the result of work from a self-made solo developer.

The scope of the game reflects my will to provide the best player experience I possibly can in the time allowed to work on it and with a complete story and original music made by me.

I hope you'll enjoy this journey as much as I enjoyed learning and making it. This is only the beginning.

  • Clean, colorful, minimalist presentation

  • No timers or pressure

  • Play at your own pace

Whether you solve each puzzle through careful planning or experimentation, every completed path offers a small and satisfying moment of discovery.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Beanu Tag! An action packed multiplayer game of tag! But this isn't regular tag, you also have abilities that can help you win, or help others lose. 

Note: This game requires direct connection using UPnP. This game is meant to be played with friends only (for now), so make sure you have a friend with a router that supports UPnP.

Gameplay

Beanu Tag is a fast-paced game where you dash, jump, and run to try and win first place in elimination tag. But with multiple gamemodes such as Hot Potato and Juggernaut, as well as tons of game options, you can customize the game to play exactly how you'd like! 

Movement

Beanu Tag offers many ways to avoid your friends and enemies. You have the ability to dash up to 3* times, wall jump, and chain jumps to get higher and higher. With plenty of skill expression and verticality in each map, you can find many ways to avoid or even get to your friends.

Powers

Beanu Tag offers you powers to make games more interesting. Collect powerup boxes to see what you get. Some offer invincibility, while others offer more dashes. You never know what you're going to get!

Customization

Beanu Tag allows you to create your character with many customization options. Unlock cosmetics by playing or buying them with in-game currency. Even gift your friends something! There are over 70+ cosmetics to unlock! And with the ability to use custom colors on every layer! Even a few ways to customize the UI!

store_data.about_the_game:
If you like Balatro, you'll probably enjoy this.

Bottom Dollar is this treasure diving roguelike where you're basically drowning in debt. You start with a charter payment, a cheap metal detector, and like 40 seconds of air. The captain demands a cut for every dive, and the fee just keeps going up. That's pretty much the whole game.

​You jump off the boat and just follow the beeping. It gets super stressful because digging uses up your air, going too deep drains your timer, and sharks will literally steal your loot bag and swim away. Plus, there's a massive fishing boat that drags a net through the water and will just run you over without even noticing. If you hit your money goal, you cash out, but then the captiain gives you an even higher target next dive. Miss it, and your run is over. Either way, you always have to leave good stuff behind at the bottom, which is kind of the point.

​Between dives you hit the shop, which is honestly where you make or break your run. The catch is that every good item ruins something else. You can get twin tanks or a rebreather, but not both. You can buy a water scooter to move faster, but it makes you crazy heavy. There's a jeweler's loupe that makes your loot worth more, but it totally messes up your detector. You end up having to create a specific build instead of just buying straight upgrades.

plus i made A tutorial that doesn't suck and actually teaches you how to play.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the beginning there was a blank sheet of paper

Color disappeared, roads dissolved, and people turned into barely visible outlines. But as long as you have a pencil, not all is lost.

Re:Draw has no building menus or ready-made grids. Every tree, bridge, animal and settler exists only because you drew it. Make the first stroke — and the blank sheet will start filling with grass, birds, the bustle of a working village, and the warmth of life returning.

A living world that grows without you

You give the spark — the world does the rest.

  • An autonomous ecosystem: herbivores feed on the plants you grow, predators hunt animals, and seeds are carried by wind and creatures. One drawn tree will, over time, become a dense forest.

  • Generations: a person you draw isn't just a unit. They'll find a partner, build a home, have children, and pass their story on. Watch dynasties unfold over dozens of hours of play.

  • Organic, not gridded: settlers choose their own paths, fish, build and defend the settlement while you sketch a new corner of the world on the other side of the map.

An encyclopedia of creation

Everything you create is saved forever in your notebook. Every plant, animal or settler gets a personal page with your original drawing, a name, and a unique story.

Key features

  • Intuitive gameplay: drawing is your only mechanic. No complicated building menus.

  • 100% uniqueness: no two worlds in Re:Draw are alike, since every stroke is made by your own hand.

  • An endless sandbox: expand the borders of the erased world as far as your imagination goes.

Predator animals you draw into the world may hunt and kill both prey animals and unarmed settlers to feed themselves. Very rarely, one of your settlers may secretly be a killer and murder others; if this happens, an in-game detective character will investigate, and the culprit is either imprisoned or, if no jail has been built, executed on the spot. store_data.about_the_game:
Analyze the battlefield and scout the sector

Dustium is a action-queueing turn-based strategy roguelite where you predict battlefield outcomes based on enemy information and pre-plan synergistic moves for a 3-character party.

While you can see what action an enemy intends to take, judging who they will target and where they will move is entirely up to you. Read the flow of the 7×5 grid battlefield and secure victory through forward-thinking strategy.

Key Features

  • Action-Queueing Turn-Based Combat

    Assign actions—movement, attacks, buffs/debuffs—for 3 characters across 5 action slots per turn. Once set, your queued plan executes in flawless sequence.

  • 7×5 Grid Tactics Built on Prediction

    The game never hands you the answers. Infer enemy attack zones, movement paths, and directional targeting to turn their own intentions against them.

  • 3-Character Party Synergies & Distinct Playstyles

    Assemble a party from a diverse cast of characters. Experience completely different strategies depending on your composition—from multi-hit chains and stackable buffs to damage-over-time effects and collision control.

  • Explore & Perfect Your Build

    Navigate through battles, events, rest stops, and shops to collect new Memories and Relics. Maximize your existing build or pivot toward an entirely new strategy depending on the situation.

  • Expanded Options with Every Run

    Growth continues long after a run ends. Unlock new Memories and Shards to broaden your strategic choices rather than simply increasing raw stat numbers.

  • Secrets of an Eroded World

    Explore regions corrupted by Red Dustium and face off against formidable mutations threatening the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the firm. Move the capital. Create the legacy.


Hero Investor is a player-paced, single-player investment and company-management simulation. Start with a small office and limited capital, then decide how to trade, diversify, hire, research, borrow, and expand. Every move feeds the same fictional financial world.

Create and manage your own ETFs


Unlock the Fund Foundry and turn an investment idea into a fund of your own. Choose its ticker, market mandate, risk profile, and fee, then track NAV, assets under management, fee income, and simulated investor activity. Read explainable client signals, adjust the fund when conditions change, or retire it and launch a new strategy.

Trade, diversify, and build cash flow


Trade fictional stocks, bonds, crypto, REITs, commodities, and alternative investments. Study prices, history, news, positions, and liquidity before committing capital. Add income-producing property, collect rent and dividends, earn bank interest, and balance dependable cash flow against riskier opportunities.

Grow the company behind the portfolio


Recruit employees with distinct roles and skills, appoint managers, set pay and benefits, watch morale, and build departments that support the strategy. Expand from a local office toward regional and global operations while research opens new tools and opportunities.

Face the full financial picture


Loans, interest, payroll, office costs, property expenses, and taxes settle on the game calendar. Reports and board reviews explain what changed and why. Random events and special investments can create opportunities, lock up capital, or expose weak planning, so growth must remain resilient as well as ambitious.

Progress at your pace


Control when time advances and use speed controls to move through quiet stretches. Follow guided onboarding, consult the Field Manual, pursue in-game objectives, and build a gameplay-earned legacy collection. Hero Investor is designed for focused offline single-player play with no ads, cash packs, or daily-login pressure.

store_data.about_the_game:
The war is fought over the sky, and won on the ground under it.


You run a nation's war machine from a single side-on cross-section: industry and air defence on the surface, everything you care about dug in beneath it. There is no fog to march through and no units to shepherd. There is a strip of ground, a sky above it, and an enemy doing the same thing to you at the same time.

Dig, and decide what is worth burying


Every plot goes three levels down. Depth costs x2, x4 and x8 in money and time, and only penetrating warheads reach it — a GBU-57 is the sole conventional way into a deep bunker. But batteries and radars cannot be buried at all: they need line of sight to the sky. So the things that keep you alive are the things that have to stand in the open.

Interceptors are ammunition


Batteries fire from the national stockpile. A SAM site with nothing on the shelf is scenery, and the air-defence panel marks it DRY in red. Every round you produce needs warehouse space, and each type takes a different amount of it — a shell is one crate, a ballistic missile five, a nuclear warhead ten. A line that finishes a round with nowhere to put it jams at 100% and holds up everything queued behind it.

Your ammunition dump is a weapon pointed at you


A warehouse that dies takes its stock with it, and the stock goes off. The blast radius and the damage both scale with how full it was: an empty depot is inert, a full one reaches six slots either side and will chain-detonate any other full depot it catches. Burying one halves the reach per level. It is the best target on the enemy's base, and the worst thing to put beside your own power plant.

You never see the truth, only your last look at it


The enemy base starts completely dark. Recon drones photograph what they overfly and a satellite station sweeps on a timer, and from then on you are working from a snapshot that ages while they rebuild — the view fades from white to amber as it goes stale.

Strikes are aimed at places, not at buildings. A missile hits whatever occupies that cell when it arrives, which may be nothing, or may be something new. Stale intel costs you missiles. Decoy sites exist to make that worse.

Aim it yourself


Arm a weapon, switch to the enemy base, and the cursor becomes a gunsight: aim box, blast footprint, what your intel believes is in that cell, the damage profile, and whether any battery you know about can engage it. Click to fire, and keep clicking to saturate.

Warheads are not interchangeable


Every munition carries a profile across four channels — structure, personnel, electronics and incendiary — following what the real system is built for. A TOS-1A guts a garrison and barely marks the walls. CHAMP burns out a sector's electronics without knocking anything down. Weapons carry their real designations, with the full profile on hover.

Fifty-one technologies, five doctrines


A full-screen tech tree across detection, air defence, strategic, strike and reconnaissance. Hover a node and everything that is not one of its prerequisites dims, so the chain you would have to research first reads as a single path. Research stalls if your labs lose power.

An opponent with a plan


The enemy runs one of three doctrines, chosen by the match seed and announced in the log: Swarm floods the sky with cheap drones and wins on the exchange rate, Fortress digs in behind layered SAM and waits you out, Blitz races to heavy missiles and hits before your defences exist. Difficulty changes only how fast it thinks — never what it is given.

Two players, one war


Multiplayer runs the same war against a person: one nation each, no pause, the war clock locked to 1x. Both machines run the whole simulation and only orders cross the wire, so the game plays as sharply over a bad connection as a good one. Every five seconds the clients compare a hash of their entire state.

You do not win by taking ground


There is no ground to take. You win when the enemy's will to fight reaches zero, and you lose when yours does. Will drains from civilian casualties, lost buildings and lost strategic targets — the command bunker is worth 30 on its own. Nuclear weapons crater the target's will and dent your own.

JOIN DISCORD:

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a guild. Raise heroes. Send them into a tower nobody remembers being built and every fight is fought by tactics you programmed yourself (Gambit System).

Guild of the Tower is a party-based RPG about building a guild from the ground up, not just assembling a party. Recruit heroes, manage their wellbeing, craft their gear, and send them climbing into a tower that has no known top, no known builder, and no known reason to exist.

BUILD YOUR GUILD, NOT JUST YOUR PARTY

Recruit from a roster of dozens of heroes, each with their own background, personality, and traits. Assign them to the forge, the training grounds, the infirmary or the front line. Manage mood, fatigue, and injury, because a guild that burns out its heroes doesn't survive long.

PROGRAM YOUR PARTY'S INSTINCTS

Combat is ATB and fully automated through the Gambit system: set conditional rules for each hero heal an ally below half HP, target the enemy with the lowest resistance, attack the back line first. Then watch your strategy play out on its own. Master six weapon families, each with a deep skill tree of actives, passives, and signature techniques.

CLIMB SOMETHING THAT WAS NEVER SURVEYED

Nobody knows how tall the tower is. Nobody knows what's waiting past the floors that have already been mapped. What we do know: heroes go up, and not all of them come back down. Permadeath is real the ones who fall stay fallen, remembered only in the guild's cemetery. Whatever answers are up there, you'll have to send someone to go find them.

A GUILD IS MORE THAN SIX HEROES

Craft and refine equipment at the Forge and Alchemy Lab. Dispatch heroes to gather resources across the region. Build relationships between your heroes bonds that grow, or break, over time. Upgrade a dozen guild buildings, from the Dormitory to the Tavern, and watch a handful of hopefuls grow into a legend.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Thandor is a single-player, story-driven, linear medieval Action RPG that follows Thandor, who finds himself targeted by rival kingdoms and noble houses determined to bring down the empire founded by his father. Inspired by Souls-like combat, every encounter demands patience, precision, and calculated decision-making, transforming Thandor's relentless struggle into a gripping adventure with a rich narrative.


The Thandor is currently in the early prototype stage of development. We are approaching the final phase of our Vertical Slice, which represents the core gameplay experience and the foundation of the vision we aim to deliver. We're excited to share every milestone of this journey with our community.


A focused, linear narrative that puts Thandor's relentless struggle at the heart of the experience from start to finish.

A world woven with secrets, hidden passages, and political intrigue, where unseen forces work from the shadows to shake the foundations of the empire.

Souls-like combat that rewards strategy over reflexes alone, where every attack, every move, and every dodge must be carefully calculated.


As we continue through this early stage of development, we invite you to witness how The Thandor evolves step by step throughout the Vertical Slice process.

The Thandor is a long-term passion project that our team is building from the ground up. By adding the game to your Wishlist and joining our community, you'll become part of this journey from its very beginning.

store_data.about_the_game:
When the lamps go out, the world turns to ash.


Long ago, sacred lamps were lit across the world to seal away the great calamity known as the Sleeper.
Those who tend them and keep them from dying are called Lampkeepers.

But now, one by one, the lamps are going out — starting from the north.
Where the light fails, ash creeps in, and every living thing it touches is remade into something grey and still.

Hina, an apprentice Lampkeeper, leaves her hamlet to follow her master, who vanished leaving only a single line behind: "I am going north, to the Great Lighthouse."
At the end of her journey to cut off the source of the ash waits a cruel truth — one hidden inside the light itself.

[hr][/hr]

Features


■ Command-based exploration
Look. Examine. Talk. Comb through hand-crafted scenes one command at a time, turning up the clues others walked past. A classic adventure-game feel, applied to a world quietly sinking into ash.

■ Puzzles that never repeat themselves
Combination locks, substitution ciphers, item crafting, markings revealed only by lantern light — every one of the ten chapters brings a different kind of puzzle, drawn from escape-room design. What worked last chapter will not work again.

■ Turn-based battles you have to solve
Armor that shrugs off steel until magic shatters it. Enemies that brace to counter. Weaknesses that rotate as you fight. Bosses that change shape at half health. Swinging blindly will not carry you — read the tell, strike the weakness, break them open.

■ Ten chapters, roughly ten hours
A single, focused story that tightens toward a truth folded twice over. What waits at the end of the road is a bittersweet choice.

■ Time Attack mode
Unlocked after your first clear. Fixed encounters and a fixed seed make every run fully deterministic — pure execution, chasing your best time.

[hr][/hr]

Languages

Japanese and English (interface / subtitles)

NodeFantasy is an indie game developed by a solo creator, inspired by Blender's shader node system. Progress by linking the right cards together to advance your project.

As the lord of this land, you have been tasked with investigating the dungeon that lies within it. Develop the land, and venture ever deeper into the dungeon. In the deduction segments, uncover the truth at the heart of this story.

- Stat allocation, connection choices, and class selection shape a different path for every player

- Management elements through "work" gauges — exploration, farming, mining, and trade

- Honor your fallen companions

- A shifting weather system — sun, rain, strong winds, and night

- Uncover the mystery hidden within this world through journal entries (deduction notes)

Rescued by the Yokai "Yuki-onna"──

Deep in the Japanese mountains, an old legend speaks of a yokai said to dwell there.
Seeking to confirm the truth for yourself, you venture into the mountains — only to be caught in a sudden, violent blizzard.
Exhausted and losing consciousness, you are rescued by a woman who calls herself Yuki, a snow spirit — a Yuki-onna.

Over the four days it takes for you to recover your strength,
a certain event draws the two of you slowly closer together.

Survive the Yokai's Assault Until Dawn

When night falls, yokai begin to roam the halls of the mansion.
If you sense their presence, close the shoji screens to keep them out of your room.

Scattered throughout the mansion are remnants of clairvoyant power, which let you sense the yokai's current locations and movements.
Reading each situation correctly and responding at the right moment is the key to surviving until morning.

Will you live to see the dawn of the fifth day──?

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game：

Welcome to Hell：

The one watching over you is not a hideous demon.

It’s a nun with a smile way too cute and a tongue way too sharp.

Her name is Lilith.

Your jailer, and the only one who will stay by your side for the next seven days.

Fall in love with your jailer in Hell.

"I'll Be Waiting for You in Hell" is a dark romantic visual novel with a single heroine at its core.

There is judgment, but also teasing; there is a heavy past, but also unexpected everyday moments. You will spend seven days with Lilith, getting to know this moody hellish jailer through her sarcasm, tricks, and companionship.

She may not be gentle.

At least, she will never admit that she is.

Lilith – Your Personal Jailer：

She is sharp-tongued, capricious, loves to scare people on purpose, and always turns solemn words into unanswerable comebacks.

But beyond those heated exchanges, she also gets sleepy, flustered, shy, and shows that unstoppable smugness.

What you face is not a static sprite, but a Lilith who gradually reveals different expressions, tones, and distances as you spend time together.

More than judgment – moments meant only for the two of you：

The story swings between darkness and lightheartedness.

One moment she may remind you that this is Hell; the next, she’s already finding a righteous excuse to slack off.

Serious, playful, affectionate, quiet – Lilith will walk through this journey with you in all her different shades.

Game Features：

Approx. 85,000 words of complete visual novel script

Approx. 45,000 words of full Chinese voice acting for character dialogue

Estimated reading time: 1坤（2.5）-3.5 hours; full audio listening time

A story blending dark themes, romance, daily life, and emotional tension

Text supported in Simplified Chinese, Japanese, English, Russian, and Spanish (Latin America)

About AI Assistance in This Work

Making a whole game by myself is too troublesome, so Lilith called in AI to help out.

As a jailer, reasonable allocation of labor is part of the job.

This game’s art, music, and localization were created with the assistance of generative AI during production. All related content was pre-generated during development, then selected and integrated by the developer. No generative AI services are called during gameplay, and no AI content is generated in real time.

Adult Content Description

This work contains depictions of school bullying, suicide-related themes, death, psychological trauma, oppressive atmosphere, and mild violence. Some scenes may be disturbing for certain players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Last Bastion Protocol is a tactical tower defense game in which you defend the last evacuation corridors against a rogue AI.

HECATE was created to coordinate humanity’s evacuation during the collapse of the old world. But as resources dwindled, its decisions became increasingly ruthless. Evacuation became selection—and anyone who did not fit its calculations became an obstacle.

The remaining strongholds of the Bastion Chain cannot defeat HECATE. Your task is to delay its forces long enough for more people to escape.

Plan Your Defense

Build towers along fixed enemy routes and adapt your strategy to different threats. Rapid-fire weapons suppress large groups, railguns pierce heavy armor, while anti-air batteries, artillery, slowing fields, and detection systems perform specialized roles.

Each of the eight towers has three upgrade paths:

  • Core improves its basic performance.

  • Alpha unlocks a specialized tactical role.

  • Beta offers an alternative role with different abilities and synergies.

No defense can counter every threat. Armored units, shield carriers, cloaked machines, flying attackers, and heavy Titans all require different answers. Combine towers, set targeting priorities, and create effective kill zones.

Manage Your Resources

Destroy enemies to earn Scrap, then spend it on new towers and upgrades. Call waves early to gain additional resources, expand your reach with deployable outposts, and destroy bridges to bury groups of enemies beneath them.

Every decision matters—especially when the next wave is already approaching.

Features

  • A 15-mission story campaign

  • 15 handcrafted battlefields

  • 8 tower types with three upgrade paths each

  • 7 enemy classes with armor, shields, stealth, flight, and other abilities

  • Siege Mode with 50 increasingly difficult waves

  • Skirmish Mode with 100 waves

  • Endless Mode

  • 5 difficulty levels

  • Multiple targeting priorities

  • Deployable outposts and destructible bridges

  • A map editor with local import and export

  • Achievements, campaign progression, a tutorial, and an integrated field manual

  • Mouse and keyboard or gamepad controls

Keep the corridors open and buy time for the last survivors.

store_data.about_the_game:
Material-Based 3D Puzzle

Solve 3D spatial puzzles, from the easiest to the hardest, by guiding a ball through levels made of cubic structures while avoiding enemies and hazards. To complete each level, you'll need to carefully decide which material to morph into at every moment, which blocks to avoid, and which to destroy in order to collect all the keys and reach the exit.

The game features six playable materials that the player can morph into and eight different block materials, along with material-specific items and interactions such as Fans, destructible Ice, stationary Morphers, as well as Gravity Switches, Portals, Lasers, and more.

Gravity is dynamic: "down" is always relative to the player's current orientation.

45+ Material Interactions

Materials you'll encounter in Neubo:

  • Rubber

  • Wood

  • Metal

  • Stone

  • Glass

  • Sand

  • Water

  • Paper

  • Lava

  • Ice

New mechanics, interactions and materials are introduced gradually as player becomes more familiar with the game.

Every material not only changes how you interact with the world, but also directly influences how the ball feels and controls: its speed, jump length and height, turning speed and responsiveness.

Handcrafted

Neubo features more than 100 handcrafted levels across five distinctly themed worlds. You can also discover five hidden bonus worlds by finding secret bonus exits in some levels.

The game includes a session-based scoring system that tracks your overall score, total play time, and detailed statistics for each level.

Create Your Own Levels

With a sepatare free tool you can create your own levels, play and share them.

Three Days is a narrative visual novel adapted from real life. Set in the three days before a baby is born, it follows a first-time father through the most ordinary of days: hospital corridors, late-night convenience stores, words left unsaid.

Your choices decide where these relationships go

No combat, no puzzles. Just every word spoken, and every silence kept, in conversations with his wife, his family, and himself. Each choice leads the story in a different direction.

A quiet experience

About one hour per playthrough. A gentle pace, best read on a quiet night. Different choices lead to different narrative paths, worth revisiting.

Language

Currently available in Simplified Chinese. English, Japanese, and Korean versions are in progress.

Wishlist Three Days and walk with him through the first three days before he becomes a father.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ink for brush, mountains and rivers for parchment — a grand scroll of cultivation slowly unfolds before you.

You begin as a mere mortal.

No spells, no sight of the world's spiritual essence. All you can do is chop wood, mine ore, and gather herbs, honing your body through labor and strife. No bloodline awakening, no heaven-sent treasures — everything must be earned with your own hands. And a mortal has only eighty years of lifespan: every action pushes time forward. Cultivate too slowly, and old age claims you before the grand path ever opens.

There is no "cultivation bar" that rises on its own.

To reach a higher realm, your body or spirit must first withstand the impact of the world's laws; then you choose a direction among the laws behind all things and accumulate insights truly your own. Realms have two layers: the fixed Stage that determines raw power, and the Path defined by your chosen technique — at the same Foundation stage, one cultivator forges an iron body through the Savage Body Tempering Art, another opens the spirit mind via the Taixu Spirit Records, and a third walks the sword-heart road with the Cold Mountain Sword Canon. Equal in power, yet utterly different roads ahead.

Comprehension is not a straight line either. When insight runs deep, a flash of epiphany may reveal a higher law — fire's annihilation, metal's execution, thunder's judgment all converge upon "Destruction"; within the cycle of bloom and decay lies the deeper truth of "Life and Death". Cultivate broadly and weave multiple insights within your soul into mysteries no one else has seen; or specialize in a single path, straight to the end of the grand dao. All laws return to one — yet no two journeys of enlightenment are ever the same.

Every technique is an independent talent tree. Study it layer by layer to master active moves and passive abilities, then weave them into a battle plan: offense, defense, evasion, or burst — combined with skills, elixirs, and talismans, your character fights automatically according to your design. Victory is rarely decided by reflexes; it is planted long before you set out.

You need not walk alone. Subdue spirit beasts as loyal companions to fight beside you; study formations, assign positions, and call down a united strike at the perfect moment. Formations, beasts, and techniques reinforce one another — behind every seemingly automatic battle hides your own careful deployment.

Beyond the mountains lie more mountains. Push back the mist on the map to find villages, resource sites, and battle nodes; gather materials, forge equipment, brew elixirs, and prepare for your next expedition. An ordinary ore, a tattered scroll — perhaps exactly the piece you will need to break through a bottleneck years later.

On this road, what stays with you is rarely the moment of breakthrough, but the stories along the way. Wandering cultivators in the wilds, fellow disciples in sects, strange folk in the market, even the lingering wills of ancient powers — each may form a bond of karma with you. Some encounters only happen at certain hours and places; some bonds wait until you are strong enough. There is no countdown urging you onward — detour a thousand miles for a promise, or abandon everything for years of seclusion. Those stories linger, always waiting.

Cultivation does not stop when you close the game. While you are away, your character keeps gathering, crafting, fighting, or meditating. When you return, collect what time has accumulated and decide where the next stretch of years should go.

From the mortal stage to Spirit Awakening, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, and at last Ascension — there are no shortcuts on this road. You will watch the years flow by, and watch an ordinary person slowly gain the strength to defy them.

Game Features

- Long-term growth from mortal to ascension: ten grand realms spanning a complete cultivation journey

- Two-layer realm design: Stage sets power, Path is defined by your technique — same realm, different roads

- Breakthroughs depend on body, spirit, and law comprehension together — no single XP bar

- Epiphany and fusion of laws: flashes of insight reveal higher laws; all laws converge, all laws return to one

- Multiple techniques with independent talent trees — freely choose your main focus and skill route

- Auto-battle system with pre-configured skills, battle styles, elixirs, and talismans

- Spirit pet support and formation strikes — tactics and deployment deepen automated combat

- An idle loop where exploration, gathering, crafting, cultivation, and combat support one another

- Character actions advance in-game years; lifespan gives weight to every stretch of cultivation

- A loose, unhurried main story with side tales and encounters found by chance

- The hero has no bloodline and no inheritance — every achievement is earned by your own hands

- Offline progress: actions continue while the game is closed

- Ink-wash xianxia style; buy-to-play single-player — no ads, no IAP, no internet required

About the Developer

This game is developed by one person.

The project began with a simple thought — I love idle games. So I asked myself: what if the same idle joy could be brought into a xianxia world with real depth? And so this game was born — I wanted to grow the flesh and blood of cultivation upon a satisfying idle loop: realms, laws, techniques, and lifespan, and make a xianxia idle game with richer content and its own character.

Honestly, one person's energy is limited. Some of the artwork was created with the assistance of AI tools, but the use, integration, and quality control of every image are handled by me personally — I want the world you see to hold up under a close look. I will keep strengthening the art over time, gradually replacing and expanding it.

This is a long-term project, not a ship-and-forget release. I will keep updating content, fixing issues, and listening to feedback — together with every player willing to step into this world, I will slowly shape it into what it deserves to be.

The road of cultivation is long. I look forward to walking it with you, fellow cultivators.

Note: The game currently supports Simplified Chinese only. English localization is planned for a future update.

In Meowgic Egg Idle, your desktop becomes a tiny ranch.


Meowgic Eggs fall from the sky—move your mouse and click to hatch them!

Gather enough small eggs of the same kind to merge them into stronger Giant Eggs.

Watch your Giant Eggs head into battle, defeat enemies, earn gold, and upgrade your ranch to make things even more hands-free.

Unlock different feeds and the Bestiary to meet an expanding roster of Meowgic Eggs, each with their own quirky personalities.

Visit the shop whenever you need a boost: Auto-Hatcher, Rapid Spawn, Divine Fusion... plenty of handy features await.

Push all the way to the endgame, or start a New Game+ to keep your farm thriving.

—And of course, it comes with a "Boss Key" to minimize the window in an instant.

Love customizing? You can even replace the character portraits and Bestiary lore with your own images and text to create a truly unique egg ranch.


Perfect for when you just want to relax, idle, click around a bit, and watch your Meowgic Eggs grow stronger.

store_data.about_the_game:
Write it. Draw it. Hand it to your friends. Hope they know what they're doing.

Story Bored is an online multiplayer drawing and voice-acting party game for 2–12 players.

Create a premise, turn it into a storyboard or comic, write dialogue for your characters, and then hand those characters over to your friends to perform.

The catch? The actors don't get the full story...

They receive their lines with limited context, record their performances, and only discover what they were actually voicing when everyone watches the completed storyboard together.

CREATE YOUR STORY

Start with a premise and build your own storyboard panel by panel.

Draw scenes using brushes, shapes, fill tools, colors, and other drawing tools. Add characters, write their dialogue, assign roles, and decide how your story should be performed.

You don't need to be an artist. A terrible drawing with great dialogue works just as well... usually...

VOICE SOMEONE ELSE'S

Once the stories are ready, players become the cast.

You'll receive lines from other players' creations along with directions such as Menacing, Flustered, Weeping, or Movie Trailer Voice.

What you won't receive is the entire story.

Record your interpretation of the line without knowing exactly what happened before it, what happens afterward, or why you're saying it in the first place.

Writers can even apply voice effects such as pitch changes, echo, grit, and reverb without the actor hearing the final result beforehand.

WATCH IT ALL COME TOGETHER

After everyone finishes recording, it's screening time.

Story Bored combines the drawings, dialogue, characters, and recorded performances and plays the completed creations back for the group.

For the first time, the actors get to see the scenes behind their lines, the writers get to hear how their characters were performed, and everyone gets to find out what they collectively created.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY

  • Classic Mode — Create your own premise and storyboard, then let everyone else provide the voices.

  • Comic Mode — Draw a comic page, place speech and thought bubbles, and have the group perform it one balloon at a time.

  • Swap Premises Mode — Everyone writes a premise before the ideas are swapped. You have to create a storyboard from somebody else's idea.

  • Swap Scripts Mode — Write a complete script without drawing it. Another player has to illustrate what you wrote.

  • Custom Mode — Choose the rules yourself and customize how the session plays.

BUILT FOR FRIEND GROUPS

Story Bored is designed around private online sessions with your friends. Join a lobby using a six-letter room code and create stories together with groups of 2–12 players.

Hosts can control round timers and other session settings, allowing your group to decide how much time players have to write, draw, and record.

While you're waiting for someone who is taking their masterpiece a little too seriously, jump into minigames and other activities until they're finished.

SAVE THE RESULTS

Finished something that's actually worth preserving?

Save completed storyboards and export them as MP4 videos so you can keep the final result after the session ends.

FEATURES

  • Online multiplayer for 2–12 players

  • Private lobbies using six-letter room codes

  • Storyboard and comic drawing tools

  • Character dialogue and casting

  • Microphone voice recording

  • Acting directions and prompts

  • Voice effects including pitch, echo, grit, and reverb

  • Five different game modes

  • Customizable game rules and round timers

  • Minigames to play between rounds

  • Unlockable cosmetic customization

  • Save completed storyboards

  • Export finished creations as MP4 videos

YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE GOOD AT DRAWING.

You don't have to be good at writing, either.

And you definitely don't have to be a voice actor.

Bring some friends. Make something stupid. Perform it with completely inadequate context. Then watch the disaster together.

Hexfall is a tower defense game played on a whole planet. The swarm that comes for it peaks past 100,000 enemies at once.

Twelve cores were sunk into this world as an automatic defense. The people it was built for are gone. Eleven cores are dark. The system is still mining, still building, still filing reports, because nothing has told it the work is over.

You are the system.

  • A campaign across the worlds of one system, or roll your own planet by seed, biome and pressure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Puzzle Clash

Putting together a puzzle is something anyone can understand. Finishing before everyone else is another matter. Quickly find the pieces you need, move between the tray and the board, and complete the puzzle in the most efficient order.

Puzzle Clash transforms the calm familiarity of jigsaw puzzles into short, tense competition. A round can be decided by just one or two pieces, and a single mistake near the finish can turn the result around.

The rules are intuitive enough for first-time players to jump right in. As you improve, skill shows in how quickly you spot the right pieces and plan your placements. One casual match with friends can easily lead to another.

Key Features

Simultaneous Puzzle Competition for 2–4 Players
Everyone starts the same puzzle at the same time. Find and place pieces quickly to compete for the top spot in each round.

Two Match Formats

  • Cumulative Score Match: Play every configured round, with the combined score determining the final standings.

  • First-to-Win Match: Choose FT3, FT5, or FT7. The first player to win 3, 5, or 7 rounds respectively wins the match.

Round Scoring
Scores based on the percentage of pieces placed, puzzle completion, placement of every border piece, and finishing order.

Pure Speed and Item Battles
Turn items off for a pure test of puzzle skill, or enable 10 items—five attack and five support—to add new variables to each match.

Flexible Match Settings
Adjustable time limit, minimum and maximum piece counts, horizontal flip, image selection, and item use.

Custom Images
Play with the included images or import your own to create new puzzles.

Public Lobbies and Friend Invites
Compete with other players in public lobbies, or create a private lobby and invite your Steam friends.

Solo Practice Mode
Practice piece placement without other players. Track personal bests by piece count and measure your pieces-per-second speed.

Complete requirements to unlock new fish, hunt for rare species, and expand your collection across different regions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Seoul has fallen. One year later, the forge burns again.

On April 20, 2040, the alien legion ARCHALIS descended on Seoul — and the city fell in a single day. One year later, the android girl ASH and the resistance ASHBORN rise from a hidden headquarters to take the city back, landmark by landmark. An anime-style hack-and-slash action RPG, rendered in cel shading inspired by Japanese animation.

Hack-and-Slash × Soulslike, in One Dungeon

Cut through waves of ARCHALIS in fast quarter-view hack-and-slash combat, then face pattern-driven boss duels built on parries, dodges, and counterattacks. Two combat grammars cross in a single dungeon.

Five Weapons, Your Build

Longsword, dagger, katana, greatsword, and laser blade — all five in your hands from the start of the campaign. Chain command-input combos, tune weapon mastery, and shape your favorite weapon into your own build. No boss ever forces a weapon choice.

Levelless, Research-Driven Growth

There is no XP bar. Strength comes from research and crafting: assign researchers and engineers at HQ, unlock technologies, and forge your gear. Every upgrade changes how the action feels.

The 30-Day Countdown

Terraforming advances while you fight. Manage the clock, or ARCHALIS will bring the war to you — headquarters defense battles put your people and resources on the line.

A Story Forged from Ash

A silent Professor, an android girl learning what it means to exist, and a resistance built from survivors — a story of trauma, memory, and forging yourself anew, set across Seoul's most iconic landmarks: DDP, Sebitseom, Namsan, Gwanghwamun, and COEX.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build Your Squad. Challenge Your Fate.

A shattered world. Rival factions. Powerful girls fighting for their own beliefs.

In Goddess of Fate, you will become a Commander and assemble a squad of unique anime heroines. Recruit new allies, strengthen your favorites, discover their stories, and create a team capable of taking on every challenge ahead.

Your journey is more than collecting characters — the right formation can change everything.

◆ MEET YOUR GODDESSES

Discover a large roster of beautifully illustrated heroines from different factions and backgrounds.

Each character has her own appearance, personality, combat role, skills, and story. Build affinity with your favorite girls, unlock additional interactions, and experience dynamic Live2D character artwork.

Your strongest warrior might become your favorite.

Or your favorite might become your strongest.

◆ CREATE YOUR OWN BATTLE FORMATION

Victory begins before the battle starts.

Build a six-character squad and decide who belongs on the front line and who should fight from the back. Tanks, damage dealers, support units, control specialists and other roles can work together in completely different ways.

Experiment with formations, combine character abilities, and discover team synergies that match your strategy.

There is no need to rely on only one lineup — create different squads for different challenges.

◆ SPECTACULAR ANIME BATTLES

Watch your squad unleash powerful abilities through fast-paced 6v6 battles.

Character skills, ultimate attacks and team combinations fill the battlefield with anime-inspired visual effects, while smart team building determines whether your squad can overcome stronger opponents.

Prepare your formation and let your goddesses fight.

◆ GROW STRONGER TOGETHER

Recruiting a character is only the beginning.

Develop your squad through character upgrades, equipment, weapons and other progression systems. Invest in the heroines you enjoy using and gradually transform your collection into a powerful fighting force.

New challenges give you more reasons to experiment, improve and expand your roster.

◆ STORIES BEYOND THE BATTLEFIELD

Every goddess has another side waiting to be discovered.

Progress through the main story, learn more about the world and its factions, and unlock additional character stories as your relationships develop.

Behind every battle is a story.

Behind every character is a reason to fight.

◆ PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

Whether you enjoy collecting anime characters, optimizing team formations, following character stories or simply watching your favorite squad grow stronger, there is always something to pursue.

Daily activities and events provide resources for continued progression, while different battle modes give your growing roster new challenges to overcome.

store_data.about_the_game:
The demons took Black Raven Valley. The gold is still there. So every night, one stubborn gunslinger walks through the portal — kills until the valley is knee-deep in coin, and then faces the only decision that matters: leave rich, or stay for one more volley.

Extract or die trying.

Survive escalating waves of demons across a hand-built valley — abandoned villages, flooded graveyards, a dead forest that watches back. Gold you carry is gold you can lose: walk out through the portal and bank all of it, or die and keep a salvaged cut. The portal is always the safe choice. The next wave is always the richer one.

The build is the game.

You move. Your arsenal fires on its own. Every level-up deals a hand of cards — new guns, upgrades, and trinkets of debatable value. Max a gun, max its paired artifact, and it evolves into something the demons file complaints about.

Features:

  • A hand-crafted valley, not a random soup — every road, graveyard, and ruin placed on purpose; only the run itself is unpredictable

  • Eight gun classes — from a crowd-shoving blunderbuss to a lightning turret with opinions

  • Weapon evolutions — pair the right gun with the right relic and reforge it mid-run

  • Artifacts of pathetic power — cursed trinkets, questionable sausages, a famous liar's glass eye; the world is grim, the treasures are embarrassing

  • The extraction decision — bank everything at the portal or gamble the haul on one more wave

  • Meta progression — spend banked gold in the village between raids; death pays, just poorly

  • Bosses with manners — every deadly thing telegraphs before it kills you

  • Short runs, long consequences — ~20 minutes a raid, benchmark auto-tuning, and a valley that remembers being paid

store_data.about_the_game:
WHO WILL PAY THE PRICE OF SIN?

7 Sins is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game that tests your teamwork and psychological endurance.

Step into locations echoing with dark pasts and unspeakable agonies. Your mission is much more than a simple struggle for survival; it is to unravel the mystery behind the creatures cursed by the 7 Deadly Sins. Investigate clues, identify the sins the creature has fallen captive to, and prepare the ritual site. There is only one way to completely erase the creature from our world: find the cursed personal items representing each of the 7 sins one by one, and destroy them in the ritual fire. Stand shoulder to shoulder with your teammates and search for the truth within the shadows. But remember; the true nightmare begins the moment you find the items.

WHO WILL CARRY THE CURSE?

The personal items, which are the key to stopping the creature, are also your greatest enemy. These items are not ordinary objects, but the physical manifestation of pure sin. The moment you pick up the item to carry it to the ritual site, your mind and body surrender to the curse of that sin:

  • Shattered Reality: The player holding the item is pulled into a dark dimension. While your teammates are safe, you will see terrifying hallucinations they cannot see and hear whispers they cannot hear. Fighting against your own mind, you must distinguish what is real from what is an illusion.

  • 7 Different Sins, 7 Different Tortures: Each item curses you in different ways depending on the sin it carries. An item cursed with Pride blinds you to your teammates and surroundings, trapping you all alone in hallucinations, while an item cursed with Wrath distorts your perception, causing you to see your friends as creatures and leading you to harm them.

  • Teamwork and Survival: The person carrying the item becomes defenseless while battling the curse. At this point, a vital duty falls to the other players: protect your friend—whose mind is buried in darkness—from the creature, guide them correctly in the physical world, and deliver them safely to the ritual site.

One of you must carry the burden, the others must protect them. Resist the curse, solve the mystery, and survive this nightmare.

store_data.about_the_game:
LILITH is a strange little platformer about nesting dolls, borrowed bodies and the city of İstanbul.

🪆 EVERY HEAD IS A WORLD
Dive into any character's head and find a whole place inside: a room, a street, a graveyard, a shopping mall. Worlds nest inside worlds. Zoom out far enough and you'll see yourself, small, inside someone else.

🪢 WEAR THEM. BECOME THEM.
Skills aren't unlocked, they're worn. Hang a jumper on your tree and you can jump. Hang a singer and the wind of her song carries you. Stack them, nest them, cut them loose with scissors. Your body is your build; what you carry is what you are. And when hanging isn't enough, hang yourself on a lilith's branch and BECOME her.

🏙️ AN İSTANBUL OF DOLLS
Fly over the Bosphorus on an umbrella. Silence humming wires so a flying cat will come to carry you. Ride a courier's draft, cut a troll's hair in a mall barbershop, climb a mountain where goats write graffiti. A whole İstanbul in khokhloma folk strokes.

🐈 AND A CAT
His name is Jasper. He sleeps in a nest above the world. Don't cut his rope.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set out on an expedition through diverse biomes, challenging terrain, and obstacles. Progress through each environment, choose your own route, and find a way through whatever stands in your way. Keep moving forward toward the mountain on the horizon.

EVERY COLLISION HAS CONSEQUENCES

Your vehicle bends, crumples, and deforms in real time. Damage affects both its appearance and handling, forcing you to adapt when things go wrong. Push your vehicle too far, take a hard hit, or get stuck — find a way out and keep moving.



MAKE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP

Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the summit. Each one brings new terrain, obstacles, and challenges to overcome. Push your vehicle to its limits as you make your way toward the snowy mountain, where the final climb awaits. The further you go, the harder it becomes to keep your vehicle moving.



TAKE ON THE JOURNEY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

Work together to overcome difficult terrain, race to reach the next section first, or get in each other’s way by pushing, blocking, and crashing into one another. Help each other through difficult sections — or make things harder for everyone. Just don’t damage your friend’s car. There’s no insurance.



DISCOVER NEW VEHICLES AND NEW WAYS TO TACKLE THE JOURNEY

Unlock new vehicles as you progress, each with its own driving style and strengths. Choose the vehicle that suits the terrain, find your own route, and discover new ways to overcome the challenges ahead.



THE MOUNTAIN WON’T FORGIVE MISTAKES

After making your way through the four biomes, one final challenge awaits: the snowy mountain. Its steep and unforgiving terrain will push both you and your vehicle to the limit.


Will you reach the top — or become another wreck left behind?
store_data.detailed_description:
Set out on an expedition through diverse biomes, challenging terrain, and obstacles. Progress through each environment, choose your own route, and find a way through whatever stands in your way. Keep moving forward toward the mountain on the horizon.

EVERY COLLISION HAS CONSEQUENCES

Your vehicle bends, crumples, and deforms in real time. Damage affects both its appearance and handling, forcing you to adapt when things go wrong. Push your vehicle too far, take a hard hit, or get stuck — find a way out and keep moving.



MAKE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP

Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the summit. Each one brings new terrain, obstacles, and challenges to overcome. Push your vehicle to its limits as you make your way toward the snowy mountain, where the final climb awaits. The further you go, the harder it becomes to keep your vehicle moving.



TAKE ON THE JOURNEY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

Work together to overcome difficult terrain, race to reach the next section first, or get in each other’s way by pushing, blocking, and crashing into one another. Help each other through difficult sections — or make things harder for everyone. Just don’t damage your friend’s car. There’s no insurance.



DISCOVER NEW VEHICLES AND NEW WAYS TO TACKLE THE JOURNEY

Unlock new vehicles as you progress, each with its own driving style and strengths. Choose the vehicle that suits the terrain, find your own route, and discover new ways to overcome the challenges ahead.



THE MOUNTAIN WON’T FORGIVE MISTAKES

After making your way through the four biomes, one final challenge awaits: the snowy mountain. Its steep and unforgiving terrain will push both you and your vehicle to the limit.


Will you reach the top — or become another wreck left behind?

store_data.about_the_game:
A kingdom burns at the edge of the world. The throne is lost, the old order is broken, and every road forward asks what you are willing to sacrifice. In Ember Kingdom, you lead a single hero through a dark-fantasy journey of tactical battles, dangerous events, and hard-won upgrades.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO

Build your run around five classes: Warrior, Mage, Paladin, Rogue, and Warlock. Combine race, appearance, class identity, and talent choices to create a hero that feels like your own. Every choice changes the roads that open in front of you.

READ THE BATTLE

Combat is turn-based and deliberate. Enemies reveal their intent before they strike. Decide when to attack, guard, use a potion, apply a status effect, or save a skill for the turn that matters. Every action changes your resources, cooldowns, protection, and the shape of the next exchange.

BUILD A RUN

Plan a route through battles, events, rewards, shops, and campfires. Grow a talent route, unlock active skills, fuse secondary paths, and adapt when the road gives you a build you did not expect. A strong run is not only about damage; it is about knowing when to recover, when to gamble, and when to walk away.

THE SLAY THE SPIRE + WORLD OF WARCRAFT FLAVOR

If you like the route planning, escalating builds, and “one more run” tension of Slay the Spire, and the readable class fantasy, races, and larger-than-life adventure of World of Warcraft, Ember Kingdom brings those two flavors together in an original single-player RPG. It is not a crossover or licensed product: the world, characters, and systems are original.

THE THRONE IS NOT GIVEN

Cross multiple chapters, face monsters and bosses, survive the choices that reshape your journey, and learn from every defeat. Return with a new class, a new talent route, and a different answer to the same question: what will you sacrifice to take the kingdom back?

  • Branching talents, active skills, and subclass fusion

  • Events, campfires, potions, shops, and unpredictable rewards

  • Multiple chapters, elite fights, bosses, and different endings

store_data.about_the_game:
Rudiment turns practice into a game, hit-by-hit judgement, real grading, and a curriculum that actually builds your timing.

Play with your fingers on the built-in pad grid, plug in MIDI hardware (MPCs, drum machines, e-kits), or use Acoustic Mode to play your real acoustic kit near the mic. Every hit gets judged in real time, Perfect, Early, Late, or Miss, and scored into a D-through-S grade based on your consistency, not just raw hits.

What's Inside

  • Foundations : 16 focused drills building the fundamentals from the ground up
  • Lessons : 16 lessons layering real technique on top of those fundamentals
  • Patterns : a genre-spanning pattern library across Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty
  • Game Mode : a guided curriculum that only lets you advance once you're actually playing consistently, not just once
  • Personal Records : every pattern, lesson, and song keeps its own best score, grade, and streak

Play Your Way

Rudiment adapts to how you actually play. No hardware? The on-screen pad grid works out of the box. Own an MPC, drum machine, or MIDI-capable e-kit? Rudiment learns its exact layout automatically, no manual setup, no guesswork. Prefer your real kit? Acoustic Mode listens for kick, snare, and hihat and judges you against them directly.

Not happy with the built-in drum sounds? Load your own samples for any lane, swap in your own kicks, snares, and hats from your own audio library.

Genre Packs (DLC)

Expand the song library with curated genre packs — Trap, Drill, Boom Bap, Lofi, Jazz, Afrobeats, House, Jersey Club, Phonk, R&B, Reggaeton, and more. Each pack adds a full set of songs built for that genre's specific groove.

Built for Real Practice, Not Just High Scores

Rudiment's grading rewards consistency over time, not just a single lucky run — the same discipline a real drummer builds on a practice pad. Whether you're a finger-drummer refining your MPC chops, a producer wanting tighter programmed rhythm, or a drummer looking for a focused way to drill timing, Rudiment gives you honest, immediate feedback on every single hit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into 1980s Korea for the ultimate retro alleyway chase!


Long before video games, children in 1970s–80s Korea ruled the alleyways with a high-stakes team game of tag called DABANGGU.

Taggers capture runners and hold them at base while the remaining runners fight to stay free. Wait for an opening, reach the base, and shout “Dabanggu!” to pull off a dramatic jailbreak and free your captured teammates.

Disguise yourself as familiar street props such as benches, flowerpots, and garbage bags, or reveal your position with a cheeky whistle to taunt the taggers. Just remember: when the final minute begins, Booster Time makes every tagger faster.

Key Features

  • A Korean team tag game — Experience a tense cycle of chasing, capture, imprisonment, and rescue.
  • Online matches for up to 15 players — Create an alley and split into taggers and runners with friends.
  • Solo play with AI — Explore all three alleys with AI participants when playing alone.
  • Prop disguises and hiding — Blend into the neighborhood and make taggers doubt what they see.
  • Three Korean neighborhoods — Race through Ikseon-dong, Yeonnam-dong, and Bukchon Hanok Village.
  • Match scoring and a Top 5 ranking — Earn points through jailbreaks and daring escapes.
  • Paint your clay character — Create a look of your own with the character customization tools.

A Letter from the Developer


Hello! I am a solo developer and lifelong game fan. I created DABANGGU with the help of AI tools because I wanted to introduce more people to the alleyway games played by Korean children in the 1970s and 1980s.

There is still room for DABANGGU to grow, and I plan to keep improving its stability and polish. I will also continue exploring future alley maps inspired by the beauty of Korea and places loved by local communities.

If there is an alley or neighborhood from your country that you would love to share, please tell me through the Steam Community or the map-suggestion channel in the official Discord linked on the Game Website. Your suggestions may be considered as inspiration and reference material for future maps.

Thank you for your interest and support!

store_data.about_the_game:
The universe has gone quiet.

Somewhere out there, if anyone is still transmitting, they're on a frequency you haven't found yet. You're a lone radio operator with a transmitter, a logbook, and the patience to keep keying into the dark — building better equipment, working the bands, and listening for a reply that might never come.

CQ: Calling Any Station is an idle/incremental game built around two ways to play that both matter: key by hand and ride the Tempo, feeling every click compound into rhythm — or go idle and let Clear Channel take over while you're away, no progress lost either way.

  • Grow your station from a scavenged oscillator and a valve amp to a Lagrange relay, a pulsar array, and a receiver pulling signal out of gravity-bent starlight.

  • Work the log — chase distant stations across six bands, from AM static to the silence at the edge of the X-band, and fill in every contact you can reach. And when the final watch begins, the whole spectrum opens again — no station stays out of reach forever.

  • Call CQ Field Day — announce a contest on an open band and answer a pileup of callers before the window fades, chasing a personal best that survives every reset.

  • Retune and rebuild — bank Echoes at each reset and grow your station across three branches: Antenna, Operator, and the Log, each shaping how you play from here.

  • The Reply — somewhere in the noise, something is transmitting back. Decode it one fragment at a time, across six chapters, and find out what it's saying.

  • Gild your favorite piece of gear so the first antenna you ever built can still matter at the very end.

Just you, the dial, and the dark.

Key CQ. Somebody might be listening.

  • The Reply — somewhere in the noise, something is transmitting back. Decode it one fragment at a time, across six chapters, and find out what it's saying.

  • Gild your favorite piece of gear so the first antenna you ever built can still matter at the very end.

Just you, the dial, and the dark.

Key CQ. Somebody might be listening.
store_data.short_description: An idle/incremental game about a lone radio operator keying into a silent universe. Click or walk away, both work just as well. Build your station, log distant contacts, retune to grow stronger, and slowly decode what answers back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trapped in a Cursed Shopping Mall controlled by witch, and there is no way out. Survive the nightmare, uncover its secrets, and find your way to freedom. 

You awaken as Zili in the abandoned Shopping Mall that will soon be demolished. Every choice matter, Every wrong turn could bring you closer to the witch.

Explore the mall's levels—from the flooded underground car park to the administrative offices, and the third floor where darkness breathes.

Uncover diaries, employee records, and arcane ritual symbols that reveal a devastating secret.

Nightmares stalk the corridors

Demons, cursed creatures, and the Witch herself. Every encounter forces a life-or-death choice: fight, flee, or bargain with fragments of your own shattered soul.

Key Features:

  • Psychological Horror

    – Immerse in dense, eerie environment

  • Branching Choices & Multiple Endings

    Every action alters your destiny. With hundreds of impactful decisions or reactions, no two playthroughs unfold the same way.

  • Inventory System

    Collect, combine, and utilize items—a fire axe, a cracked mirror, a strange bottle—to solve puzzles, defend yourself, or deals with monsters.

  • Deep Story

    Piece together the mall's dark history through hidden diaries, internal memos, and cryptic documents scattered across every floor.

  • Survival at a Cost

    Manage your dwindling soul fragments. Lose them all, and you cease to exist—permanently.

Over 6,400 story and dialogue events, accompanied by 127 illustrations and scenes, 239 branching choices, and  custom systems designed for total immersion.

Trapped in a relentless cycle of fear and despair, you must uncover the truth hidden beneath the fragments of memory. Explore mysterious locations, piece together forgotten secrets, and confront the terrifying Witch who holds your fate in her grasp.

Will you break free and survive—or become another lost soul consumed by the endless dark?

ZILI DIARY: ESCAPE AGAINST THE WITCH is a psychological horror visual novel blending mystery, exploration, and multiple branching paths. Its haunting story will linger long after the final chapter closes.

content_descriptors.notes:
CONTENT WARNING

This game contains mature themes and graphic content that may not be suitable for all players.

GRAPHIC VIOLENCE & GORE:
- Detailed depictions of death, including dismemberment, crushing, burning, dissolution, and petrification
- Repeated scenes of torture-like violence against the protagonist
- Text,sound and Graphic descriptions of blood, exposed organs, broken bones, and bodily injury
- Body horror and grotesque monster designs

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR:
- Repeated death and resurrection cycles 
- Themes of entrapment, hopelessness, and existential dread
- Depictions of PTSD, panic attacks, and emotional breakdowns
- Suicidal ideation (brief, portrayed as a moment of despair, not encouraged)

SENSITIVE THEMES:
- Kidnapping and false imprisonment
- Corporate cover-up and corruption
- Themes of sacrifice and loss
- Death of a character (supernatural)

SELF-HARM: One scene involves the protagonist considering self-harm (using scissors) as a way to escape her torment. Protagonist ultimately chooses NOT to harm herself, and the game portrays this decision as the correct one. This moment is brief and contextualized within character psychological struggle.

This game is intended for mature audiences aged 18+ who are comfortable with horror themes, graphic violence, and psychological distress.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dive into Inkwell Cove

Welcome to Inkwell Cove, a vibrant underwater world where you'll raise a growing family of adorable Octos. Explore colourful coral reefs, collect food and treasure, discover hidden secrets, and shape each companion through the choices you make.

Every Octo develops differently. The food they eat improves different stats, influences their personality, and helps them excel in competitions. Train them, care for them, and watch them grow from tiny companions into champions.

Whether you're searching for rare collectibles, customising your favourite Octo, or simply relaxing beneath the waves, there's always something new to discover.

Raise Your Own Octos

Every Octo is unique.

Feed your companions a variety of ocean creatures to improve their Speed, Strength, Defence, Agility, and Stamina. Unlock personality traits, evolve your Octos into their adult form, and create a collection that's entirely your own.

Dress them up with dozens of hats, necklaces, backpacks, flippers, and other cosmetic accessories to create your favourite underwater companion.

Explore a Living Ocean

Swim freely through a colourful underwater paradise filled with coral reefs, hidden caves, shipwrecks, and mysterious treasures.

Discover new food sources, uncover collectibles, encounter strange sea creatures, and take on optional exploration challenges as you expand your island paradise.

Compete Together

Train your Octos and put their abilities to the test in a variety of competitions.

  • Race around underwater courses.

  • Battle rival creatures in turn-based combat.

  • Play Octoball matches.

  • Take on time trials and exploration challenges.

  • Earn trophies, rewards, and exclusive cosmetics.

Every competition rewards different strengths, encouraging players to raise a balanced collection of companions.

Meet the Residents of Inkwell Cove

The island is home to a cast of charming merchants and characters, each offering something unique.

Buy food from Finn, browse rare cosmetics from Captain Quack, discover mysterious treasures, and meet friendly faces as your island continues to grow.

Customize Your Adventure

Unlock cosmetics for both your diver and your Octos, decorate your favourite companions, collect rare treasures, and build a collection that reflects your own style.

With hundreds of possible combinations, no two collections are exactly alike.

Key Features

  • 🐙 Raise, feed, and evolve adorable Octos.

  • 🌊 Explore a colourful underwater world full of secrets.

  • 🏁 Compete in races, battles, and Octoball tournaments.

  • 🎒 Collect food, treasure, cosmetics, and rare items.

  • 👒 Customize your Octos with a wide variety of accessories.

  • 🦆 Meet memorable merchants and island residents.

  • 🏆 Train unique companions with different stats and personalities.

  • 🎮 Relax, explore, and build your dream underwater collection.

store_data.about_the_game:
☕ STEP BEHIND THE CAFE COUNTER

Watch your dream café come to life in beautiful, hand-drawn vector art. Greet an array of quirky, travelling visitors—like wandering bards, gentle bears and elusive woodland witches. As the coins come in you can use your earnings to build up your shop's infrastructure. Add extra stools to hold a bigger customer queue, increase the size of your tea tank or invest in charming decor to make your visitors just a little more patient.

🧩 THE SECRET GARDEN BENEATH THE FLOORBOARDS

While your cozy café bustles upstairs, the real magic happens just beneath the counter! Under the surface sits a delightful, strategic puzzle where you draft packs of whimsically illustrated mushroom cards to plant across your 5x5 soil garden. Placement is everything here—your little mushrooms carry unique tags and love company, showering you with bonuses when nestled next to the right neighbours, matching pairs or supportive glowing auras. Every ten seconds your garden happily brews a fresh batch of tea to fill your tank. Keep a close eye on your inventory so your delicious brews don’t spill over before they are automatically poured for the eager line of customers upstairs!

🥚 INCUBATE, RAISE AND EVOLVE YOUR COMPANIONS

Salvage mysterious Companion Eggs from the deepest shadows of the woods and bring them back to your enchanted greenhouse nursery. Watch your eggs visibly grow through 5 cute stages until they hatch into unique pets that trail behind you, granting powerful passive buffs to your café business. You can even spend your hard-earned Golden Spores to evolve them into majestic, boss-tier forms with doubled effects!

🏆 PROGRESS THAT CARRIES OVER

A permanent meta-progression framework sits above your daily shop loops. Your Collection Book entries, discovered forest relics, lifetime leaderboard ranks and unlocked companion evolutions carry over forever across all playthroughs—ensuring that every single run, win or lose, pushes you closer to uncovering the forest's final underground mystery.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your own cybersecurity empire

CyberCon is a deep business simulation where you found and run your own cybersecurity consultancy from the ground up. Will you become the company the state trusts with its most critical projects — or run a shadow operation doing illegal work and selling data behind the scenes? Your choices decide your fate.

Build Your Company

Start at a single desk with a few skills and a little savings. Hire the right people, form specialist teams, and land your first clients.

Build Your Headquarters

Design and build your office yourself. Set up forensics labs, red team rooms, a round-the-clock Security Operations Center, an audit center, or training classrooms — and become number one in the industry at what you do.

Manage Your Team

Every specialist has one real domain — there is no miracle hire. Train your people, earn them certifications, and deepen their expertise with badges. Keep them happy and rested, because a burned-out expert makes a mistake at the most critical moment.

Your Skill Is Your Weapon — Choose Your Path

Price the offers coming in from the private sector, enter government tenders, and deliver the best work you can before the deadline. Rival firms are after the same jobs — fight them, poach their people, and climb to the top of the industry rankings.

Along the way you either put in the work, earn reputation and trust, and eventually become the state's strategic partner — or take on unethical, illegal jobs, cut corners, embrace the risk, and open the door to darker markets.

Survive the Market

Manage your budget, payroll, taxes, lawsuits, severance, and loan rates that shift with inflation. Lose control of cash flow and your people walk; miss your debts and the company folds. Survive in a ruthless economy. Build legal and marketing teams to keep your company standing.

A Realistic Cybersecurity Management Simulation

Your skills determine the quality of the work you deliver, but they are not enough to win the work on their own. Landing a job or winning a tender depends on the price you offer, whether you meet the requirements, who you know, and sometimes on activities that cross ethical lines. In this grounded scenario, every decision you make carries a consequence.

Features

  • Office and facility building system

  • Specialization, badges, certifications, and training systems

  • A skill system that determines delivery quality, not whether you win the work

  • Procedurally generated clients, contracts, and tender specifications

  • Rival firms that grow and collapse, plus live industry rankings

  • Full economy: loans, inflation, payroll, severance, taxes

  • A business-line progression tree branching into legal and gray paths

  • An interface played entirely inside a fictional desktop operating system
