store_data.about_the_game:
Falling Was Only The Beginning.

In the aftermath of a desperate escape—jumping into burning waters—Ilia Movahed plunges deep into a towering, unforgiving vertical abyss. The only way forward is up, toward a summit that seems almost impossible to reach.

This is not a casual walk to the top. Every jump matters, every vault carries weight, and every slip risks total ruin.

Fluid Parkour, Brutal Consequences

Master responsive, skill-based parkour mechanics where timing, angle, and momentum dictate survival.

  • Precision Movement: Execute clean ledge vaults, wall climbs across diverse surfaces, drop-catches, and high-velocity jumps.

  • No Checkpoints: Every inch of progress is earned. A missed ledge or miscalculated landing will send you falling down—costing seconds, minutes, or hours of progress.

  • Master the Route: Learn the geometry of the climb, adapt to difficult wall positions, and find momentum through seamless parkour chains.

  • A Pure Test of Skill: No safety nets, no shortcuts, and no mercy. How high can you climb before your first mistake?

store_data.about_the_game:
Star Corsairs

Star Corsairs is a single-player 2D space RPG where every captain chooses their own path.

Build your fortune through a living economy, battle pirates and other dangerous enemies, explore mysterious wormhole anomalies, and uncover rare technology. Become a trader, bounty hunter, pirate, or smuggler—how you survive is entirely up to you.

LIVING ECONOMY

The galaxy runs on supply and demand. Trade over 100 different commodities between stations, complete lucrative contracts, or risk everything by smuggling illegal cargo.

Markets react to your actions. Flood the market with the same goods, and prices will crash before your eyes.

ACTICAL SPACE COMBAT

Your enemies don't just fly straight at you. They keep their distance, maneuver for better firing angles, attack in groups, and exploit your mistakes.

Hire escort wings, manage weapon heat, master your ship's strengths, and board enemy vessels to claim valuable loot.

46 UNIQUE SHIPS

From agile interceptors to massive capital ships, every vessel offers a distinct playstyle.

Heavy warships can absorb tremendous punishment but turn slowly, while fast raiders rely on speed and precision—one mistake can be fatal.

CAPTAIN PROGRESSION

Gain experience, level up, and customize your captain to fit your preferred playstyle.

Unlock active and passive abilities, recruit officers with unique specializations, and overcome stronger opponents through tactical boarding actions.

WORMHOLE ANOMALIES

Venture into mysterious pocket dimensions filled with danger and valuable rewards.

Discover more than 50 unique encounters, including abandoned wrecks to hack, ancient structures, mysterious space creatures, and legendary bosses guarding loot that can't be bought anywhere else.

store_data.about_the_game:
SKYSUNDER is an auto-battler fought on floating isles left over from the cataclysm. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics and unique unit modifiers called imprints, strategize each battle by giving every squadron its orders, then intervene in the course of battle yourself with 11+ spells!

GAMEMODES

  • Ascension mode - a single-player survival. 15 rounds of increasingly difficult randomized enemies before going endless and lasting as long as possible. Post your best high score!

  • FULL-RELEASE Multiplayer mode - face up to 7 friends in a private host multiplayer lobby. Grab your friends and test your skills in the free multiplayer demo.

  • FULL-RELEASE: Skirmish mode - practice for multiplayer by facing 7 opponents in a head-to-head battle! Each opponent has unique strategies and preferences.

  • FULL-RELEASE: Matchmaking - ranked system with a match-finder for battles of 8 players!

FEATURES

  • 64 unique units across 8 races - Human, Goblin, Elf, Troll, Dwarf, Ogre, Mystic, and Animal. These units are further divided into 6 combat classes and 4 tiers of rarity.

  • In-depth combat triangle - strategic ways to counter every playstyle.

  • Unique imprint system - every unit you see in the shop differs from the next with a system that encourages you to hunt for the best possible setup. Settle for CLUMSY units who perform poorly, search for ELITE or HEROIC troops that can single-handedly change the battle, or find the rarest EMPEROR trait that boosts the stats of all units sharing its own race.

  • 11 spells each with 3 tiers of power - change the course of battle by casting real-time spells from a BLACKHOLE that sucks units into the center, a MIRROR IMAGE spell to clone your Burrow and summon even more units, to a PLUNDER that blasts units and grants you gold for every kill you secure with it.

  • Upgrade your units with items and enchantments - each squadron in your army can be gifted up to three powerful upgrades to their equipment and 1 of 5 unique enchantments!

  • Build your town - 10 buildings make up your town, with each offering unique bonuses that shape your strategy. Will you be greedy and hyper-scale your economy, or will you take a careful balanced approach and invest heavily into your army and spells?

  • 60+ relics - relics are obtained every 3rd round, and have game-changing effects to shape your strategy. Combine relics for powerful effects and shoot for the perfect setup!

store_data.about_the_game:
Law Firm Simulator is a serious 3D management simulation about turning a small legal practice into a respected firm.

Design the office. Hire the right people. Take on the right cases. Every decision affects your team, your finances, your clients, and the future of the firm.

Create an office that supports the way you want to work. Paint rooms, place walls and doors, choose finishes, and furnish offices, reception areas, conference rooms, break rooms, storage, and specialist spaces.

Arrange the workplace around your priorities: prestige, comfort, facilities, efficiency, or a balance of all four.

Build your docket carefully and keep every deadline in view. Review incoming opportunities, understand the client behind each brief, assign the right counsel, and decide how much attention each case deserves.

Cases move through a six-stage workflow:

  • Open and investigate

  • Legal analysis

  • Strategy and negotiation

  • Filing and preparation

  • Hearing and execution

  • Client closeout

Balance favorable outcomes against time, workload, staffing capacity, and financial risk. A full docket is only valuable if your firm can deliver.

Recruit across six roles, from legal assistants and paralegals to associates, investigators, and partners. Match skills to assignments, develop specializations, and build teams that can handle increasingly complex work.

Track workload, stress, satisfaction, salaries, productivity, and career development. A successful firm depends on more than individual talent; it depends on putting the right people in the right place at the right time.

Watch cash flow, revenue, expenses, payroll, retainers, and projected runway. Decide when to grow, when to invest, and when to protect the firm from unnecessary risk.

Your reputation opens new opportunities. Unlock practice areas, recruit stronger talent, develop firm-wide initiatives, and choose the operating principles that define your culture.

Your firm is not operating in isolation. Track rival firms, compare market standing, and respond to a legal market shaped by reputation, outcomes, client relationships, and financial performance.

Choose between a full-firm start with an established team or the more demanding path of a solo practitioner. Name your firm and partners, set the pace of the simulation, and decide what kind of practice you want to build.

Core systems include:

  • Design and furnish a complete 3D law office

  • Manage clients, case opportunities, deadlines, and outcomes

  • Progress cases through investigation, analysis, negotiation, preparation, hearing, and closeout

  • Hire, assign, train, and support a multi-role legal team

  • Balance cash flow, payroll, retainers, expenses, and growth

  • Unlock practice areas and firm-wide initiatives

  • Track reputation, experience, market standing, and rivals

  • Choose between Full Firm and Solo Practitioner scenarios

5066560.name: NOW SHOWING: A Cinema Programming Game

store_data.about_the_game:
You decide what plays, and when.

Seven days. Five start times a day. Thirty-five screenings to fill, and never quite the right films to fill them with. Welcome to the chair.

Read the week before you book it

Five audiences come to your house — families, youth, working adults, seniors, cinephiles — and they do not come at the same hours. The film that sells out Saturday at seven plays to an empty room on Tuesday morning. Every cell on the board tells you who is likely to walk in. What you put there is your call.

Sign the new release, or licence the revival

Distributors offer you new films on their terms: a minimum number of runs, sometimes a clause demanding your best slots. Take the deal and you owe them those screenings. Revivals work the other way — you buy a fixed number of runs outright, and every booking spends one. A shelf of old films you own outright is freedom. A tentpole with a prime-time clause is leverage. You will want both, and you will not be able to afford both.

Two kinds of trust, and they pull apart

Standing is what the public thinks of your house. Credit is what distributors think of your word. Standing fills seats; credit decides which films you are offered at all. Serving one usually costs you the other — and some weeks the right move is to pay the penalty, break the contract, and keep the audience.

Spend where it pays

Better seats. Better sound and projection. A concession stand people actually use. Staff who make them come back. Or put the money into advertising this week and see it return by Sunday. The house you end up with is the one you chose to build.

Choose how long you have

Thirty weeks, sixty, or a hundred. The term is the difficulty, and it is also how much of this game you will get to see. Pick it once, at the start. It does not change.

Then find out what the week was worth

Open the doors and watch it run: the house counts up day by day, and the numbers land. At the end of your term, a certificate — Staff to CEO — printed with your cinema's name and the figures that got you there.

What is not in here

It does not run on a clock you cannot see. Nothing grows while you are away, nothing needs checking in on, and there is nothing you can pay to make time pass faster. It does not go on forever either: you set the length before you start, and at the end you are graded on what you did with it. Every film is invented — not one is a real title, and not one is a parody of one. One cinema, in Japan, for exactly as long as you chose.

Villages on Wheels is a strategic horde survival game where you build and expand your moving village while fighting endless waves of monsters.

You don't wait for the monsters to come knocking at your door, instead you drive head-on into the battle!

Gather and Expand

Harvest wood and stone to construct specialized buildings and to grow your village to add even more buildings.

Create Powerful Synergies

store_data.about_the_game:
Play as Hetja, a young traveler raised high above the Suspended Forest. Explore the forests, cliffs, ruins, and lakes of Aezharyth to put an end to the curse cast by Kaethior, the Sorcerer of Broken Winds. Your quest will lead you to the dome, where the final confrontation awaits.

🌳 Explore five unique worlds filled with platforming challenges, puzzles, and traps.

🧩 Collect every portal fragment to unlock the next stage of your adventure.

⚔️ Battle fantastic creatures and overcome countless dangers.

🛡️ Use your shields wisely to survive.

👑 Face Kaethior inside the dome and free the Bird of the Skies.

Progress from platform to platform through a variety of environments. Cross wooden bridges, leap across fleeting clouds, climb suspended logs, and avoid the many traps scattered along your path. Every challenge requires careful observation, precision, and perfect timing.

The world of Aezharyth is inhabited by hostile creatures. Living trees, stone men, ravenous fish, fish-men, and immortal serpents will do everything they can to stop you.

Choose the right moment to fight them... or carefully find another way around.

After crossing the lands of Aezharyth and overcoming every danger, enter the mage's dome. The fate of the kingdom now rests in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
Who's the strongest in history?

Napoleon? Miyamoto Musashi? The First Emperor of Qin? No backstory needed — Napoleon lines up his cannons, Musashi draws his twin blades, and the First Emperor raises the Terracotta Army. The moment you see the name, you know how they fight. Pick one legend, mow down the oncoming hordes, and survive the battlefield! You only move — attacks are automatic. Anyone can be fighting within a minute.

Legends become weapons

Every legend has a signature weapon. Level up, choose upgrades, and raise that weapon until it evolves into a form shaped by its owner's legend. Who you pick changes how you fight; what you pick changes your build — the same legend plays differently every run.

Real history rewrites the battlefield

Battlefields are more than backdrops. At Austerlitz the ice underfoot is slick. At Sekigahara the fog swallows your sight. At Julu, shattered terracotta soldiers rise as enemies. At Thermopylae, cliffs squeeze the horde into a narrow pass. And on a battlefield tied to a legend, you can recruit that legend — every new battlefield is a door to a new hero.

Survive history, four players at a time

Online and local co-op for up to 4 players. Open a room with a passphrase to play with friends anywhere, or share one screen at home. Each player picks a different legend and stands on the same battlefield. On one screen you can drop in mid-run with one button, and keyboard and gamepads mix freely — history doesn't end until the whole party falls.

Even in defeat, you grow

Lose a run, and your gold and achievements remain. Permanent upgrades make every run stronger, and every enemy you defeat is recorded in the bestiary. Keep playing your favorite legend, forge them stronger, and raise your own strongest.

  • Legends of history — playable heroes, each with a signature weapon and their own growth

  • Weapon evolutions shaped by each legend's myth

  • Battlefields with historical gimmicks (ice, fog, terracotta soldiers, narrow passes)

  • Online and local co-op for up to 4 (passphrase rooms online; one screen with drop-in and keyboard + gamepad mix)

  • Hordes that flood the screen — thousands of enemies at once

  • Permanent upgrades and a bestiary — progress persists through defeat

  • Full keyboard / gamepad support with rebindable controls

And all the legends, and all the battlefields, are waiting.

Who's the strongest in history? Settle it on the battlefield.

Streaming and Video Content

You're welcome to stream and make videos of this game.

  • Live streams, recorded videos, clips, and Shorts are all fine to publish.

  • You may monetize your content — ad revenue, channel memberships, Super Chats, tips, and similar features are all allowed.

  • No permission or notice is required, before or after. There are no spoiler restrictions.

  • This applies to individual creators, companies, and talent-agency members alike.

Please don't redistribute or sell the game's assets (images, audio, etc.) on their own, separately from covering the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Darkness has consumed an ancient dungeon, and the only way forward is through it.

Dungeon of Hope is a third-person atmospheric adventure that combines exploration, environmental puzzles, and tense encounters in a world where combat is never the answer. As you descend into forgotten halls and ruined sanctuaries, a mysterious light accompanies your journey, quietly guiding you toward your destination while leaving every discovery in your hands.

The dungeon is far from abandoned. Creatures born from the darkness patrol its corridors, forcing you to stay alert, think quickly, and escape when you're discovered. Every encounter rewards awareness, movement, and timing instead of direct confrontation.

Each handcrafted room presents new challenges, hidden mechanisms, locked passages, and environmental puzzles that gradually reveal the history of a world consumed by shadow. Every step deeper uncovers new mysteries, but few answers come easily.

Accompanied by an evocative soundtrack and a world rich in atmosphere, Dungeon of Hope is a journey about perseverance, curiosity, and finding hope even in the deepest darkness.

Key Features

  • Explore handcrafted dungeons filled with secrets and environmental storytelling.

  • Solve environmental puzzles through observation, movement, and interaction.

  • Escape relentless creatures that stalk the darkness.

  • Follow a mysterious light that guides your journey without revealing the solutions.

  • Experience dynamic music that builds and shifts with the tension around you.

  • Uncover ancient mysteries hidden beneath the ruins.

  • Full controller support.

  • Available in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

The darkness blocks your path. Hope gives you the courage to continue.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore the darkness. Command your allies. Build your legacy.

The war between Chaos and the gods left the world broken.

Kingdoms are collapsing, ancient horrors are awakening, and supernatural forces are spreading across the land. As a warrior marked by tragedy, you must gather allies, uncover forgotten secrets, and build enough power to confront the forces threatening to consume everything.

Dungeon Explorers 2 is a dark fantasy RPG that combines first-person dungeon crawling, tactical battles, party-based combat, faction management, exploration, meaningful choices, and romance in a single evolving adventure.

Enter Deadly First-Person Dungeons

Descend into dangerous labyrinths filled with roaming monsters, hidden passages, deadly traps, powerful enemies, and valuable treasures.

Navigate every corridor carefully, uncover secret rooms, avoid threats you are not prepared to face, or hunt them down for greater rewards.

Every expedition demands preparation, awareness, and courage.

Command Tactical Battles

Lead your warriors across strategic battlefields in turn-based tactical combat.

Position your units, exploit enemy weaknesses, protect vulnerable allies, and use each companion’s abilities to turn impossible battles in your favor.

Your decisions on the battlefield can determine who survives.

Fight Alongside Your Party

Face enemies through a classic front-view battle system built around party composition, equipment, abilities, and teamwork.

Recruit new companions, strengthen your group, unlock new skills, and create a party capable of confronting increasingly dangerous threats.

Build and Manage Your Faction

Your influence extends far beyond the battlefield.

Recruit warriors, guards, gatherers, merchants, and specialists. Send followers on missions, collect resources, protect refugees, respond to emergencies, and decide how your growing faction should operate.

Your companions will offer advice, but every final decision belongs to you.

Make Choices That Matter

Your actions shape your reputation, alliances, relationships, and personal path.

Choose between virtue and ambition. Support rival factions, resolve conflicts, decide who deserves your trust, and face the consequences of every major decision.

Different choices can unlock new opportunities, alter relationships, and change the direction of your journey.

Forge Meaningful Relationships

Meet warriors, merchants, nobles, adventurers, outlaws, and mysterious beings from across the world.

Earn their trust, discover their personal stories, fight beside them, and develop relationships that can grow into lasting romances.

Explore a Dark Fantasy World

Travel through cities, forests, roads, fortresses, refugee settlements, ancient ruins, and forgotten places shaped by war and supernatural forces.

Accept quests, discover hidden events, visit specialized shops, train new abilities, acquire powerful equipment, and encounter characters with their own goals, loyalties, and secrets.

Create the Warrior You Want to Become

Your choices define your journey.

Develop your abilities, customize your equipment, recruit the companions you trust, and decide what kind of leader you will become.

Will you protect those who cannot defend themselves, pursue power at any cost, or carve out a path between both extremes?

Challenge Chaos Itself

Ancient churches, ambitious nobles, legendary warriors, forgotten gods, and servants of Chaos are all fighting for control of a wounded world.

Build your faction.

Strengthen your allies.

Uncover the truth.

And prepare to challenge forces far greater than yourself.

Early Access

Dungeon Explorers 2 is currently in Early Access and already includes its core dungeon exploration, tactical combat, party battles, faction management, relationship, progression, and choice-driven systems.

Future updates will continue expanding the world with new dungeons, quests, characters, enemies, events, locations, relationships, and story content.

The world is falling into darkness.

Your journey begins now.

store_data.about_the_game:
A 1–6 player co-op sub adventure into the depths of leviathan infested waters. Leave your sub to swim, scavenge and carry physics salvage back to survive the journey. Watch out for feral creatures and deadly hazards as you venture into the unexplored deep. Will you discover what lies at the bottom?

HOME SWEET SUB

Your trusty sub will keep you and your friends safe! Pilot it through the depths as a mobile home to return to, just make sure you keep it stocked with oxygen, battery and revive fish. Take care of it and it'll take care of you. 

SCAVENGE THE ENVIRONMENT

Can't stay in the sub forever! Swim and search for resources, upgrades and items. Smaller items can be used in your hands or carried back to the sub, but larger items need you to work together and use the sub's dredge hook to reel them in. 

WORK TOGETHER TO SURVIVE

No diver should go it alone! You'll need to rely on your friends to collect items, solve challenges, for oxygen and ultimately to survive the depths. In the likely event of death, bring your friends' bodies back to the sub to revive them and keep diving. 

EXPLORE THE DEPTHS

The surface is only the beginning! The deeper you go, the more hostile the environment. Creatures, hazards and oxygen will challenge your dive. Uncover the mysteries and use what you discover along the way.

BRING YOUR CREW

This is you and your friends journey! Deep Trouble is for friend groups - make it yours by customizing your character and sub. Prove and show off your skills with tons of achievements to unlock and cosmetics to earn. Dives are made for groups, but going solo is possible and is the ultimate challenge!

Features

  • Play with up to 6 friends

store_data.detailed_description:
A 1–6 player co-op sub adventure into the depths of leviathan infested waters. Leave your sub to swim, scavenge and carry physics salvage back to survive the journey. Watch out for feral creatures and deadly hazards as you venture into the unexplored deep. Will you discover what lies at the bottom?

HOME SWEET SUB

Your trusty sub will keep you and your friends safe! Pilot it through the depths as a mobile home to return to, just make sure you keep it stocked with oxygen, battery and revive fish. Take care of it and it'll take care of you. 

SCAVENGE THE ENVIRONMENT

Can't stay in the sub forever! Swim and search for resources, upgrades and items. Smaller items can be used in your hands or carried back to the sub, but larger items need you to work together and use the sub's dredge hook to reel them in. 

WORK TOGETHER TO SURVIVE

No diver should go it alone! You'll need to rely on your friends to collect items, solve challenges, for oxygen and ultimately to survive the depths. In the likely event of death, bring your friends' bodies back to the sub to revive them and keep diving. 

EXPLORE THE DEPTHS

The surface is only the beginning! The deeper you go, the more hostile the environment. Creatures, hazards and oxygen will challenge your dive. Uncover the mysteries and use what you discover along the way.

BRING YOUR CREW

This is you and your friends journey! Deep Trouble is for friend groups - make it yours by customizing your character and sub. Prove and show off your skills with tons of achievements to unlock and cosmetics to earn. Dives are made for groups, but going solo is possible and is the ultimate challenge!

store_data.about_the_game:
REALM RUNNERS IS A SINGLE-PLAYER ACTION RPG ROGUELITE WHERE BECOMING POWERFUL IS ONLY HALF THE PROBLEM — YOU STILL HAVE TO GET OUT ALIVE.

Enter a brutal tournament built by The Architect, an ancient AI promising one wish to the winner. Survive escalating enemy pressure, hunt valuable gear, shape a deadly build, and face bosses and Rival Runners fighting for the same prize.

Then make the choice at the heart of every run: extract with what you've earned, or push deeper for greater rewards and risk losing the gear that you worked hard for.

BUILD SOMETHING WORTH LOSING

Every item can change the direction of your run. Combine stats, randomized enchantments, and build-defining Aspects to turn your Runner into something more.

Aspects are powers bound to gear that grow stronger as you build around them and can evolve into more powerful forms. Chase better rolls, discover powerful synergies, and decide when your build is valuable enough to secure — or powerful enough to risk it.

THE WAVES TEST YOUR ENDURANCE. BOSSES TEST YOUR SKILL.

Fight through mounting enemy pressure with weighty combat built around movement, timing, positioning, and impact. A strong build can turn a swarm into dust instantly, but raw power won't carry you through everything.

Bosses and Rival Runners demand execution. Rival Runners aren't just another monster in the crowd, they are competitors with player-like movement and abilities, chasing the same prize you are.

EXTRACT OR GET GREEDY

The longer you stay, the more valuable your run can become and the more it hurts to die.

Take the route out and secure your loot. Or keep pushing into deadlier encounters, optional high-risk challenges, and greater rewards.

In Realm Runners, greed isn't just a feeling. It's a gameplay decision.

RETURN. REBUILD. GO AGAIN.

Back at the Hub, buy and sell gear, gamble for new items, reroll Attributes and Aspects, recover and replace some of what you've lost, and prepare for stronger attempt.

Every successful extraction gives you more ways to shape your Runner and more worth risking when you step back into the tournament.

ONE WISH. WHAT COULD GO WRONG?

The Architect claims the tournament was created to help living beings. Win, and you are promised one wish — anything you desire.

Every Runner enters with their own reason to believe that promise and their own story to uncover. But the deeper you push into the tournament, the harder it becomes to believe that The Architect's idea of “help” is one you should trust.

Build your Runner. Risk what you've earned. Know when to leave.

BUILD FAST. GET GOOD. EXTRACT BEFORE GREED GETS YOU KILLED.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE MODEL DOES NOT PRODUCE REASONS.

SECTION 61 DOES.

Adverse Action is a paperwork thriller from QuietMachines (solo developer). A scoring model decides who in the city of Newmark gets credit, housing, insurance, a utility connection. It does not explain itself, but the law says every denial must carry a signed Statement of Reasons, prepared by a person.

That person is you. Desk 9, Reasons Section.

RECONSTRUCT. Each case arrives as continuous-feed printout: the subject's file, the source records, and a stub reading DENIED. No explanation. Cross-reference the sources, work out which fact the model acted on, and cite the exact lines that prove it.

COMPOSE. Select the reason code and attach your evidence. Wrong reasons come back as appeals — and appeals cost you shift time and go on your record.

SIGN, OR REFUSE. If the reason is there, sign it, in your name. If the reason is monstrous, it is still true, signing it is the game. And when there is no reason at all in the file, you can fabricate one that will probably survive appeal, or refuse to sign and eat the time. It costs you either way.

The model gets retrained. Your hard-won heuristics quietly stop working. And the deeper you get, the more the denials start to make a shape the paperwork never names.

  • A bureaucracy game of pure deduction: no combat, no meters, just documents, a clock, and your signature

  • Every case hand-written; a document inspection game where the answers are hidden, not checked

  • Rendered entirely as dot-matrix printout on greenbar paper, a dot matrix game with not one generated pixel

  • 5–6 hours to your first ending; multiple endings; your final performance review is built from how you actually played

  • Entirely hand-made: every word, portrait, and sound in this game was written, drawn, or recorded by a person. No generative AI anywhere in the pipeline.

The Section thanks you for its accuracy.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wash ashore in 1789 with nothing but the clothes on your back and the salt in your lungs. The Pacific stretches out in every direction, a chain of more than thirty islands, each one a gamble between salvation and another slow death.

Forage. Hunt. Scavenge the wrecks. Build a boat from whatever the islands give you. Then watch it fall apart the moment the waves decide they're tired of your company. Every voyage is a risk. Every repair is a race against hunger, weather, and the next hull breach.

Explore caves that haven't seen daylight in decades. Dive for underwater loot. Raid shipwrecks. Trade with the few merchants willing to deal with a half drowned stranger. Fight or flee the tribes who don't want you on their shores. And if you finally reach civilisation, don't expect a free ride home.

FEATURES

  • Single player survival — a solo journey across a hand crafted archipelago of islands, each with its own resources and dangers

  • Boat building and repair - scavenge materials to construct vessels, then keep them seaworthy

  • Deep resource gathering - forage, hunt and dive for loot both above and below the waterline

  • Shipwreck and cave exploration - raid sunken wrecks and delve into caves untouched for decades, hunting for gear and story fragments

  • Dynamic NPC factions - trade with wandering merchants or navigate tense encounters with island tribes, through diplomacy or combat

  • Forgiving survival systems - manage hunger, thirst and health without the fear of permanent death, so every mistake is a lesson, not a wipe

  • A handcrafted world - every island is designed by hand, not generated, so exploration always has intent behind it

Currently In active development, Wishlist to stay tuned in for trailers, demos and eventual release!


Demon's March is an old-school first-person dungeon crawler blobber RPG with tactical round-based party combat, made to be a spiritual successor to classic western CRPGs like Wizardry, Might and Magic, or Bard's Tale.  

Your party awakens, washed upon an unknown shore. Once great heroes, now amnesic and stripped of power. Can you survive the hostile landscape, uncover the mystery of how and why you're here, and stop the looming march of evil? 

Features:

  • Real-time grid-less and map-less exploration

  • Initiative/round-based "give orders and go" tactical party combat with positioning

  • Enemy patrols you can ambush/be ambushed by

  • Attrition mechanics with health, energy, fatigue and limited resting

  • Create up to 3 characters with customizable Attributes, Traits (classless system), appearance, personality and speech pitch

  • Party size of 1-8, with optional ironman/permadeath mode

  • Multiple interconnected overworld maps complete with secrets and dungeons

  • Mystery-style story with many characters to speak to and recruit into your party

  • Dozens of combat abilities, dozens of hand-drawn enemies, 100+ items

  • Old-school dark fantasy presentation with original, hand-crafted soundtrack

store_data.about_the_game:
RUN THE STUDIO. CREATE THE KILLER. MAKE HORROR HISTORY.

Dead Famous is a turn-based horror movie studio management game where every production becomes a story—and every star brings problems of their own.

Build your company from a struggling independent studio into the biggest name in Horrorwood. Commission movies, assemble casts, choose directors and manage the relationships, risks and rivalries unfolding behind the cameras.

MAKE THE MOVIE

Choose the genre, tone, budget, cast, director and locations for each production. Expand your story-card collection and unlock new creative possibilities, then shape films capable of terrifying audiences, impressing critics or becoming infamous disasters.

MANAGE THE STARS

Scout and sign actors with their own ambitions, personalities and hidden strengths. Co-stars can develop electric chemistry, fall in love or refuse to work together. Negotiate contracts, repair feuds and decide who deserves their next career-defining role.

MASTER THE HORROR HANDBOOKS

Every horror genre has its own branching progression tree. Make movies to earn genre points, then decide what your studio learns next—slow-burning fear, brutal violence, twisting mysteries, stronger characters, relentless chases or new backlot locations.

Each lesson expands your creative collection with story cards, castable roles, filmmaking techniques, locations and legendary commissions. The branches you master shape both the movies you can create and the reputation your studio builds.

BUILD YOUR OWN POSTERS

Turn every release into its own piece of artwork. Combine cast portraits, unlocked props, backgrounds, titles, taglines, colours and effects in the Poster Designer. Position elements by hand, refine the composition and create a campaign that improves the film’s marketing.

IMPORT YOUR OWN CAST

Bring your friends, original characters or your own performers into Horrorwood. Import a folder of portraits and Dead Famous turns them into simulated actors with generated personalities, ambitions, screen personas, relationships, drama and evolving careers.

Create a complete custom five-studio draft using only your imported cast, or combine them with the game’s original actors. Imported images remain stored locally on your device.

CREATE HORROR ICONS

Develop memorable killers and unlock new weapons, roles, sets and story possibilities. Each film expands your creative collection, giving future productions more ways to surprise audiences.

SURVIVE HORRORWOOD

Rival studios compete for talent, dominate headlines and produce movies of their own. Careers rise and collapse, scandals leak to the press and yesterday’s unknown actor can become tomorrow’s biggest star.

BUILD YOUR LEGACY

Every month brings new opportunities and consequences. Take calculated risks, nurture franchises, chase awards and turn your studio’s strange history into a horror legacy nobody will forget.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Baaft!

Remember the feeling of opening a cozy board game with friends on a quiet evening?

That was the feeling I wanted to capture.

Baaft is a small multiplayer board game about lost sheep, a drifting raft, and friendly competition. The rules are simple enough to learn in minutes, but every match is filled with clever decisions, unexpected moments, and just enough chaos to keep everyone laughing.

Gather your flock before your opponents do. Chase the enchanted raft as it drifts along the river, play action cards to outsmart each other, and race to reunite your sheep first.

I created Baaft to give people another reason to spend time together. Whether your friends live next door or on the other side of the world, I hope this game gives you an excuse to jump into Discord, laugh together, and enjoy a few cozy matches.

The raft is more than just a game mechanic to me. It represents the journey toward reunion—a reminder that, no matter how far apart we may be, sharing moments with the people we care about is something truly special.

Invite your flock, set sail, and enjoy the journey together.

store_data.about_the_game:
Command a swarm. Devour everything. Come back hungrier.

Swarmvore is an active incremental about a swarm of tiny predators eating its way through living, cellular structures — one bite at a time. Every session runs against a hunger clock: bite, earn biomass, spend it on in-run upgrades, and keep the swarm alive as long as you can.

When the session ends, your biomass becomes permanent Essence. Spend it back at the Nest on a 29-node lab tree across five branches — grow the swarm, stretch the clock, multiply your Essence, unlock active abilities, or armor yourself against specific threats — and dive back in stronger.

Descend a well that fights back. Seventeen kinds of hostile structures wait below, each with a real counter to learn — not just a bigger health bar. Spikes that punish greedy bites. A regenerator that heals if you stop attacking. A hive that builds drones to hunt your swarm one by one. Pylons that shield a core until every one of them falls. A boss every ten levels.

Face the Core of the Well. At the bottom of the well, when your hunger finally runs out, the final boss rises — seven times tougher than anything before it, resistant to being stunned, and armed with everything the well has thrown at you at once. Beat it and watch the well come apart in a single, deliberate explosion.

Then keep going. Once the well is conquered, spend your surplus Essence to open the Abyss — depths below the last one, where every level down doubles the challenge and grants zero extra power. It's a pure difficulty sink: the swarm you already built is the only swarm you get.

  • Command a living swarm through a well that escalates with real, learnable counters — not just numbers.

  • A 29-node lab tree across five branches of permanent progression.

  • Five castable abilities: drill a Vortex, split into a pincer, stun with a Sonic Wave, summon a spectral Tide, or Fracture prey for instant biomass.

  • A real final boss — the Core of the Well — with a full explosive finale.

  • The Abyss: an endless, post-victory difficulty climb that never inflates your power.

  • A Bestiary that documents every threat you've met and exactly how to beat it.

  • 15 milestones tracking your way to Steam achievements.

  • Fully playable in 12 languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
A boy had a strange dream.

Unable to explain his strange dream, a boy draws it and creates a world. You play the drawing.

Dream Draw Dungeons is a top-down action RPG about a boy's dream, rendered in pixel art that stays true to how a child would imagine it. Seven realms, forty-nine dungeons, and a boss at the end of each road.

Seven realms, one dream

Travel from The Forest through The Mire, The Sunscar, The Dead City, The Frostbitten Wastes, The Ashblown Depths and The Blighted Canopy.

Each region brings its own unique environment, wildlife, ruins, and weather. Face wolves and goblins in the woods, explore sand-drowned tombs in the desert, and wander a city of the dead where the streets still hold their dogs and their soldiers.

Forty-nine dungeons, forty-nine guardians

Each region hides seven entrances: a bear cave, an old well, a flooded sluice, a burnt mill, a hornet hive, a grand theater with its stage still standing. One guardian in each holds a part of the gate key. Take all seven and the eastern gate opens onto the region's boss.

Every boss features a unique mechanic

No boss is just a scaled-up enemy with a huge health bar. The Fallen King holds his shield and enrages when it breaks. The Ashen Queen throws her own sword and floods the floor with molten pools. The Frost Golem freezes you on a clock you can only beat by warming yourself at four torches - and he snuffs them out one by one as you do it.

Build a hero

Twenty-one skills across three trees - Warrior, Rogue and Holy. Swing wider, vanish mid-fight, smite what stands in front of you. Ranks let you master what you love, but never everything, so every run feels unique.

Equipment

Discover and use a variety of weapons and armor sets across dedicated gear slots.

Every realm keeps a secret

Hidden within each of the seven realms lies an unmarked quest. Completing one unlocks a one-of-a-kind reward, ensuring no two secrets are ever the same.

New Game+

Finish the dream and begin it again, harder. Quest chains come back, skill mastery unlocks, and enemies and rewards keep scaling with every cycle.

Dual Perspectives

Toggle between pure 2D sprite mode

and an immersive Semi-3D camera at any time

Features

  • 7 Unique Realms and 49 hand-built dungeon interiors

  • 21 skills across three trees, with mastery ranks in New Game+

  • Hand-crafted bosses and mini-bosses, each with its own mechanic

  • Side quests with permanent rewards, replayable across New Game+ cycles

  • Fog-of-war world map that fills in as you explore

  • Full keyboard, mouse and gamepad support

  • Classic offline single-player experience

store_data.about_the_game:
A roguelite space action shooter about piloting a fighter through branching battle routes while escorting a vulnerable convoy. Build your fleet, disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and survive five passages.

Featuring all-original soundtrack by Vincent Iannone, composer for Galaxy Drift.

GENRE: ROGUELITE

Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter about flying into danger so a civilian fleet can reach the other side.

You are the convoy’s fighter escort. Pilot your ship, destroy hostile systems, collect salvage, and keep the Ark and its passengers alive across five dangerous passages.

BUILD YOUR CONVOY

Assemble a fleet around the Pilgrim Ark and at least one passenger vessel. Add support ships with different abilities, risks, payouts, and formation effects. Arrange their order and decide how much protection, speed, and salvage capacity you are willing to sacrifice.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE

Each passage contains branching encounters. Choose between patrol clashes, stations, distress calls, salvage fields, elite fleets, anomalies, and shortcuts. Routes reveal only partial information, so every decision carries a risk.

DESTROY ENEMY CRUISERS SYSTEM BY SYSTEM

Enemy cruisers can lose engines, weapons, shields, reactors, and other systems independently. Disable a cruiser, destroy it, or ignore it and push for the gate. Mines, sentries, gas clouds, solar wind, pirates, mosquitoes, asteroid fields, and moving hazards keep every route dangerous.

MAKE EVERY CONTRACT FEEL DIFFERENT

Eight contracts offer distinct regions, battlefield layouts, encounter behaviors, gate defenses, hazards, and optional bonus objectives. Salvage wreck fields, survive hostile weather, navigate mine corridors, outrun speed-lane ambushes, or break through an armored blockade.

UPGRADE BETWEEN PASSAGES

Visit two very different station owners, purchase multiple upgrades, reroll the shop at an increasing cost, and prepare for the next sector. Improve your weapon, shields, repairs, point-defense, thrusters, dampers, and support systems.

GROW THROUGH BREADTH

Successful runs unlock new fighters, encounters, crew, artifacts, and unusual fleet options. Nine playable fighters offer different speeds, hulls, weapons, and abilities. Unlocks expand your choices instead of simply making every run easier.

PLAY YOUR WAY

  • Campaign mode with branching expeditions and suspend-and-resume saves

  • Survival mode with endless enemy waves and seeded powerups

  • Custom Battle mode for designing your own encounters

  • Test Flight mode for trying unlocked fighters

  • Optional full-run speed timer and detailed pilot records

  • Rebindable keyboard and controller controls

  • Full gamepad menu navigation

  • Color-vision alternatives and high-contrast mode

  • Native fullscreen support

Escort the convoy and make the hard choices. Good luck.

SURVIVE. EVOLVE. BREAK THE CYCLE.

KLAST is a neon-soaked twin-stick shooter combining bullet-hell combat, roguelite progression, and score-driven arcade action.

Pilot an evolving starfighter through overwhelming enemy formations, dangerous arenas, and massive guardians. Chain kills to build your multiplier, rescue stranded survivors, collect upgrades, and develop powerful weapon combinations capable of tearing entire swarms apart.

THREE DISTINCT CAMPAIGNS

  • Vector Campaign — Conquer 12 escalating signals and master every level to earn the coveted Omega rank.

  • Cycle Campaign — Navigate a one-way journey across a changing sector where every victory—and every loss—shapes the run.

  • Asteroid Campaign — Battle across 25 ranked worlds, with a powerful guardian waiting every fifth world.

MASTER THE ARCADE

Take on a large collection of standalone game modes, each built around different rules, hazards, enemies, scoring systems, and abilities. Chase higher scores, perfect your technique, unlock rewards, and experiment with custom difficulty profiles.

FEATURES

  • Fast twin-stick shooting and responsive movement

  • Dense bullet-hell encounters and enormous enemy swarms

  • Three complete campaigns with unique progression systems

  • A wide selection of score-driven arcade modes

  • Ship upgrades, weapons, abilities, paints, and unlockable rewards

  • Procedurally changing arenas and encounters

  • Boss battles and ranked level mastery

  • Keyboard, mouse, and controller support

store_data.about_the_game:
Directional Melee Action RPG

Action RPG with a directional melee combat. No automated fights, no hand holding. Your survival depends entirely on your positioning, directional attacking, and timing. Chose your attacking direction based on your character's movement; parry at the right time or dodgeroll to defend yourself. Kick them to disorient, breaking their defenses or to throw them on spikes for environmental damage. It is all up to you and your skills!

Train Your Mind And Body:

3 Different stats to chose from when leveling up; HP, Breath and Damage. Pick whichever you think is important and make your own builds on different runs!

Chose Your Gear:

4 different types of weapons and 4 different visual styles of those 4 different types; in total 16 weapons, each style also favoring different passive stats.

One handed Sword: Fastest weapon type with decent Reach and decent Parry window. Favors your Breath stat; so you can do more actions!

Sword And Shield: Best Defense with largest Parry window with decent speed and range. Favors your HP stat; so you can endure more!

Greatsword: Best Range and Reach with decent Parry window for more balanced gameplay. Favors your HP and Damage stats!

Dual Swords: Best Offense with better Parry window and wider effective area. Favors your Damage stat; so you can slay more!

Also 6 different armors: Light Armors making Dodging easier; while Heavy Armors providing more defence.

Immersive First Person or Third Person Cameras:

Immersive First Person Camera with full body motions; or more action oriented Third Person Camera. Pick the one you want, anytime you want!

Choose Your Fate:

ARPG Difficulty: Perfect for players who want to master the mechanics at their own pace. Explore, farm, upgrade and conquer without the fear of losing your hard earned golds, materials and levels.

Roguelite Difficulty: Die, adapt and repeat. You keep your unlocked armors and weapons, but dieing strips away your unspent golds, materials and zone progress. Can you defeat the Renegade Lord in a single clean run?

Solo Developer:

This game is being worked on by a Single Developer. Around 90% of the work has been done by the same person.

store_data.about_the_game:
The empire that engineered water

The Khmer built the largest pre-industrial city on earth in a floodplain that was underwater half the year and parched the other half. Angkor is a city builder about that problem, and about what you can raise once you have solved it.

Lay out roads and house plots, watch families move in and grow their homes, and keep the grain, stone, and labor moving. Every building has a walker; every walker needs a route. Get the layout wrong and your masons never reach the temple site.

A campaign in five reigns

  • Angkor Borei - A delta settlement at the mouth of the empire. Learn to work with water as it arrives.

  • Sambor Prei Kuk - Inland, from trade to rice. Dig the canal, fill the baray, and feed the fields from it.

  • Phnom Kulen - A plateau with no floodplain at all, but lots of sandstone.

  • Roluos - A network of reservoirs, gamboge trees, and wild elephants to be tamed.

  • Angkor - The capital. Command the flood, fill the great baray, and raise Angkor Wat from the ground up.

Features

  • Isometric cities in the Khmer architectural tradition

  • Water as a first-class system: canals, barays, reservoirs, monsoon cycles

  • Monument construction in stages, from foundation to blessing

  • Free play on any map - no objectives

  • Map editor: cut the rivers, plant the forest, build the empire you want

What this is, and isn't

Angkor is a small strategy game built by one person, not a genre epic. Five missions, roughly 6 hours, plus free play and the editor. No military, no combat, no diplomacy screens. Three city services and one water system, tuned deep instead of wide - closer to a focused Impressions-era campaign than a modern grand strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Two buttons. A quarter mile. Three-tenths of a second between you and the other car.


Hold the throttle. Watch the tree — three ambers, then green. Leave a hair early and
it is a red light and the run is over. Leave late and you have given away the race
before you have moved a foot.

Then it is just the shifts. Every engine has a band where the next gear starts pulling
harder than the one you are in, and the light on your tacho is pointing at it. Take it
there and the car keeps pulling. Take it early or hold it too long and you pay, every
time, on the clock.

The car is doing something under all that


Grip is not a number that gets added to your speed. The tyres have a real slip curve,
the clutch is a torque capacity that can overwhelm them, and weight moves onto the rear
axle as you pull — which is why a drag car hooks harder the harder it pulls, and why
lighting the tyres off the line costs you the run.

You will feel it before you read about it: too many revs on the line and the car goes
up in smoke, too few and it bogs. Somewhere between is your best sixty-foot, and it is
different for every car you own.

Earn it, spend it, go faster


  • Twenty-three cars across six classes, from a tired hatchback to a nitro rail.
  • Five upgrade slots — engine, forced induction, transmission, tyres, weight — and every rung of every ladder is worth real time on the clock.
  • A tuning bench that matters: launch RPM, tyre pressures, individual gear ratios, final drive.
  • Ten strips, each with its own light — high desert noon, industrial dusk, neon midnight.
  • Paint your car and take it down the strip.

A weekly run, against yourself


A spec car on a spec track, chosen by the week. Your rival is your own best ghost from
that week — the exact run you made, played back beside you. It resets every Monday and
it is generated from the calendar, so there is no server to go dark and nothing to log
in to.

What is not in it


No online. No in-game currency you can buy. No daily login, no season pass, no timers,
nothing that pings you. You buy it, you own it, and it works on a plane.

Built for it


  • Full controller support — the whole game is two buttons and a menu cursor.
  • Keyboard, and every menu reachable without a mouse.
  • Windows, macOS and Linux/SteamOS, one native build each.
  • Deterministic simulation at a fixed 120 Hz, so a run is the same run whatever your frame rate.

store_data.about_the_game:
A critical global energy shipping strait has been blockaded, trapping a lot vessels. The sea is littered with mines, while suicide unmanned boats and drones continuously harass shipping lanes. Supply routes for crude oil, chemical feedstocks and food are hanging in the balance. A full closure of the strait would trigger global energy shortages, supply chain disruptions, and risk social unrest in parts of the world.

As a ship‑borne attack helicopter pilot, you take off from a destroyer deck on high‑risk escort missions. Safeguarding merchant vessels as they escape the blockaded strait means defending the supply lifeline for millions.

Core Gameplay

Pilot an attack helicopter armed primarily with autocannons to eliminate threats across the shipping lane.

Escort formation sizes are variable. You must race back and forth along the lengthy convoy to counter threats coming from ahead, flanks and the rear.

Resupply: Return to your destroyer to refuel, rearm and repair before running out of fuel, exhausting ammunition or sustaining critical airframe damage.

Diverse Environments

Missions take place day or night under varying weather: clear skies, heavy rain, sandstorms and thick fog. Harsh weather reduces your detection range.

Threats You Will Face

  • Sea Mines: Deal catastrophic damage to nearby merchant ships and warships.

  • Suicide Unmanned Boats: Fast surface units ramming the convoy from all directions.

  • Suicide Drones: Low‑flying raiders targeting merchant vessels and destroyers, and also capable of attacking your helicopter directly.

Disclaimer: This is a fictional military simulation game created for entertainment purposes only and does not represent real‑world positions.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR CHICKEN HAS BEEN STOLEN!


It was a peaceful day. You were living happily with your beloved chicken... until a mysterious stranger appeared and kidnapped it!

Now, you must gather your friends, chain yourselves together, and embark on a hilarious yet challenging parkour adventure to bring your feathered companion home.

CHAIN UP AND WORK TOGETHER


You and your teammates are physically connected by a chain. Every jump, climb, and mistake affects the entire team.

Communicate, coordinate your movements, and learn to trust each other—because one careless move could send everyone falling!

CONQUER CHALLENGING PARKOUR


Overcome carefully designed parkour courses packed with:

  • Moving platforms
  • Swinging obstacles
  • Dangerous traps
  • Tricky jumps
  • Unexpected hazards

Each section will put your timing, coordination, and teamwork to the test.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH UP TO 4 PLAYERS


Take on the journey alone or join forces with up to four players in online co-op.

Help your teammates cross dangerous obstacles, pull each other to safety, and try not to drag the entire group into the abyss.

CHAOTIC PHYSICS-BASED FUN


The chain turns every obstacle into an unpredictable physics-based challenge.

Save a falling teammate, swing across massive gaps, or accidentally send the whole group flying. Every attempt creates hilarious failures, surprising recoveries, and unforgettable moments.

RESCUE YOUR CHICKEN


Your mission is simple: reach the mysterious kidnapper, overcome every obstacle standing in your way, and reunite with your beloved chicken.

Will your teamwork be strong enough to save your feathered friend?

FEATURES


  • Physics-based chained movement
  • Solo and online co-op gameplay
  • Support for up to 4 players
  • Challenging parkour courses
  • Moving platforms, traps, and dynamic obstacles
  • Chaotic and hilarious multiplayer moments
  • A heroic mission to rescue your stolen chicken

Chain up, work together, and bring your chicken home!

store_data.about_the_game:
A one-button ricochet score-attack shooter

You don't aim freely. The reticle swings left and right on its own, and only one bolt can be in play. You choose when to fire. Learning to work with that limitation — and turning one shot into a long ricochet — is the heart of the game.

Three rules

  • Left click (or Space) to fire
  • Press again to clear the bolt
  • If a single enemy reaches the line at the bottom, the run is over
That is everything you need to know. The rest you pick up by shooting.

Every shot is a small ricochet puzzle

Your bolt ricochets off the walls and keeps flying until it burns out. Some monsters knock it back as well, so every shot carves a different path through the swarm. Bad angle? Clear it and fire again. You are only ever planning one bolt at a time.

The longer a shot lives, the more it pays

Every monster a single bolt kills feeds a running total that keeps building until that bolt is gone. The second kill pays more than the first, the third more than the second — one well-placed shot can swing an entire run. How you make it bounce is for you to find out.

Two modes, two difficulties

  • Normal — a run takes about five to seven minutes. Survive the swarm, and a boss is waiting at the end.
  • Endless — no finish line. The monsters are the same ones you meet in Normal, but each lap makes them more dangerous. See how far you can push your LEVEL, and pick up again from a level you have already reached.
Difficulty comes in Standard and Nightmare. Nightmare does not bring in new kinds of monsters, but more of them show up, and some of them move far more aggressively. Under a moonlit sky, it asks you to fight through denser waves than Standard, and it unlocks as you progress through Endless.

Compete

  • Online leaderboards — four boards, one for each combination of mode and difficulty
  • 19 achievements

Start with the free demo

The swinging aim is deliberately different from free aiming. Try the free demo to see whether its rhythm clicks with you — the entire Normal mode is included, at exactly the same balance as the full game, with no time limit and as many runs as you like.
  • Demo scores do not carry over to the full game or to the online leaderboards
  • The full game adds: Endless, online leaderboards, 19 achievements, and Nightmare difficulty

What this game is

A game built around short runs you replay to get more out of a single shot. Under one simple set of rules, you keep noticing that the last shot could have gone further — and the way you read the next one changes. A run takes about five to seven minutes, and it ends just early enough to make you want one more.

store_data.about_the_game:
straywild is a free and open-source multiplayer fishing game about catching and collecting fish, upgrading your equipment, and spending time with other players. Host a room, join a public server, or run a dedicated server for your community. Complete daily and lifetime jobs, sell your catches, customize your character, and fish through changing times of day and weather.

The Art Kit lets players paint together directly in the game world. Session artwork is shared with everyone in the room, giving hosts and players a simple way to leave drawings, signs, and other collaborative additions around the map.

The game is currently in Early Access and active development. Expect bugs, unfinished systems, balance changes, limited content, and occasional changes that may break compatibility with older versions. Multiplayer requires everyone to use the same game version. Player feedback and real-world testing will continue to guide development.

Future updates are planned to expand the fish catalog, character clothing, fishing accessories, customization options, activities, multiplayer tools, and the world itself. Existing systems will also continue to receive improvements as development progresses.

straywild is completely free and open source. There are no paid upgrades or required purchases.

store_data.about_the_game:
# Dice Chemist

**About the Game**

Dice Chemist is a roguelike dice-poker game about turning lucky rolls into powerful combos. Roll five dice, hold the ones you want, and chase poker hands — pairs, straights, full houses, five of a kinds — while alchemical catalysts twist the rules in your favor. Build a run over twelve rounds, survive punishing hell difficulties and boss trials, and see how far your combos can carry you into the endless beyond.

**Key Features**

- **Dice Poker at Its Core** — Hold, reroll, and discard your way to the best five-dice hand, from High Card to Five of a Kind.

- **Catalyst Synergies** — Place catalysts in a deliberate order to chain their effects; certain pairs fuse into entirely new catalysts with mechanics neither original had alone.

- **Elemental Alchemy** — Collect Fire, Water, Earth, and Air dice to trigger elemental reactions like Steam, Lava, Mist, and Sandstorm.

- **Special & Cursed Dice** — Gold dice that pay out on every scoring hand, fragile Glass dice with a huge multiplier and a chance to shatter, Obsidian dice that double their value but can never be rerolled, and more.

- **Chemistry Cards** — Permanently upgrade your hand size, reroll count, play count, and more with over 20 one-time alchemy cards.

- **Hell Difficulties** — Take on runs where only even (or odd) numbers count, where one number is sealed away entirely, or where every catalyst falls silent.

- **Boss Trials** — Face a different boss gimmick every round: sealed numbers, inverted scoring, frozen interest, corroding dice, and more.

- **Ascension & Endless Mode** — Push past a standard 12-round clear into escalating ascension tiers, or keep going forever in Endless Mode for a new high score.

- **Puzzle Mode** — Solve hand-crafted dice puzzles with a fixed target score and a limited toolkit.

- **Multiple Profiles & Steam Achievements** — Track your progress across separate save profiles, with 21 Steam achievements to unlock.

**In-Game Languages**

Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese

store_data.about_the_game:
A Living World That Never Stops

Magna Conquest is a fully real-time medieval fantasy grand strategy game where the campaign world and battles unfold simultaneously. Switch seamlessly between ruling your kingdom and commanding battles as both continue to progress in real time. Kingdoms expand, economies grow, diplomacy evolves, and armies clash in one persistent living world. Rule your kingdom, command colossal armies, research new technologies, develop legendary heroes, and reshape the fate of the continent.

Epic Battles with up to 100,000 Units

Command armies of unprecedented scale with battles featuring up to 100,000 units simultaneously. Lead infantry, cavalry, archers, siege engines, legendary heroes, and devastating magic across vast battlefields where positioning, logistics, and tactics determine victory.

Deep Kingdom Management

Develop thriving cities, construct infrastructure, manage resources, strengthen your economy, and expand your realm. Every decision shapes your kingdom's prosperity, military strength, and long-term future.

Complex Diplomacy

Forge alliances, negotiate treaties, manage vassals, influence rival kingdoms, and navigate an ever-changing political landscape. Every nation pursues its own ambitions, creating new opportunities—and new threats—throughout every campaign.

Research and Technology

Advance your civilization through an extensive research tree, unlocking new military doctrines, economic improvements, and strategic capabilities. Adapt your technological progress to support your long-term strategy and your nation's unique path.

Legendary Heroes

Recruit powerful heroes, each with unique traits that shape both your kingdom and your armies.

Develop every hero through dozens of unique skills and exclusive equipment, creating commanders specialized in leadership, warfare, magic, logistics, economy, and many other roles. With flexible progression and distinctive traits, no two heroes need to develop the same way.

Dynamic World Events & Faction Storylines

Every campaign is shaped by major world events that can transform the balance of power. Face continent-wide crises such as Horde Invasions, Necromancer Uprisings, and other world-changing threats that demand new strategies and alliances.

Every faction also follows its own unique storyline, featuring dedicated quests, objectives, and challenges that reveal its history, ambitions, and destiny.

Campaign Multiplayer

Experience the entire grand campaign with multiple players in one persistent real-time world. Every ruler controls an independent kingdom, creating a dynamic landscape of diplomacy, trade, alliances, rivalry, and war where every player's decisions shape the course of history.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bring Reimu to your desktop

Your Reimu is a desktop companion who shares your daily life with Hakurei Reimu from Touhou Project.

Leave Reimu in a corner of your screen while you work. Now and then she'll mutter to herself, greet you when you come back after a while, and tell you something different on special days.

Indifferent and blunt, but she stays by your side in her own way.

Click, lift, and move her around

Click Reimu and she'll react with a line of dialogue. Keep clicking over and over and she might grumble that you're being a pain.

Press and hold to lift Reimu up and move her wherever you like. She sways and tilts as she follows your cursor, then settles naturally wherever you let go.

You can also resize her with the mouse wheel, and her position and size are kept even after you restart the app.

Leave your to-dos with Reimu

Put a simple TODO list on your desktop to jot down what you need to get done.

Add tasks, check off the ones you've finished, or delete the ones you don't need. Reimu reacts each time you knock one out, and when you clear the whole list she'll acknowledge your effort, saying you've earned a little rest today.

“Got one done. Not bad, actually.”

Timers and alarms too

When you need to focus, start a timer right away or enter any duration you like. You can also set an alarm to go off at a specific time.

One minute before the timer ends, Reimu lets you know it's time to wrap up, and when time's up she nudges you herself along with an alert sound.

“I'll watch the clock. You just do your thing.”

The TODO list and alarm widgets can each be opened separately and moved wherever you like.

Never in the way, but always there

Areas without Reimu or a widget stay clickable, so she won't get in the way of other programs. Talk to her only when you feel like it, or open the TODO list and alarm when you need them.

Less of a secretary who does the work for you, more of a housemate who watches from the side and chimes in now and then.

Spend your days with Reimu—blunt, allergic to hassle, and fond of a good donation.

store_data.about_the_game:
A package arrives at your doorstep, you open it, and suddenly, you are lost. Can you ever find your way back home? To do that, you'll have to work, craft, and trade your way through the unknown.

Welcome to The Rift Trader

A narrative-driven crafting and negotiation game where survival and success depend on what you make out of the forgotten and broken. Step into your workshop, salvage the remnants of various realms, and deal with the unique locals who come through your door.

Every choice leaves a mark. Sometimes good, sometimes not.

Scrap, Merge and Build

Collect discarded materials, break down acquired parts or items into their basic components, and use modular crafting mechanics to merge, fix, and forge brand-new tools, weapons, and items. Fulfill custom orders from unique clients by using your crafting skills to find the exact right combinations.

Trust is Earned

Relationships are fragile and deeply transactional. Build trust with the unique characters and locals around you carefully—because once trust is lost, it's not easy to win back. Every deal, fair trade, or cunning trick affects how they treat you, unlocking new opportunities or closing doors forever.

Add The Rift Trader to your wishlist now and begin your journey back home.

store_data.about_the_game:
Otherworldly Business is an action RPG with an anime-styled otherworld setting.

As a career professional living in the real world, with no warning at all, you discover a way into another world inside a computer program. After entering the otherworld, you learn the real reason behind it, along with the mysterious passages formed by countless collapsed and intersecting parallel universes. You will travel between different prime universes to complete contracts, and return to your own real world with the earnings and the loot.


An American Western region

Combat

A soulslike-leaning combat system, but with a lighter overall style. Anime-style animation plus realistic physical feel, the interplay of combo chains, and a spell and weapon switching system will deliver a highly satisfying sense of impact plus the fun of loot hunting!

Classes and Weapons

Four playable classes during the demo: Knight, Warrior, Mage, Archer.

Weapon types include sword and shield, greatsword, axe, hammer, bow, staff and spellbook. Different weapons vary in reach, attack speed and recovery — every class is worth experiencing yourself!

World Travel

You will gradually unlock the ability to travel between otherworlds. Destinations include but are not limited to:

  • An American Western region
  • A post-apocalyptic city overrun by zombies
  • A Japanese-style castle town
  • Elven territory
  • Viking territory
  • A sealed dark castle

Every world has its own enemies, terrain, contracts, unique gear and rare cosmetics!!


A post-apocalyptic city overrun by zombies

Time and Weather System

The game has its own independent time and weather system, which is also a potential trigger condition for certain special events.

Housing System

Players can buy houses in both the real world and the otherworld's prime universe, complete with a full farming system — you can grow crops yourself to make a profit or to craft special items. The housing system also provides gear upgrading and special gear crafting, and gear crafting includes cosmetic crafting! But you need to obtain the recipe beforehand.

Fantasy Towns

The game currently has two settlements designed in the otherworld's prime universe — a village and a town, both full of NPCs and explorable areas — but the demo will only open the frontier village. In the full game to come, villages and towns will hide all kinds of random periodic events, delivering a one-of-a-kind treasure-hunting experience!


A Japanese-style castle town

Character and Appearance

Characters have gender and a face-creation feature, currently supporting only basic adjustments such as skin tone, body type and facial features. Besides the fact that every stat-bearing piece of gear has its own appearance, the game also provides a cosmetics system; cosmetics only provide appearance variation, with no actual stat increases whatsoever. Cosmetics are obtained through purchase and through contract events.

Co-op

Online co-op is supported. Parties are formed by leader invitation — your friend accepts and enters your world directly to explore together, taking on even richer rewards!!

Monetisation

The game itself is completely free. The only paid content is cosmetics and other appearance items; nothing that affects combat power is sold.

All gear is obtained in-game, and can be traded on the in-game exchange and the Steam Community Market.
